tei:div.tei:p: ji ga 4spo/smo nga

rgyud 'bum/ 6) (87)0521 'phags pa lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud chen po/ 3gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 3sngon gyi spyod pa yang dag par bsgrub pa'i gtam gyi tshul 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 21me'i tshig le'ur byas pa'i rnam par phye ba/ 25dbang bskur ba'i rim par phye ba/ 93bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mtha' dang bral ba'i cho ga zhib mo thogs pa med pa/ 96rdo rjes dbang bskur ba'i rim par phye ba/ 245de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon gyi spyod pa'i rgyu mthun pa bstan pa dang cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa'i gnas las phyag rgya rab 'byam ji snyed pa/ 250stang stabs kyi rim par phye ba/ 290de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum rnams kyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i cho ga 3361

rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī lend+ra bo rnyi dang /zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(373) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(463)0522 'phags pa lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs/ 464rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī lend+ra bo snyi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(468) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(468)0523 bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi rgyud ces bya ba/ 469dang po/ zhi ba'i las sgrub pa dang lha'i le'u/ 469gnyis pa/ gtor ma'i le'u/ 473gsum pa/ rnam thos sras kyi le'u/ 475bzhi pa/ bsnun pa'i 'khor lo'i le'u/ 479lnga pa/ bri ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga'i le'u/ 480drug pa/ sbyin sreg gi rim pa'i le'u/ 482bdun pa/ bskrad pa'i 'khor lo'i le'u/ 483brgyad pa/ sngags kyi le'u/ 484dgu pa/ nges pa dang rnam par dag pa'i le'u/ 485bcu pa/ bsrung ba'i le'u/ 486bcu gcig pa/ sngags btu ba'i le'u/ 487bcu gnyis pa/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i le'u/ 4882

bcu gsum pa/ gsang ba gtan la dbab pa'i le'u/ 489kha che'i paṇḍi ta tse lu dang / bod kyi lotstsha ba 'phags pa shes rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(491) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(496)0524 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can rdo rje sa 'og ces bya ba'i rgyud/ go7dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 497gnyis pa/ nor bsgrub pa dang gnod pa bzlog pa'i le'u/ 499gsum pa/ bcos dka' ba'i nad bzlog pa'i le'u/ 500bzhi pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 504lnga pa/ gnod sbyin sgrub pa'i le'u/ 505drug pa/ klu sgrub pa'i le'u/ 507bdun pa/ gtam rgyud kyi le'u/ 509rgya gar gyi mkhan po dri paṃ ka ra dang /sgra bsgyur gyi lotstsha ba dge slong bya'i gdong pa can gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(510) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(513)0525 rdo rje sa gsum du rgyu ba zhes bya ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po/ 514rtog pa dang po/ 514rtog pa gnyis pa/ 516rtog pa gsum pa/ 518rtog pa bzhi pa/ 521rtog pa lnga pa/ 5233

rgya gar gyi mkhan po ku mā ra badzra dang ra byin lotstsha bas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(525) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(529)0526 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can zhes bya ba 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i rgyud/ 530dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 530gnyis pa/ sa 'og 'dul ba'i le'u/ 532gsum pa/ sa bla 'dul ba'i le'u/ 534bzhi pa/ sa steng 'dul ba'i le'u/ 537lnga pa/ yongs su gtad pa'i le'u/ 539rgya gar gyi mkhan po dri paṃ ka ra dang /zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(540) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(542)0527 dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ 543de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i le'u/ 543gsang sngags kyi sgor spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i rig pa mchog gi rgyal po bsdus pa'i le'u rab 'byam/ 565byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yum nam mkha'i spyan zhes bya ba'i rtog pa/ 590thogs pa med pa don yod par grub pa rig pa'i rgyal mo rab 'byam rim par phye ba/ 600gtsug tor rab 'byam gyi rim par phye ba/ 604spyi gtsug rab 'byam gyi rim par phye ba/ 609gzi brjid rab 'byam rim par phye ba/ 610

kun du rab 'byam gyi rim par phye ba/ 611gsang sngags kyi sgor spyod pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa'i rim par phye ba'i rab 'byam/ 612snying po rab 'byam gyi rim par phye ba/ 633pho nya mo rab 'byam gyi rim par phye ba/ 642bka' nyan mo rnams bstan pa/ 648pho nya dang / pho nya mo dang / bka' nyan pho mo'i rim par phye ba'i phyogs gcig bstan pa/ 653rig pa 'dzin pa'i rim par phye ba/ 657drag po'i las/ 668thun mong gi cho ga/ 689rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛ paṇḍi ta dang /lotstsha ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(702) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(742)0528 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 743rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /dā na shī la dang /shi lend+ra bo snyi dang /zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(803) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(813)0529 'phags pa bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla bee ḍūrya'i 'od kyi 5

sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 814rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba brje ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te/skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(837) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(840)0530 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs bskyed pa bai ḍūrya'i 'od ces bya ba'i gzungs/ 841rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /dā na shī la dang /shrī lend+ra bo snyi dang /zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/slad kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po dri paṃ ka ra shri dzñā na dang dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas tho ling gser khang du skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(847) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(849)0531 sman gtong ba'i tshe sman la sngags kyis gdab pa/ 850bsdur mchan/(851) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(851)0532 'phags pa nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa gsang ba dam pa'i gsang ba'i cho ga zhib 6

mo'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 852cho ga dang po/ bskul ba'i le'u/ 852cho ga gnyis pa/ rig sngags rgyas par sgrub pa'i le'u/ 882cho ga gsum pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sgrub pa'i le'u/ 893cho ga bzhi pa/ phyag rgya rgyas pa'i le'u/ 896cho ga lnga pa/ sku gzugs rgyas pa chen po'i le'u/ 897cho ga drug pa/ sbyin sreg grub pa rgyas pa'i le'u/ 901cho ga bdun pa/ gsang ba dam pa'i gsang ba'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po'i le'u/ 9 04rgya gar gyi mkhan po thab ka ra pra bha dang lotstsha ba bande dpal gyi lhun pos bsgyur zhing / slad nas rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba bande dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(907) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(918)
ci ri

bskur ba'i rgyud chen po/(1ste༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ārya badzra pā ṇi a bhi ṣe ka ma hā tant+ral/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud chen po/ bam po dang po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das lha'i tsho rgyal po dbang sgyur rinagyi khang pa chen po rnam par smin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa las rin)mngon par grub pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyod pa'i rgyu mthun 96pa'i 57 rin po che'i rgyal po chen pos shin tu rnam par spras pa'i tshonakhang bzang chen po rin po che'i rgyal po/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i khang pa na / padma'i snying po'i seng ge'i khri chen po/ nor bu chen po dbang gi rgyal pos ngos gnyis rnam par spras pa la bzhugs nas/ lham me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /'di lta ste dper na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni nam thang 9ba'i nam mkha' la lham me 87—3

lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyang padma'i snying po'i seng ge'i khri chen po de la lham me lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen pos kun nas bskor te sems kyi dbang thams cad kyi dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni brnyes/ sku dang gsung dang thugs ni mnyam par byin gyis brlabs/ g.yo ba dang rlom sems thams cad dang ni bral zhing lhun gyis grub par sangs rgyas kyi ①mdzad pa la 'jug cing / 'di lta ste/ lus mnyam pa nyid kyi gnas zhes ②bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs dang / ngag mnyam pa nyid kyi gnas zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs dang / de bzhin du yid mnyam pa nyid kyi gnas zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi chos ston to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas/ lus dang ngag dang yid mnyam pa nyid kyi bkod pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob steme/ ting nge 'dzin de bathob pa dang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad de nyid kyis ⑤byin gyis brlabs kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor nas/ 'di lta ste / lus dang ngag dang yid ⑥mnyam pa nyid kyi gnas bkod pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi chos ston pa dag mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang la la dag /me tog gi gzhi'i snying po'i rgyan bkod pa dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam ⑦du ma nges par ston pa 'di ni(she/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang spyod pa la nan tan byed pa dang / sa bsgrub (7pa dang / byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs 87—4

rgyas pa ①dang / chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po ston pa de thams cad ni bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis ②byin gyis brlabs kyis so/ /mdor na sems can gang la la dag dge ba mngon par 'du bya ba byed pa de dag thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi po 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa dang / snyan par smra ba dang / don spyod pa dang / don mthun pas bsdus pa sha stag ste/ de dag ni rgyu de nyid dang dmigs pa de dag ②nyid kyis dge ba mngon par 'du byed do/ /de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' de dag bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi ye shes chen po shin tu rgyas pa de thams cad mthong zhing 'jug ste/ rnam par blta zhing nye bar sems te/ dge ba ci ④tsam mngon par 'du byed pa yang rgyu de nyid dang dmigs pa de nyid kyis so/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' de dag ngo mtshar rmad ⑤du byung zhing ⑥/ ya mtshan gyis 'dun ⑦pa'i snying du gyur nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo snyam ste cang ⑧mi smra bar gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das nyid la rnam par blta zhing nye bar sems so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ya mtshan gyis ①snying 'dun pa mkhyen nas/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yang dag par bskul ba zhes bya ba'i 'od zer 'khor 'od zer stong phrag du ma ⑩mgur nas phyung ngo / /de byung hunyenas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku thams cad snang bar 0byas te/ nam mkha'i khams rab 'byam dag dang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag dbang dang ldan par gyur 87—5

pa 'khod pa de dag la/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bcom ldan rims ①nad bral ba de/ /dbang sgyur ②rgyal po'i khang pa ni/ /skyon kun rnam par spangs pa na②/ /snying 'thad chen po seng ge'i khri/ /dpag tshad sum brgya yod pa la/ /padma'i ④snying po der ⑤bzhugs nas/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bskor/ /gnas der thub pa chen po yis/ /bkod pa chen por ⑥gang sprul pa/ /de dag gi ni grangs tshad dang / /dbyibs dang kha dog gang yin pa / /de ni bskal pa grangs med du/ /bstan par nus pa ma yin no/ /de ru deng ljoral dpa' bo che/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog /yid gnyis som (denyi spangs pa po6)/ /dogs 7pa gcod pa blta /rtebar gyis/ /zhes bskul to/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bskul nas slar log ste/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi 8mgur du rang gi gnas su bzhugs 13so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 8yang mdzod spu ⑫nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu bkod pa'i mdzod kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad yang dag par bskul ba 'khor 'od zer brgya stong dang ldan pa phyung ste/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la/ 'dren pa bcom ldan tsornam par snang mdzad la/ /blta ba dang ni mchod pa bgyi ba dang / /sems can 1 tshophan par bzhed pas chos brjod phyir/ /khyed cag thams cad ma shol 'dir (3gshegs shig3lta /ces yang dag par ston to/ /de nas 'od zer de dag yang slar log nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 2 )mdzod spu nyid du zhugs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag 'od zer des bskul ma thag tu/ rang rang gi de bzhin 87—6

gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la/bcom ldan 'das dag bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la blta ba dang / phyag bgyi ba'i slad du/ rgyal po dbang sgyur gyi khang pa chen por mchi stin/ rgyal po dbang sgyur gyi khang pa chen po de ni 'jig rten gyi khams gang zhig na mchis/gang du bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams de'i ming ni ci zhes bgyi/ de'i byang chub kyi snying po ni ci 'dra ba zhig lags zhes zhus so/ /de skad ces gsol ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis / rang rang gi byang chub sems dpa' de dag la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud me tog gi gzhi'i snying po'i rgyan bkod pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ②'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam du ma nges par ston pa dag duyod de/ 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam re re nges par ston pa re re la yang /'jig rten gyi khams kyi mtshams sbyor ba nges par ston pa'i bkod pa rab 'byam du ma yod par khong du chud par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu dag de la mtshams sbyor ba bkod pa rnams kyi tshad ni/ gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams (gebye ba phrag brgya dang ri'i rgyal po ri rab ⑤bye ba phrag brgya dang rgya mtsho chen po ⑨bye ba phrag brgya dang / zla ba dang nyi ma bye ba phrag brgya dag gang gi ⑦'ongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa de stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams so/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i du'ajig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya ⑨gang gi khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa de/ me tog gi gzhi'i snying po'i rgyan bkod pa dang 87—7

ldan pa rab 'byam gyi mtshams sbyor ba rnams kyi khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs par ①gcig go/ /me tog gi gzhi'i snying po'i rgyan bkod pa dang ldan pa rab 'byam gyi mtshams sbyor ba bye ba phrag brgya gang gi khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa de/ me tog gi gzhi'i snying po'i rgyan ②bkod pa rab 'byam gyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud gcig go/ /me tog gi gzhi'i snying po'i rgyan bkod pa'i rgyud bye ba phrag brgya rnams gang ③gi khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa debya/me tog gi gzhi'i snying po'i rgyan bkod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud bar ma gcig go/ /'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam ⑤bar ma ⑥bkod pa'i rgyud bye ba phrag brgya gang gi khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa de/ me tog gi gzhi'i snying po'i rgyan bkod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams bkod pa gcig ④ste/ de ni ⑧bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad desakhya/ sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na yongs su sbyongs 0so/ /rigs kyi bu dag 'jig rten gyi khams de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gcig po de nyid/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de nyid yin te/sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis ni yongs su bskor / lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sa las ni shin tu 'das shing nam mkha' nyid byang chub kyi snying por byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams bar ma de na rgyal po dbang sgyur gyi khang pa chen po na bzhugs so/ /rigs kyi bu dag bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de ni de 'dra ste/ de'i yon tan nam/spyod pa'am/ smon lam mamanyunye/ ye shes kyi mtha' ni nged kyis bskal pa grangs med par yang rtogs par mi 8nus so/ /rigs kyi bu dag nged kyang bcom ldan 87—8

dang ske/ nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po la sogs pa ①thams cad kyi mdun du/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po bris nas/ lag na rdo rje dbang chen po bskur bas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po dbang bskur nas de nyid la bstan pa gtad do/ /lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po las/ sngon gyi spyod pa yang dag par bsgrub pa'i gtam gyi tshul 'byung ba ②zhes bya ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// // 'phags pa lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud chen po/(kye bam po gnyis pa / 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i ④dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das grong khyer chen po dpal yon tan gyi ⑤'byung (yeganas na/ shing sā gel sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i ⑧nags tshal stug po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngon gyi spyod pas rnam par rol pa'i rgyu mthun pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i nags tshal chen po mchog na/ dge slong khri nyis (9rwastong lnga brgya'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig tu bzhugs te/ thams cad kyang zag pa zad pa/nyon mongs pa med pa sems kyi dbang thams cad kyi 7dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor dang / tshe dang ldan pa ba lang bdag dang / tshe dang ldan pa dbang chen dang / tshe dang ldan pa nyin gung dang ske/ tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung nyunyachen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal nyurtagyi bu chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo dang / tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' bo dang ske/ tshe dang ldan pa bzang po dang / tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan 'dzin hunyedang /tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa ka pi na kyi chen po dang /87—25

tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong dang / tshe dang ldan pa ga yā cha'od srung dang /tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas 'od srung dang / tshe dang ldan pa tshems chen sridang /tshe dang ldan pa gsus po che dang / tshe dang ldan pa mdzes dga' zhudang / tshe dang ldan pa gyad bu ④nor dang / tshe dang ldan pa seng ldeng nags pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa bsod snyoms len pa ba ra dwa dza ⑤dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung ⑥spyod dbang po'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa nye sbyor dang / tshe dang ldan pa gzhon nu 'od srung (7)dang / tshe dang ldan pa lam phran bstan dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / de dag la sogs pa dge slong khri nyis stong lnga brgya dang thabs cig gol/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po sha stag la (8)'di lta ste/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / dra ba can gyi 'od tshigazhon nur gyur pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' dkon mchog 'byung gnas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' lag na rin po che dang /byang chub sems dpa' lag na phyag rgya rin po che dang / byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu brtson par 7chos la gnas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad kyi tshig rab tu 'byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gdung ba thams cad rab tu zhi ldan dang / byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rab tu brtan hu7pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' lhag pa'i bsam pas phan byed dang / byang chub sems dpa' snying rje can dang / byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras 8gzigs dbang phyug dang / byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen thob dang / byang chub sems dpa' spos kyi glang po che nyi dang / byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod dang / byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po dang / byang chub sems 87—26

dpa' nam mkha'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'brug sgra'i rgyal po dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' sang sang po'i dbyangs dang / byang chub sems dpa' blo gros dri ma med pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa'i 3)blo gros mi zad (0pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa'i blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' bla ma'i blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba (midang / byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed dang / bzang skyong la sogs pa skyes bu dam pa bcu drug dang /thabs cig ste de dag thams cad kyang sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa dang / gzungs dang ske/ stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / 'phags pa'i lam dang /dbang thob pa dang (pe/ sems kyi dbang thams cad kyi dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa(pe / bsam pa ci lta ba bzhin du sems can thams cad tshim par byed pa/sngon gyi smon lam ci lta ba bzhin du (nanges par byung ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa dang rim gro bya ba la mkhas pa/ rtag tu (7rgyun mi 'chad par dam pa'i chos yongs su tshol (85ba la mkhas pa sha stag ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ⑨de lta bu chadag gis yongs su bskor cing (1lhamadun gyis bltas natunye/ bcom ldan 'das padma'i snying po 32seng ge'i khri chen po la bzhugs te/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis mnan genas/ shin tu lham me/ lhan ne/ lhang nge'o/ /gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i bu rnams kyang de nyid du 'dus te 'khod do/ /mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa tshayang tshangs ris kyi 87—27

lha'i bus kun nas bskor cing de nyid du 'dus te 'dug par gyur to/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin yang lha'i bu brgya stong phrag ①du mas yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas te 'khor ②de nyid du 'dus nas 'dug par gyur to/ /lha ma yin gyi dbang po rab sim dang / thags bzangs ①ris dang / zhing mchog dang ske/ ba ṭi byadang / rnga chen dang / dus ⑤kyi 'khor lo can dang / dri ma med pa 6)dang / tog dang / zla gdong dang / rnam par 'joms dang /zab mo dang / stobs can dang / sgra gcan ⑦dang / tog dregs dang /rnam par snang ba dang / lha ma yin gyi dbang po sna tshogs phreng ba can dang /de dag la sogs pa dang / lha ma yin gyi dbang po gzhan stong dang lha ma yin gyi dbang po de dag thams cad rang rang gi gnas nas byung ste/ lha ma yin gyi mthu chen po dang / lha ma yin gyi rdzu 'phrul chen pos me tog dang / spos dang /phreng ba dang / bdug pa dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rgyan dang / sil snyan dang pheg rdob ⑧rnams mngon par sprul nas shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ ci ltar sprul pa'i me tog dang / bdug pa dang /spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rgyan dang / sil snyan dang ske/ pheg rdob 3)rnams bcom ldan 'das ga ⑩la ba der ⑩gtor to/ /gtor nas kyang bcom ldan 8'das la phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /87—28

klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho dang / klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa dang / klu'i rgyal po 'od zer brgya ①pa dang / klu'i rgyal po glog lalce dang / klu'i rgyal po rin po che'i ②cod pan can ④dang / klu'i rgyal po 'jog po dang / klu'i rgyal po sog ma med dang / klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas dang / klu'i rgyal po stobs kyis ⑤rgyu dang / klu'i rgyal po rna rdum dang / klu'i rgyal po padma can dang / klu'i rgyal po dung skyong dang ske/ klu'i rgyal po padma chen po dang / klu'i ⑥rgyal po dus can dang / klu'i rgyal po rigs can dang / klu'i rgyal po mgo gcig pa dang / klu'i rgyal po brdzun po dang / klu'i rgyal po dbang po'i sgra dang / klu'i rgyal po stobs ldan dang ske/ de dag la sogs pa klu'i rgyal po khri rang rang ⑦gi gnas nas byung ste/klu'i mthu chen po dang / klu'i rdzu 'phrul chen pos tsandan (kyegor shi sha'i chu'i sprin mngon par sprul nas/ shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i (9)nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste/ lhags nas ci ltar sprul pa'i spos chu'i sprin rnams kyis shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug por char du ⑩mngon par phab bo/ /phab shinas kyang bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal blunas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rnam 8thos kyi bu dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po 'brog gnas dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yul 'khor srung dang /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po 'phags skyes po dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po mig mi ④bzang dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gang ba 8bzang po dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nor bu ②bzang po dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rmongs byed 'dzin nyunyechu'i dbang po dang / gnod sbyin 87—29

gyi sde dpon chen po lag pa brgya ①pa dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lngas ②rtsen dang / de dag la sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon ①chen po khri ④rang rang gi chaganas nas byung ste(6)/ me tog dang / bdug pa dang ⑦/ spos dang /phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan rnams thogs nas/ shing sā la sna tshogs kyi 984rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste lhags nas/ ci ltar thogs pa'i me tog dang /bdug pa dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang /na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan rnams bcom ldan 'das la gtor to/ /gtor nas kyang bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /mi 'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa 'khor mi'am ci du ma dang ldan pa yang ④mi 'am ci'i me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang /phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa rnam pa mdu ma thogs pa brgya stong du ma rang terang gi gnas nas byung stephorte/ shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song nya3ste phyin nas ci ltar thogs pa'i me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang /tshe phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan dang ske/ pheg rdob (12rnams bcom ldan 'das la gtor to/ /gtor nas kyang ⑩bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te rmo tshophyogs gcig tu 'dug gos/ /nam mkha' 87—30

lding gi dbang po rnam par 'dud byed yo)kyi bu dang / nam mkha' lding gi dbang po 'jigs ②'gro dang / nam mkha' lding gi dbang po 'dab brgya (gedang /nam mkha' lding gi dbang po gtsug phud ④can 'khor nam mkha' lding brgya stong du ma dang ldan pa yang / bcom ldan 'das /merag la ba der song ste lhags nas/bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /srin mo'i 96rabadag po khros bzhin dang / srin mo'i ④bdag po mche ba bzang dang / srin mo'i khubadag po drag po dang / rab tu tshigatum pa tshedang / 'jigs 'jigs lta dang / skrag byed dang / 'jigs byed chen po dang / gdong bcu dang /gshin rje dang / gshin rje'i dril bu dang / rnam par 'jigs 'jigs lta dang ske/ zla ba'i sde 'khor srin po du ma dang ldan pa dag kyang shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba sh-i/der song ste lhags nasanyurte/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 8zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /drang srong chen po me 'khor drang srong du ma dang ldan pa yang shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi 7zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do / /rlung sprin gyi phreng ba can dang / rlung 'jig 91nyebyed dang / rlung 'chags tshabyed dang / rlung kun 7tu 'jog nyunyebyed dang / rlung rnam par 'thor nyurtadang /rlung dus ldan dang / rlung rnam par 'thor tsu )rlung dang / rlung rlung dmar dang /rlung 'jig rten 'dzin dag 2nyekyang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags ༷ rtenas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /87—31

skar ma'i rgyal po zla ba 'khor skar ma brgya stong du ma dang ldan pa yang shing sā la chen po ①sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang /bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin ②nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /nyi ma du'od zer gyi phreng ④ba can dang / tsha bar byed pa dang / skems ⑤byed dang / du ba 'byin dang /rab 'bar dang / nyi ma sred ⑤byed 'khor lha'i bu gzi brjid 'phags ⑦pa brgya stong du ma dang ldan pa dag kyang shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin ⑧nas / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /klu'i rgyal po chu lha 'khor klu'i rgyal po du ma dang ldan pa yang shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug lapo ga la ba dang /bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /khyab 'jug 'khor dang bcas pa yang shing sā la sna tshogs kyi 7rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste tunyephyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /drag po yi dgas 32kyi 'khor dang ldan pa yang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 0phyogs gcig tu 'khod dosko/ /'byung po'i bdag po dbang ldan 'khor 'byung po brgya stong du ma dang ldan pa yang shing sā la sna tshogs kyi 8rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin tsonas/ bcom 87—32

ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te 7phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /gza'i rgyal po chen po smin drug gi bu 'khor gza' ②brgya stong du ma dang ldan pa yang shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /sprin lha'i bu skya bo zhes bya ba dang / sprin lha'i bu glog sa)phreng zhes bya ba dang / sprin lha'i bu sprin gyi ④dra ba stug po 'joms ⑤byed ces bya ba dang / sprin lha'i bu char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'khor lha'i bu brgya stong du ma dang ldan pa dag kyang shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/(be bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ / glog stug byed lnga ces bya ba dang ske/ glog lagazi brjid can zhes bya ba dang / glog lastug 'od ces bya ba dang ske/ glog 'od ces bya ba dang /bo glog /nyamadzes phreng can zhes bya ba 'khor glog tsobargya stong du ma dang ldan pa dag kyang shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags 0tshal stug po ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba skider song ste phyin 8nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang / ri'i rgyal po spos kyi ngad ldang ⑩dang / ri'i rgyal po gangs ri dang / ri'i rgyal po 'bigs byed dang ske/ ri'i rgyal po ma la ya dang / ri'i rgyal po dbang chen dang / ri'i rgyal po mi mjed 0can dang / ri'i rgyal po rtse mo brgya pa dang / ri'i rgyal po sna tshogs brtsegs dang / ri'i rgyal po rig sngags 'chang dang / ri'i rgyal po ⑫87—33

gzhan dag kyang shing sā la sna ①tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste lhags (snyenas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas ③phyogs gcig tu 'khod do6)ske/ /gshin rje dang / mtshan mo nag mo dang / be con nag mo can dang /skyes bu nag po dang / 'chi bdag dang / dpal byin ma sridang / rna nag ma yang shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /dka' 0thub zlog tsom dang / tsa mu ṇa ḍa medang / drag po'i chung ma dang / tshangs pa'i chung ma dang / khyab 'jug gi chung ma 99)dang / gzhon nu'i chung ma dang / lus ngan gyi chung ma dang / phag gi chung ma dang / 'jigs byed chen po'i chung ma yang lngashing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /chu klung chen po gang gā nyadzodang / chu klung chen po si tā (snyedang / chu klung turtechen po dbyangs can dang ske/ chu klung chen po 76bi da masta dang / chu klung chen po zla ba'i cha can dang /chu klung chen po ya mun nyanyan dang / chu klung chen po kun gyi bshes gnyen dang /chu klung chen po mgyogs ldan dang / chu klung chen po mtsho sten dang / chu klung chen po ba lang nya 7sbyin mchog ldan dang / chu klung chen po brtse 13ba sbyin yang shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang nyam/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs 87—34

la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /dri za'i rgyal po sna tshogs phreng ba can dang / dri za'i rgyal po 'phrog po dang / dri za'i rgyal po shugs chen dang ske/ dri za'i rgyal po rnam par gnon pa dang / dri za'i rgyal po chu skyes dang /dri za'i rgyal po utpa la lta bu'i mig dang / dri za'i rgyal po tsandan brtsegs kyang shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal 3)stug po ga la ba dang /bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po tog (gedang / rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po nye ba'i tog py-i byedang / rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po rab sprigatum (5)dang / rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po bsnyems ldan dang / rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po shugs 'chang dang / rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po sna tshogs sde dang / rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po de dag dang ske/ gzhan yang 'khor rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po brgya stong du ma dang ldan pa dag kyang shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba rinader song ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /srin mo so can zhes bya ba dang / srin mo g.yengs byed ces bya ba dang / srin mo mtshan mo rgyu zhes bya ba dang / srin mo so 'cha' ma mezhes bya ba dang / srin mo rmongs byed ma bzhes bya ba dang / srin mo rgod ri94)ma zhes bya ba dang / srin mo rdo rje lta bu'i lto zhes bya ba dang / srin mo bum lto ma zhes bya ba dang / srin mo zangs 'dab can zhes bya ba dang / srin mo glog 7rtse ma zhes bya ba dang / srin mo pun tsa le zhes bya ba dang / srin mo bong mo zhes bya ba dang / srin mo 'jigs su 87—35

rung ma zhes bya ba dang / srin mo zhib ma ①lta bu'i sen mo can zhes bya ba dang /srin mo chen mo ②de dag dang / gzhan yang lasrin mo 'khor 0du ma dang ldan pa dag kyang shing sā la sna tshogs kyi durgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags yitshal stug po ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /'byung po'i rgyal po mdung can dang / 'byung po'i rgyal po gshol can dang /'byung po'i rgyal po gtun shing can dang / 'byung po'i rgyal po gshol 'dzin dang ske/ 'byung po'i rgyal po 'gugs byed dang / 'byung po'i rgyal po yang dag 'gugs byed dang / 'byung po'i rgyal po gnya' drag 'khor 'byung po brgya stong du ma dang ldan pa yang shing sā la sna tshogs kyi ⑦rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /sha za thams cad dang / mdangs 'phrog ⑧pa thams cad dang / gnon po thams cad dang / grib gnon thams cad dang / yi dgas thams cad dang /bdud thams cad dang / bdud kyi ris kyi lha thams cad dang / stobs po che'i tshogs kyi bdag po dang / de dag thams cad shing sna la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /srin 6)mo bzhi gang yin pa de dag kyang phyogs bzhi nas lhags te gcig tu 'dus nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste lhags nas / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 87—36

'khod do/ /de'i tshe shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po shin tu yangs shing tha ⑨gru che la ka tsa lin di ka ②ltar reg na bde bar gyur cing / sa gzhi rdo rje dang bee ḍūrya ②dang spug gi kha khyer gyis rnam par phye ba/ngos gnyis ku'i ④sgo khang rjodang rta babs dang skar khung gis brgyan 0te mdzes par byas pa steng du rin po che chen po'i dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba bres 4)pa/ mu tig gi do shal mang po dpyangs ⑧pa/ dar gyi lda ldi ⑨mang po bres ⑩pa sil snyan phonyedang pheg rdob pa snyan cing yid du 'ong ba'i sgra 'byin pa/ lha'i me tog utpa la dang ske/ ku mu da tsodang / padma dkar po dang / dri mchog gis yis phyogs de ④bkram par gyur te/ 'di ltar tunyesangs rgyas kyis ⑩byin gyis brlabs dang /sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po thams cad rdo rje chen po'i 'khor 0yug gi ris bskor tsob rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi khyams 7su gyur pa chu zheng dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu pa dus thams cad pa'i me tog gis mmu legs par brgyan pa/ lha'i chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pas phyogs cha yongs su gang ba byang chub sems dpa'i las kyis byung ba ste dper na gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi rgyal po'i gnas dag pa'i 0las kyis zhunyebyung ba lham me 0lhang nge gnas ④pa de bzhin du 3shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po yang / bcom ldan 'das kyi mthus lhan ner rnam par mdzes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa rdo rje'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis mnyam par gzhag ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis legs so zhes 87—37

bya ba'i gsung phyung ste3)/ rdo rje 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i snying po 'di gsungs sol/ / dpa' bo (0chen po legs so legs/ /rdo rje 'byung gnas stobs po che /shākya seng ge skyob pa yi/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 'di la ni/ /rdo rje stobs chen bsrung bar gyis/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥswā hā/ rdo rje 'byung gnas kyi snying po'i mchog 'di gsungs ma thag tu 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad du rdo rje'i 'byung gnas kyi snying po 'o/sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags ④par gyur te/ rdo rje 'byung gnas dpa' bo tsoche/ /sems can kun la phan mdzad pa/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 'di la ni/ /thub pa chen pos byin gyis rlobs/ /rtag tu srog chags thams cad kyang / /snying po 'di ni 'dzin gyur cig /des na ༅'dir ni de dag kun/ /tshul chen dngos grub thob par shog /ces grags (meso/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas 5shethams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor la gzigs nas / kun tu bzang po dang byams pa dang / 'jam dpal la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi (9)sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gang rnam par dag pa'i sgo la 'jug pa'i mdzod kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags la 'jug pa tsogasang sngags kyi sgo /1byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i rjes su 'brang ba byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po'i gnas rdo rje ye shes kyi dbang bskur snying po zhes bya ba'i 1rtagasang ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yang dag par ston pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal po lta bu 'phral du tu 'bras bu mang ba byang chub sems dpa'i gsang chen byang chub sems dpas ⑩legs par 87—38

brjod pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i mig 'phrul byang chub sems dpa'i sgyu mas rnam par rol pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang yongs su mi shes na/ sems can gzhan dag gis shes par hu)'gyur ba lta ci smos te/ gzhan du na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhan gyi dring (༄mi 'jog pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su 'byung ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa dag ni ma gtogs te/ rdo rje chen po'i ye shes dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor lag na rdo rje dbang chen po bskur ba zhes bya ba gsang ba'i mchog yod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la sogs pa dang thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor des mgrin gcig tu tshig smras pa/ bcom ldan tshomi'adi ni dus lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa 'di ni tshod lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das sngon gyi spyod pa yang dag par ston pa ④bsgrub pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas sngon gyi spyod pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo rdo rje chen po'i 'byung gnas gsang sngags kyi rgyal po 'di gsungs so/ /na maḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba thā kho(snye/ gsang sngags kyi rgyal po gsungs ma thag tu de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de ngo mtshar du gyur pa'i snying gis (6)mgrin gcig tu tshig smras pa/ kye ma ye shes skyid pa che/ /bsam gtan bde ba mchog thob pa⑦/ /kun kyang de yi dbang phusne)du byas(9)/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de ngo mtshar rtse gcig tu gyur par mkhyen nas/ dpal be'u las byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bskul ba zhes bya ba'i 'od zer phyung ngo / /de byung bonas byang chub sems dpa'i gnas thams 87—39

cad snang bar byas te/ yang bcom ldan 'das kyi dpal ༅be'u nyid du zhugs so / /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du bzang po zhes bya ba'i ge'ajig rten gyi khams me tog gi gzhi'i ①snying po'i rgyan bkod 0pa 'di thams cad du bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sngon gyi duspyod pa ston par yismon lam btab nas gnod sbyin 'dul ba'i dbang nye bar bzung ste dbus kyi 'dzam bu'i ༅gling mi mjed 'dir lcang lo can du zhu)gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po 'brog gnas kyi gnas na gnas pa de'i la'od zer gyi 0snang ba des snang bar gyur nas7/ mig dang bzhin rgyas par gyur nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod de8/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 8bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid yid la byed cing cang mi skozer bar 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑫de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po 'ong bar 'gyur ba'i brda ⑩mdzad de tshigs su bcad pa yang 'di bla phyogasungs so/ /sems can dag pa zla bzhin tshur gshegs shigatunye /de bzhin gshegs pas byin brlabs ⑩byang chub gzhol/ / bsam yas ris )mnyam nyid legs rtogs khong chud khyod/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas byas gzo tshur shog cig /dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la rtag gnas pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje mchog tshur shog /phyogs bcu dag na sangs rgyas ci snyed cig /sems can don mdzad bubasam yas gzugs mnga' ba/ /de dag ma lus don gyi mdun 'gro khyod/ /gsang ba'i bdag po sems can mchog tshur shog /gsang ba'i dam pa sems can snying po tshur/ /gdul dka' rtag 'dul dbang thob tshur shog cig /brtan 3te byung las skyes pa'o bu/ /dus dang tshod shes tshur shog cig /dam pa thob pa tshur shog cig /dam pa sbyin byed tshur 87—40

shog cig /dpal byed dpal sdud dpal ldan pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gyosras tshur shog /sems can bzang po stobs po che/ /rdo rje lta bur (getshur shog cig /sangs rgyas sras po 'jigs med pa/ /stobs can rnams kyi mchog tshur shog /rtag tu srid pa gsum de ②yi/ /snying dga' byed pa tshur shog cig /yang dag lam ni ston byed pa/ /stobs bcur gnas pa tshur shog cig /sems can dag pa rdzu 'phrul che/ /kun du bzang po tshur shog cig /kun du mdzes pa tshur shog cig /srid gsum dbang phyug tshur shog cig /khyod ni gzugs bzang shin tu brgyan④/ /glang po rna ba khyod tshur shog /sna tshogs gzugs can 'khrul med khyod/ /mthong na dga' ba tshur shog cig /'gro lding ba yi gzugs can tshur / /tshur shog nā ⑤da ku be ra(ye/ /rtag tu sna tshogs gos (7)phreng 'chang / /cod pan mgul pa tshur shog cig /mi 'jigs thob pa tshur shog cig /'jigs pa 'jigs ⑧pa tshur shog cig /sangs rgyas sras po rdzu 'phrul che(9)/ /phyi shol ma byed tshur shog cig⑩ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs nas 'ongs pa /spel 'jigs pa med pa'i sgo'i rig (2sngags kyi rgyal mo tsogasungs pa/ na maḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥmisarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba thā mas bisma tsoye bee ⑩sha ra rya mu 8khe bha ga ba ti badzra a ma li ni mā (16bi lo ba swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mi 'jigs pa'i sgo'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di bka' stsal nas cang mi gsung du )bar bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'dis bskul bas/ byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos gnod sbyin gyi tshogs thams cad la smras pa/ grogs po dag tshur shegasang rte/bcom ldan 'das de la blta ba dang phyag bya ba dang bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir byang 87—41

chub sems dpa' du ma'i tshogs kyis ni bskor/ nyan thos brgya stong du mas ni bskor / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang ske/ nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa bye ba stong phrag 07/du mas 9kyeyongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te shing sā la sna tshogs kyi ②rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang ④/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa bzhugs pa ga la ba (snyeder 'dong 0ngo / /de nas gnod sbyin gyi tshogs de dag dang gnod sbyin gzhon nu rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu tshig smras pa/ sems can chen po bka' stsal pa bzhin du ④bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa de la blta ba dang phyag bgyi ba dang bsnyen bkur bgyi ba dang thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de la yang labalta ba dang phyag bgyi ba dang bsnyen bkur bgyi ba'i slad du/ shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba der bzhud do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po ('o/de'i tshe rgyan sna tshogs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin spyod pa thams cad kyi rgyu mthun pa ston pa la snyoms par zhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos ting nge 'dzin de la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu de nas de'i mod la rnam par snang mdzad kyi rgyan bkod pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams tsam du yangs shing rgya che 57ba nor bu chen po'i ka ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma zug pa/ sgo khang nyunyadang rta babs dang stegs pho)bu du mas brgyan pa 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser las shing sā la gcig nyu pa lta bur byas pas rnam par spras pa mtha' mthar phug ron lta bu'i phreng gis mdzes par byas pa 87—42

mu tig ①sna gnyis ku'i ②dra bas ②bris pa rin po che'i ༅dril bu g.yer ku'i dra bas steng gi bar snang yongs su bskor ba lha'i ras bcos ma dang dar gyi lda ldi mang po bres pas mdzes par byas pa/ lha'i sil snyan dang pheb (snyerdob pa snyan cing yid du 'ong ba'i sgra 'byin pa/ lha'i bu mo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong glu len gar byed rol mo byed cing snyan par smra la gdu bu dang rna cha gdub 'khor gyis brgyan cing lha'i lus dang ldan pa rnams kyis gang ba/ rin po che chen po'i bla re kun du bres pa sa gyephyogs bai ḍūrya (7chen pos legs par spras pa/ ka tsa li ririnanadi ka ltar reg na bde ⑨ba dus thams cad pa'i me tog gi shing ljon pas legs par brgyan 7pa lha'i rin po che'i them skas kyi phreng gis rnam par spras pa/ ngang pa dang ske/ bzhad yidang / ngur pa dang / shang shang te'u nyusnyedang / ne tsho nyusnyedang /ri skegs chadang / rma bya dang / khrung khrung dang / bya'i tshogs du ma sgra 'byin pa dang / lha'i me tog utpa la dang / ku mu da bladang / padma dkar po dang /dri mchog dang / padma dang / ka la tsor ka dang / yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus gang ba'i rdzing byang chub sems dpas 1— tshoyongs su spyad par bya ba lha'i tsandan sbrul gyi snying po'i rdzab kyi rnyog pa 12can dag gis kun nas mdzes par byas pa rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par khang pa brtsegs pa der lha'i me tog man dā 19ra ba dang ske/ pa ru sha ka dang / pa ru sha ka chen po dang / sa brtol shu byedang / sa brtol tsochen po'i me tog gi char mngon par 'bab pa/ a ga ru nag po'i bdug pa'i sprin mang pos khebs pas zhurternam par mdzes par 22byung bar gyur te|mi/khang pa brtsegs pa de'i nang du byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi tsunaso so'i gnas bsam pa ci lta ba bzhin du las kyis (9bskyed pa de ri snadag mngon par sprul 87wa 43

tol/ /khang pa brtsegs pa de dag re rer ①yang rin po che'i dbang ②gi rgyal po la sogs pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu bcu drug /rin po che'i rgyal po ①la sogs pa ④ci ltar 'dod pa bzhin du yongs su spyad par bya ba sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i nor bu rin po che chen po dag bkod do/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyi rgyan ⑤bkod pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa thams cad gdugs ⑥dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan bsgreng ⑦bas mdzes par byas so/ /khang pa ⑧brtsegs pa de dag tu yang padma'i snying po'i seng ge'i khri rnams sprul to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa thams cad kyang bee ḍūrya 0chen po gsal ba'i rang bzhin can te/'di lta ste dper na shin tu phyis pa'i me long ci lta ba bzhin du rnam par snang tsu )mdzad kyi rgyan bkod pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa yang rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing gsal ba ste bee ḍūrya skyegasal ba'i phyir der stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams 8cad gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du snang ngo / /dbus su ni bcom ldan 'das kyi seng ge'i khri 'gro ba thams cad kyi bkod pa'i snying po rin po che'i 8rgyal po las byas pa mngon par sprul to/ /sems can thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba'i yo byad kyi sprin dag khang pa brtsegs pa der kun nas rtag tu bab (8par mngon par sprul te/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sngon gyi spyod pa rgya mtsho spyad pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i 8phyir mngon par sprul yinas/bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang phyag bya ba dang bsnyen bkur bya ba dang chos mnyan pa'i phyir gnod sbyin gyi tshogs chen po dang lhan cig tu gnod sbyin gzhon nu bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang pos yongs su bskor ⑩cing mdun du bdar nas/87—44

byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mthu chen pos khang pa brtsegs pa de lag pa gnyis kus 7blangs te steng gi bar snang las babs te/ shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa ga la ba der song ngo / /khang pa brtsegs pa de'i 'od kyis shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal (mistug po 'di thams cad snang ba chen pos khyab par ⑤snang bar gyur nas gang dag 'khor der 'dus shing 'khod pa'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang mi dang ④mi ma yin pa de dag snang ba des snang bar byas pas phyogs bzhir rnam par bltas pa ⑤dang steng gi bar snang la dpag tshad 'bum phrag drug cu yirtsa brgyad na me'i phung po chen po ltar 'bar ba'i ④nyi ma stong ltar lham ⑧mer rnam par ⑨mdzes par mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang ya mtshan du gyur pa'i snying gis phan tshun rnam par bltas tsonas cang mi smra bar 'khod par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag gzungs thob pa dang / bzod pa thob pa dang / stobs thob pa de dag gis tunyekyang rnam par bltas na me'i hu)phung po chen po ltar 'bar ba nyi ma nyusnyestong ltar lham mer rnam par mdzes par tsomathong nas de dag kyang ya mtshan du gyur pa'i snying gis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di nas 8dpag tshad 'bum phrag drug cu 8rtsa brgyad kyi steng gi bar snang la lham me lhan ne lhang nger gda' zhing bcom ldan 'das rtogs par dka' ba brjod hunyepar 87—45

dka' ba 'di ni ①ci lags de skad ces gsol ba dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa ②yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas / byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang lha'i 'khor chen po de dag ②la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba de sting la blta ba dang / phyag bya ba dang / mchod pa bya ba dang /⑤ bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'ongs te/nga la mchod pa'i phyir rnam par snang mdzad kyi rgyan 6)bkod pa zhes bya ba'i khang pa brtsegs pa mngon par sprul pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyod pa bstan pa'i cho 'phrul sngon (7gyi spyod pa bsgrub pa'i rgyu mthun pa ste 'di ni chos gang gi (kyeyon tan bskal pa brgyar yang mtha' rtogs par mi nus pa de'i 'od lham me lhan ne lhang nger 'dug pa'o9)/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du bzang po de yang theg pa chen po la 'jug pa'i sgo rnam par dag pa'i gnas zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs kun du 'dri'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshig gi lan ⑩ 'di bka' stsal ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du bzang po shing ta la bdun srid tsam gyi steng gi bar snang la 'dug nas shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po thams cad du lha'i me tog dang ske/ bdug pa dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang ske/ gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang /pheg nyaterdob pa'i sprin mngon par sprul te char du phab nas steng gi nam mkha' las babs te khang pa brtsegs pa de bcom ldan 'das la phul lo/ /phul nas kyang bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod pa/ sku dang gsung dang thugs mkhyen 87—46

pas / /rnam dag brtul zhugs bzang po pa/ /rtog pa kun gyis rnam dag pa/ /phyag 'tshal sems can dag khyod la/ /mig dang de bzhin rna ba dang / /sna dang de bzhin lce dang ni/ /lus dang de bzhin yid kyis ②ni/ /smra ba'i mchog la bdag phyag ②'tshal/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/ /reg bya yul can 'tshal ba yi/ /dngos po kun las ②rnam grol ba/ /rgyal ba mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod ④nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa'/ /sku gsung thugs la sogs pa yis⑥ / /gzugs brnyan lta bur 'jig rten du/ /mnga' bdag khyod ⑦ni rtag tu dga'adu/ /khyod ni sems can srog ma lags/ /gang zag kun gzhi khyod ma lags / /dus dang rang bzhin las ma byung / /ci ltar ma lags ci ma lags/ /khyod ni brten stinas byung ba tsam/ /sgyu ma lta bur dngos por 7spangs/ /chos rnams sgyu ma lta bur ni/ /thugs su khyod chud rkang gnyis mchog /khyod ni ngo bo nyid kyis stong / /stong pa nyid kyang mchis tsom lags/ /stong dang mi stong rnam par grolanyunye/ /nam mkha' 'dra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du bzang pos bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod nas/ g.yog 'khor dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das la lan 8brgya stong du mar bskor ba byas te④/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das la blta lho zhing phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas khang pa brtsegs pa de dang bkod pa de dag dang sil snyan dang pheg rdob pa ⑩de dag las theg pa chen po'i thog ma'i 0spyod pa'i sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grag ste/ gzod nyunyenas zhi zhing mtshan nyid med/ /chos nyid gcig tu 1tshedag pa ste / /khyed cag the tsom dogs sbyo )spongs la/ /kye ma'o 0'di la brtson par gyis/ /87—47

theg pa chen po'i gnas 'di ni/ /sngon gyi spyod pa bla na med/ /spyod pa'i rgyal po skyid ①che ba/ /kun gyis shin tu thob par gyis/ /sngon gyi spyod pa rgya mtsho rnams / /yongs su dag pa'i rgyu yis ni/ /rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad ni/ /rtag tu 'di na ②mdzes la ltos/ /ston pa gang du'ang mi gnas la/ /gang du'ang spyod nu)par mi gnas kyang / /gang dag spyod pa rnams cisbyangs pa/ /de dag kun la gnas par 'gyur(pe/ /'gro ba'i mnga' bdag mig dang ni/ /rna ba de bzhin sna dang ni/ /lce dang de bzhin lus dang yang / /yid du snang ba ma lags so/ /dang po 'byung ba'i spyod pa ni/ /gang gi tshe na sbyangs gyur pa/ /de tshe bcom ldan rnam snang mdzad/ /rnal 'byor can gyis rtag tu mthong / /ring ba ma lags nye ma lags/ /nang dang phyi ni ma lags te/ /rtag tu nam mkha' 'drar gnas pa ste/ /rnal 'byor pa ni chen po snang / /①byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang pos de ltar ③tshigs su bcad pa de dag thos ⑨ma thag tu stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 0logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gal te zhus nas zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la skabs phye na bdag bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' rtso)kun du bzang po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu khyod ci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang tsongs dris pa de dang de'i lung bstan pas khyod kyi rtso sems rangs par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' 87—48

stsal pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du bzang pos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ theg pa chen po la 'jug pa ⑩theg pa chen po la ②'jug pa zhes bgyi ba 'di ni ②chos gang gi tshig bla dgas lags/ theg pa chen po la 'jug pa de'i spyod pa ni ci lta bu ④zhig lags spyod pa de rtogs ⑤par khong du chud pa ni su zhig lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po la legs so zhes bya ba byin te sems can chen po legs so legs so/ /sems can chen po khyod de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'di 'dri ba ni 0yang legs so / /de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung ④shig dang mengs theg pa chen po la 'jug pa dang theg pa chen po la 'jug pa'i gnas bshad par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu de ⑨la theg pa chen po zhes bya ba 'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos nyid kyi tshig bla dgas so/ /de'i 'jug pa ni byang chub bo/ /rigs kyi bu gnas zhes bya ba 'di ni bogazhi'o/ /de yang snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro ba'i spyod pa ste sems can thams cad hunye'adul ba'i dbang nye bar bzung nas yul dang dus kyi dbang gis de'i rnam pa ston pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang theg pa chen po ni rnam pa gnyis te 'dus byas kyis rab tu phye ba dang 'dus ma byas kyis rab tu phye ba'o/ /de la 'dus byas kyis rab tu phye ba ni spyod pa'i ngo bo'o/ /'dus ma byas kyis rab tu phye ba'i theg pa chen po nyid ni theg pa chen po'o/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang 'dus byas ni rkyen gyis bskyed pa ste rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /rigs kyi bu 'dus ma byas ni mi skye ba'i chos nyid dang stong pa nyid nyunyerang gi ngo bo'o/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang spyod pa'i ngo bo'i theg pa chen po 87—49

gang zhe na stong pa nyid mngon du byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi ①yul dang dus kyi dbang gis sems can 'dul ba'i dbang nye bar bzung ste bya ba dang las kyis kun du bslang ba'i (kyetshul gyis 'dogs pa ste rigs kyi bu 'di ni spyod pa'i ngo bo'i theg pa chen po'o/ /rigs kyi bu de la 'dus ma byas kyi theg pa chen po nyid chagang zhe na 'di lta ste/ci ltar gnas pa'i chos nyid kyi tshig bla dgas so/ /rigs kyi bu ci ltar gnas pa'i chos nyid ces bya ba 'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid kyi tshig bla dgas so/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de ni 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /'dus ma byas pa ④gang yin pa de ni mtha' gnyis la mi ltos ⑤pa ⑥de la gdags pa'i ngo bo nyid memed cing mi gdags pa'i ngo bo nyid ⑧yang med do/ /gang ⑨la gdags pa'i ngo bo nyid ⑨ med cing mi gdags pa'i ngo bo nyid yang ⑩/med pa de la spyod pa med do/ /gang la spyod pa med pa de brjod par 8bya ba ma yin no/ /gang brjod par bya ba ma yin pa de 8dngos po thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /gang dngos po thams cad dang bral ba de ④mi 'khrugs pa'o/ /gang mi 'khrugs pa de chos so/ /chos gang yin pa de de bzhin gshegs pa nyusnyemangon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'o⑩ / /gang de bzhin gshegs pa ⑩/mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa de bden pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu bden pa gang yin pa de yod pa'o/ /yod pa gang yin pa de brdzun ma yin pa'o/ /gang brdzun pa pho ma yin pa de yang dag pa'o/ /yang yodag pa gang yin pa de ni py-i — )chos nyid do/ /chos nyid gang yin pa de mi rtog rnam par mi rtog go/ /gang mi rtog rnam par mi rtog pa de ye shes so/ /ye shes gang yin pa de rnam par shes pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa gang yin pa de de bzhin 87wa 50

nyid do/ /de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de (1)btags pa'o/ /btags pa gang yin pa de ⑤rtog pa'o/ /rtog pa gang yin pa de kun rdzob ces bstan te/ kun rdzob yod pas spyod pa 2btags so/ /btags pa yod pas de bzhin gshegs pa (4dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ba ston tol/ /sangs rgyas kyi rin)mdzad pa bdud bzhi pham par byed pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po la thug tshormepa'i bar dang / gnas pa dang / 'byung ba dang / 'jig pa dang / skye ba dang ske/ rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'byor pa dang / rgyad pa 'jig rten du kun du ston to/ /rigs kyi bu de la sogs tso)pa dus dang yul gyi dbang nye bar bzung nas spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor bcas te/ thabs sna tshogs kyi tshul rnams kyis sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /chos bstan pa de ni yang dag pa'i 98)phul tso)yin te theg pa gcig tu yang dag par 'du ba yul gcig yang dag par thob par byed pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /rigs kyi bu chos nyid gang yin pa de la ni gdags pa'am rnam par rig pa med cing mi dmigs te/ ye shes rnam par mi rtog pa'i phyir ro/ /de la ni spyod pa yang med mi spyod pa yang med 7bslab pa yang med bslab pa ma yin pa yang med do1sto/ /'dul ba yang med 'dul ba ma yin pa yang med do/ /de la ni lus sam ngag gam yid kyi 'jug pa'am/ ldog pa mi dmigs so/ /de la ni kyi de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya ba'am3ge sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'am/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba'am/ nyan thos zhes bya ba'am / rang sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'am/ chos zhes bya ba'am/ dge 'dun 87—51

zhes bya ba'am/ lha zhes bya ba'am/ klu zhes bya ba'am/ gnod sbyin zhes bya ba'am / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang ske/ lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa zhes bya ba'i bar ram/yod ces bya ba'am/ med ces bya ba'am/ bsod nams zhes bya ba'am/ bsod nams ma yin zhes bya ba'am/① 'khor ba zhes bya ba'am/ mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya ba'am/ 'ching ba zhes bya ba'am/ thar pa zhes bya ba med do/ /rigs kyi bu de la ni dus zhes bya ba 'am/ tshod ces bya ba'am/ skad cig ces bya ba'am/ yud tsam zhes bya ba'am/ thang cig ces bya ba med do/ /de la ni zla ba zhes bya ba'am/ skar ma zhes bya ba'am/ nyi ma zhes bya ba'am/ me zhes bya ba'am/ rlung zhes bya ba'am/ chu zhes bya ba'am/ sa zhes bya ba'am/mtshan mo zhes bya ba'am/ nyin mo zhes bya ba'am/ dus tshigs ②zhes bya ba'am/lo khyud 'khor ④zhes bya ba'am/ zla ba zhes bya ba med do④/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar na rtog pas brtags ⑤pa'i sgo 'jig rten gyi tha snyad kyi ⑥mthar ltung ba ji snyed pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i brtags ⑦pa'i sgo ci snyed pa de dag thams cad ni de la mi 'byung 0zhing med de de ⑥mi dmigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / chos nyid de gnyis su med pa'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir te de la gnyis su mi 'byung ngo / /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' gnyis pa ma skyes pa'i phyir nam mkha'i khams ni gnyis su med pa'o⑩/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du chos nyid kyang gnyis su med pa'o/ /0rigs kyi bu de ltar na gang chos nyid 'di lta bu la spyod pa de ni8/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi 8spyad pa spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems 87—52

dpa' chen po rnams su bstan to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ spyod pa ma yin pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'o/ /bslab pa ma yin pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'o/ /thob pa med pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thob pa'o / /rtsom pa med pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rtsom pa'o/ /'dul ba ma yin pa de ①ni 'dul ②ba'o/ /gdags nisu med pa ni 'dogs ④pa'o/ /mthong ba med pa ni sangs rgyas mthong ba'o/ /bsnyen bkur mi byed pa ni dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byed pa'o/ /mi nyan pa ni chos nyan pa'o/ /khong du chud pa med pa ni khong du chud pa'o/ /'gro ba med pa ni 'gro ba'o/ /gnas pa ⑤med pa ni gnas soyi/ /stong pa nyid ma yin pa ni stong pa nyid do/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni shes pa med pa thob pa med pa ⑦mngon par rtogs pa med pa ⑧ mngon sum du byed pa med pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu rnam grangs 'dis kyang 'di ltar rig par bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni spyod pa spyad pa'o / /gang du yang mi chags pa'o⑨/ /gang du yang rjes su chags pa med do/ /gang du yang khong khro ba med donyu bye/ /gang du yang zhe sdang ba 7med do8/ /de mi snang tsom rmongs phyin ④ci ma log pas 8rtag tu mnyam par gzhag pa ste/ rnam par mi rtog pa/ zhi ba/ legs par gnas pa/ zla med pa/ mi g.yo ba/rab tu mi g.yo ba/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang ⑩sems can gyi don bya ba la yongs su mi skyo ba ⑩dus gsum du yang sgyid lug pa med do8/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i khams ni rdul lamatha/ du ba'am/sprin gyis ⑥kun nas nyon mongs par mi 'gyur/ sgyid lug par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nam mkha'i khams rnam par mi rtog pa'i phyir ro/ /rigs 87—53

kyi bu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa ①'di lta bu spyad pa yang sgyid lug par mi 'gyur/ kun nas nyon mongs par mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de la spyod pa 'di lta bu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpas ②rdo rje chen po'i ①dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i rgyan rdo rje chen po'i litog gi spyod pa rdo rje chen po las byung ba'i zhi)de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod pas ⑥bsod nams la sogs ⑦pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs gzung 'u)bar bya/ bklag par bya/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par bshad par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du bzang pos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar to/ /bde bar gshegs pa ngo mtshar to/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di dag tshigang dag mgri rna lam du grag ⑪par 'gyur ba'i 8byang chub sems dpa' de dag rnyed pa 0legs pa 0rnyed pa lags na/ gang dag nyan pa dang / 'dzin pa (snyedang / klog pa dang / yid la bgyid pa dag lta smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das de dag ni theg pa chen po tshebla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges pa lags so/ /nyurtebacom ldan 'das de dag ni theg pa chen po bla na med pa de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par rdzogs par 12byang chub pa rnam par 'phrul pa'i 3)gnas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul la skal ba mchis pa lags so/ /bdag la thugs brtse bar dgongs te bcom ldan 'das kyis theg pa chen po bla na med pa 'phral du 'bras bu mang ba bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bar bzhugs te/ rdo rje chen po 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis mnyam par gzhag ma 87—54

thag tu de nas de'i mod la phyogs thams cad kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje chen po'i sgra sgrogs te gsung gcig tu rdo rje chen po 'bar ba'i 'od 'phro ba'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ②rdo rje'i 'byung gnas rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brjod cing shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa ga la ba der gshegs te byon nas rdo rje chen po padma'i gdan la skyil mo krung ②bcas te bzhugs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la (miganod pa chung ngam zhes snyun ④gsol te/ nyam nga ⑤ba nyung ngam bskyod ⑥pa yang ngam stobs dang ldan nam 'tsho 'am bde ba la reg par ⑦gnas sam zhes snyan dushegasol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad slod ⑨nas rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa'i rdo rje gsang sngags kyi rgyal po 'di gsungs so/ /na maḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba ta thā 0ga te bhyaḥsarba thā shi.o badzra ka ra khaṃ swā hā/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis rdo rje chen po'i 512dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa'i gsang sngags gsungs nas sangs rgyas kyis hunyebyin gyis brlabs kyis /sternam par 'phrul nyugepa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs spe'uso/ /de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor chen po de ya mtshan du hu)che'o snyam du snying 'dun par gyur nyu2te/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la blta /6zhing 'khod do/ / de nas sri )'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'khor de ya mtshan che snyam du rtse gcig tu gyur par rig nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par 87—55

rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'dus pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ①la zhus pa/ gsang sngags rgyal po bka' stsal nas/ /rnam par 'dren rnams mi gsung las/ /bde gshegs sras la rdo rje yis/ /dbang bskur du ni nges par gda'/ /gsang sngags spyod pa ye shes chel/ /theg pa chen po'i go 'phang mchog /der ni thams cad mkhyen nyid dang ske/ /don kun grub ③pa'i spyod pa 'thobasti/ /gsang sngags spyod las byung ⑤ba yi/ /theg pa chen po thams cad mkhyen/ /sngon gyi rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams kyis / /nags tshal mchog 'dir rtag tu bshad/ /sā la'i rgyal mtshan nyams dga' che/ /spyod pa yang dag bstan pa'i gnas/ /sngon gyi spyod las byung gyur pa⑨ske/ /gsang sngags shes las byung ⑦bar bshad/ /gang dag 'das pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /mgon po gang dag da ltar ⑧byung ske/ /rnam par 'dren pa labazhugs pa rnams/ /de dag thams cad 'dir gshegs nas0/ /gsang sngags spyod las byung ba yi/ /theg pa chen pos ⑪dbang bskur 'di/ /bde gshegs sras la rab tu stsol/ /sangs rgyas drang srong chen po pa/ /kun gyi dbang ni bdag lags so/ /'jig rten phan par 'tshal bas na8/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la gsol ba 'tshal/ /bstan pa kun la bsrung ba dang 'oste/ /dam chos rtag gnas bgyi slad du/ /bdag nyid che ba'i spyi gtsug tu / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis tsodabang bskur stsol8/ /gsang sngags spyod las byung ba yi/ /theg chen rtogs par khong du chud/ /sngon gyi smon lam nges byung ⑩ ba / /sangs rgyas sras po grags chen lags/ / thog ma'i spyod ldan nges pa 'di / /masangs rgyas 'dra tsam hu)ci zhig ste0/ /bde zhu gshegs sras po chags med 87—56

pal/ /byang chub mthar thug dbang thob 0)lags/ /gsang sngags mgon pos rnam kun dul/ /'khor 'di byin gyis brlabs lags na/ /gsang sngags rgyal po bka' stsal nas/ /ci slad ②mi gsung gyur cing bzhugs/ /thams cad ngo mtshar 'dzin 'gyur te/ /bde bar rtog la brtson par gnas/ /dpa' bo che rnams the tsom ④dang / /de bzhin yid gnyis bsal du gsol/ /da ni dus la bab lags na/ /phyi shol stim mdzad bshad du gsol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas gsol ba btab par mkhyen nas/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas yigasungs pa/ 'dren pa rnams kyis 〈pegang sangs rgyas / /chos nyid 'di ni gcig tu mchog /rtag tu mnyam par (shegazhag rnams kyisal / /rab tu bsgrims te de rtogs 0bya/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la sogs pas shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po kun du rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi khyams bkod palho / gru bzhi lham pa/ sgo bzhi gtod pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyi phyi ras bskor ba/ sgo gang /2dang / rta babs 8dang / stegs bus brgyan pa④/ steng du rin po che'i bla res rmo bres pa/rin po che'i dril bu dpyangs 7pa rin po che sna lnga'i srad bu bres pa 3 tshobyin gyis brlabs te/ dbus su rdo rje padma'i khri dang phyogs cha brgyad du rdo rje chen po'i phreng bas bskor ba dang rdo rje'i phyi ras kun du bskor ba dang rdo rje'i 'o)phyi rgyab tu ni rdo rje'i phreng ba dang rdo rje'i srad bus 0bres pa dang rdo rje bcing bas 3 )bcings pa dang / rdo rje'i phur bu dag gdab 0pa dang thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin can phyedu byin gyis brlabs nas steng gi gtsug tor nas 2nyethams cad du thogs pa 87—57

med pa'i stobs zhes bya ba'i 'od zer phyung ngo / /'od zer de dag phyung nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la ①snang bar byas te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du bzang po'i spyi ②gtsug du zhugs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer de dag zhugs ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ②kun du bzang po dga' zhing mgu nas rab tu dga' ste thogs pa med pa'i stobs zhes bya ba'i snying po smras pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo rjobi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā a pra ti ha ta ba la/ ma hā badzra ā ②dzñā ka ra ṇa0/ na mo stu te swā hā/ de nas thogs pa med pa'i stobs rdo rje'i snying po smras ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis (3)ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang / stobs dang ske/ byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam dang 'phags pa'i bden pa dang stong pa nyid dang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dang ⑧/ stong pa nyid chen po'i mtha' las byas pa sbyin pa dang / dul ba dang yang dag par sdom pa dang /des pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis rnam par bskyed pa'i gzugs can gyi rdo rje byin gyis brlabs te byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po'i lag tu byin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis kun du bzang po'i lag tu rdo rje byin ma thag tu/ de nas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam rnams dang sangs rgyas kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / nyan thos thams cad dang /rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye (7chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu/87—58

kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di ni lag na rdo rje'o lag na rdo rje'o zhes brjod do// //'phags pa lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba/ bam po gsum pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis dam tshig 'di byin gyis brlabs nas yang gsang ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i snying po 'di ①gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā gu ②phya badzra dha ra swā hā/ de nas gsang ba'i rdo rje'i snying po gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang sangs rgyas kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor ①thams cad du gsang ba'i bdag po ④cigasang ba'i bdag po (5)zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags nas 'di lta ste/ snying po 'di'i mthu dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis (67brlabs kyi stobs kyis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs dang ye shes phun sum tshogs pa dag mngon sum du zhugs so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis bstan pa kun du bsrung ba dang 'gro ba yongs su skyob pa'i snying po rdo rje chen po rgya che ba'i gzungs zhes bya ba'i snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā meg te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā badzra dha ra bi ra bi ra bi ki ra (8)swā hā/rdo rje chen po rgya che ba'i snying po gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du rdo rje chen po rgya che ba las byung ba'i lag na rdo rje sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad dang 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang nyunye/ sems dang po bskyed pa 87—59

rnams dang / las dang po pa rnams dang / sems can rnams kyi rgyab dang /mdun dang ma nyal pa'am gnyid kyis ②log pa'am chos ston pa'am byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'am sems can gyi don byed pa'am sprul pa rab tu byed pa'i bar du thams cad kyi drung na gzugs thams cad yang dag par ston pa'i cho ga shes pa lag na rdo rje cod pan can ②kun du snang ngo / /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis phyogs rdo rjes bcings pa ②zhes bya ba'i ④rdo rje'i snying po mchog gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā di ga badzra ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭaṃ swā hā/ phyogs rdo rjes bcing ba'i ⑤nying po 'di gsungs ma thag tu phyogs bcu na sems can ma rungs pa thams cad rdo rje'i bcing bas bcings par (nasnang ngo / /de nas yang ⑦de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis sa'i rdo rje'i 0phur bu zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i ①snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā ṭha ṭha ṭha ṭha khri swā hā/ sa rton gyi rdo rje'i snying po 'di gsungs ma thag tu/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di 8rdo rje'i sa rton to zhes bya ba'i hunyesgra gcig nas gcig tu bur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis sa'i 8thog gi rdo rje zhes bya ba'i snying po mchog gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā ya ṭa ya ṭaṃ swā hā/ sa nyuge'og gi rdo rje'i snying po 'di ④gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang sa'i bya'og gi phrag thams cad du/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni sa'i ⑩thog gi rdo rje hu 7zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis rig sngags 'chang hu)thams cad kyi 'gro ba gcod pa zhes 87—60

bya ba'i snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā can① / sarba bīrsāskyo ②ra ga rim nipra bar ma las ④tha dza ya ⑤su hā/ rig sngags 'chang gi 'gro ba gcod pa'i snying po mchog 'di gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang / rig sngags 'chang gi gnas thams cad du/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni rig sngags 'chang gi 'gro ba gcod pa'o zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis gnod sbyin tshar gcod pa'i rdo rje chen po'i snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā badzra yakṣa ṇi kṛ byaha da ta swā hā/ gnod sbyin gyi rdo rje'i snying po gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang gnod sbyin gyi gnas thams cad du/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni gnod sbyin gyi ⑦rdo rje'o zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis klu'i rdo rje bsgrags pa'i tog rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i snying po gsungs padu/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā ha ra ha ra nā ga badzra swā hā/ de nas klu'i rdo rje'i snying po 'di gsungs ma thag tu / 'jig rten gyi khams ⑨rab 'byam thams cad dang klu'i gnas thams cad du / kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni klu'i rdo rje zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang ⑩de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis rdo rje chen po dri za'i snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā ma tha ma tha badzra garnyarba skṛ tsod ya swā hā/ rdo rje chen po dri za'i snying po gsungs ma thag tu de nas de'i mod la 'jig rten gyi 87—61

khams rab 'byam thams cad dang / dri za'i gnas thams cad du/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni dri za'i rdo rje'o zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis rdo rje chen po nam mkha' lding gi dbang po'i snying po gsungs pa①/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā badzra pi ta tadha ra ka ra haṃ ha swā hā/ de nas rdo rje chen po nam mkha' lding gi ②dbang po'i snying po 'di gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang nam mkha' lding gi gnas thams cad du/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje chen po 'di ni nam mkha' lding gi dbang po'i rdo rje ④zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis rdo rje chen po mi'am ci'i snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā badzra kinda ra danda bi dza ya shabha swā hā/ de nas mi 'am ci'i snying po mchog 'di gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang mi 'am ci'i gnas thams cad du/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni mi'am ci'i rdo rje'o zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis rdo rje lto 'phye chen po'i snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā ma ho ra ga badzra dzā lā ④ya swā hā/ de nas rdo rje lto 'phye chen po'i snying po 'di gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang sto 'phye chen po'i gnas thams cad du/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni lto 'phye chen po'i rdo rje'o zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de 87—62

dag gis rdo rje chen po srin po'i snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā badzra rākṣa ①sa klu ②ra da ha pa tsa ni rgyu rtsu stiswā hā/ de nas rdo rje chen po 0srin po'i snying po 'di gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang srin po'i gnas thams cad du/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni srin po'i rdo rje'o 0zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis rdo rje chen po mkha' 'gro ma zhes bya ba'i snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā badzra skṛ da ⑦te ha ②swā hā/ de nas rdo rje chen po mkha' 'gro ma'i snying po 'di gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas thams cad du/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni ⑨mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje'o skyezhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis rdo rje chen po 'byung po'i snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā ha le rtswa 7le badzra ma hā sgyu te ashwa ra swā hā/ rdo rje chen po 'byung po'i snying po 'di gsungs ma thag tu 1༄'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang 'byung po'i gnas thams cad du/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni 'byung po'i rdo rje chen po ④zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis rdo rje chen po 8sha za'i snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā ma hā badzra pi shā tse 0shwa ra bi shwa skṛ pho tshad ya gi mi tsi 8mi tsi tsom ṭa ma ṭa badzra swā hā/rdo rje chen po sha za'i snying po 'di dag gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams 87—63
