rab 'byam thams cad dang sha za'i gnas thams cad du/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni sha za'i rdo rje'o zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis rdo rje chen po sha za (7mo'i snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā badzra dru ④ti pi shā tsi ki ri mi ri mi ②le swā hā/ rdo rje chen po sha za mo'i snying po 'di gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang sha za mo'i gnas thams cad du/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni sha za mo'i rdo rje'o ④zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis rdo rje srin mo'i snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā badzra ka rā duli rākṣa si hā ⑥ri mi ri swā hā/ rdo rje srin mo'i snying po 'di gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang srin mo'i gnas thams cad du/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni ⑥srin mo'i rdo rje'o 40zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis rdo rje chen po gnon po'i 0snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā o stu tshur ka badzra nyi si swā hā/ gnon po'i 7snying po 'di phortegasungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang gnon po'i gnas thams cad du/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni gnon po'i rdo rje'o 8zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis grib gnon rab tu 'jigs 8pa'i rdo rje'i snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe 87—64

bhyaḥsarba thā ①kyi li ki li badzra bi dha hi ni swā hā/ grib gnon rab tu 'jigs ②pa'i ①snying po 'di gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang ske/ grib gnon gyi gnas thams cad du/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni grib gnon gyi rdo rje'o zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis brjed byed kyi gdon 'gog pa'i ④rdo rje'i snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā gro gro ⑤spa ra ṇa badzra swā hā/ brjed byed kyi gdon 'gog pa'i ⑥rdo rje'i snying po 'di gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang brjed byed kyi gnas thams cad du/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni ⑦brjed byed kyi rdo rje'o zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ / de nas nide bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis yang gdon thams cad bzlog ⑨pa'i rdo rje'i snying po 'di ⑩gsungs pa / na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā bi ra badzra hunyesarba gra ha ni yon tsota na dzā ṭi ba ()lo po da ra ra ṭa ra ṭa swā hā/ gdon thams cad bzlog pa'i rdo rje'i snying po 'di dag 8gsungs ma thag tu 8'jirgo rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang / gdon thams cad kyi gnas thams cad dutso/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni gdon thams cad bzlog pa'i rdo rje'o zhes sgra gcig nas gcig du 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis lha la sogs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā byabardza badzra si saṃ swā hā / lha la sogs pa'i rdo rje'i snying po 'di gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi 87—65

khams rab 'byam thams cad dang / lha la sogs pa thams cad kyi gnas rnams ①su / kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni lha la sogs pa'i snying po rdo rje'o zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis nad kyi gdon thams cad ②tshar gcod pa'i rdo rje'i snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā lha ṣa ༷badzu badzra a mṛ bta bha ⑤ba swā hā/ rtsi sman chen po'i rdo rje chen po'i 0snying po 'di tsogasungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang /rtsi sman chen po'i gnas rnams subya/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni rtsi sman gyi rdo rje'o zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis ⑨nad kyi ⑨ gdon bsal blaba'i rdo rje'i snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā tra ṭa tra ṭa 8badzra swā hā/ nad bsal 1 ba'i rdo rje'i snying po 'di gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad du0/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i rdo rje'o mezhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis rga ba'i gdon tso'agog pa'i rdo rje'i snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā a mṛ tu snatod bha ba badzra la la la la swā hā/rga ba 'gog pa'i snying po 'di gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad du/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni rga ba 'gog pa'i rdo rje'o zhes bya ba 3stegacig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags sonyurtel/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis 'chi ba rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i rdo 87—66

rje'i ①snying po ②gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā zhug te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā ka ti ④badzra dza ya ha ha swā hā/ 'chi ba rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i rdo rje'i snying po 'di gsungs ma thag tu (snye'ajig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad du/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni 'chi ba las yirgyal ba'i rdo rje'o ⑦zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis rgyad pa'i gdon bzlog pa'i rdo rje'i snying po 'di (8༄gsungs pa / na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā pa ra (shem badzra sarba shri yaṃ a bhu da tsu )yanda da ma hā kā 7ru ṇi hu ka dha ka dha kyi ka swā hā/ rgud pa thams cad 'gog 3 )pa'i rdo rje'i snying po 'di gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad du/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni rgyad pa thams cad 'gog pa'i rdo rje'o zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /de nas yang 32de bzhin gshegs pa de tsodag gis 'khor los sgyur ba chen po'i 8stobs thogs pa med pa'i rdo rje'i snying po rtsonagasungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā oṃ badzra tsakra brti tt+waṃ swā hā/ de nas 'khor los sgyur ba chen po'i gsang sngags kyi rgyal po 'di gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang sangs rgyas kyi 'khor gyi nyicadakyil 'khor thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i gnas thams cad dang lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang sha za la sogs pa'i gnas thams cad du byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje 'di ni tsu )rdo rje chen po'i 'khor los sgyur ba zhes bya ba'i tsho )sgra gcig nas 87—67

gcig tu 'ur zhes grags so/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis rdo rje chen po'i ①'khor los sgyur ba'i snying po gsungs pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te ②bhaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā dzī shrī ①rgyu swā hā/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis yang 'khor los sgyur ba chen po la sogs pa rdo rje chen po'i snying po rnams byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje la byin te④/ byin nas kyang 'od zer gyi dra ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sprin stug po'i dra ba ②chen pos thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor snang bar byas nas chos gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs kyi ༅stobs kyis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje byin gyis brlabs nas chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil du'akhor du bdag nyid chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du bsgyur nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas kyang de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dkyil 'khor 'khor los sgyur ba chen po'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por lag tu merdo rjes dbang bskur bas khyod dbang bskur to/ /ting nge 'dzin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma las byas pa'i rdo rje khyod la byin no/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po chen po'i rdo rjes khyod byin gyis brlabs so/ /rdo rje snying po thams cad khyod la bstan to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis khyod la khyabastan pa thams cad kyi don bya ba dang bsrung bar gnang ngo / /khyod kyi sngon gyi smon lam chen po yongs su rdzogs so/ /rigs kyi bu da rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi cho ⑩'phrul nges par ston cig /rigs kyi bu lag na rdo rjes 0dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 87—68

'khor chen po shod cig /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /chos kyi rjes ci ①skad ②bka' stsal pa bzhin du 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag mchog tu ngo mtshar thob pa dang bdag rnam par rgyal ba'i chos dam pa thob pa ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bdag la thugs brtse bar ②mdzad do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje de'i tshe rdo rje brtsegs pa chen po rnam par bsgrags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas lag na rdo rje rdo rje brtsegs ④pa chen po rnam par bsgrags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ⑤ting nge 'dzin ⑥la snyoms ⑦par zhugs ma thag tu de nas de'i tshe 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang zhing thams cad rnam pa drug tu g.yos kun du rab tu g.yos so/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad kyang ⑧rnam pa drug tu g.yos rab tu g.yos 0kun du rab tu g.yos so/ /chem chem rab tu chem chem kun du rab tu chem chem 0mo/ /'gul rab tu 'gul kun du rab tu 'gul lo/ /ldeg rab tu ldeg kun du rab tu ldeg go/ /shar phyogs mtho na nub phyogs dma'o//nub phyogs mtho na shar phyogs dma'o/ /lho phyogs mtho na byang phyogs dma'o/ /byang phyogs mtho na lho phyogs dma'o/ /dbus 7mtho na mtha' dma'o/ /mtha' mtho na dbus dma'o/ /snang ba chen po yang 'jig rten du byung bar gyur to/ /gang dag 'jig rten gyi bar mun pa mun nag smag 8tu gyur pa na 'khod pa de dag kyang 'od des snang bar byas nas sems can gang dag der skyes pa de dag phan tshun blta 7zhing gcig gis gcig mthong nas sems can gzhan dag gcig 87—69

'dir skyes pa blta 0)sems can gzhan dag gcig 'dir skyes pa blta'o (gyesnyam mo//de dag gis bltas pa dang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje (kyerdo rje'i yi ge'i snying po'i gzungs kyi ④chos ston to/ /de dag gis chos de thos nas dad pa rnyed de shi 'phos nas lha'i nang du skyes te shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po ga la ba der lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba chen pos dbang bskur ba'i du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' yichen po lag na rdo rje la blta ba dang phyag bya ba dang mchod pa bya ba'i phyir dong ngo / /tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag kyang skad cig de dang yud tsam de dang thang cig de la chad par gyur to/ /de'i tshe dud 'gro'i skye (7)gnas kyi ming yang mi grag par gyur to/ /yi dgas kyi gnas thams cad kyang rin po che dusna bdun gyi ra bas kun du bskor ba dang / lha'i zas dang / skom dang / yo byad yongs su rdzogs pa dang lha'i lus dang ldan par gyur to/ /shing sā la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa'i nags tshal 59stug po 'di thams cad kyang snang ba chen pos snang bar gyur tosku/ /lha'i bu nyi ma dang zla ba rdzu 'phrul che ba mthu che ba 3lhaganyis kyang 1gelham me ma yin lhan ne ma yin lhang nger cho1nyam yin te de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od dang sa bcu thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i 'od ma gtogs par 'od gzhan thams cad mog mog por gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes ting nge 'dzin 'di nyid tshosal snyoms 3 par gzhag ma thag tu de'i tshe spu'i bu ga thams cad nas khro bo'i rgyal po dag byung nas hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i sgra chen po ni bsgrags17ske/ lag na rdo rje ni thogs/ gdong gi dpral ba'i khro gnyer ni bsnyer/ rmo/stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di 18dbyangs gcig gis go 87—70

bar byed cing / kye ma rungs pa yi hu)srin po dang / / pha yi (2mtshun dang sha za dang ske/ /ma mo'i ②gdon dang 'byung po dang / /brjed byed 'a grub pa (5)sbrul 'dzin bcas4)/ /gnon po (7)bgegs dang log 'dren ⑧sogs(9 ni/ /gdon gyi tshogs rnams 8thams cad ni37/ /ser sna yongs su btang byos la/ /dul ba'i sems kyis mnyam gzhag ste/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /mkhas pa dag ni skyabs su dong 8/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal ldan 'di'osnye/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar 'dzin pa/ /nags tshal dam pa nyams chadaga' bar/ /yid 'ong khang pa brtsegs na bzhugs/ /dong nyusnyel mgon po de las ni/ /dam tshig yongs su stsal byos la/ /nga rgyal nga yi med byos te/ /sa rnams kun du rgyu bar byos/ /gzhan du khyed cag de 7ring nyid/ /rdo rje 'bar ba rab 'khrugs pa/ /'bar ba 'jigs chen de hu snadag gis/ /mgo ni shin tu 'gems par 'gyur/ /de ltar khro bo'i rgyal po dag /'jig rten khams 'di hu)thams cad du/ /btsal nyu)med tshig gis go byas nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin gyi gan dengs sum̐ )shig /ces ched du 3)brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /de'i tshe 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje'i bstan pa 'di tshol 32zhing sangs rgyas la skyabs su dong ngo / /chos la skyabs su dong ngo / /dge 'dun la skyabs su dong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes de'i tshe rang gi snying po smras pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā tsaṇḍa 3nyem hā ro ṣa ṇa badzra pā buṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes rang gi snying po smras ma thag tu de nas 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad dang sangs rgyas kyi 87—71

'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding ①dang / mi 'am ci dang /lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyi gnas rnams su/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje 'di ni lag na rdo rje drag po'o/ /lag na rdo rje drag po'o zhes sgra gcig nas gcig tu 'ur zhes grags sol/ /de thos nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul chen po la smon lam shin tu btab par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes ②rdo rje drag po'i snying po 'di smras nas/ de nas ②de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gnang bas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la bltas te dkyil 'khor chen po smras so/ /de la slob dpon ④gsang sngags kyi(pe/ /de nyid don gyemakhas latshul khrims laldan⑨/ /sgyu rtsal rnams la mkhas pa dang tso/ /snying rje'i shirang bzhin 43bzod yidang ldan④/ /sangs rgyas mchos dang dge 'dun semasam/ /nges pa dang ni nyurtedus shes pa/ /g.yer ba sro shi 'osnyem yin pa/ /mdangs che 7zab mo'i chos la mos( )/ /bzlas brjod la brtson 0rtag tu nis/ /bsam gtan byed pa la dga' zhing ⑫/ /lag na rdo rje'i buming thos pa'i/ /sngags pa de yis rtag snyipar ni/ /mchi tsom 'byung zhing spu zing byed/ /rmi yang lag na rdo rje la/ /yid gnyis 4༄the tsom du nyemed pa dang ske/ /dus shes de bzhin tshod shes shing / /byas gzo 2de bzhin bden smra bshu )ske/ /slob dpon de lta bus ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten nam sku gzugs kyi spyan snga'am rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du zhugs te gong du smos pa'i snying po de dag re re zhing yang 'bum 'bum bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu 87—72

lag na rdo rje drag po'i snying pos yungs kur hunyedang mngar rdzu gsum bsres pa dag lan khrir sbyin sreg ②bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu 'khor los sgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su 'dug ste ④bcom ldan 'das 'khor los sgyur ba chen po bzlas brjod bya'o/ /drag po'i snying po chen pos ⑤slob ma dag par bya ba dang bsrung ba'i cho ga bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu sa brtag (6)par bya ste rdo dang gseg (pem dang gyo mo med pa skye ba po grog spur la sogs pa'i skyon dang bral ba'i sa ni thams cad du yang shis pa'o/ /der gza' dugatum po la ma bab pa tshes grangs ngan pa ma yin pa mi mthun par 'jug pa dang phrad pa spangs pa dang nyi ma dang byed pa dang yud tsam dang rgyu skar dang gza' bzang por mngon pa la ⑨las brtsams na shis par 'gyur 0ro/ /dmar dang ser dang dkar dang nagalhonya /'dren ma pa ni lnga pa /geyin / /gang yang rung ba'i sa der ni/ /mkhas pas khru gang tsam brkos nas1snye/ /sngags pa yis ④ni brkos pa de/ /sa de nyid kyis dgang bar bya/ /lhag na rnam pa kun du mchog /kha da chad ni tso'abring du brjod/ /gang bar ma gyur sa de spang ske/ /mkhas pas der ni brtsam mi bya/ /dkar po dag ni zhi bar bstan/ /dmar po dbang gi don du 'dod/ /ser po rgyas par shes par bya/ /nag po drag shul spyod par shes/ /der ni mchod yon gtor ma dang / /mar me spos dang bdug pa dgatso /bsgrims te byin nas bsrung bya ste/ /mnyam par gzhag nas sa la brjod/ / de yi 7nub mo hunyes der ni/ /ku sha bting ba'i steng du nyal / /gal te sa de yirung gyur na/ /der ni bsgrims na )te bri bar bya/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas mi mchog gis/ /de ni bgegs med yin zhes brjod/ /gzhan du na ni der mi bri/ /bgegs dang bcas pas phung bar 'gyur/ /de nas 87—73

sngags pa langs nas ni/ /de yi nyin mo mkhas pa yis/ /sa ni shin tu yongs bzung ①phyir/ /sbyin sreg bya ba 'di byas te / /sbrang rtsi dang ni 'o ma dang / /mar bsres sbyin sreg mchog tu 'gyur/ /zhi ba'i sems kyis sbyin blugs ni/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig sbyin sreg bya/ /de nas sngags pas sa brkos ②la/ /sa de nyid kyis slar dgang ngo / /yang na dkyil 'khor las kyi tshe/ /sngags pas spos kyis sa dgang ngo / /legs par brdung zhing mnyam 'jam bya/ /phyogs cha dag dang sgo yi ④rnams/ /kun kyang rnam pa thams cad du/ /rin chen sna lngas rab mdzes bya/ /bye brag tu ni sa dbus su/ /rin chen sna lnga gzhag par bya/ /de nas yon tan ldan pa yi/ /slob ma dag ni gdams te gzung (nye/ /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg rnams (6)kun gyis/ /bsgrims te de dag bsrung bar bya/ /mchog sbyin rdo rje blo ldan gyi/ /gsang sngags 'di ni zlos pa ni/ /skyon dang yon tan rnam dpyad ⑦pas/ /de dag thog mar brtag par bya/ /yon tan 'di dag ldan pa ni/ /shin tu brtags nas gzung zhi)bar bya/ /rig dang bzo dhini phun sum tshogs/ /gsal zhing dul la brtson pa dang / /shes rab ldan brtan byas gzo bodang / /dkon mchog gsum la gzhol ba dang / /gzugs mdzes yan lag yongs rdzogs dang / /gang dag theg chen dga' ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa' kun la yang / /yang rmo/rnyedag rtag tu gus gnas dang / /pha la gus dang ma la gus/ /bla ma mchod la rab brtson dang / /gang dag pha rol don spyod la/ /snying nas rtag tu 'jug pa dang / /gang dag drang hunyezhing des pa dang ske/ /g.yo hunyemed cing ni mchos brtson dang / /lus dang ngag dang yid dag pa / /de dag nye bar brtags 'omigazung bya/ /gang dag snying nas 'jig rten 87—74

'di / /'jig rten pha rol yid ches dang / /bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dang ske/ /dmangs ①rigs gang dag chos brtson zhing / /sngags kyi theg chosapa rtogs 'dod pa/ /de dag bsgrims te gzung sa bar bya/ /nyan thos theg pa can 3rnams min/ / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg can min/ /rin1zhar ba lag zha za ma dang ske/ /sgur (nyapo 'on pa mi thung dang / /gang dag sna leb gyur pa dang / /de bzhin mig yon gnong bag can/ /'jungs dang byas pa mi gzo dang / /mkhas snyems ⑦sems dang g.yon 6)can dang / /sngags kyi theg pa skyed 59chen gyi//theg pa la ni ma mos pa/ /de dag nam yang gzung mi bya/ /de dag bstan 'dir skal ba med/ /bstan bcos ri7mi shes mi gzung nyu7ste/ / thor bu thor 12bu 'dzin pa dang / /de bzhin bla ma mi gus panyusnye/ /smad pa de dag ring du spang / /gang dag yan lag ma tshang dang / /rkang zha dag dang theng thupo dang / /yan lag lhag par gyur pa rnams/ /mkhas pas bsgrims te yongs su spang / /ci skad smos pa'i slob ma rnams/ /de'i (2tshe cho ga bzhin brtags te/ /gcig pu yod na'ang de gzung ngo / /yang tson slob ma bzhi zhig gzung / /de nas smyung ba byed bcug la/ /spos dang me tog rnams kyis mchod/ /dkyil 'khor nang gi sa la ni / /ku sha gding ba bting hu tshob la/ /des pas hu)slob ma lhan cig tu/ /der 16ni rtag zhu tu nyal bar bya/ /slob dpon yud tsam yud tsam zhing / /de tshe slob ma rnams la ni/ /theg chen zab mo rgya chen 'di( kā/ /chos kyang rab tu bshad par bya / /gsang sngags brjod las 'byung sab yi/ /yon tan kun du brjod na phan / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/rte/ /rdzu 'phrul la sogs yongs su brjod / /pha rol rgyun zhustel snying rje ba/ /de dag yud tsam yud tsam brjod/ /87—75

nam gyi bzhi cha lus pa'i tshe/ /gal te rmi lam bzang rmis hunyen/ /dkon mchog gsum la gzhol rnams kyis/ /nam langs pa dang legs rab tu/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar 'dug nas ni/ /khyod ②kyis de dag brjod par gyis/ /padma'i steng na ②'dug na mchog /gzung ④dang mthong ba'ang de bzhin te/ /rgya mtsho mthong ba durmis pa dang / /rkyal dang 'thung la'ang yide bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas mthong na snying dga' ste/ /byang chub sems dpa' skyob rnams dang / /'jig rten rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / /nyan thos rnams ⑦dang gang mkhas pa/ /de dag mthong na snying dga'o⑧/ /me yi phung po grags pa dang / /ba lang dhikhyu mchog glang chen dregs0/ /rta ni dkar por gang 'gyur ba7/ /de dag mthong dang zhon pa dang / /ba lang khyu yang shis pa yin/ /bram ze dang ni rgyal rigs dang //rgyal po dge bar grags pa dang / /sdug pa'i gnyen dang grub pa dang / /nyi ma dang ni zla ba dang / /de dag mthong na 'o)shis par 'gyur/ /mi lam smra zhing gtam zer dang / /rang gi mgo bo gcod pa dang / /sha chen za bar byed pa dang ske/ /khrag gis 'khru bar 8byed pa dang / /de bzhin mi gtsang nub pa dang ④/ /zho dang 'bras chan 8za ba dang / /chang yang 'thung bar byed pa dang //skra 'breg ⑩pa ni mchog yin no/ /so yang lhung ⑩bar gyur pa 8dang / / thang shing dang 37ni n+ya gro dha pya / /de la 'dzegs 0pa shis par 'gyur/ /legs so bu zhe'am blo ldan zhes/ /sgra ni de skad thos pa dang / /yid du 'ong ba'i bud med dang du nye/ /nyin mo zhunyenyal po byed pa dang / /tshangs pa drag po'i ④nyi ma dang / /khyab 'jug dang ni zla ba dang / /lus ngan po dang nor sbyin dang / /brgya byin dang ni chu lha dang / /de dag mthong ngam smra ba du snyedang / /'bel tsogatam byed na 87—76

nges par 'grub/ /gzhan yang de lta'i rmi lam dag /dngos grub 'dod pa rnams kyis gzung / /rmi lam de las bzlog pa dag /'jigs med rnams hu)kyis gzung mi bya/ /sa la rgyug dang mchong ②ba dang / /gar byed pa dang glu len dang ske/ /rgod dudang bong bu rnga mo la/ /zhon pa shin tu ngan pa yin/ /'bru mar gyis ni lus bskus ④dang / /gcer bu dag dang smra ba dang / /zhar ba theng (5)po sgur 0po dang / /mi sdug rnams dang phrad pa dang / /phag rnams dang ni khyi rnams dang / /bong ⑦bu rnams kyang de bzhin te/ /ma he rnga mo ce ②spyang dag /rmi lam mthong na 0rtag tu smad/ /rtse gsum rtse gsum gdengs thogs dang / /mig dmar shin tu 'jigs pa dang / /gcer bu dag dang sna leb dang / /sdigs 0mo byed pa'i 'jigs byed dang / /mdog gnag 'o)mi bzad chen po dang rka/ /gos sngon gzugs byad 8mi sdug pa/ /su yis tsormi lam rmis pa ni/ /de la dngos grub yod mi 'gyur/ /zung 8shig rgyob 8shig choms shig ce'am/ /zo shig ces pa'i mi bzad sgra/ /drag po ⑩'jigs byed khro thos dang / /phung dang ma rnyed thos pa dang / /bya rgod bzhad tunyedang bya dkar hunyedang / /'ug pa bya rog byi la dang / /byi ba sdig pa sre mo ⑩sprul/ /gang dag 2 skugazhan yang (1skye bo gdug /de dag rmi lam mthong gyur tam/ /reg par gyur na'ang mi dge'o/ /de nas phyi de nyin par slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i snying pos ba'i rnam lnga la sngags kyis btab ste ( )slob ma bos la rdo rje drag po'i snying pos bsang gtor byas te( snye/shing a shwattha'i bulo ma kong bu'am 3snyim pa'i nang du snod du bya ba sbyin zhing khyed de ring zas kyi tshod shes par gyis shig ces bsgo bar bya'o/ /nyi ma nub na rig pa'i rgyal mo 'jigs med kyis/ sreg 0blugs dang yam sreg snye 7shing nyi shu rtsa gcig 87—77

sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas a shwattha'i ①shing ngamal/ /yang na u dum bā ra las / /sor brgyad tsam gyi ④so shing bya/ /thog ma gcig ni me tog brgyan/ /rdo rje drag po'i sngags btab la/ /de dag la ni bca' phyir sbyin/ /shar gyi phyogs su mdun bstan nam/ /yang na byang phyogs bstan te gzhag /gsang sngags mgon po dran byas la/ /gar bltas (snyede bzhin shes ⑥par bya/ /de nas phyi ④nyin slob ma rnams/ /smyung ba byed du bcug nas su/ /rdo rje mi pham ⑧me zhes bya/ /srid pa gsum po rmongs khabyed pa/ /rtag dran bya phyir de dag la/ /dri ma med pa'i gzungs sbyin 7bya/ /snying du sdug pa'i 1rnyedam tshig brjod/ /nyams pa la yang lhag par brjod/ /sdig pa rab tu zhi bar byed/ /mchog tu bkra shis byed par 'gyur / /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan pa/ /thams cad kyi 8ni ma yin te/ /sdig pa thams cad byang byed pa/ /de ni kun du rtag dran bya/ /slob dpon gyis ni thams cad du/ /rtag tu mnyam par gzhag 8sems kyis/ /sna lnga'i tshon ④las byas pa yi/ /thig skud skorab tu bzang 7blangs la/ /bsgrims 0te sa 'di thams cad la/ /thig ni legs par gdab par bya/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil du 'dug nas (12su/ /sngags pas de bzhin gshegs rnams dang 8/ /de bzhin rdo rje 'chang ba dang / /'khor los sgyur ba dran byas la/ /bdag nyid der bsgoms byas nas su/ /de'i sngags yid kyis dran byas la/ /de nas shar phyogs kha bltas 3 )te/ /shar phyogs nyid du thig gdab bo/ /de nas yang ni 0bsgyur byas lasbyo se/ /nub phyogs kha bltas 'dug nas su/ /nub phyogs nyid du thig gdab bo/ /de nas bsgyur te mkhas pa yis/ /byang gi 'phyogs su ④kha bltas la/ /byang phyogs nyid du da gethig gdab bo/ /de nas yang ( steni bsgyur byas 87—78

la / /lho phyogs su ni kha bltas te/ /rnam par dbye ba shes pa yis0) lho phyogs su ni (mithig gdab bo/ /de ltar nang logs sedakyil 'khor ni/ /cha brgyad yod pa ④rab tu bya/ /de nas de lta'i tshul gyis ni/ /phyogs bzhi ⑤yongs su bskor byas la/ /kun du gru bzhi lham par ni/ /rab tu bsgrims te 96stegadab par byame/ /dbus kyi ⑧gnas nas byung nas su/ /me ⑨yi phyogs kyi 7phyogs 'dug la/ /sngags pas (1sngags kyi cho ga bzhin/ /shar phyogs ngos kyi thig gdab bo/ /de nas cho ga shes pa yis/ /gus pas hunyedabang ldan phyogs song la/ /nub phyogs su ni kha bltas te/ /byang phyogs ngos kyi thig gdab bo/ /dbang ldan phyogs nas song nas su/ /rlung gi phyogs kyi phyogs 'dug la/ /der ni lho phyogs kha bltas la'oste/ /nub phyogs ngos kyi thig gdab bo/ /gnas de nas ni de 8byung la/ /bden bral phyogs su song nas su/ /me yi phyogs kyi bar du ni/ /thig skud legs par gdab par bya/ /kun du gru bzhi lham par ni/ /de ltar gnas de byas nas su/ /de nas phyi rol de bzhin du/ /cho ga bzhin du cha brgyad bya/ /tshad ni bcu drug khru yin te/ /slob dpon nyid kyi khru yis so02/ /de nas byung la blo ldan gyis/ /cha gzhan dag ni bya bar bya/ /phyi rol sa dang bcas par ni/ /khru grangs 7nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /der yang snga ma ci rtso snabazhin du'o// /cha brgyad nyid du gcad ⑩par bya/ /brgyad pa nas ni gzung rdzu )nas su/ /sngags pa yis ni thams cad du/ /'khor sa'i thig ni gdab par bya/ /gnas gsum dag tu nges par yang / /cha brgyad gang dag tso'atsham pa yi/ /thog ma'i sgo ni gdod par bya/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa bar ma ni 3/ /snga ma nyis 'gyur sgor shes nas2rte/ /rim pa gsum par sum 'gyur dang / /sgo gang dag kyang mkhas 87—79

pas bya/ /rta babs dag gi tshad rnams ni/ /dbus kyi cha dang mnyam par bya/ /lha yi gtso bo rnams la yang / /sgo gang dag ni bya bar bya/ /rim pa gsum du rnam dbye bas/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor legs phye la/ /sngags mgon gnas la 'dug pho)nas su/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /tshon rtsi 'dir ni bye brag tu/ /rin chen sna lnga yin par 'dod/ /sā lu btags ②pa'i phye yang rung //ci ltar 'byor pas ②byar yang rung / /gos dkar bgos shing gtsang byas la/ /dul zhing ze'u kha byabacings nas su/ /bsgrims ⑤te byang shar phyogs mtshams nas / /tshon rtsi dag ni dgye yibar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur tshul gyis sam/ /yang na lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas sam/ /snod ⑦kyi phyag rgya'i tshul gyis sam/ /rig byed 'don pa'i lag pa sa so/ /thog mar dkar po dgye bar bya/ / de yi ni'og tu dmar po dgyel/ /de yi 'og tu ser 0po dgye0/ /de yi 'og tu ljang khu na)dgye/ /thams cad dag gi hunyenang rol du/ /sngags pas tshon ni ④nag po dgye②/ /cha brgyad dag tu gang bstan pa/ /dbus kyi cha yi cha rnams ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi ste/ /de dag rdo rje bcing tshul 'dod/ /gdan ni padmar bstan pa ste/ /mchog tu dkar zhing mdzes pa yin/ /de yi steng du rdo rje gzhag /de bzhin rdo rje'i gtsug tor 8te/ /me lce 'bar ba'i snying po bya/ /mdor na sa bon ldan par bya/ /de la shar 4)phyogs su ni de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen me tog gzhag par bya'o/ /lho phyogs su ni 8de bzhin gshegs pa me tog shin tu rgyas pa'i rgyal po'i dbang po'o/ /nub phyogs su ni ⑩de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med do/ /byang phyogs su ni smyo )de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa'o/ /byang shar na phyogs mtshams su ni ༷ snyede bzhin gshegs pa gtsug 87—80

tor can no/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su ni ①de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs so/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams su ni (bde bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyob bo/ /nub byang gi phyogs ①mtshams su ni ④de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor ba 'jig go/ /mdor na dbus kyi padma ni/ /'dab ma brgyad par brjod pa ste/ /'dab ⑤ma dkar po shar phyogs su/ /nub phyogs su ni dmar po nyid/ /byang phyogs su ni ser po ste/ /lho phyogs su ni menag po nyid/ /'dab ma lhag ma rnams kun du/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis 'dren mar megasungs/ /de yi snying po'i dbus su ni/ /bum pa zla ba'i du'od 'dra ②bri/ / de yi 0steng du rlung chen te0//'bar zhing tog dang ldan par bri/ /zla gam 'dra zhing drag po ste/ /'od ni dbyar gyi bosprin mdog 'dra0/ /rlung gi steng du me bri ste④/ /dbyibs ⑩ni gru gsum gnas pa yin/ /rtags ni 'bras bu zur gsum pa/ /'jig pa'i dus kyi me dang mtshungs/ / de yi chadabus su padma bri/ /'od ni dus mtha'i me dang mtshungs0rka/ / de yi tsosnying po'i dbus su ni/ /'khor los sgyur ba bri bar bya/ /de la bcom ldan 'das de ni gzugs sam phyag rgya'am yi ge ci rigs su gzhag par bya'o/ /phyag rgya gzhag na rdo rje ste/ /bsgrims nas sa bon ldan par bya/ /de yi phyi rol cha rnams ni/ /brgyad po dag tu'ang bsnga ma bzhin/ /sngags pas cho ga ci bzhin du/ /lha rnams rnam par dgod par bya/ /de la shar phyogs su ni 'khor du lo'i dkyil 'khor du me'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa dam pa 0sbyin pa'i rdo rje'i 'khor zhugyedang bcas pa rdo rje utpala'i phyag rgya dang bcas par bri'o/ /shar lho'i zhunyematshams su ni rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du kun du bzang po la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'khor dang bcas pa yid bzhin gyi 87—81

nor bu'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /lho phyogs su ni rdo rje'i 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du lag na rdo rje 'khor dang bcas shing rdo rje 'chang thams cad dang lhan cig tu rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa 7bri'o/ /lho nub kyi phyogs ②mtshams su ni rdo rje 'khor lo'i ②dkyil 'khor du byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba 'khor dang bcas pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa ④bri'o / /nub phyogs su ni rdo rje'i 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po 'khor dang bcas pa ral gri'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa dgod par bya'o⑤/ /nub byang gi phyogs ⑥mtshams su ni padma rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du byang chub sems dpa' byams pa 'khor dang bcas pa ril ba spyi blugs ⑦kyi phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /byang phyogs su ni padma rdo rje'i 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen por byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi (shedabang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa padma'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa ⑨dgod par bya'o⑩/ /byang shar gyi phyogs lhonyematshams su ni rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po 'khor dang bcas 8pa rin po che chen po'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa dgod par bya'onyunye/ /phyogs bzhir ④ni 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi 'khor 8dang bcas par rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshenang du chud par bri'o/ /de la rnam ⑩thos kyi bu'i phyag rgya ni dbyug to 8yin no/ /'phags skyes po'i phyag rgya ni be con no/ /mig mi bzang gi phyag rgya ni rdo rje'o/ /lus ngan gyi phyag rgya ni zhags pa'o/ /phyi rol khor 7/)yug chen po'i dkyil 'khor ni gru bzhi lham pa sgo bzhi gtod ṭu )pa sgo khang (7dang rta babs dang mu ran shin tu rnam par phye ba khor duyug chen pos yongs su bskor ba'o/ /de'i nang rol du ni 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams 'khor 87—82

dang bcas pa tshibri'o/ /de la shar phyogs su ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /de'i byang phyogs su ni tshangs pa 'khor dang bcas pa padma'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /tshangs pa'i byang phyogs su ni dbyangs can 'khor dang bcas pa pi bang (gegi phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o / /de dang nye bar sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa bum 5gepa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /de'i byang phyogs su ni dpal chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa padma'i byaphyag rgya'am yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /dbang ldan gyi phyogs su ni 'byung po'i bdag po dbang ldan 'khor dang bcas pa mdung rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /brgya byin gyi lho phyogs su ni nyi ma 'khor dang bcas pa shing rta'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /me'i phyogs su ni drang srong me ②lha 'khor dang bcas pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /lho phyogs su ni gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa yigashin rje'i be con gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /de'i shar phyogs su ni 77)'chi bdag gi ⑧dril bu bri'o⑨ske/ /mtshan mo nag mo'i ni tog go/ /nag mo'i pho )ni zhags pa'o/ /drag po'i chung ma'i rtsoṇḍini mdung rtse gsum pa'o/ /tshangs pa'i chung ma'i 12ni padma'o/ /khyab 'jug gi chung ma'i (rteni 'khor lo'o/ /gzhon nu'i chung ma'i ni khumadung thung ngo ske/ /phag gi chung ma'i ④ni tho ba'o/ / tsā muṇḍi'i 3steni mi thod do/ /dbang po'i chung ma'i hu 7ni rdo rje'o/ /lus ngan gyi chung ma'i nya ni dbyug to'oturte/ /gshin rje'i nub phyogs su pya ni yi dgas rnams 'khor dang bcas pa kha'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /sha za rnams 21ni dra ba rdo rje can gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /gnon po rnams ni ni lcags kyi sa rdo rje can gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /grib 87wa 83

gnon rnams ni gdugs rdo rje can gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /brjed ①byed rnams ni lag pa brang la bcar ba'i ②phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma ②rnams ni lag pa bkan 0pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /srin mo rnams ni mche ba rdo rje can gyi phyag rgya'am lce rdo rje can gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o / /sha za mo rnams ni rdo rje bab col ⑤gyi lag pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o / /bden bral gyi phyogs su ni bden bral 'khor dang bcas pa ral gri'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /nub phyogs kyi sgo'i lho phyogs su ni chu lha 'khor dang bcas pa dang / klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho la sogs pa ⑥klu'i rgyal po rnams 'khor dang bcas pa zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /de nas sgo dang nye bar dbang phyug chen po mdung rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /de dang nye bar dka' thub zlog pa ⑨rtse gsum gdengs pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa dubri'o/ /sgo'i byang phyogs kyi ngos su tshogs kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa dgra sta'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /de'i byang phyogs su thags bzangs ⑨ris la sogs pa lha ma yin gyi rgyal po rnams 'khor dang bcas pa dbyug to rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /rlung gi phyogs su rlung lha 'khor dang bcas pa ba dan gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /byang phyogs su rnam thos kyi bu la sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnams 'khor dang bcas pa dbyug to rdo rje can gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'ol/ /de dag gi shar phyogs su khyab 'jug 'khor dang bcas pa 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /de'i 'og tu nam mkha' lding 'khor dang bcas pa 'dab ma'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /de'i shar phyogs su 0sna tshogs phreng ba can la sogs pa dri za'i rgyal po rnams dang ljon pa la sogs pa mi 'am ci'i rgyal 87—84

po rnams 'khor dang bcas pa ①rang rang ②gi phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri bar bya stedu / de la dri za rnams kyi duphyag rgya rnams ⑤ni rnga phre'u 6)dang pheg rnams so/ /mi 'am ci'i phyag rgya dag ni sku'i ⑦mi bang dul sogs pa brdung bsgreng ⑨ba rnams so / /de nas lto 'phye chen po rnams dang 'bab chu chen po rnams rang gi zer chu'i ⑩phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /de nas skye dgu'i bdag po rig byed 'don pa'i lag pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o/ /de dag gi shar phyogs su zla ba 'khor dang bcas pa padma dkar po dang 0bum pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa tshibri'o/ /nub sgor ni ki li ki 0la rang gi phyag rgya 0bri ste drag po skyerdo rje'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa bri'o⑩/ /byang sgor ni sgo srung ⑩gnyis bri bar bya ste/ de la gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnam thos kyi bu ni dbyug to'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa 3/bri'o/ /klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyi bu ni zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa 7bri'o/ /shar sgor ni khro bo'i rgyal po gnyis bri bar bya ste de la 'jig rten gu gsum rnam par rgyal ba ni rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa 0bri'o/ /be con sngon po can ni be con gyi phyag rgya du rtedang bcas pa 'bri'o/ /lho sgor ni thub par dka' tho ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa ④bri'o/ /mngon phyogs su ⑤ni rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa du ༅bri'o/ /'og logs su ni rgya mtsho dang rgya mtsho'i 'gram na ⑥sring mo bzhi rang gi phyag rgya dang bcas pa ( 3bri bar bya ste'u/ de la tum 0 bu ru'i phyag rgya ni dbyug to'o0/ /rgyal ma'i du)phyag rgya ni mdung thung 9rtse gsum pa'o/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i phyag rgya ni padma'o/ /mi pham ma'i phyag rgya ni 'khor lo'o/ /gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i phyag rgya ni rdo rje'o/ /sring mo bzhi'i lho phyogs su ni smin drug gi ④bu 'khor dang bcas pa mdung thung gi phyag rgya dang bcas pa dubri'o/ /byang phyogs su ni rig sngags 'chang gi burgyal po 87—85

rnams ral gri dang ras la sogs pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa ②bri'o/ /'khor thams cad kyi gnas ni thig ler bri'o/ /de dang de dag de ltar (0lhag mar ⑧brjod pa thams cad ni thig ler byas te/ thams cad kyang rdo rje drag pos byin gyis brlabs te bya'o④/ /dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bya ba de thams cad ⑤ni rdo rje drag po'i snying pos byin gyis brlabs te bya'o②/ /lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba ⑦las dkyil 'khor rnam par bkod ⑧pa'i cho ga'o/ /cho ga shes pas de lta ༅bur/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor mchog bris te/ /byin gyis brlabs pa byas nas su/ /rab tu bsgrims 8te mchod par 7bya/ /de nas bum pa zhabs mi gnagatso /kha yi cha ga shel kha can/ /mgrin pa ring zhing lto che ba/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga blang bar bya /sa bon rin chen sna lngas hunyebakang / /spos kyi chus kyang rab tu bkang / /kha rgyan yal gas khebs byas shing / /de bzhin 'bras bus kha bkang la/ /mgul chings 8kyis kyang bcings 8byas lam/ /kha dog ci rigs rnam par dgod/ /sgo bzhi po ni thams cad du/ /bum pa snga ma ci bzhin du/ /brgyad nyid du ni gsungs pa ste/ /dgu pa de ni bsang gtor ba⑩/ /rdo rje drag pos rnam kun tu//bsgrims te de ni sngags kyis gdabasko/ /bcu pa dbus su shes par bya/ /de ni 'khor los sgyur la dbulam/ /rta babs rnams ni mdzes pa ste/ /rin chen rnam pa bzhi las byari sta/ /yang na yid 'ong shing las bya/ /tsan dan yang na gzhan yang rung / /dum bu ma yin ma grugs pa/ /gas pa med cing 'dzer pa med/ /ba ru na dang sha ma nyedang / /sa la khri 0kang ka ta'ang 3nyerung / /rin chen dril bu rab dpyangs 34shing / /dar dang ras la sogs pas brgyan 3/ /khru ni brgyad dam bdun nam drug /me tog phreng dang ldan par 'dod/ /steng du rin chen 87—86

bla re bre/ /mu tig rgyan phreng rnam par dpyangs①/ /dar dang ras kyang dpyangs par ②bya/ /dkyil 'khor las ①ni che bar ④bya/ /kha dog sna tshogs ba dan rnams/ /phyogs bzhi dag tu dpyangs par ⑤bya/ /srad bu la ni brgyu 6)bar bya / /dril bu sgra dbyangs duldan par bya/ /kha dog sna tshogs gdugs kyi rnams/ /ci rigs par ni bri ⑧bar bya/ /rin chen bzhi las byas pa 'am/ /de med zangs las byas pa'ang rung / /mchod pa'i yon gyi lasnod bzhi zhig /blo dang ldan pas gzhag par bya/ /sna tshogs spos su gsungs pa ni/ /gur gum 7dang ni tsandan dang / /spri tunyeka la sogs ci yang rung / /srog chags yan lag kun mi rung ske/ /sna tshogs bdug 8pa dbul byas te0/ /a ga 8ru dang sgron shing dang //ga bur shi ri ba sa 48 /ce pog dang ni ru rta tsodang / /sā la'i shing gi thang chu 'amatshul/ /yang na thang shing thang chu dbul/ /rdo rje 'byung ba'i rig /nyepa 'am/ /rdo rje drag po yibazlas brjod bya/ /utpa la dang padma mchog /tsam pa ka dang klu shing dang / /ke (3 sa ra dang ma li ka /mya ngan 'tshang medang skya snar dang /ce /ta ka ra dang pu na ga /dong ku'i me tog mdzes pa yin/ /ka ra bī soster ku mu dadu snye/ /sna ma dha ④nu ka ri ④yi/ /me tog ci rigs dbul bar bya/ /de bzhin lha bshos sna tshogs te/ /'o thug zho nunyedang 'bras chan sum̐ 7dang / /mar dang sbrang rtsi rab tu bzang ske/ /bag chos chadang ni la du dang / /sbrang rtsi gzhag pa'i cung peng dang / /a sho brti be na ka /spyan gzigs khaṇḍar ( ༄grags pa dang / /shi re bhe rdu )snya ka mo ta0la/ /garjod ka ra ka dang ni/ /be reg dang ni dwo (rtetshe dang / /sha ku la dang par pa ta/ /'bru yi la thug du ste'abreng bu dang / /shun tha pa li ka dgedag dang / /gha ri ka budang swa sti duXka /mon sran gre'u 0zhu te'u dang / /rtsa ba dang ni drungs ga87wa 87

pa dang / /'bras bu sna tshogs dbul bar bya/ /sran tshod kha dog ldan pa dang / /sge'u gsher nges par dbul bar bya/ /sran tshod ril bu che chung dang / / sge ga ①na dang saṃ ②bha snyi / /bu ram bsres te byakhu sman dang / /rab tu bsgrims ⑤te byas pa dang / /bu ram sna tshogs btsos pa dag /kun du rnam pa thams cad dbul / /rnam pa sna tshogs zho dag dang / /zho bsrubs 6)bu ram btags ⑦des dbul / /'o ma legs par btsags pa dang / /de bzhin btung ba rnams kyang dbul / /kha ri'i (nyedabu ba kha ra dang / /mar dang bu ram 'bru mar dang / /sbrang rtsi dang ni lan tshwa dang / /dge bar grags pa dbul bar bya/ /btung ba bsgos pa ⑨byas pa dang / /tam bu 0la dang mal cha 0dang / /snod spyad bzang zhing mdzes pa dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs rtsi sman dang phonye/ /rab tu bsgrims 0te cho ga bzhin/ /byang chub sems dpa' skyob la dbul/ /de nas so so re re la'ang ④/ /na bza' ras zung re re dbul/ /me long mig sman yid 'ong dang //dung dang de bzhin gi 8wang rnams/ /byang chub tshogs ni bskang ⑩ba'i phyir/ /mgon po kun la dbul bar bya/ /skyob pa rnam pa tu thams cad du/ /de ltar legs par mchod byas nas/ /de nas sngags pas sbyin sreg bya/ /snying po cho ga bzhin du bya/ /sreg hu)blugs nyi shu rtsa gcig ni/ /cho ga bzhin du sbyin sreg ⑩bya//thams cad 'grub byed yid 'ong ba/ /zho ( byedang 'o ma sbrang rtsi'o/ /yi ge klog ⑥pa bzhi zhig du rtekyang / /phyogs bzhi dag tu gzhag par bya/ /de la shar phyogs bzhag pa ni/ /'phags pa shes rab pha rol phyin/ /byang phyogs su ni mdo bzhag pa/ /gser 'od dam par dam pas bzhed/ /nub phyogs su ni gzhag bya ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba yin/ /sdong po bkod pa'i tshul chen 87—88

ni / /lho phyogs logs su shes par bya/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams ci lta bar/ /de dag la yang gus par mchod/ /dam pa'i chos ni bklag (17pa 'di na / /bsrung ba rnams kyi dam pa yin/ /de nas lha rnams thams cad kyang / /de yi tshe na dgyes par 'gyur/ /gang dag 'jig rten mi srun pa/ /de dag phyogs phyogs 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de lta bas na rnam kun du/ /de tshe dam chos bklag dpar bya /slob ma thams cad bos nas su/ /de dag la ni skyabs gsum sbyin/ /sdig pa mi bya brjod par bya/ /sdom pa dag kyang 'dzin du gzhug /mkhas pas cho ga 'di bzhin du/ /byang chub sems kyang bskyed du gzhug /rdo rje drag po'i sngags chu yis / /de nas kun la bsang hrigator bya/ /dam tshig yongs su brjod byas la/ /mkhas pa ⑤nang du zhugs yinas su/ /gos rnams yongs su brje bya ste / /sngags kyis mngon du ⑧gdab par bya/ /de tshe snying rje ldan pa yis/ /slob ma de dag gdong bkab la(pe/ /'khor mos (7sgyur ba'i dam tshig gi/ /phyag rgya sngags pas 'ching bcug ste/ /lag tu me tog byin nyu1byas nas1rta/ /de tshe snying gar 1 yi ge bsam/ /skyob pa kun gyi spyan ④sngar ni/ /me tog de dag dor 15du gzhug /blo dang ldan pas slob ma yi/ /rna tshegayas rdo rje dril bu bzhag /rdo rje rnga zhes bya ba yi/ /lha mo chen mo 1 tshogayon par ro/ /me tog rnams ni gar bab pa/ /lha de de yi yin par 'dod/ /de ltar slob ma bcug byas nas/ /de tshe dam tshig bstan par bya/ /mkhas pas zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ /'di ltar sbyin sreg rab tu bya / /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa dang / /dbang dang de bzhin drag shul spyod/ /sbyin sreg las ni mdor bsdus pa18/ /sems dpa' 87—89

chen pos brjod par mdzod/ /cho ga thams cad rgyas pa dang / /de bzhin tha dad las kyang gsungs/ /sems dpa' chen po'i ①gnas gang du/ /me yi thab kyi khung bu bgyi/ / yam sreg ②shing ni ②ji lta bur/ /las ni ci zhig brtsam dupar bgyi/ /khyab bdag thab khung bka' 455 la/ /bdag gi the tshom dubasal du gsol / /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /sems dpa' chen po legs so legs/ /khyod kyis dri ba ⑥gang byas pa de dag thams cad brjod par bya/ /g.yeng ba med pa'i 4)yid kyis nyon/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i dbus su ni/ /sbyin sreg me thab khung bu bya/ /de tshad gtan la dbab pa ⑧ni/ /khru gang tsam ni ⑨brjod pa ste/ /mtho gang tsam zhig brkos ⑩nas su/ /dbus su rdo rje gzhag par bya/ /kha khyer yang ni der byas te/ /mkhas pas mdzes pa'i gzugs su bya/ /rtsa bas rtse mo (skyedakris pa yi/ /ku sha dag ni der dgram mo/ /de ltar kun du legs par yang / /sngags pas shin tu dgram par bya/ /ha cang mi nye mi ring bar/ /sbyin sreg me yi tshethab byas te0/ /tshul bzhin du ni byas nas su/ /der ni sbyin sreg brtsam ④par bya/ /ku sha sbams hu'usteng bdag 'dug ste/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams dran byas nas/ /de nas me ni 'bar byas la/ /de la bsang gtor bya ba tsamanyuste/ / de yi bya'og tu me der ni/ /me tog gcig cig gzhag par bya/ /de nas phyag rgya bcing bar bya / /rang gi phyag rgyas dgug hunyepar 'gyur/ /de la me yi phyag rgya ni/ /lag pa g.yas pa drang brkyang 7ste/ /mthe 2) bo mthe suchung drung du gzugs/ /sngags 'dis dgug par bya ba'o/rta/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe abhyaḥsarba thā 87—90

asna ①ye hā bya kā bya bā ②ha na ya swā hā/ blo dang ldan pas rig sngags kyis( tsho/ /de nas dgang blugs sbyin sreg bya/ /de la dgang blugs byin (genas ni/ /slob ma g.yon du gzhag par bya/ /de dag re re'i phyir yang ni/ /dgang blugs nyi shu lnga lnga bsreg /rnam pa sna tshogs las kyi rnams/ /'di lta bu dag rab byas te(snye//zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa dang / /dbang dang drag shul spyod pa'o/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'o mar bcas/ /mar dang 'o ma sbrang rtsi'o/ /rgyas la zho dang 'bras chan (67dang ske/ /gang dag gzhan nas stigasungs pa'o/ /drag shul spyod pa (0tsher mar (9)gsungs / /dbang byar ⑩ snga ma ci bzhin du/ /las 'dod 'jigs pa med rnams kyis/ /ci rigs par ni sbyin sreg bya/ /ci ltar rigs pa so so las/ /de dag la ni yon dgug hu'ego/ /yang na yid la gang 'dod pa/ /de ni ci bder sbyin par gyis/ /de yi tshe na slob dpon la/ /slob ma rnams kyis yon dbul lo/ /ma byin na ni dam 8tshig nyams8/ /dngos grub thob par mi 'gyur rol/ /dper na nyi ma zla ba gnyis/ /'jig rten mig tu mkhas pas 'dod/ /de bzhin skye bo 'di la yang / /slob dpon de ni mig 'drar 'dod/ /dper na me ④yi khams des 8ni/ /bud shing thams cad sreg par byed/ /de bzhin slob dpon shes par bya/ /mi shes bud shing sreg par byed/ /dper na chu yi khams de ni/ /'jig rten gdung ba thams cad gcod/ /de bzhin du ni slob dpon yang ske/ /gdung ba kun gcod shes par bya/ /dper na rlung gi khams de ni/ /'jig rten thams cad rtag tu bsgrub/ /de bzhin slob dpon slob ma la/ /dge ba ⑩rnam par sgrub par byed/ /dper na lus can thams cad la/ /sa ni rten du grags pa yin/ /de bzhin du ni slob dpon yang / /chos kyi rten du 87—91

'dod pa yin/ /dper na bcom ldan rnam snang mdzad/ /chos kun rtogs par khong du 51)chud/ /de bzhin slob dpon shes par bya/ /②dper na dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /gsang ba thams cad mthun par 'dzin/ /de bzhin du ni slob dpon ④yang / /'dir ni sngags kyi co gsang ba 'dzin/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bsngags shepa rnams/ /de ni rtag tu rjod 6)par byed/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi/ /bsngags ⑦pa chen po'ang rjod (8)par byed/ /dper na sangs rgyas mig 'dra ste/ /yang dag lam ni ston mdzad pa/ /de bzhin sngags ⑨pa 'jigs med kyang / /theg chen gnas 'di ston pa yin/ /bdag ltar sngags pa de bzhin te/ /slob dpon ci bzhin rgyal de bzhin/ /slob dpon gyi ni yon tan bzung 3 )/ /skyon rnams nam yang shigazung mi bya/ /yon tan 'dzin na grub par 'gyur/ /nyes pa rnams ni dngos grub nyams/ /slob dpon la ni smad byas na/rta/ /'jig rten dag na tshe thung zhing / /de bzhin ngan song 'gro bar 'gyur/ /nya pa la sogs rigs su skye/ /'di ni nyes kun 'byung gnas te//mkhas pas bla ma skur mi gdab/ /chos 'dod rnams kyis slob dpon la/ /rtag tu 6rgyun du mnyes par bya/ /gang na rgyal ba'i sras gnas pa/ /sa de mchod rten 'dra ba yin/ /der ni rgyal sras thams cad dang / /bdag kyang snying las chung ba tshayin/ /sbyin sreg las kyi medam pa 'di/ /dpa' bo khyod la brjod pa ni/ /sems can rnams la phan bzhed pas / /mgon po rnams kyis sngon chad 1 thobashad/ /sbyin sreg bya ba'i las rnams la/ /gang gis 'di ltar rnam shes pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas gsungs pa bzhin/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur / /lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba las me'i tshig le'ur byas pa'i rnam par 87—92

phye ba'o// //'phags pa lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba/ bam po bzhi pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /sangs rgyas snga mas bsngags 17pa yi /dbang bskur dkyil 'khor brjod par bya/ /khru gsum tshad gcig gzhag nas su//phyi rol dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /de yi tshad ni khru bzhi ste/ /dkyil 'khor logs su mngon phyogs bya/ /der yang sngags pas cha bsnyams rinashing / /kun du gru bzhi lham par bya/ /sngags pa ②sngags kyi tshul gnas te/ / me yi 54phyogs su 'dug byas la/ /de tshe byang du mngon phyogs te/ /cho ga bzhin du thig skud brizhen//snga ma'i gnas (yeni spangs nas ni⑦/ /dbang ldan phyogs su 'dug byas te/ /rlung phyogs spyod yul bar du ni/ /byang phyogs ngos kyi thig gdab po/ /rlung gi phyogs su 'dug nas su(de/ /lho phyogs logs (rtesu mngon bltas te/ /bden bral phyogs kyi bar du ni/ /nub phyogs ngos kyi thig gdab bo/ /de bzhin rlung gi phyogs spangs te/ /bden bral phyogs su 'dug byas nas/ /de nas shar phyogs mngon bltas te/ /sngags pas gsang sngags rjes dran zhing / / me yi 'iphyogs kyi bar du ni/ /lho phyogs ngos kyi thig gdab bo/ /cho ga 'di bzhin thams cad kyang / /gru bzhi lham par rab tu bya/ /mkhas pas thog ma nyid du ni / /nang rim cha brgyad byas nas su/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor tshul bzhin du'onyul/ /mkhas pas rim pa gnyis pa hu bya/ /dbus kyi padma mdor brjod na/ /'dab brgyad ze bar bcas pa ste/ /'dab /sema'i bar bar thams cad du/ /rdo 87—93

rje dag ni bri bar bya/ /de dag la yang snying po bri/ /rang gi snying pos bskul nas nime/ /phyogs skyong brgyad po de dag kyang / /ci bzhin gnas su rnam par dgod / /de la nang rol grwa rnams su/ /'jig rten skyong ba rnam par dgod/ /bgegs kun zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ /sgor ni bdud rtsi thab ②sbyor gzhag /dkyil 'khor lha la ci lta bar/ /der yang mchod pa rab tu bya/ /ras dang bla re dril bu dang / /gdugs dang me tog rnams kyang dbul/ /mu tig phreng sogs me tog phreng / /ci nus ci 'byor dbul bar bya/ /de la dbus su ni phyogs bcu rgyas par 'gengs pa'i rdo rje'i gzugs brnyan bri'o/ /rin po che sna bzhi'i bum pa rin po che dang / sman thams cad kyis bkang thub/ rin po che me btog dang / me tog kun du rgyas pa dang / 'od dpag med dang / mi 'khrugs pa dang / kun du bzang po dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / byams pa dang / sa'i snying pos byin gyis brlabs pa dag gis spyi bor dbang bskur ro/ /sngags pa padma dam pa der/ /rab tu bzhag nas bdag nyid kyis/ /me tog spos kyis ⑤mchod byas la/ /mar me mchod yon dbul bar bya/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang / /sil snyan sgra rnams phyung ba dang / /rol mo'i sgra sil snyan mang gis/ /yang dag mngon du dga' byas la/ /skyob pa kun gyi (yemangon sum du/ /bsgrims te de ni dbang bskur ro/ /ji ltar gling bzhi'i dbang phyug go⑦/ /'khor los dusgyur rgyal dbang bskur ba/ /de bzhin sngags pas ngo mtshar dang / /bkra shis kun gyis dbang bskur ro/ /me tog rnams dang bdug pa dang / /spos mchog rnams kyis yang mchod la/ /lag pa g.yas su rdo rje dang / /g.yon du 'khor lo bzhag nas su/ /slob ma de 87—94

la 'di skad du/ /rdo rje slob dpon khyod 'gyur ①te/ /de nas rdo rje ldan pa khyod / /rdo rje'i chos ni rab brjod pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis khyod lag tu/ /ting ②'dzin 'byung ②ba'i rdo rje byin/ /deng ④nas 'jig rten thams cad kyi/ /lag na rdo rje rdzu 'phrul che/ /sdang ba rnams ni tshar bcad dang / /bstan pa la ni gnod byed pa⑤/ /de dag gdul bar bya ba'i phyir/ /'dren pa rnams kyis ⑥rdo rje byin⑦/ /ci ltar 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal/ /bdag por bya phyir dbang bskur ⑤ba/ /de bzhin chos rgyal dbang bskur phyir/ /rdo rje blo ldan dbang bskur brjod/ /rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgya yis/ /de la bsrung ba ⑨bya bar byayi/ /slob ma rdo rje chos brjod layi/ /lag pas blang snyi/ba byas nas su/ /dkyil 'khor chen po der khrid la/ /dam tshig dag ni rnam bsgrags te/ /byang chub sems ni gtang 8mi bya/ /khyod kyis byams dang snying rje dang / /lag na 'khor lo gzhar mi btang ⑫/ /blo dang ldan pas thabs rnams dang / /rdo rje bzhag pa khyod kyis ni / /nam yang yongs su gtang tsomi bya/ /blo ldan ⑩byang chub sems dpa' dang //sangs rgyas dam tshig 'di yin te/ /ci ltar rang gi yonalus bsrungs pa(/3 de ltar khyod kyis 'di srungs tu)shig /de byas sangs rgyas byas gzo rdu )ba sangs rgyas sras zhes brjod pa yin/ /gzhan du na ni dam tshig nyams/ /rdo rje can du khyod mi 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'chang ba thams cad kyi/ /rigs ni byang chub sems yin te / /rtags ni snying rje yin zhes brjod/ /thabs ni dbang du bstan pa ste/ /rdo rje bzhag pa go cha bgos/ /rdo rje mtshon cha thogs pa yin/ /khyod la lha rnams phyag kyang 'tshal/ /khyod ni ⑥bsrung ba kun du byed/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yang / /rnam pa kun du bsrung ba mdzad/ /lag na rdo rje dbang 87—95

bskur ba ①las dbang bskur ba'i (kyerim par phye ba rdzogs sol// //de nas 'jam rab dpal ldan pa/ /ya mtshan gyis duni mig rgyas pas/ /rdo rje 'dzin la sku 'di skad smras/ / dpa' bo yigazi brjid chen po legs/ /khyod kyis dkyil 'khor gang bshad pa/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dam pa mchog /gang gis (pedangos grub thob tsho ste'agyur ba/ /gsang chen bcas pa yang gsungs shig /lha rnams thams cad so so dang / /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyi/ /phyag rgya dang ni sngags bcas pa'i/ /sbyor ba rnams kyis rab sbyor dang / /bsam gtan brtan 997bca' man ngag dang / /rig ⑩pa'i chos ni yang shod ciganyu1 /brtul zhugs dang ni spyod dang rtags/ /yul dang dus kyi rnam kun dang ske/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa dang / /de bzhin drag shul spyod pa dang / /'byung nyurtapo dag ni dgug pa dang / /nor yang tsorab tu dgug pa dang / /gsang sngags spyi yi mtshan nyid dang / /bye brag rnams kyang bshad par 8mdzod/ /'jig rten 'dir ni 'dor ba su/ /gzhan du 'gro ba su zhig gsungs/ /'di dang gzhan 'bras 'jig rten na/ /rnyed dka' rgyal bas rnam tsogasungs dang / /las ni gzhan gyis byas 'gyur la/ /'bras bu gzhan spyod 'gyur ba dang / /dkyil 'khor 'di dang sngags rnams kyi/ /'bras bu bdag la bshad par mdzod//sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnyed par dka'/ /mi yi lus kyang rnyed par dka'/ /gsang sngags 'byung ba rnyed par dka'/ /dad pa phun sum tshogs par ⑩dka'//sangs rgyas kun gyis de ring khyod/ /lag ⑩na rdo rje rdzu 'phrul che/ /bstan pa 'di yi bya ba la/ /gsang chen 'dzin par dgongs pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor 'di 87—96

yi bar dag gi/ /cho ga rgyas par bshad par mdzod/ /de skad ces smras pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag ①na rdo rjes 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis gang dris pa'i tshig 'di ni ②legs par smra ba (geste/de'i phyir 'jam dpal rab tu nyon la yid la zung ④shig /'jam dpal de la dkyil 'khor gyi gsang chen ni lha gang yin pa de kho bo yin no(nye/ /kho bo gang yin pa de dkyil 'khor yin no/ /lha'i gnas gang yin pa de kho bo'i gnas so/ /kho bo'i gnas gang yin pa de dkyil 'khor ro/ /dkyil 'khor la gnas pa ni gsang sngags te dkyil 'khor med ⑥par gsang sngags med del/ 'jam dpal gzhan yang dkyil 'khor gyi dugazugs yod pa dang gzugs med pa'o/ /de la gzugs yod pa ni ri mor bri ba'o/ /gzugs med pa ni bri ba ma yin pa'o/ /gzhan yang bri bar bya ba ni brir stirung ba'o/ /mi bri ba ni brir mi rung ba'o/ /gzhon nu de la bri ba tsom yin pa ni las thams cad bya'o/ /bri ba ni bya ba dang las kyi tsunyergyu tsam du zad de/ de ni pha rol dad pa bskyed 8pa yin la/ gcig gis ni lha'i gnas su byin gyis brlab hunyepar bya ba ste don gnyis bsgrub pa dang bya ba dang rnal 'byor tha dad pa ma yin pa'i dkyil 'khor skradang ldan pa'i dkyil 'chikhor ro/ /slob dpon las dang / bya ba dang / dus dang / byed pa dang /nus pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / bsam gtan du bya ba dang / man ngag dang /rnal 'byor thams cad dang ldan pa bdag 8la dbang thob pas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o/ /gzhon nu de la man ngag gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ slob dpon dang slob ma'o/ /slob dpon ni slob dpon gyi yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ /de ni de'i 87—97

spyod pa'i rjes su 'jug cing tshig bzhin du byed la mi slu ①ba'o/ /tshad ma de ni man ngag go/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa gzhan yang tshad ma gang zhe na/gang mdo sde dang gsang sngags kyi don mi slu ②ba dang por ①shes nas de'i ro myong ba dang don de shin tu chud pas de las mi nyams pa dang brtan par 'gyur ba dude ni chos nyid do zhes tha snyad 'dogs pa de ni man ngag bshad pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni gang gsungs pa ⑤de de bzhin te gzhan du mi 'gyur bas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi tshad ma ste de ni mi slu ba'o༅/ /de mngon par rtogs pa dang mngon sum du byas pa ⑦dang 'bras bu thob ⑧pa gang yin pa de ni chos nyid do/ /gzhan yang chos nyid de ⑨thob par byed pa'i rnal 'byor la sbyor ba nyid gang yin pa de ni rigs ⑩pa'o/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang yon tan 'di lta bu dang ldan pa'i sngags pa ni rgyal ba rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon du bzhed do/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni gsang chen 'di/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis sngon bshad de/ /gzhan du bri ba 'ba' zhig ni//rgyu dang 'bras bu bral ba yin/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang lha ni ⑩rnam pa gnyis te / 'bras bu'i ngo bo dang rnam par smin pa'i ngo bo'o/ /de la 'bras bu'i ngo bo ni chos nyid rtogs pa'o/ /chos nyid de mngon sum du 8thob pa snyi/gang yin pa ⑫ni 'bras bu'osnyi/ /'bras bu gang yin pa de rnam par smin pa'o/ /rnam par smin pa gang yin pa de ngo bo'o/ /ngo bo gang yin pa de tha snyad du lhung ba'o/ /tha snyad du lhung ba gang yin pa dang tha snyad kyi ngo bo gang yin pa de ni btags ⑩pa'o//de ni bya ba'o/ /bya ba gang yin pa de las so/ /chos nyid gang yin pa de la ni 'bras bu med/ mngon par rtogs pa med/ mngon sum du bya ba med/ rnam 87—98

par byang ba med kyang ①las dang rnam par smin pa'i sa la gnas pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'bras bu dang /thob ②pa dang / mngon par rtogs pa dang / rnam par byang ba ston to/ /gsung ②ngo / /brjod do/ /'dogs so/ /rab tu 'jog go/ /rnam par 'grel to/ /'chad do/ /tshul bstan pa sna tshogs kyis tha snyad 'dogs so/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang las dang rnam par smin pa med pa'i sa la gnas pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams rjodang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni 'jig rten 'di zhes bya ba dang / 'jig rten pha rol zhes bya ba dang / skye ba zhes bya ba dang / rga ba zhes bya ba dang / 'chi ba zhes bya ba rjodang / nad ces bya ba dang / rgyad pa zhes bya ba dang / phun sum tshogs pa zhes bya ba dang /'dus byas zhes bya ba dang / 'dus ma byas zhes bya ba dang / 'gro ba zhes bya ba dang / 'ong ba zhes bya ba dang / rig pa zhes bya ba dang / ma rig pa zhes bya ba dang /yi shes rab can (1)zhes bya ba dang / rtogs pa zhes bya ba dang /'dod chags pa ⑤zhes bya ba dang / zhe sdang zhes bya ba dang / gti mug ces bya ba dang / 'ching ba zhes bya ba dang / thar pa zhes bya ba dang / bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / sred pa zhes bya ba dang / de kho na zhes bya ba dang / yang dag pa zhes bya ba dang / mi slu ⑨ba zhes bya ba dang /mig ces bya ba dang / rna ba zhes bya ba dang / sna zhes bya ba dang / lce zhes bya ba dang / lus zhes bya ba dang / yid ces bya ba dang / gzugs zhes bya ba dang —/ sgra zhes bya ba dang / dri zhes bya ba dang / ro zhes bya ba dang / reg ces bya ba dang / sangs rgyas zhes bya ba dang / chos zhes bya ba dang / dge 87—99

'dun zhes bya ba dang / nyan thos zhes bya ba dang / rang sangs rgyas zhes bya ba dang ske/ rgyun du zhugs pa zhes bya ba dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba zhes bya ba dang ske/ phyir mi 'ong ba zhes bya ba dang / rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du bya ba'i phyir zhugs pa zhes bya ba dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba zhes bya ba dang ske/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon sum du bya ba'i phyir zhugs pa zhes bya ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba zhes bya ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ①mngon sum du bya ba'i phyir zhugs pa zhes bya ba dang / dgra bcom pa zhes bya ba dang ske/ 'dod chags dang bral ba zhes bya ba dang / bden pa mthong ba zhes bya ba dang / 'jam dpal gzhan yang lha zhes bya ba dang / klu zhes bya ba dang /gnod sbyin zhes bya ba dang / dri za zhes bya ba dang / lha ma yin zhes bya ba dang /nam mkha' lding zhes bya ba dang / mi 'am ci zhes bya ba dang / lto 'phye chen po zhes bya ba dang / mi zhes bya ba dang / mi ma yin pa (mizhes bya ba dang / skyes pa zhes bya ba dang / bud med ces bya ba dang / ma ning zhes bya bar (kye'adogs sol/ /'jam dpal de ltar na las dang rnam par smin pa med pa la gnas pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams stisems can gyi bsam sbyo pa tha dad pa'i sgo nas 'dogs (7pa mdzad do/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ gang nam mkha' lta bu'i chos de la ci ltar gdags pa'am rnam par rig par dzodamadzad/ lag na rdo rjes smras pa/ 'jam dpal las dang rnam par smin pa med pa'i sa nyid la gdags pa'am rnam par rig par mdzad de98)la/ 'jam dpal las dang rnam par smin pa med pa stong pa nyid yin la/stong pa nyid de la yang gcig ces bya ba'am gnyis zhes bya ba yokā'adogs te/ de 87wa 100

ltar grangs bstan pa rnams dang / ming gi brdar byas pa rnams kyis 'dogs pa mdzad pa la ltos/ 'jam dpal gzhan yang nam mkha'i khams las dang rnam par smin pa med pa ①yin na/ nam mkha' la yang sngon po zhes bya ba dang /ser po zhes bya ba dang / dmar po zhes bya ba dang / dog ces bya ba dang /yangs zhes bya ba dang / dag ces bya ba dang / ma dag ces bya ②bar 'dogs so / /'jam dpal de bzhin du las dang rnam par smin pa med pa'i sa la gnas pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'dogs pa mdzad de/ 'dogs pa de yang las dang rnam par smin pa med pas byas pa yin na/ byis pa so so'i skye bo phyin ci log tu gyur pa rnams kyis khong du ma chud par zad de/ de dag yang dag pa ①ji lta ba bzhin du mthong ba la gzhug pa'i sgo dkyil 'khor 'di rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs so/ /gsum ni 'dus par gyur pa las/ /sngags 'byung bar ni 'dir ④bstan to/ /phyag rgya'ang de bzhin 'byung ⑤ba ste/ /gzugs can ma yin bstan du med/ /rtag tu 'jig rten gsum rnams su/ /thogs pa med cing chod pa med/ /dper na gtsub kunastan brten gnas su/ /gtsub ⑧shing gtsubs ⑨pa byas gyur na/ /mi 0yis rtsol ba byas rgyu las/ /stobs dang ldan pa'i me 'byung ngo / /de bzhin gsum ni 'dus pa las/ /gsang sngags dang ⑩ni phyag rgya lnga/ /chen po dag ni 'byung 'gyur te/ /byung nas yid la hunyebasams pa yi8/ /las rnams byed par 'gyur ba 8yin/ /'jam dpal dper na/ rig sngags 'chang rnams kyis bsams ma thag tu lha'i zas dang / skom dang / rgyan dang / rta dang / glang po che dang / shing rta dang ske/ bud med dang / khang khyim dang / gzhal med khang la sogs 8pa 87—101

thams cad 'byung ngo ①/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du gsang sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / lha 'dus pa las thams cad 'byung ngo / /'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che skyon thams cad dang bral ba de ②med par ma gyur na de'i tshe gang bsams pa de thams cad ①'byung ngo du/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du sngags kyi tshul yang khong du chud par bya'o/ /'jam dpal gang gi tshe rang gi gzugs yongs su spangs ⑤te/ lha'i nga rgyal la duthe tsom ④med pa thob pa de'i phu)tshe gsang sngags kyi chos nyid des chos nyid ston te/ de'i tshe des tshig gis de'i rnam pa ston ⑨pa na bya ba nus par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal brten pa'i chos nyid ci ltar las 0byed nus par gyur pa hunyel ltos/ 'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na rgya la brten tunyenas rgya'i yonye'abur 'byung bar 'gyur te/rdzas med na yang rgya'i 'bur mi 'byung la yod kyang bya ba dang las dang bral na rgya'i 'bur mi 'byung ste/ 'jam dpal gnyis ka ④yang phan tshun du ltos 8pa dang bcas pa'i phyir ro/ /mis rtsol ba byas pa de las ci 'dir rdzas 'byung ba'amatso / 'on te las kyi bya ba de 'byung ngam tshugang yin te/ snga phyi 'gal ba'i phyir brten nas gsang sngags sam/ phyag rgya 'byung ba tsam la ma gtogs par 'byung ba med do/ /'jam dpal sems can rnams kyi hustenyon mongs pa ci snyed par byang chub sems dpa' gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rka/)sbyor ba yang de snyed du blta'o pya ske/ /'di la rgyal bar byed nus ( 3pa su yin zhe ༷ snyen/ phyag rgya dang /gsang sngags dang ldan pa'i so chos kyi dbyings kyis rgyal bar byed do/ /'jam dpal chos kyi dbyings nyid la rnam pa mang por brtags pa'i phyir te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'di ni gsang sngags so//87—102

'di ni phyag rgya'o/ /'di ni lha'o zhes rnam par gzhag par ①mdzad do/ /chos kyi dbyings de ni gzugs can ma yin pa bstan ⑧du med pa/ gzung ba ma yin pa / dkrug pa ma yin pa stedu/ de bzhin gshegs pas rten cing 'brel bar 'byung bar rnam par gzhag pas rnam par bzhag go/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i phyir bya ba thams cad byed do/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang ci ltar gzhan gyis las byas pa la ci ltar gzhan spyod ces gang smra ba de ni/ 'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na lha'i bu dbang phyug rang gi sems la dbang thob pa de 'dod pa bzhin du longs spyod sna tshogs la yongs su spyod par byed de/ 'di lta ste / lha'i khang khyim dang / gzhal med khang la sogs pa dang ④/ rta dang /glang po che dang / shing rta dang / bud med dang / bza' ba dang bca' ba la sogs pa mngon par sprul nas bdag kyang yongs su spyod cing gzhan dag la yang sbyin par byed deX/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de nyid kyis sngags de bsgrubs pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du gzhan gyis byas pa la gzhan yongs su spyod dol/ /'jam dpal gcig byed pa la mang po yongs su spyod pa'i rnam grangs yod deyi / dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'am zhing pa bzhin no/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang 'jig rten 'di 'dor ba ni su gzhan du 'gro ba ni su zhes gang (khesmra ba ni/ 'jam dpal gang gi tshe sems dang sems las byung ba'i tshogs 'dus byas kyi khams la gnas pa de'i tshe de 'jig rten 'di yin no/ /gang gi tshe sems dang sems las byung ba'i tshogs de nyid 'dus ma byas kyi khams la gnas par 'gyur ba ⑧de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams 'jig rten 'di 'dor zhing ⑨/ 'jig rten pha rol du 'gro'o ⑩87—103

zhes 'dogs te/ 'di ni chos nyid rtogs pa'i gang zag gi tshig bla dgas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos nyid ni 'dus ma byas kyi khams su rnam par gnas te①/de ni nam ( yang 'dus byas kyi dri mas mi gos so/ /'di lta ste/ dper na rdo rje ni zhu/'dam rdzab kyi rtog ④pa'i dri ma'i skyon thams cad kyis mi gos so/ /de bzhin du chos nyid de yang 'dus byas kyi skyon thams cad kyis mi gos so/ /'jam dpal byis pa so so'i skye bo'i ⑤'dus byas kyi khams su gtogs pa dag ni nyon mongs pa can gyi rgyud du lhung yib/ ngar 'dzin pa dang nga yir 'dzin pa las byung ba'i sems pas srid par skye ba rnams ④nyon mongs pa can rnam par sgrub po/ /de dag 'chi ba'i dus nye bar gnas te/ 'du byed kyi tshogs 'di 'gags pa'i tshe lha'o snyam mam(nya/ mi'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal nyid rgyud de'i rjes su 'brel to/ /'di lta ste/ dper na rab tu phyis pa'i me long gi dkyil 'khor la bzhin 3)blta ba'i mi nyu 7ni bdag gi bā/bzhin yon tan khyad par can 'di lta bus bzang mngo zhes sam/lha/ mi bzang ngo zhes rtog ④par byed kyis 8de dang tha dad pa yang ma yin tha 3stedad pa ma yin pa'ang 4)ma yin mod 8kyi 'on kyang 'khrul pa'i phyir sems la ngar 'dzin pa skyed 9/shedo/ /'jam dpal mthong ba'i 'bras bu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ gsang sngags rnams kyis 4 )dug dang rims la sogs pa sel ba'ol/ / tshe 'di ma yin pa'i 37'bras bu gang zhe na/ mngon sum dang / rtog pa'i dra ba dang bral ba bsam gtan rtogs pa'i 'bras bu thob pa ste/ rjes su dpag pa dang dpag par bya ba'i rtog ge'i yoyul las yang dag par 'das pa yid ches pa'i lung gis grub 2gepa dang / rnal 'byor dang / rigs pa dang ldan pa dang zhu / rang gis myong ba'i rnam pa du snyeni 'bras bu bubastan te/ 'di ni 87wa 104

tshe 'di ma yin pa'i ①'bras bu'o/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang drag shul spyod pa'i las smos shig ces gang smras pa ni bya dgos par 'gyur bas ②na khro bo nyid brtsam phurapar bya ste/ zhi ba'i sems dang / snying rje ④dang / byams pa'i rang bzhin dang ske/ rang gi las kyi 'bras bu la blta bas lha'i gzugs dang rang gi khro bo'i gzugs tha mi dad par sbyor ba dang ldan par byas pas6)/ me'i yang khro bo'i ⑥gzugs la cig shos kyang khro bo'i gzugs so/ /rang dbang ④sgyur ba'i ①khro bos sngags kyi 0ngo bos bkug la myur du brang ngam/ snying ga'am0/ mgo'am/lto'am / rked ⑩pa'am/ byin pa'am/ rkang pa'am/ rgyab bam(nya/ rkang pa g.yon pas mnan la srog chags thams cad dgod 8kyang rung / chags kyang rung cha/ rtse yang rung ⑫/ sdod kyang 8rung / lam du 'gro 3 7yang rung /nyal yang rung / 'dug kyang rung / 'greng yang rung / chu (steklung gi pha rol dpag tshad brgya na 'dug kyang rung / lha la sogs pas bsrungs kyang rung bdag la me sbar bas sreg 0blugs nyi shu rtsa gcig sbyin sreg bya'o/ /zhi ba la ni zhi ba ma zhi ba la ni sro )ma zhi bar gsungs so/ /de nas lag na rdo rjes rumathogs pa med pa'i ngag gi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang / bstan pa don yod par yang dag par bsgrub ( nyepar bya ba'i phyir yang tsosangs rgyas kyi gsung bkod pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje ting nge 'dzin de la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ de nas de'i tshe stobs mtshungs pa med pas ④chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa dam tshig chen po'i gsang sngags smras pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tsunyete bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe zhunyargyaḥ/ sarba thā badzra sa ma ya ṣṭṛ ke ⑦/ dam tshig gi rdo rje'i gsang sngags smras ma thag tu de 87—105

nas sangs rgyas kyi 'khor gyi ①dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad du dam tshig la 'jug pa'i rdo rje'i sgra 'ur zhes grags so/ /'di thos byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /de dag skad cig de nyid la/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyan snga ru/ /rdo rje mchog stobs gzungs thob bo /yang bdud bzhi pham par byed pa'i rnam par bsgyings pa'i byin gyis brlabs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te②/ bsrung ba chen po stobs po che stobs bcu'i gzi brjid las byung ba'i gsang sngags 'di smras so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā/ badzra gi ni/ badzra shu u la ni/badzra mu ta re/ ba li na ma a gra/ ma hā ba le/ nyi li hi mi②/ mi li mi lihri/shi lo shi lo/ ṭi lo ṭi lo/ ṭa ṭa le/ ma hā tsaṇḍibya/ kuyu sto yin/ shwe ⑦ta/padma mā (deli ni/ hi hi he he/ rakṣa rakṣaposte/ ma hā sa ma ya/ a nu ga te swā hā/de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor des mgrin gcig tu tshig smras pa/ kye ma bsrung ba dam pa 'di/ /gsang sngags rjes su spyod pa yi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /lag na rdo rjes rab tu brjod/ /de nas yang ⑩lag na rdo rjes yang 3skyedakyil 'khor gyi thabs thams cad kyi hunyegasang sngags kyi mdzod smras pa/na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā badzra a tsog dha ra/ a na lo bi boshwa saṃ bha ba swā hā/ rdo rje'i skeme lce chen po 'bar ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥsarba mu khe bhyaḥbyuṇḍi ⑩badzra artsi spha bla 1ra ṇa swā hā/ rdo rje 'od 'phro chen po'i rtso)sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ ma hā tsaṇḍa hurtebadzra ka ba tsa bi sku 2 )ra ba rgyu(lhag swā hā/ rdo rje go cha'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ(nya/ ma hā badzra a gra dha 0ri te dzo da chag 87—106

langs te rdo rje chen po gsang ba mtho ba'i tog rdo rje mthon po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ①lag na rdo rjes mnyam par bzhag ma thag tu de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rdo rje lhangs zhes bya ba'i tshig dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i ②yi ge'i snying po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzi brjid kyi stobs zhes bya ba de ①byin no/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ0ta ṭa ta ṭa/ sbo ṭa ya ⑤badzra saṃ kṛ rjota bi byu stidzi hā dunānta (shed ma ka spud ha si ta/ lo bo khyad ra ka ha ka ha/ tsu lu tsu lu/ muñtsa askyo hā (nyes na/ dā yinyer bi dā tsor/ badzra bklu0/ badzra e ga /badzra nee 8tra/ badzra sho 8tra/ badzra smra 0ṇa/ badzra des 8a nu tsa ra/ kyi: rā yiya si/ pra bi sha badzra pā ṇi skṛ da yo0 / ā 0bi sha ā 0bi sha / kurṇa kurṇa kurṇa ⑫pa ya ghurṇa pa ya(ste/ sarba zhuta thā ga ta ā budzñā ka ra/ pra dub ra/ dmas las badzā ku sheya hūṃ kṛ na/ta swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis lhangs zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i snying po gsungs ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje tshim zhing mgu ste rab tu dga' zhing 0yi dunyarangs nas/ de'i tshe rdo rje me zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes ting nge 'dzin 'di la (nyamanyam par bzhag ma thag tu de nas de'i tshe 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ kun du rab tu g.yos so'i /'gul / rab tu 'gul/ kun du rab tu 'gul to/ /rgya mtsho chen po thams cad kyang ④'khrugs/ rab tu 'khrugs/ kun du rab tu 'khrugs so9/ /ri'i rgyal po ri rab thams cad kyang 'gul/ rab tu 'gul/ kun du rab tu 'gul to / /chem chem/ rab tu chem chem/ kun tu rab tu chem chem mo/ /'jig 87—108

rten gyi khams thams cad kyang 'bar/ rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur par snang ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje yang 'bar/ rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu 'bar te/ 'jigs 'jigs lta chen po'i gzugs 'dzin la/ rdo rje'i mig las me lce 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcur snang bar byed cing / rdo rje 'jigs 'jigs lta chen po zhes bya ba'i khro bo 'bar ba/ rab tu 'bar ba/ kun du rab tu mched cing 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur pa mig gsum pa/ mche ba bzhi pa/ gad mo rta skad ①'byin pa/lus la glang po chen po'i pags ②pa khrag can gyon pa/ lag na rdo rje thogs pa phyung ngo / /yang ba spu'i bu ga ①thams cad dang / yan lag gi tshigs thams cad nas rdo rje khro bo thams cad mi sdug cing 'jigs su rung ba'i gzugs can ④lag na rdo rje thogs pa dang / kha dog tha dad pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du sgras go bar byed pa dang / lag na mdung rtse gsum pa ②thogs pa dang ske/ sdang ba thams cad skrag par byed pa dang / bdud kyi gnas thams cad rnam par 'jig par byed pa dang / 'cha' ba dang / rgod pa dang /'bug du'abug po'i sgra 'byin pa dang / rmug rmug po'i 0sgra 'byin pa dang /lag na rtse gsum gdengs pa dang / gtun rked ②nyag thogs pa dang ⑨/ lag na be con thogs pa dang / lag na ral gri thogs pa dang /tshu lag na tho ba thogs pa dang / lag na dgra sta thogs pa dang / lag na mtshon rtse gcig pa dang ske/ ka na ya dang / mda' bo che dang / 'khor lo dang / lcags mda' dang ske/ zhags pa dang / dbyug to yidang / lcags thag dang / khab 8'dra ba 'dang / gshol dang / rnga dang / 'khar 0rnga dang / dril bu dang / rnga 87—109

bo che thogs pa dang / gzi brjid can thams cad kyi gzi brjid mi snang bar byed cing de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam tshig la lta ①ba lhur len par bstan nas/yang gtsug tor nas khro bo'i rgyal po 'jig rten gsum rgyalas rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul las byung ba/ me lce 'bar bas lang long du gyur pa / thor tshugs can gsus ④'phyang po②/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i ñtsa)'jig rten gyi khams bcu'i tshad tsam gyi lus dang ldan pa rab tu 'jig pa'i dus kyi me dang 'dra ba dpral ba khro gnyer gyi rim pa can ri dgas kyi rgyal po'i pags (me༄pa khrag can gyi busmad g.yogs gyon pa/ bka' nod cing 'dug pa thodabastan to/ /yang dpral pa'i dkyil na 0khro bo'i rgyal po chen po gzhan khro bo hu7zla ba'i thig le zhes bya ba lag pa brgya stong du ma yod pa/ mig gsum pa/mche ba bzhi pa/ gad mo rta skad 8kyi sgra 'byin pa/ gshin rje'i gzugs 'dra ba khro bo'i g.yog 'khor brgya stong du ma dang ldan pa/ lag na mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs gyon pa/ sems can thams cad dbang du byed pa kun du bstan to/ /yang lag na rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas khro bo rdo rje be con chen po can lto ba spyang ki'i lto ba 'dra ba/ mig dmar ba/khros pa dang bcas pa/ an da rnyil ltar sngo ba/ lag na be con thogs pa/skrag nyunyepar byed pa drag pa3ste/ sdig pa'i pags pa'i tsosham thabs can ⑩sdigs mo byed pa bstan to/ /yang stobs mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ snyoms par zhugs nas khro bo'i rgyal po chen po 8stobs po che zhes bya ba lag pa bzhi pa/ spa gyen du 'greng ba mig ser ba mche ba bzhi pa dbyar gyi sprin 'dra ba lag na be con thogs pa lag na dgra sta thogs pa gsus 'phyang (3po 87—110

mig gsum pa stag lpags kyi ①sham thabs can rang gi lus ②me lce 'bar ba'i nang na 'dug pa bstan to/ /yang lag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i gom pas rnam par gnon pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ gom pa 'dor ba'i ①rdo rje chen po zhes bya ba'i khro bo spa bshor ④zhing gyen du 'greng ba/ gshin rje'i gzugs 'dra ba/ gdong gi dpral ba khro gnyer gyi rim pa can mig dmar ba / gad mo cher rgod (snyepa/ kha gdangs pa/ lag pa bzhi pa/ lag na mdung rtse gsum pa dang / rdo rje dang / 'khor lo dang / ral gri thogs pa/phyogs bcur blta ⑥ba bstan to/ /yang lag na rdo rje rdo rje drag po 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo ⑦rdo rje lu gu rgyud don yod cing thogs pa med pa/ 'jig rten gsum kun du rmongs par byed pa/ sems can thams cad la mi 'jigs pa bskyed ⑧pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad las byung ba/ mdog pri yang ku ltar sngo bsangs (7ma/rdo rje'i rtags can ma 7me lce'i phreng bas lang long du gyur pa/ bzhin yid (lhakhros pa 'dra ba/ lag na rdo rje'i lcags thag thogs pa/ bka' nyan pa lhur len pa/'khor pho nya mo khri dang ldan pa 'di bstan to/ /yang rdo rje rtse mo chos thams cad nges par rtogs pa/ stobs thogs pa med pa/ sems can sdang ba thams cad 'dul ba/ stobs che ba/ rdo rje'i rtse mo lag na thogs pa/ gdong khro gnyer gyi rim pa can bud med 'bring mo'i tshod tsam pa/ lag pa drug pa la malag na zhags pa dang / gtun 8shing dang / tho ba dang / gtun 8skad nyag dang /kha ba thogs pa dang li/ 'khor pho nya mo khri dang ldan pa bstan to/ /yang rig pa'i rgyal mo rdo rje'i khu tshur de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi khu tshur 87—111

las byung ba/ rdo rje'i rtags can rab tu 'bar ba 'od ⑨ston ku'i ⑤zla ba'i 'od zer 'dra ba/ mig gsum pa/ lha mo thor tshugs can ras dkar po'i sham thabs can/ lha dang lha ma yin gzhom par dka' ba thams cad rnam par 'joms pa bstan to/ /khro bo de dag gi snying po ni du'adi dag yin no/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā badzra dzā ④la/ a na la sam bha ⑤ba / tra ṭa tra ṭa/ sbo yiṭa ya sbo ⑦ṭa ya/ hūṃ kro dha niswā hā/ rdo rje 'jigs 'jigs lta'i 0sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā ho/ tree 0lo kya bi dza ⑩ya ha ha swā hā/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ma tha 8ma tha/ gro dhen du ti la ka swā hā/ khro bo zla ba'i thig le'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā te nī 8la badzra daṇḍa kyi: rā ④ya si ha 8na da ha ⑩bhañdza0/ ta thā ga 8ta sa ma ya ma nu sma ra ṇa hu)swā hā/ rdo rje be con sngon po can gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta dushā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā ma hā ba la rakṣa a beb lo ki ta 'badzra a dhi ka ha na bi dhwa ( nyen sa ya hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ stobs po che'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā ta thā ga ta no tso'o rya a na a tsob lo ki te ⑩badzra mar dha brjo smi ṣa nye/ hūṃ hūṃ pra dzā 0li ta myur dhi 6)swā hā/ rdo rje gtsug tor gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā/ bha dug ba ༄nyute badzra thi dukha le 0ban dha ④ban dha.a/ mos moskyog so ko tsa ya saṃ ko tsa yal/ sarba sandi hri rdunyeb ra de swā hā/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā bhinda ginadu/ sarba duṣṭa zhun maḥbya87—112
