po zhi ba'i blo gros kyis/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so / /'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ji ltar tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin/ ji ltar 6)brtul zhugs la gnas pa yin/ ji ltar spyad pa spyod pa yin/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa'i ②spyad pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang du naganas pa de ④yongs su mi nyams pa'i chos can du 'gyur ba dang / gsang sngags rnams la dngos grub thob ⑤pa dang / theg pa chen po las yongs su mi nyams par 'gyur/ de skad ces smras pa dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba'i blo gros la 'di skad ces smras so/ /zhi ba'i blo gros legs so legs so yang legs so/ /zhi ba'i blo gros khyod de'i phyir legs par dunyon la yid la zung ④shig dang / kho bos khyod la bshad do(kyi/ /zhi ba'i blo gros gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa 6)gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod la nyu rmebadag nyid rang gi lha'i gzugs su byas la the tshom med pa'i yid kyis/ nga rgyal bskyed cing 'gro yang rung / 'greng yang rung / 'dug kyang rung / nyal yang rung / rtag tu dus thams cad du bskyod kyang mi g.yo ⑩ba de'i tshe/ zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i hu)tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin no/ /gang gi tshe des ltas bstan pa de'i tshul dang mthun par bya ba byed pa dang / de'i rnam pa bsten 8pa dang / rnal 'byor la brtson pa de'i tshe brtul zhugs tshal gnas pa yin no/ /gang gi tshe brtul zhugs 8de la bzlas brjod dang / sbyin sreg la sogs pa'i las spyod pa de'i 0tshe spyad pa spyod pa yin no/ /lha'i gzugs de dang 87—215

tha mi dad pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson zhing gang gi tshe bslab pa'i gzhi rnams kyang yongs su bzung ste/ theg pa chen po la spyod pa de'i tshe gsang sngags rnams la dngos grub 'thob bo/ /zhi ba'i blo gros gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu mtshan ma med pa la gnas par bya'o/ /zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa la 6)ci ltar mtshan ma med pa la gnas pa yin zhe na/ zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub kyi sems bsgoms na mtshan ma med pa la gnas pa yin te/ zhi ba'i blo gros gang la mtshan ma rnams mi 'byung zhing thams cad kyi thams cad du med cing ⑧mi dmigs sol/ /zhi ba'i blo gros sems mi dmigs pa'i phyir sems kyi sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha'i ngo bo nyid dmigs su med do / /de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa'i ⑦spyad pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpas ①rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par ⑥byang chub kyi sems yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir brtson par bya'o/ /sems can rnams la phan bzhed pas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis ⑦bcas pa yi/ /brtul zhugs dang ni tshul khrims dang / /spyod dang bslab 6)pa'i gzhi rnams la/ /gang tshe gnas na de yi ṇitshe/ /sngags pas 'di ltar sngags grub ⑩bo/ /rtog dang bral ba'i ye shes ni/ /sngon gyi rgyal bas ⑩mngon sangs rgyas/ /rtog dang bral ba de la ni/ /gsang sngags 'grub par bstan pa yin/ /de yi 'bras bu rnam dag pa/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal 'gyur/ /gang zhig rtog la gnas byed pa/ /de la dngos grub mi 'byung ngo / /de lta bas na rtog 7spangs la/ /sngags kyi gzugs ni bsam par bya /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa 87—216

gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi don dang phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir/ byis pa rtse ba'i spyod pa'i ①gar rnam par dag pa'i mdzod ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas ting nge 'dzin de la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor des ②mgrin gcig tu tshig smras pa/ phyag 'tshal mchog rdo )sbyin rdo rje mchog④ /'jam pa'i dbyangs can stobs po che/ /dpa' bo chen po cher grags pa/ /ma dul rtag tu 'dul mdzad pa/ /sngags dang gsang sngags spyod pa dang / /rnam pa kun du gyis rtsen dang / /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs rnams dang / /bsam gtan bsam gtan byed rnams kun/ /bdag cag rnams la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba/ /gsang sngags shes pa che 'byung ba/ /dkyil 'khor chen po gtsor gyur pa/ /spyod pa kun du bstan ⑤pa'i gzhi/ /dkyil 'khor 'di 6)ni bshad du gsol/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas/ gzod stim nas skye ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs tel/ rang gi snying po rdo rje chen po'i yi ge smras pa tshor/na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā yib ra da badzra mo11ri/ de nas dam pa sbyin pa'i rdo rje'i snying po chen po 'di smras ma thag tu thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de ngo mtshar du gyur nas/ mgrin gcig tu kye ma dam pa sbyin pa'i rdo rje tso'adi ni sngon gyi spyod pa las byung ba'o zhes smras so/ /yang 'jam dpal gyis rang gi dam bcas pa'i rdo rje'i yi ge /nyesmras pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā he he ku mā yir ka /badzra badzra sma ra sma ra pra ti dzñā 8swā hā/ 'jam dpal gyis yang rang gi ngag yang dag par grub pa'i 87—217

gzhi'i gsang sngags 6)smras pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/sarba thā bā kye da tā (7re ku mā (gur rū 8)pa dha ra swā hā/ yang 'jam dpal gyis rang gi ngag yang dag par grub pa'i sgo'i gsang sngags smras pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā bā kye da badzra te swā hā/ yang ⑤'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas/ rang gi ngag gi don sgrub par byed pa'i gsang sngags smras pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā bā kye da badzra ko bi da swā hā/ yang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas khro bo'i rgyal po chen po rdo rje mtha' dang bral ba (7smras pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ / sarba thā haṃ tsho7)badzra tī niswā hā/ yang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas rang gi pho nya mo'i tshogs kyi snying po smras pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ / sarba thā badzo spub ki ṣi ⑩ni swā hā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā badzrata 7ka ke shi ṇi hunyes hā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te 'abhyaḥ/sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā su ma ti brdzu 0ṇi swā hā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā tsi tā snyikṣi badzre tī yiswā hā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā ā kuṇḍa ṇi badzrata ⑩shi swā hā/ de nas 9/nyeyang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas rang gi rdo rje mchog gi dkyil 'khor smras pa/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po (7ni/ /kun du gru du bzhi lham pa la/ /rdo rje mtshan rtags ( nyamatshan ma can/ /de yi dbus su bya ba ni/ /gru gsum rnam par gnas pa ste/ /gru gsum lta bur gzhag par bya/ /me 0las byung ba'i dkyil 'khor bri/ /tshon ni kun du dmar po ste/ /rdo rje 'bar bcas mtshan ma can/ /de yi cha gsum gzhag nas su rte/ /utpal yi gzugs bris te/ /de 6 )yi steng du rdo rje 87—218

bri4) / /'bar dang bcas shing thig ler mdzes/ /tha ma thog thag bya ba ni/ /utpal gzugs kyi (7phreng ba'o/ /sngags pas de yi dbus su ni/ /gzhon nu byis pa'i gzugs ldan pa/ /mgo la phud pu lnga gzhag pa/ /sha mdog gur gum (gu'adra ba bzhag /lag pa g.yon pa na utpal ④rdo rje dang bcas pa thogs shing g.yas pas dam pa sbyin pa'o/ /yang na phyag rgya'i gzugs so/ /yang na yi ge'o//de yi phyag rgya (mibri ba ni/ /utpal yirab tu bzang po ste/ /de yi steng du rdo rje bri//'bar dang bcas shing thig les mtshan/ /de'i g.yas rol du snying po rnams gzhag go/ /g.yon rol du pho nya mo rnams gzhag go(7/ /'og rol du khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje mtha' dang bral ba'o⑧/ /lho phyogs su ni byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'o/ /nub phyogs su ni nam mkha'i snying po'o/ /byang phyogs su ni byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po 'khor dang bcas pa ste/cha byad ji lta ba bzhin du gzhag pa'o6)/ /yang na phyag rgya rnams so/ /yang na yi ge'o / /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas snying po mchog 'di'i bobasgrub pa (nyesmras pa/ de la byang chub tu sems bskyed pa/ dbang bskur 3geb/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa/ sdom pa blangs pa/ rig pa'i brtul zhugs 3)spyod pas gnas khang ngam/ phug dben pa'am/ lhugs yimed par snying po 'di lan sum 'bum bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de nas ur mo'am/ lcags sna gsum mama'i/tsandan las byas pa'i ral gri'am/ 'khor lo'am/ lcags kyu'am/ be con nam / dgra sta'am/ mdung thung ngam/ zhags pa'am/ mda' bo che gang yang rung ba zhig ⑩ba'i rnam lngas bkrus la yang spos chus bkrus te/ ba lang gi lci ba'i phung po'i steng du gzhag la 'khor los sgyur ba chen pos bsrung bar bya'o/ /87—219

tha mar de nyid du mchod pa rgya cher ①byas la/ ba lang gi lci ba sa la ma lhung bas dkyil 'khor la (mibaskus la / dam pa sbyin pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pas / a ga ru'i yam sreg shing zho dang sbrang rtsi las ④sgyugs pas mtshan thog thag sbyin sreg byas na/ nam phyed dam nyi ma shar (nyakar mtshan ma chen po dag 'byung zhing rdzas kyang 'gyur te 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de thogs nas ⑥rig sngags 'chang du gyur ⑦te/ yid ltar mgyogs (7pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan du mar rnam par rgyu ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa byed pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag gi gzungs thob pa dang / nyi ma shar ba lta bu'i mdog can dang / rga (1)ba dang 'chi ba rnam par spangs pa dang /sems can thams cad kyi don byed par 'gyur ro/ /smon lam gyi dbang ma gtogs par lus de nyid kyis byang chub kyi snying po la gnas kyi bar du sa gnon no( ) / /rig /skyesngags 'chang gzhin nu'i gzugs dang ldan paturnye/ dam pa sbyin pa'i rdo rje'i mtshan ma can lha la sogs pa thams cad kyis phyag byas pa'amanyunye/ma dul 8ba 'dul ba sna tshogs gzugs can gyi nor bu dang 'dra ba/ rig sngags 'chang bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma'i g.yog 'khor 3nadang bcas par (nyayid las byung ba'i khang pa chen po na gnas pa/ de mthong bas rig sngags 'chang rnams hu 7mi dbul po dang 'dra bar sems shing bdag cag (nyekyang de bzhin du gyur cig ces smon lam 'debs par 'gyur ro/ /ma bsgrubs kyang las su 'gyur te/ nyin gcig bzhin du tsho/rjes su dran par byed na/ mtshams (3 med pa lnga 31la sogs pa'i (srilas rnams kyang samibyang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyin gcig bzhin du nyi ma shar kur ( ciphyag rgya bcings te/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas khunyebarjod byas ( sgye87—220

zhag bdun mi shas ①sbyin sreg byas na ②sha zas zin pa la bltas pas gtong bar 'gyur ro/ /ne'u le'i spu las lan drug stong sbyin sreg byas na sha za thams cad dbang du 'gyur toni/ /'byung po thams cad kyang ④dbang du 'gyur ro/ /lug nag po'i bal mar la smyugs pas ⑤lan 'bum sbyin sreg byas na bud med dbang du 'gyur ro/ /sha za mthong bar 'dod na dur khrod du ba lang gi ko ba tsam gyi dkyil 'khor byas la nya la sogs pa'i gtor ma byas te/ kha shar phyogs su bltas la mi'i skra khrag la yisgyugs pas lan brgya (7stong (8)sbyin sreg byas na sha za thams cad 'ong bar 'gyurapo)/ 'jigs par mi bya bsrung bar mi bya'o/ /'di skad du khyed tsonga'i dbang du 'gyur ro ⑩zhes brjod par bya ste/ de bzhin du gyur cig ces smras nas mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyin gcig bzhin du de la 15ti na ra tunyelnga lnga sbyin par byed deyi/ de dag kyang 'god par bya'o/ /mdzub mo la lan bdun bsngags pas tsosprin zlog tshugo/ /thal ba la lan bdun bsngags 17pas smra ba rengs 8par 'gyur ro6)/ /yungs zhi )kar la lan bdun bsngags 21pas ri 'gul bar 'gyur ro/ /ma (gel ta'i me tog gam/ ku ti dza'i /me tog la lan bdun bsngags pas tsobud med gang gis bsnams sam/ gang la byin nam/gang gi mgor 6)bor ba (9de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin mo dbang du 'gyur dubar 'dod na dur khrod du slong ( shemo'i zas bza' zhu)zhing sngags bzlas brjod bya'o/ /der skam sar ba lang gi ko ba tsam gyi dkyil 'khor byas la gtor ma rgya cher bya'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang (3 gis shing arka'i (7yam sreg shing khrag la smyugs pa (nyelan bdun stong sbyin sreg byas na gnod sbyin mo'i gzugs zhu/mi sdug pa 'ong bar 'gyur te/ de la 'jigs par (stemi bya bar rig pa dran par 87wa 239

byas la 'dug cig 'dug cig 6)ces brjod par bya'o/ /de dam pa rnam pa ②gsum las zhugacig sbyin par (4)byed de'abye/ ma'am sring mo'am chung mar 'gyur ro//mar gyur na ni bu bzhin du dgos pa thams cad byed deyi/ sring mor gyur na ni nyin gcig bzhin du ti (penar re re sbyin par byed do/ /chung mar gyur na ni de dang lhan cig rtse'o/ /lo lnga brgya thub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis 'khor lo de (8)bsgrub po)pa yin te/ sngar spyad pa byas pas mgar ba gtsang ma gso sbyong bzung ba/ yan lag ma tshang ba med pa la ur mo'i 'khor lo byed du bcug la sor brgyad pa me lce 'bar bas bskor bar yibya'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis huḥ'akhor lo de ba'i tu)sna lnga'i nang du bcug ste zhag gcig gzhag go/ /de nas phyung la bkrus te bskus (3la/ ras gtsang mas dkris te ⑫de'i 'og tu mdun du gzhag la mchod pa dang gtor ma byas te/ mchod yon gyi snod blangs la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis lha thams cad spyan drang ngo / /de dag la yang mchod yon phul la yang rtsa ba'i sngags kyis slar gshegs par bya'o/ /thal ba la lan bdun bsngags btab 8pas thal ba'i ra bar 'gyur ro/ /rtswa'i tshume la lan bdun bsngags tu )pas me'i ra bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas cho ga bzhin bsrung ba tsobyas te/ yungs kur la lan bdun bsngags hu)pas sa bcing ngo / /chu la lan bdun bsngags zhu )pas nam mkha' bcing (1ngo / /de nas sngags pas mchod yon gyi snod ( 3spos chus bkang ste( nye/ me tog dkar po bcug pas rtsa ba'i sngags kyis rang gi ( )lha spyan drangs la mchod yon phul te ( nyestan la gzhag la yongs su rgyas par byas te ṭa nyemar dang sbrang rtsi dang 'o ma'i sreg blugs thog mar lan bdun sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas sngags pas 'khor lo lag pa gnyis mas blangs la 'bar gyi 87—240

bar du bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de nas rnga 6)sgra grag par 'gyur ro/ /'brug ni na/di ri ri zer ro/ci /mar me'i ①me lce ring por 'gyur ro/ /'khor lo yang 'gul lo//nam mkha' las kyang rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /khyod 'khor lo 'di grub pa dang / khyod byang chub kyi lam du zhugs pa dang / khyod srid pa'i rgya mtsho las rgal ba legs so zhes sgra grag ④par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sngags pas la gor la gor du lag na rdo rje 'ong gi (gebar du bzlas brjod bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje 'ongs nas skyosgrub pa po la bu khyod bdud kyi dpung las rgyal ba dang / khyod byang chub kyi lam du zhugs pa de tshulegs so zhes smra bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas lag na rdo rje'i lag pa g.yas pas sgrub pa po'i spyi bo la nyug go/ / byugs pa 8)de'i mod la rigs kyi bu de'i mdun du gzhal med khang rgyar dpag tshad stong yod pa9ri/ dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba dpyangs 7pa/ gser (nyaskud 42bres pa/ mu tig gi phreng ba bres pa/ anda 8rnyil dang / mthon ka chen po dang / padma rā ga chodang /margad tsochen po dang / dri mchog dang / rin po che'i khyad par gzhan dag gis kyang mdzes par byas pa/ rdo rje sna tshogs bkod pas 9rnam par bkram pa lha'i bu mo'i tshogs dang / rig ⑩sngags 'chang la sogs pas mdzes 1)par byas pa la sogs pa tu)de dag kyang / glu len cing sgra snyan pa'i pi bang ri dang / rnga dang /gling bu dang / pheg rdob pa byed pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ste/ /de nas rig pa'i rgyal po'i mthus 'phags pa lag na rdo rje nyid kyi zhu lag pa g.yas pas sgrub pa po ṭa stebazung ste/ gzhal med khang du 'jug shustecing rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa ltar song shig ces smra bar ( ge'agyur ro/ /de nas rin rig 2 sngags 'chang gi 'khor los lu sgyur ba 'gro ba thogs pa med par gyur nas/khe/ khro bo'i 87—241

rgyal po chen po 6)de'i mthus rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur ba thams cad kyi bdag por 'gyur ro/ /de nas lag na rdo rjes rig sngags 'chang de gzhal med khang du bzhag nas mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po 'khor (snyerig sngags 'chang bye ba phrag du mas yongs su bskor nas/ rig ①sngags 'chang gi rgyal po du ma la phyag 'tshal zhing ri mor gobyed la mchod pa byed cing / mdun ⑤na rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los yisgyur bas tshuthams cad la bsgo zhing 'gro'o/ /khro bo 'di ni dam pa dpal dang ldan pa/ rtag tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rjes su 'brang ba/ las thams cad byed pa ste bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyis las thams cad byed do/ /'byung po thams cad skrag par byed do / /dgug go/ /dbang du byed do/ /skam ⑧par byed do/ /gnod po)par byed do/ /rig sngags 'chang thams cad ⑩ci 'dod pa de thams cad sgrub bo/ /ci ste bzhon pa bsgrub par 'dod na de yinas ngang pa'am glang khyu pa'am/ rma bya'am / nam mkha' lding ngam/ glang po che'am/ rta'am gang yang rung ba zhig byas la/ ri mo mkhan gso hu)sbyong bzung ba ri mo 'drir gzhug ⑩ste/ ri mo'i ⑫gzugs nub phyogs su bstan la gzhag ste7/ mchod yon ⑩rgya cher byas la mar me yang 'bul zhing bsrung ba'i cho ga yang yo)byas la u dum bā ra'i tunyeyam shing tu)bsreg cing so )stong yang ( nyesbyin sreg bya'o/ /spos chus lha spyan drangs la ⑤slar gshegs su gsol nas mchod yon dbul lo/ /mchod yon phul nas bzhon pa gang yang rung ba zhig lag pas mnan la 'bar gyi bar du bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de nas sngags pas chal gor la gor ( stedu bzlas brjod bya'o/ /gal te ngang par gyur na de'i dngos grub kyi mtshan ma ni ngang pa byasgra 'byin to/ /khyu pa ni ngar ro//87—242

rma bya ni lhung lhung zer ro/ /nam mkha' lding ni 'phur ro/ /glang po che ni sgra ngur ngur ①zhes zer ro/ /rta ni skad tse ②re re zer ro/ /'di dag gi mtshan ma ni 'di dag ①yin no/ /ngang pa la zhon na mi mjed ④kyi bdag po tshangs pa gnyis par 'gyur te/ tshe bskal pa mchog pas kyang mchog thub par 'gyur ro/ /khyu pa la zhin na lha chen po gnyis par 'gyur ro/ /rma bya la zhon na smin drug gi bu gnyis par 'gyur te/ dpa' zhing pha rol gnon pa chen po dang ldan pa tshe bskal pa chen po thub par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe shi 'phos na (snyede'i tshe bram ze'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur te⑨/ tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste nam mkha' lding bsgrubs la de la zhin na khyab 'jug gnyis par 'gyur te9)/ tshe bskal pa (8 stethub par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe shi 'phos pa de'i tshe shing sā la chen po lta bu'i rigs su skyes par 6)'gyur te/ tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste glang po che grub cing de la zhon na brgya byin gyi brtson 'grus dang ldan par yo )'gyur zhing /lha'i rgyal po byed la nad med pa dang / mdzes pa dang / lha mo rnams dang rtse bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe shi 'phos pa de'i tshe shing sā la chen po lta bu'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur te/ tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste rta bsgrub cing de la zhin na nyi ma gnyis par 'gyur te/ mthu che zhing tshe bar gyi bskal pa thub par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe shi 'phos 7pa de'i tshe shing sā la chen po lta bu'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur tetunye/ tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste rdo rje bsgrub par 'dod na zangs sam/ a ga ru'am/ tsandan nam/3) tsandan dmar po'am/thang shing ngam/ seng ldeng ngam/ shing banda'amayi/ shing nim pa'am/ shel lam / sgron shing las rdo rje rtse gcig pa sor brgyad pa'am/ sor bcu drug pa 87—243

mgar ba'am/ shing mkhan gso sbyong bzung 0)ba byed du bcug la ba ser mo'i sna lngas bskus 67te/ zla ba yar gyi ngo tshes bcwa (kyelnga la bcom ldan 'das kyi (pemadun du mchod pa rgya cher byas la gtor ma yang byin te/ rdo rje spos chus bkrus la byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bdag phul te/ smon lam btab la khro bo'i snying po brjod de mchod yon gyis lha spyan (5)drangs la mchod yon dang stan phul te/mar dang sbrang rtsi'i sreg blugs lan bdun sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas sngags pas lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje blangs la 'bar zhing sgra tsig tseg (6)mi zer gyi bar du bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de nas sngags pas la gor la gor du (7)bzlas brjod bya ste58 / shar phyogs nas khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje mtha' dang bral ba (9)pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyis yongs su bskor la/ rig pa bye ba phrag dgus yongs su bskor zhing yi'ong gi bar du bya'o/ /rig pa de re re la yang 'khor bye ba phrag lnga brgyas yongs su bskor ba'o(1lha/ /rig pa'i rgyal po de lag pa g.yon par yirdo rje bzung ste/ lag pa g.yas pas sgrub pa po la snyan cing zab pa'i sgras tsodabugs 'byin cing / gzi brjid nyi ma ltar 'bar la lha thams cad kyis ni mchod me tog gi char ni 'bebs shing 'ong ngo / /de nas sgrub pa pos 'ongs pa la mchod yon dbul lotsho dī/ /stan yang dbul lo/ /smon lam btab la bcom ldan 'das thugs brtse bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po tshulag pa g.yas pas sgrub pa po'i mgo la reg par byed cing 'di skad du bu yici bya zhes smra'o/ /de nas sgrub pa pos mchod yon phul la pus mo gnyis btsugs te bdag la rdo rje'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ des bdag khyod kyi tsho)bka' drin gyis brtson 'grus 87—244

chen po dang / stobs chen po dang ldan zhing rig sngags 'chang gi 3)rgyal por gyur ②te/ rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi bdag por 'gyur bar shes (5)par bya'o / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sgrub pa po la bu khyod kyis 'a༄rdo rje 'di grub ste / brtson 'grus dang pha rol gnon pa dang ldan zhing rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po thams cad kyi rgyal po chen por 'gyur ⑤zhes brjod par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje ci lta bar mdung thung la sogs pa bsgrub pa'ang (6)de bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mtha' dang bral ba'i (7)cho ga zhib mo thogs pa med pa rdzogs so58) //de nas byang chub sems dpa' lag 5)na rdo rjes/ byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba'i blo gros la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye sems dpa' chen po rdo rjes 3 phodabang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor yod de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de yi/kho bo gcig pu la bshad do/ /yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa (rtechen po'i tshe/bstan pa dang gsang ba'i ()yang ches gsang ba/ gsang chen dam pa/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang rnam par mi rig na/ gzhan 'jig rten pa rnams kyis lta smos kyang ci dgos pa gsang ba dam pa 'di yang kho bo la gtad de/ zhi ba'i blo gros mchog tu gsang ba chen po'i 'dakyil 'khor gang zhe tson 'di lta ste/ rdo rjes yidabang bskur ba zhes bya'o/ /'dis rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba dang bcas pa ma lus pa 'di mtha' dag khyab ste/ zhi ba'i blo gros 'dis sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang ma khyab pa med do/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba'i blo gros kyis tunyebyang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la (she'adi skad ces smras so/ /kye 17sems dpa' chen po gang gis byang chub sems 87—245

dpa' sems dpa' hu)chen po dag mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di lta bu dag thos ②nas/ sems can rnams kyi don byed par 'gyur ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i skye bo rnams la bltas nas bstan pa gnas par 'gyur ba'i don du ①mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor de bshad du gsol/ de skad ces smras pa dang / lag na rdo rjes byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba'i blo gros la 'di skad ces smras so/ /zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa ④gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams thabs sla ba gang gis don chen po byed par 'gyur ba mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor de nyon cig /zhi ba'i blo gros thog ma nyid du slob dpon gyis sa gang yang rung ba zhig yongs su bzung ⑤la dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o/ /sa de byang chub kyi yisems kyis sbyang bar bya'o/ /dmigs pa'i tshul la gnas nas su/ /sngags pas ⑦gang zhig gzhan du byed/ /de la dngos grub myur mi 'gyur/ /dngos grub nyid kyang mi 'thob bo/ /zhi ba'i blo gros (shenyon cig /dkyil 'khor dam pa mthong nas ni/ /gang gis dngos grub thob gyur pa6)/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal po dgod pa ni/ /brtul zhugs bzang po khyod la bshad/ /dam tshig don du lus can la/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis yibashad/ /de bri 7cho ga bshad par bya/ /nges par bsgrims te mnyan par gyis / /khru lnga kho ra khor yug la/ /stegs bur bcas pa'i sgo bzhi gtod8/ /de nas sngags pas 'o bya ba ni/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa gnyis su dbye/ /nub phyogs sgo nas gzhug yopar bya/ /yang na byang phyogs sgo nas gzhugatso /snying rjer ldan pa'i yid kyis su/ /kho ra khor yug de bzhin bya/ /nang du zhugs nas sngags pa yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dran byas la/ /sems can rnams la 87—246

phan 'dogs pas/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal po bri bar bya/ /zhi ba'i blo gros 6)nyon cig /dkyil 'khor rgyal po dgod pa ni/ /ci ltar sangs rgyas gsungs pa bzhin / /khyod la thams cad brjod par bya/ /g.yeng med yid kyis mnyan par gyis / /blo dang ldan pas de dbus su/ /phyag rgya mchog tu mdzes par (mibri/ /padma chen po 'dab brgyad pa / /sna tshogs mdzes pa nyid du 'dod/ /shar phyogs 'dab ma dkar po ste/ /nub phyogs su ni ljang khu'o/ /byang phyogs su ni dmar po bri/ /lho phyogs su ni nag po'o/ /'dab ma lhag mar ④brjod pa ⑤ni/ /'dren dumar rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs/ / de yi rtsisnying po dbus su ni/ /bum pa bsgreng ba bri bar bya/ /de yi steng du padma che/ /padma'i steng du rdo rje bsgreng rjo/ /de yi tha mar 'od zer gyil/ /dkyil 'khor shin 7tu mdzes pa bri/ /dkyil 'khor gang dang gang yin pa/ /sa bon dang ni ldan par bya/ /blo dang ldan pas de steng du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo mdzes pa ste/ /padma dkar po'i tunyasteng gzhag la/ /rdo rje rnams kyis tso'akhor ba bskoratso/ /mkhas pa sa dbang ldan phyogs su ni/ /phyag rgya mchog tu bzang bri ste/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dra ba la / /dkyil 'khor yid bzhin rin chen gzhag / de yi yisteng du bri ba ni/ /padma dkar po mchog tu mdzes/ /zhi zhing me lce phreng bas 'khor/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas bsngags 8pa bri/ /byang phyogs su ni dung bri ste/ /dkar la mchog tu 'tsher bar ⑩bya/ /'jig rten dbang po 'dra ba ste/ /gzugs bzang phyag rgya 'di bri'o/ /dung gi steng du rdo rje bri/ /rdo rje'i steng du padma'o/ /lho phyogs su ni song nas su/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor 'dra ba yi/ /phyag rgya bsgrims te bri bar bya/ /de yi steng du rlung gzhag go/ /de yi steng du padma ste/ /dus mtha'i 87—247

me 'dra'i 6)'od can bri/ /de yi steng du blo ldan pa/ /lag na rdo rje'i rdo rje bri/ /nub phyogs su ni song nas su/ /utpa la zhes bya ba yi/ /phyag rgya shin tu mdzes bri ste(ge/ /padma'i steng du gzhag par bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthu bo che/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba yin⑧/ /bden bral phyogs su song nas su/ /ral gri gcig ni bri bya ste/ /padma dkar po'i ④steng du gzhag /'od zer gyis ni 'khor bar bya/ /sgo yi g.yas g.yon ngos gnyis sul/ /khro bo'i rgyal po gnyis bri ste/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal mgon po dang / /khro bo zla ba'i thig le'o / /khro zla thig le'i tho ba ste/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal rdo rje'o(nya/ /de nas sngags pas mnyam gzhag ste/ /phyi rim ngos su bri ba ni/ /de la shar phyogs su ni 57)'byung po'i bdag po dbang ldan 'khor dang bcas pa bri'o(8)/ /byang phyogs su ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin 'khor dang bcas pa bri'o6)/ /lho phyogs su ni gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa bri'o/ /nub phyogs su ni rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa bri'o/ /sgo'i g.yas g.yon du ()ni thub dka' dang /mngon du gyur pa gnyis bri'o(nya/ /phyogs bzhir ni bsrung ba chen mo ⑩bzhi gzhag par bya ste/ 'di lta ste6ge/ shar phyogs su ni mi 'jigs pa sbyin ma'o/ /byang phyogs su ni 1 gzhan gyis mi thub ma'o/ /lho phyogs su ni 'od zer can zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas par 'bri'o/ /nub phyogs su ni 'jigs pa 'jigs byed dbyug to'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa 7bri'o/ /de nas phyogs bzhir bum pa mgul chings dang bcas pa bzhi gzhag go/ /dbus su bum pa gcig gzhag go/ /de nas slob dpon gyis/ cho ga 7snga ma'i tshul bzhin (nyedu/ /rab tu bsgrims te slob ma bzung 19/ /dkyil 'khor snga ma'i skabs bzhin du/ /spos dang me tog 87—248

sbyin par bya/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba'i blo gros ngo mtshar gyis 'dun tu)par gyur pa'i snying gis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la rnam par blta dzubazhing 'dug nas tshig smras pa/ kye ma'o (2)sems dpa' (4)chen po gang 5ri/ /sangs rgyas zhing du thams cad du/ /bsgrags pa chen po bstan pa ni/ /khyod kyis spyod pa ci 'dra zhigayi /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong nas su/ /gang gis 7dngos grub 'grub (nya'agyur la6)/ /rdo rje dbang bskur dam pa mchog /shin tu rmad du byung 'di bstan/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba'i blo gros la 'di skad ces smras so/ /zhi ba'i blo gros legs so legs so/ /tshig brjod pa 'di bzang ngo / /zhi ba'i blo gros de bzhin gshegs pas kyang 'di skad du tilag na rdo rje/ rdo rjes dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di ni mchog tu ches gsang ba'o zhes gsungs so/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / zhi ba'i blo gros kyis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye ma spre)sems dpa' chen po rdo rjes dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba ji skad du bstan pa yin/ de skad ces smras pa dang / lag na rdo rjes byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba'i blo gros la 'di skad ces smras so/ /zhi ba'i blo gros gang khyod kyis dris pa de 8legs so legs so/ /zhi ba'i blo gros rdo rjes 1nadabang bskur ba'i mthu bsgyings ④pa nyon cig /zhi ba'i blo gros dkyil 'khor 'di rnye zhig gi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis nyu5ting nge 'dzin du ma las nges par byung ba gzungs du ma'i 'khor dang ldan pa'i rdo rje yang kho bo la byin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yiye shes 'di ni sangs rgyas rnams 1 pas ches snga ba'o/ /zhi ba'i blo gros ye shes kyi rdo rje 'di ni/ sngags pas rigs 87—249

kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la (11mgu ba'i mgo bor bsams la sbyin par bya ste 'di nyid de'i dam tshig yin no/ /des na rdo rjes dbang bskur ba zhes bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bdag po'i rdo rje 'di ni mchog tu srung bar byed pa dang / bstan pa kun du bsrung ba dang /(mi de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa yin pa dang /bgegs thams cad phung bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bsngags pa'i rdo rje sngags pas nam yang rnam pa thams cad du yongs su gtang (kyebar mi bya'o/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / zhi ba'i blo gros kyis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lag na rdo rje sems can rnams la phan par 'dod pas gang khyod kyis ④mchog tu gsang chen ⑤gyi dkyil 'khor bshad pa legs so legs so/ /ye shes rdo rje bla na med/ /bdag nyid de bzhin gshegs pa yi4)/ /ye shes gzugs su gnas pa (7)'di/ /blun po rnams kyis mi shes so/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba'i blo gros la 'di skad ces smras so/ /zhi ba'i blo gros khyod la gsang chen bshad kyis(8)/ zhi ba'i blo gros khyod kyis ma dad pa su la 9yang dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po 'di ma bstan 7cig /dam tshig 'di yang yongs su dag pa ma gtogs pa 41su la yang ma sbyin cig /lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba las 12rdo rjes dbang bskur ba'i rim par phye ba'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje nyusnyede'i tshe/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la rnam par bltas nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la smras pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa gsang sngags kyi 87—250

sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 0)rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du (gedon yod pa yang dag par bstan pa las/ don nges par 'byung (8)ba rnams kyi rtags su gyur pa/rdo rje mchog las yang (gi)dag par byung ba'i phyag rgya rab 'byam dbyibs (5)rnam pa sna tshogs 6)mngon par grub pa/ sems can gyi khams bsam pa tha dad pa rnams ci lta ba bzhin du yang dag par tshim par byed pa/ 'gro ba tha dad pa rnams dang / rigs dang / skye gnas dang / kha dog dang / dbyibs tha dad pa rnams dang / spyod pa tha dad pa rnams dang / bsam pa tha dad pa rnams dang /tshul dang nges pa'i tshig brjod pa tha dad pa (7)rnams dang / tshig gi lam tha dad pa rnams su sna tshogs kyis spras (8)pa'i lus kyi dbyibs dag mngon par sprul nas/'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam mtha' yas pa nges par bstan pa rnams su lus 59ridang ngag dang yid 7kyis mnyam pa nyid la nges par sbyor bar byed pa1nya/ chos kyi dbyings 4)kyis rnam par bskyed pa'i lus dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i mig 'phrul las yang dag par 'byung ba'i phyag rgya rab 'byam dag yod de/byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi don du de dag kho bos khyod la bshad kyis //nyon cig /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje la smras pa/ rigs kyi bu de'i dus yinatso/ de'i tshod yin gyisam/rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po'i rgyan gyi sgo'i phyag rgya rab 'byam bshad du gsol/ de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor des mgrin gcig tu tshig smras pa/ byang chub sems dpa' de'i dus la bab par mkhyen na de'i dus lags de'i tshod lags sotshe/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' lag na 87—251

rdo rjes de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyan gyi snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes de'i tshe na0)/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rgyu (nyamathun pa las byung ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyan du gyur pa'i phyag rgya rab 'byam smras pa/ thog mar lag pa gnyis snyim pa (0sbyar la srin lag gnyis nang du gzhug 57gung mo gnyis gshibs (5)te gyen du bsgreng (nyal/mdzub mo gnyis tshigs (mugasum pa'i thad ka (8)nas gang tsam gyis yinam reg tsam du (1rtegazhag /3)mthe'u chung gnyis dang mthe bo ⑩gnyis kyang de la phyogs par gyen du bsgreng ngo 3ge/ /'di ni dam tshig thams cad kyi rdo rje'i phyag rgya ste sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te sa ma ya badzra hūṃ/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ya mtshan gyis spyan 8rgyas par gyur nas / drang srong chen po sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' kun gyi dam tshig 'di ni ngo mtshar to/ /de bzhin rgyal ba'i nyan thos dang / /rang rgyal gang dag 3ge'ajig rten na/ /gnyis med bse 7ru lta bu dang / /tshangs pa la sogs 'phrul po che/ /'jig rten lha rnams gang yin dang / /gang gzhan gnod sbyin dri za dang / /mkha' lding mi 'am ci la sogasanyurte/ /srin po yi dgas gnon po dang / /grib gnon brjed byed grags pa rnams/ /de dag kun gyis tshig smras pa/ /dam tshig dam pa ngo mtshar to/ /sangs rgyas skyob pa thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig 'di las su 'da' ba18/ /sdang sems ldan pa de dag gi/ / mgo bo (6dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /sems can kun la phan byed pas 7/ /me lce phreng 'khrugs mi bzad pa'i/ /rdo rje rnams kyis rtag tu 'gems/ /dam tshig 'das pa nges 87—252

par ni/ /ngan song 'gro la sogs par 'gyur/ /skyob pa byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams mi mnyes byas/ /de dag dngos grub tshe 'di dang / /tshe gzhan 'bras bur gyur 'dir (1)med/ /gal te 'bras bu mchog 'dod na/ /de lta bas du na rnam kun du/ /blo dang ldan pas bsgrims byas la/ /dam tshig 'di ni bsrung bar bya/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid las mdzub mo gnyis de nyid du sbyar ba ni rdo rje 'chang thams cad kyi phyag rgya'o/ /mdzub mo gnyis myur du slar bkyed ④pa ni rdo rje dzhai ga ra'i ⑤phyag rgya'o/ /mdzub mo gnyis bsogs (6)su bkyed (7pa ni kun du brjod pa'i rin me'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid las mthe bo gnyis nang du gzhug 49)pa ni rdo rje ra ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis bkug hu 7ste thur tshoḥdu bstan la mthe bo dang lhan cig gzhag pa ni rdo rje tsho phur bu'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid las mthe'u chung gnyis bkug (snyel lhag ma de bzhin gzhag pa ni rdo rje dra ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las sor mo thams cad gcig tu kha bye 1 ba la thug pa'i tshul du byas pa 15ni rdo rje utpa la'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje utpa la'i phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis kyis 1tshisor mo thams cad 'khyud nyu la/ mthe bo gnyis mdzub mo'i drung du bzhar 1 ba ni rdo rje gdu tsho/bu'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje gdu rdu 1bu'i phyag rgya las mthe bo gnyis mdzub mo'i ngos la bzhar ( steb ni khro bo ( )rdo rje kha'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje kha'i phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis nang logs su bcug la stod de gzhag pa ni rdo rje mche ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mthe bo gnyis mdzub mo'i ru logs su yid tsam dgug pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po'i phyag rgya'o/ /mthe'u chung gnyis nang du bkug la (4srin lag gnyis gshibs gete gyen du bsgreng 87—253

ba ni byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mthe'u chung gnyis kyis srin lag gnyis bsnol 0)mar 'khyud la lhag ma de bzhin du gzhag pa ni 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob pa'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid las gung mo gnyis kyis srin lag gnyis 'khyud la lhag ma de bzhin du gzhag pa ni bcom ldan 'das ma (na)mā ma khri'i ③phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mthe bo gnyis srin lag gi drung du bzhar ④ba ni rdo rje sgeg (snyepa'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje sgeg 6)pa'i phyag rgya 'di nyid las mdzub mo gnyis bkyed (7)pa ni rdo rje me tog ⑧gi phyag rgya'o/ /lag 59)pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs la mdzub mo gnyis 7rdo rje'i tshul du bkug pa 11ste/ gung mo gnyis gshibs tu pa ni rdo rje mdung rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis ku'i sor mo rnams lan bu tu thabs su byas pa tsobazlog ste/ mdzub mo gnyis gshibs pa ni rdo rje rtse mo'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid las mthe bo g.yon gyis bogayas pa mnan la lhag ma snga ma bzhin gzhag pa ni rdo rje lcags sgrog gi phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid las gung mo gnyis gshibs te bkyed 7la mthe bo gnyis de logs su phyogs par gzhag pa ni rdo rje 'byung gnas kyi phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid las srin lag gnyis brkyang ba ni rdo rje sen nyi mo can gyi phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid 18las mthe'u chung gnyis brkyang la mthe 19bo gnyis sbas pa ni rdo rje rigs mdzes ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis snying gar gshibs tshote mthe bo gnyis nang du bcug la lhag ma thams cad brkyang ba ni rdo rje bla re'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid las srin lag gnyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis kyang nang du bkug 37pa ni rdo rje tog gegi phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis mthe bo gnyis kyi khri snartse mor gzhag la snga ma bzhin 87—254

gzhag pa ni rdo rje lag 6)pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis ku'i snyim pa sbyar te/ sor mo thams cad dril bu'i tshul du byas la srin lag gnyis (5)nang du bcug ste bskyod pa ①ni rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya'o/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis 94khu tshur bcangs (snyel mthe'u chung gnyis gshibs (6)te bsgreng ba ni rdo rje rnga bo che'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mthe bo gnyis bsgreng la mthe'u chung gnyis nang du bkug (7)pa ni rdo rje tho ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /(8)de nyid las gung mo gnyis gshibs 59cite bsgreng ba ni rkyu )'khyud pa'i tshul du bya zhing mthe bo gnyis yid (1tsam bkug pa nyu2ni rdo rje be con gyi phyag rgya'o/ /'di nyid las mthe bo gnyis nang du bcug pa ni be con sngon po'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i ngos kyis 12drung du bkug ciste bzhar tsob ni rdo rje lus dmar gyi phyag rgya'o/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs la bskor ba'i tshul gyis gzir cing tsomathe bo bsgreng ba ni rdo rje tī li gī 'o li'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mthe bo gnyis 1 nang du bkug la srin lag bsgreng tu ste/ tshi gas tsho sdugasum pa bkug pa 2lhadagug pa ni gzhon nu lag bzang gi ( shephyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis gshibs zhugel tshigs si rigasum pa rdugebakug pa ni gzhon nu rdo rje sde'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid las gung mo gnyis gshibs ri te bsgreng la lhag ma snga ma bzhin du gzhag pa ni gzhon nu rdo rje spyi gtsug gi phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid las mdzub mo g.yon pa nang du bkug pa ni gzhon nu rdo rje dbu rgyan rtse bran gyi phyag rgya'o/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis thal mo bkan la srin lag gnyis dang mthe bo gnyis bsgreng gung mo gnyis dbus su rtse mo dgug pa ni na da ku be ra'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mthe'u chung gnyis nang du bkug ri shel srin lag gnyis thad 87—255

kur brkyang ba ni khro bo zla ba'i thig le'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs la smin mtshams 0)su bzhag ste/ mdzub mo dang tshigung mo mig gi tshul du dpral bar sbyar ba ni rdo rje 'jigs 'jigs lta'i phyag rgya'o/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis snyim pa sbyar la mdzub mo gnyis kyis gung mo gnyis gshibs ①pa la 'khyud pa ni kun du bzang po la sogs pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis gdu bu'i tshul du khu tshur bcangs la mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ste yid tsam bkug pa ni stobs po che (debe con ⑤gyi phyag rgya'o/ /yide nyid las mdzub mo gnyis rtse (7)sprad de zlum por byas pa ni rdo rje zhu)zhags pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /mdzub mo de nyid tshorabasnol te sbyar ba ni rdo rje gdu bu'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las mdzub mo ⑫g.yon pa yid tsam dgug ‘/7pa ni rdo rje yu ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis snyim par 12sbyar te mdzub mo gnyis lag mthil du bkug la gung mo gnyis tshigs 1rigasum pa bkug ste thur du bstan pa ni rdo rje hūṃ zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis snyim par 7sbyar ba bol srin lag gnyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis nang du bkug ste/ mdzub mo gnyis 7mthe bo gnyis la tu 7'khyud pa ni rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo thams cad bsdus la gung mo yid tsam brkyang ba ni rdo rje gtsug tor thams cad kyi phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid las mdzub mo gnyis (gyebarkyang ba ni rdo rje mtshams (7kyi phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid las gung mo dang mdzub mo gnyis gshibs zhugyete bsgreng ba ni rdo rje ral gri'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid las mthe bo phyoganyis kyi drung du bcar la lhag ma snga ma bzhin gzhag pa ni rdo rje pho nya mo rnams kyi phyag rgya'o/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs la khu tshur g.yon pa brdeg par gzas pa ltar bya zhing /87—256

du bkug 6)pa ni bcom ldan 'das 'khor los (khusgyur ba chen po'i dbu'i phyag rgya'o / /sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā ( chikha tra mi ④su hā/ phyag rgya 'di nyid las gung mo gnyis phyung ste gshibs la bsgreng ba ri5ni / bcom ldan 'das 'khor los (7sgyur ba chen po'i gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya'o/ /sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā rdza 7ni/ phyag rgya 'di nyid las (shemadzub mo gnyis phyung ste tshigs dang po bkug pa de nyid la sbyar ba ni spyan gyi phyag rgya'o/ /sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ(9) / sarba 7shā dri/ phyag rgya 'di nyid las mthe bo gnyis yid tsam bkug la mdzub mo gnyis la phyogs par byas te1rta/ lhag ma snga ma 32bzhin /lhagazhag pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyi bo'akhor lo'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā i/ snga ma bzhin du tsolag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs la mdzub mo gnyis phyir bkyed 7de brkyang la tshigs dang po bkug nyu cing mthe bo gnyis phyir bkyed de 18brkyang ba ni bcom ldan 'das dpal be'u'i phyag rgya'o / /sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā shrīḥhu(/phyag rgya 'di nyid las gung mo gnyis bkyed 2 )de brkyang la stomathe bo gnyis nang du bcug pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyi lte ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā hri/ snga ma bzhin du 6rtelag pa gnyi ga (snyekhu tshur bcangs la/ mthe'u chung 3 staganyis phyung ste bkyed gepa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi phyag rgya'o/ /sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā traṃ/ 'di dag ni bcom ldan 'das 'khor los 5 0sgyur ba chen po'i phyag rgya ste dgos pa'i don thams cad sgrub po tsho/ /gang zhig nang gi 87wa 287

dag pa yis/ /phyag rgya 'di dag 'dzin byed pa/ /sngags pa 'di ni sdig bral ①bar / /'gyur te 'di la the tsom (mimed/ /rdo rje 'chang rnams thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang ni/ /rdzu 'phrul che ba'i lha kun yang ni/ /blo dang ldan pa de la bsrung / /de lta bas na rnam kun du/ /bdag nyid che la gus par bya/ /rig (gesngags rtag tu bzlas byas na/ /de la dngos grub mi dka'o⑤/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis (6)gsungs pa'i sngags/ /tshe 'di la ni grub par 'gyur/ /'jig rten sngags rnams gang yin pa/ /de dag de yi dbang 'gyur ⑦te/ /bsgo ba ci (8)zhig gyis shig 6)ces/ /de yi g.yas g.yon 'khor bar tso'agyur/ /mi (spremin lha yi 1rtesman rnams kyang / /de yi (snyedabang du gyur cing 'khod/ /sngags pas skisngags kyi tshul gnas nas/ /gang tshe lus ni 'dor 'gyur na8/ /dbang sgyur gyi yini gnas mchog tu/ /de tshe de ni skye bar 'gyur/ /gang na dbang ⑩ldan bcom ldan 'das/ /rnam par snang mdzad che bzhugs par/ /rgyal ba'i sras po 'dod pa bzhin/ /skye ba dag ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ /ji srid byang chub gyur gyi bar/ / de yi kyi spyod pa nyams mi 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'chang rnams thams cad kyis/ /thams cad du ni byin gyis brlabs/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyi ga (rtesbyar la srin lag gnyis nang du bcug ste/ mdzub mo gnyis tshigs dang po bkug la gung mo gnyis gshibs pa la zhu )nas gang gis ma reg pa (7tsam du (shegazhag cing /mthe bo gnyis de'i drung du gzhag pa ni ( nyerdo rje drag po chen po'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā tsaṇḍa bum hā ro ṣa ṇa zhugergyu/ phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub mo g.yas pas gung mo bsgreng ba la 'khyud pa 'di ni rdo rje drag po chen po'i mgo'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta 87—288

thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā mo/ mdzub mo g.yon pas gung mo bsgreng ba la 'khyud pa la yo)mdzub mo g.yas pa phye ste/ snga ma bzhin du (5)tshigs dang po bkug ste gzhag pa ni rdo rje drag po chen po'i (migatsug tor gyi phyag rgya'o/ /sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā dzī/ de bzhin du mdzub mo gnyis kyis gyogung mo bsgreng ba la 'khyud pa ni rdo rje drag po chen po'i go cha'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ / sarba thā ā/ de bzhin du mdzub mo gnyis phye la glog 'gyu (5)ba'i thabs su brkyang ba ni rdo rje drag po'i ⑥rdo rje me lce 'bar ba chen po'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags la / na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā 89)/ phyag rgya 'di nyid las mdzub mo g.yas pa bkug ste mdze bo'i drung du gzhag pa ni rdo rje (8)drag po chen po'i dpral ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā ni lo ba ti ka hu)ti swā hā/ de bzhin du mdzub mo g.yon pa'i ⑩mthe bo'i drung du gzhag la gung mo bsgreng ba'i hu)tshigs dang po bkug ste yid tsam smad pa ni rdo rje drag po chen hunyepo'i nu mjing tunyegi phyag rgya'o/ /sngags la/na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā ha sa ha sa/ dha ka dha ka /tsa ra tsa ra/ haṃ pra tsaṇḍa yibadzra swā hā/ de bzhin du nu mjing 8gi phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis bkug ste bkyed yil brkyang zhing mthe'u chung tu gnyis nang du bcug pa ni rdo rje drag po chen po'i dpal be'u'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā hunyepo phu (pel badzra tsaṇḍa 2 rig hā/phyag rgya 'di nyid las mthe'u chung phyung zhunyaste snga ma bzhin du nu gzhag pa ni rdo rje drag zhu po chen po'i rkang pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/87wa 289

sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā bi tsi tra ga ti swā hā/ de ltar phyag rgya rab 'byam shi)'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa rnam pa sna tshogs su gnas pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams du mar sems can gyi khams du ma rnam par sbyor ri bar byed pa/ dus gsum la ni nastobs thogs pa med pa4)/chos kyi dbyings rtogs pa las byung ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang /lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang ske/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba gcod par byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rtogs pa thob par byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi bkod pa bstan pa 'i 5rnam par gnas par byed 6pa/ bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ rdo rje don yod pa'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa sgrub par byed pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 7pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma 8yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mig tu gyur pa sha nyastag go/ /lag na rdo rje dbang bskur 10ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po bkod pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon gyi spyod pa'i rgyu mthun pa bstan pa dang cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul 11pa'i gnas las 12phyag rgya rab 'byam 1 ji snyed 1 pa'o// // 'phags pa lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba/15 bam po bcu pa/ de nas yang 16lag na rdo rjes bdud thams cad pham par byed pa/ bkod pa rnam par sprul pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /byang chub sems 87wa 290

dpa' lag na rdo rje snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ de nas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis phyag g.yas pa brkyang ste/ lag na rdo rje'i mgo 1la byugs nas legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ sems can kun la 2 phan byed pa/ /dpa' bo chen po legs so legs/ /gsang sngags spyod 95)las byung ba yi4/ /rdo rje stang (5)stabs ched kyi phyir/ /sdang ba'i sems can 'jigs byed pa/ /ti nga 6'dzin 'di (7/la snyoms par zhugs/ /rdo rje stang 58distabs cho ga'i rim/ /sems can chen po khyod kyis ston/ /rdo rje 'byung ba'i rkang stabs 9ni/ /sngags rgyal rnams kyi spyi yin te/ /'dug pa dang ni 'gro ba dang / /ldang dang rnam par gtor ba dang / /dgug pa dang ni brkyang ba dang / /rkang pas 1 bcing dang 1 bskum pa dang / /spo 12ba dang ni gzhag pa dang / /khu tshur bcangs 15pas gzung 1 )ba dang / /gzir dang rdo rjes gzhom 15pa dang / /rdo rje'i phyag rgyas phur btab tshadang / /seng ge lta bur mchong 1 ba dang / /hūṃ zhes bya bas bsdigs 18pa dang / /stan las langs nas mchu gnon 19dang / /khro gnyer dpral bar blta ba dang / /smin ma bskyod par bya ba dang / /de bzhin mig gnyis bgrad 2 )pa dang / /rkang stabs 21rnam par dbye ba nadang / /lag gnyis sbyar bar bya ba dang / /de bzhin lag pa bskyod pa dang / /rkang pa gnyis kyis mchong na ba dang / /lus ni bsnyems 5 skudang bcas par yang / /bye brag tu ni ston na pa dang / /bcad 27dang gtub dang bgad na pa dang / /bza' 8dang rnam par bgad 7pa dang / /kun du sgra dang rnam sgra dang / /drag tu byed dang bcing ba sha )dang / /sdang ba thams cad tshar bcad 1dang / /rengs par bya dang rmongs bya dang / /gyen du mchong dang nabasnun pa snyedang / /mdzes pa'i stabs 87wa 291

dang gtsub pa 11dang / /bsgrub pa'i 55)dang por tsho sngar spyad dang / /de bzhin lha la bsnyen bya dang / /sngags pa yis 4ni dkyil 'khor dang / /dngos grub ci 'dra yin pa dang / /sems can khams la rnam kun du/ /bsrung dang sba ba bya ba dang / / dpa' bo 5'di dag thams cad dang / /gzhan yang yid la ci 'dod dang / /sdang sems ldan pa de dag la/ /de bzhin phyir gso bya ba (6dang ske/ /'di dag thams cad rgya cher ni/ /sems can thar 57)bar 'dod pas 58tshosmros / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis dzorsha)rkang stabs kyi thabs bokyis rnam par rgyal bar bya ba'i phyir 11gsang sngags 'di lta bu 12gsungs so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa lha/tsaṇḍa 1 tshobadzra pra dzwa 15li ta mūrti 10swā hā/ de nas lag na rdo rjes 1 gsang sngags 'di thos nas dga' zhing mgu la12/ rab tu dga' ba'i yid kyis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor la rnam par bltas nas smras pa/ kye grogs po dag nyon cig /sems can gang la la dag 19sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su dong na ba rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang dag gsang 21sngags kyi spyad pa spyod cing / gsang 22sngags kyi tshul la brtson pa de dag la ci nas kyang na ston pa'i bstan pa 2 yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ deng phyin cad bsrung bar digyis shig /bste na stang du gyis shig / ri mor 2 gyis shig /mchod pa nagyis shig /de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor des mgrin gcig tu tshig 9smras pa / chos kyi rjes bka' stsal pa bzhin 'tshal lo zhes brjod nas cang mi smra bar 'khod do/ /de nas lag na rdo rjes yang thams cad dang 1ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la smras pa/ rigs kyi bu dag 2gang la la zhig ma 'ongs pa'i dus 87wa 292

na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon gyi spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor la bsrung ba 17bsgrub par brtson pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod nanopa gsang sngags kyi /sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dam tshig las 'gal bar byed na/ rig pa'i rgyal po drag pos rdo rje (4)'bar ba rab tu 'bar ba kun du mched cing rab tu 'bar bas de'i (5)mgo tshal pa bdun du 'gems so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 96)chen po lag na rdo rjes byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba'i blo gros la 'di skad ces smras so/ /zhi ba'i blo gros stang 7ristabs kyi mtshan nyid sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis (8gsungs pa bshad kyis nyon cig /mthun pa'i rkang stabs byas nas su/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag byas nas99/ /sngags pas shar phyogs kha bltas te/ /'greng la thal mo mtshog tshamar gzhag / gsang sngags 11lta bur 'jo 12mchog gis/ /rdo rje stangs tshul gar byed cing / /mtshog 1lhanas thal mo phab nas su/ /snying gar ngagazhag pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /phyogs rnams kun du bskor bar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcangs nas su/ /lag pa g.yas pa bteg byas la/ /g.yon pa rked pa'i rgyab tu gzhag /rkang pa g.yas pa bteg nas su/ /g.yas pa bskum par legs par sbyar/ /g.yon pa mtshog 15mar bstod 17nas su/ /snang ba kun la bsdigs par bya/ /rkang pa g.yas pa brkyang bya zhing / /gnyi 1 ga rdo rje khu tshur bcangs18/ /khros 39bcas hūṃ zhes bya bas bsgyings / /rdo rje bsnun 7pas bsnun par bya/ /rdo rje gar gyis bsgyur nas su/ /rkang pa g.yon pa bskum gebyas la/ /de ltar phyogs bzhi rnams su yang / /rdo rje'i gnon na 'gros gnon ri tshopar bya/ /rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas su/ /rked pa'i gnas su gzhag par bya/ /rting sprad gnas la gnas nas su/ /mig ni thur du blta bar 87wa 293

bya / /rdo rje phur bus 1btab nas dunani/ /sa 'og rnam na)bdun g.yo bar 'gyur//'brug sgra dal 'dra'i 4rgyu ldan zhing / / rab 'bar (5)rdo rje 'chang 'dra bar/ /rdo rje gyen du 'gyed 6par bya/ /rgyab tu thal mo sbyar bar bya/ /de nas rdo rje gar bya zhing / /lte ba'i gnas su gzhag par bya/ /'di 'dra'i gnas la gnas nas su/ / myur 'grol shin tu bslabs pas bzhag ri /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /khro bo phyag brnyan bran mo yi/ /mtshon cha'i phyag rgya 8)ji snyed pa/ /rdo rje be con dbyug tho 99dang / /mdung thung mda' chen 'khor lo dang ske/ / rdo rje rtse gcig gtun 57shing sogasanyam/ /pho nya pho smos gang yin dang / /bgegs la sogs pa rnam par zlog12 /phyag rgya'i tshogs gzhan gang gsungs pa/ /bgegs rnams gzhig 12par bya ba'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni bstan rnams kyis / /spyi yi cho ga rgyas par ni/ /bslabs nyu no pa'i sngags pas lhar bcas dang / /lha min gsang ba kun du gzhom/ /dkyil 'khor la ni bgegs bya'i phyir/ /tshangs pa'i sdong bur thug pa nas/ /sa steng /tshoganas pa'i lha yi skobar/ /gcig tu 'dus nas lhags gyur kyang 1rte/ / stang stabs nye cho ga shes pa yi/ ci/sngags pas hūṃ zhes bya ba yis19/ /thams cad rnam par gtor 2 'gyur te/ /shing bal 'dab ma rlung gtor bzhin/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i 31mer gyur nas/ /bskal pa'i me 'drar langs nas su/ /rdo rje rkang pa na ldan par 2 ni/ /rdo rje phyag rgyas kun du gzhom/ /rdo rjes gnon dang ldan par ni/ /rdo rje'i 2 phyag rgyas 25bcom nas su / /sngags pas sa gsum phung byed na/ /bgegs dang log 'dren smos ci dgos / /27chen po'i 2 rdo rje phyag 28rgya yi smyo/ /stang sdo stabs 'di ni spyi yin te/ /bsgrub rdo min don kyang sgrub 2byed na/ /cho ga zhib las byung ci smos da/ /rdo rje 87—294

'byung ba (1)dam pa ni/ /thog mar bcing ba 2byas nas su/ /de nas rdo rje mchog rig 95)las/ /'byung 94)ba gzhan yang bcing bar bya/ /'di las gsang sngags rnams dang ni/ /stang ge stabs rnam pa thams cad 'byung / /de lta bas na rnam kun du/ /sngags pas bsgrims 7te bslab par bya/ /dam tshig chen po rdo rje 'byung ba'i rtsa ba'i stang 9nastabs so/ /rdo rje 'byung bar 'dug nas su/ /seng ge bzhin du pha rol gnon9/ /rdo rje phyag rgyas kun du gzhom/ /rdo rje rkang pa chubarkyang bar bya/ /hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sgra sgrogs shing / /rdo rje'i phyag rgyas bcom nas su/ /sa rnams kun kyang g.yo 'gyur na/ /gsang dang klu rnams smos ci dgos / /seng ge'i tshul du mchongs nas ni/ /bgegs gang 1 seng ge'i 12gzugs 'dra dang / /glang chen shing rta spre'u dang rta1na/ /gzhan yang gang dag rkang bzhi pa/ /de nas rnam par 'bros pa 'am/ /'chi 1 bar 'gyur 15te the tsom 16med / /tshangs pas byas pa'i bgegs rnams kyang / /skad cig de la myur du 'jig17 /seng ge ltar pha rol gnon pa'i stang 1/stabs so/ /rdo rje 'byung bar yang 'dug ste/ /rkang pa bsnol nya ba'i tshul gyis su/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyi ga 2 ni//rked pa'i gnas su gzhag par bya/ /hūṃ brjod mgul 1pa bsal na ba'i sgras/ /rdo rje gar gyis gar bya zhing / /rkang pa g.yon pa bteg nas ni/ /de yi rtse mo sar btsugs la/ /rkang pa g.yon pa bteg nas ni/ /lag pa na rdo rje na gsor bcas 25par/ /lag g.yon snying gar na bzhag nas ni/ /sngags pas 'khor lo bzhin du bskor/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i mer bsgyur nas/ /rdo rje'i nyi ma'i mig 2 ldan par/ /rdo rje mgul pa bsal 28ba'i sgras/ /phyogs kun yongs su rdzogs 29par bya/ /bgegs kyi gnas su dmigs nas ni/ /myur du rdo rje gom stabs 87—295

kyisal/ /rkang 0)g.yas brkyang ba'i rdzun/gnas na ni(5)/ /rdo rje phyag rgyas kun du gzhomal/ /de bzhin phyogs dang mtshams rnams kyang / /kun du yang dag gzhom par bya/ /bdud sde mi bzad chen po dang 4)/ /phyogs rnams kun nas byung ri 5)ba kun / /g.yas brkyang gom dzinopa'i stabs sbyar te/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgyas kun du gzhom / /sa gsum thams cad g.yo 'gyur na/ /bgegs dang log 'dren smos ci dgos/ /rdo rje phyag rgya 57/bltas nas ni/ /bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad dang / /mi bzad gzugs can srin po rnams/ /phyogs rnams kun du 'bros par 'gyur/ /rdo rje g.yas pa brkyang tsho8)ba'o/ /rdo rje 'byung bar 'dug nas su/ /mtshog 9rimar rdo rje thal 7sbyar te/ /rdo rjer bcas pa'i lag bskor zhing ske/ /sprin ltar yongs su khyab par bya/ /rdo rje gar gyis /spegar bya zhing / /mchu ni so yis gnan 12par bya/ /khu tshur g.yon pa bteg tu par bya/ /g.yas pa snying gar rshagazhag par bya/ /rkang pa g.yon pa bteg nas su/ /g.yas rol du ni gcu bar chodabya/ /'brug sgra dal 'dra'i 8rgyu brjod pa/ /g.yon pa brkyang ba'i rkang gnon 1 te/ /rdo rje rkang pas bsnun par bya/ /g.yas pa sa la gzug 1 par bya / /rdo rje rkang pa 19sa 'og tu/ /bsnun na thams cad g.yo bar byed/ /sa yi 'og na gnas pa'i klu/ /gsang dang lha min srin por bcas thams cad g.yos pa 'di ci zhes/ /ya mtshan 3 ci'adzin pa'i sems gyur nas/ /ya mtshan 1'dzin pa'i snying gis su/ /'di dag thams cad cir 'gyur kye 2/ / bskal pa 2lhazad par ma gyur grang / /de skad phan tshun 'dri bar byed/ /gnas de nas ni yang bskyod nas/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i mig ldan par/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgyas hūṃ brjod de/ /rdo rje rkang pas bsnun par bya/ /klu dang gsang 22ba thams cad 87—296

dang ske/ /gzhan yang gang dag sar gnas pa/ /gang na 1sngags 'chang 'dug pa yi(ge / /gnas der thams cad lhags (8)nas su/ /lung 4)ni yongs su nod byed cing (5)/ /rdo rje 'bar bas rab nyen pas/ /jo bo ci 6zhig tshol 7cig pa/ /bka' lung myur du bdag cag stsol/ /bcud kyis 8len tam 9dngul chu 'am/ /'on te mig bsku'i 0sman rdzas sam/ /gnod sbyin pho smos 11'bangs su 'am/ /'on te rgyal srid bzhed gyur /2tam/ /'on te dpal gyi sgo bzhed dam/ /'on te yul sa gzhan bzhed na/ /rdo rje 'bar bas gzir gyur pas/ /bzhed pa thams cad bskang nyusnyebar bgyi/ /sngags pas 'ga' zhig blangs nas su/ /de dag la ni byams par bya/ /rdo rje gar ni legs bya zhing / /phyag rgya de ni bsdu bar bya/ /cho ga mthong ba'i las kyis su/ /rdo rje gnas su gzhag par bya/ /gzhan du na ni gsang thub dang / /srin po thams cad skaganod byed de17/ /glags (7lta klan 518ka tshol byed pa/ /gzir ba de dag gnod par byed/ /glags 19su gyur pa shu smirtogs nas su/ /sngags pa la ni gnod par 21byed/ /de lta bas na rnam kun du/ /blo dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos/ /rdo rje'i gnas ni rig byas la/ /stang gastabs bya ba sbyar bar bya/ /g.yon na brkyang rkang pa'i stang 2 stabs so/ /rdo rje'i 'byung bar 'dug nas su/ /dpral bar thal mo sbyar bar bya/ /rdo rje gar ni byas nas su/ /thal mo snying gar 25gzhag par bya/ /tshangs pa'i rkang stabs byas nas su/ /padma'i 7thal mo rgyas par bya/ /gnyi 2 ga khu tshur bcangs nas su/ /g.yas pa gyen du brkyang 28bar bya/ /g.yon pa snying gar 9bzhag nas su / /hūṃ dang phaṭa rdo bcas 1khros bsgyings shing / /sos rtenani mchu yang mnan ribyas nas byu/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i mig ldan zhing / /bzhin ni khro gnyer rim 'chas 87wa 297

pas1la/ /gar byed pa yi tshul gyis ni/ /rkang pa g.yas pa dgug rdo par bya/ /g.yon pa yang dzos ni de bzhin dgug(4sku /rdo rje gsor ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /lag pa gyen du bsgreng bar bya/ /gyen du bltas na 5drag tu ni/ /rdo rje phyag rgyas bsnun 96par bya/ /rdo rje phyag rgyas bsnun pas ni / /tshangs pa 8bcas dang brgya byin bcasal/ /gnas dang bcas pa thams cad 'gul/ /phan tshun gcig la gcig lta zhing / /grogs dag bskal pa ri9 'khrugs gyur tam/ /'on te sems can che byung khongam/ /'on te sangs rgyas byung gyur tam/ /ci zhes thams cad phan tshun smra11ske/ / myos ches 1 gyur nas phan tshun dang / /phyogs bcu dag tu lta bar byed//rdo rje 'bar bas gzir bas na/ /gnas de nas ni dong nas su/ /rdo rje'i ldan pa ci bzhed pa/ /gsungs zhes lung ni nod par byed/ /bdag cag nongs pa ma mchis shing / /bka' dang 'gal bar 1 bgyid ma lags/ /rdo rje 'bar bas 1 gzir gyur nas15/ /bka' lung myur du bdag la 7stsol/ /rdo rje can gyis 1 rdo rje la/ /mig mi 'dzums 1 par rtag tu blta419/ /lha phal gzhan rnams de dag kyang ske/ /rdo rje 'bar bas brgyal 2 gyur nas/ /rdo rje'i dam pa ldan pa la/ /thugs la ci dgongs blang 21mdzod dang / /gal te rgyal srid bzhed gyur tam/ /de bzhin mi dang lha na bzhed dam/ /lha yi bu mo bsnyems dpa dang / /lha yi bde ba yid mthun bzhed/ /thugs la gang bzhed de dag rnams / /de dag dbul bar bgyid par 'gyur/ /de nas lha mang na rdzu 'phrul che/ /de dag yid ni rab dga' nas/ /rdo rje 'bar bas gzir 2 dzob dag /sgrub pa po la myur du dbul/ /de nas byams pa'i sems kyis ni/ /sngags pas bltas nas gtang 2 bar bya/ /gzhan du na ni gzir de dag /glags 2 rnyed gnod pa byed par 'gyur/ /rdo rje 87wa 298

'byung bar yang 'dug ste/ /rdo rje gar ni rab tu bya/ /mtshog 1mar thal mo sbyar nas su/ /phyogs rnams kun du rgyas par bya/ /rkang pa spo ba'i tshul gyis su / /g.yas pa bteg cing de bzhin g.yon/ /rdo rje khu tshur tshul gyis ni/ /g.yas pa gyen du bsgreng 2)bar bya/ /g.yon pa snying gar bzhag nas su/ /smin ma dgug cing bsgul (4)bskyod de/ /mig gis bgegs la bltas byas na5/ /hūṃ dang bcas pas rang bskul na/ /gal te tshangs pa nyid gyur 6tam/ /gal te khyab 'jug nyid gyur 7tam/ /drag po brgya byin nyid gyur yang / /bltas pas myur du 'jigs par 'gyur/ / ci ste khyab 'jug drag po rnams/ /8bdag gi dbang du gyur 9'dod pas/ /kun du bskyod 7pa'i tshul gyis su/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i mig can gyis/ /rkang pa thabs 11sbyar 15tshul gyis su/ /rdo rje phyag rgyas bsnun par bya/ /rdo rje phyag rgyas bsnun pas na/ /sa rnams thams cad rab tu g.yo/ /de nas brgya byin lha rnams dang / /lha min srin po gsang 1 ba paci/ /stan 15las nyams par bdag nyid kyis/ /ma shes shig 17ni brgyal bar 'gyur/ /de nas khyab 'jug drag po 1 rnams1 / /yid ni blong 19zhes gyur nas su/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor cher 2 ldan pa/ /ga la ba der thal sbyar dong 21/ /bdag cag nongs pa ma mchis par/ /sngags kyis bdag cag shin tu gzir/ /gzir ba'i lha rnams de dag kun/ /stan na las sems ni nyams par 'gyur na/ /ci ltar ci bgyi bka' 465 ces/ /lung 2 la gus pas lta 25zhing 'khod ‘/ /kun la byams pa byas nas su/ /snying la bsam pa gcig blangs na na/ / de yi 2 mod la de dag rnams / /dga' zhing mgu nas sbyin par byed/ /sngags pa mnyam par bzhag nas su/ /de dag 29phyag rgya'i rgyal po btang da / /rkang pa spo ba'i tshul gyis su/ /87wa 299

rdo rje'i gnas su gzhag par bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje'i gnas ni rked nas gcod1/ /rdo rje 'byung bar 'dug nas su/ /dbang po chen po'i (5)gnas su brtanaci ri/ /mtshog 4kyimar thal mo sbyar byas la/ /phyogs rnams kun 5)du rgyas par bya/ /rkang pa spo ba'i tshul gyis su/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcangs byas la/ /gar byed pa yi lag pa yis/ /bgegs kyi gzugs rnams bsdigs 6par bya/ /de bzhin g.yas dang g.yon gyis kyang / /gnas nas song gi 7 bar du bya/ / ci ste 8bgegs chen rab snang ba/ /bsdigs nas (9)'gro bar mi byed na/ /rdo rje gom pa myur bor la/ /gyen du lag pa kun du bskyod/ /lag gnyis sa la brdabs khonas su/ /'brug sgra dal 'dra'i hūṃ brjod la/ /gsang sngags blo ldan rkang bskums te511/ /rnam pa kun du lus bskor ro/ /de nas sdang 12ba'i tshul gyis su/ /rdo rje'i lag pa g.yas /2brkyang la/ /rdo rje lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad dgug par bya/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi tshul gyis 7ni/ / re re tshangs pa'i byed dbyas la/ /'brug sgra dal 'dra'i hūṃ rnams dang / /phaṭa rnams kyis ni rab bskul te/ /rdo rje gzir ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gzir bar bya/ /bde gshegs go 'phang ma gtogs par/ /rdo rje can dang 'khor lo can/ /sangs rgyas sras po gang gzhan gyi17/ / de yi 1 lus la mi sems na/ /lha dang dri za gsang ba dang //gzhan yang gang dag klu 1 rnams dang 19/ /shing bal 'dab ma rlung gtor bzhin//hūṃ brjod 'jigs 'gyur smos ci dgos/ /lha min srin po ma rungs pa / /yi dgas grul bum mngag gzhug dang / /bdud dang bdud kyi pho nya rnams/ /'di ltar gyur pa 21ci zhig smos/ /byams pa'i sems la mnyam bzhag cing / /87wa 300

snying rje la yang mnyam bzhag nas/ /byang chub sems dran sngags pa yis/ /phyag rgya bsdu ba brtsam (1)par bya/ /nyes pa cung zad tsam gyi 2phyir/ /bgegs rnams la ni gnod mi bya/ /shin tu sdang bar rig nas su / /gal te bgegs la gnod bya na/ /shin tu sdang ba drag 4kyirnams la/ /'jam des 5nyid du 6mi bya'o / /gal te 'jam des nyid byas na/ / de yi du mod la gnod pa nabyed/ /thog mar 'jam por sbyar bar bya/ /lan 9gnyis tshe na 1 skudabye bar brtson/ /gsum tshe mchod yon thogs nas su/ /me tog snyim par gnas byas la/ /de nas bgegs la mchod par bya/ /'byung po kun phan gtor byin na11/ /'di skad kyi ni tshig brjod de nya/ /bdag gis de ring khyod mchod kyis15/ /song shig bgegs chen 'gro bar gyis/ /phyin chad de ltar ma byed cig /khyod kyi stobs dang rtsal mthong ste/ /khyod ni bgegs 1 kyang byed par nus/ /khyod ni lha yi 15sprul pa ste/ /khyod ni bgegs 17byed mi nus min/ /sngon cad 1 mchod pa ma thob 1 pa / /de ring bdag gis mchod byas na19/ /khyod )kyis da ni mchod khyer la/ /bgegs kyi dbang po song zhes brjod/ /gal te 'dug kyang bgegs min na/ /de ni 1spyod pa bzang po yin/ /sngags pas mchod byas 'os 22kyang ni/ /ci ste bgegs ni yang byed na/ /phyogs bcu nanasangs rgyas dbang gyur pas/ /mi mchog rnams kyis mkhyen par 2lhagasol/ /bgegs la chad pas gcad na slad du / /sbyor ba bgyis kyang 2 nongs ma mchis/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang sangs rgyas sras/ /byang chub sems dpa' pa 2rnams kyis / /bka' dang bdag 'gal mi bgyid brjod/ /lha dang lha min gsang rnams dang / /phyogs bcu kun gyi dri za dang / /gza' dang mi'am ci gang dag /mgon po mgon po che 87wa 301

rnams la/ /bgegs kyis gtses 1pa bsgrag 2par bya/ /gal te chung zhig bskyab 5)ce na/ /myur du yongs su skyobs shig ces/ /bsgrags 94)pa gang dag (5 mnyan byas nas/ /bgegs 6)byed zhi bar gyur na ni/ /de nas phyogs rnams thams cad kyi/ /lha rnams la ni mchod par rdo skubya/ /gal te de 8)ltar mi 'dug na / /me tog thal mo mchod yon gyis/ /sangs rgyas la sogs rab bskul la/ /de la chad pas gcad ri9 par bya/ / drag po 7shin tu sdang sems can511/ /bka' lung las ni 'gal byed cing / /srog kyang shin tu 'phrog byed la/ /sanges rgyas rnams kyang mi g.yel ba12/ /de la phan par 12shes nas su/ /bskal pa bye ba du mar ni/ /sems dmyal rnams su skye ba yi/ /sdug bsngal mang po 'dir 1 'gyur zhes15/ /ji ltar sman pas sems can gyi/ /nad rnams gso bar 7byed pa bzhin/ /gzir bas bdag la nyes pa med/ /mkhas pas 1 rnam par spangs ma yin1 / /de ltar sems ni mnyam bzhag cing / /snying rje yid dang ldan pa yis / /byang chub sems ni brtan byas te19/ /de la chad pas bcad 23pa brtsam21ske/ /ji ltar sman pa mkhas pa yis/ /nyes te yal bar mi 'dor bzhin na//thabs dang shes rab na mkhas pa yang / /mi byed 2 mkhas na'ang gnyes dang bcas / /ji ltar sman pa mi mkhas pa/ /thabs dang shes rab bral ba yis/ /nad pa yal bar 2 dzo'ador byed cing / /gso ba'i cho ga mi byed pa/ /de bzhin shes 2 dang bral ba yis/ /gal te gso bar brtson na yang / /thabs dang shes rab bral ba la/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bsngags 2 mi mdzad/ /nad pa nad pa rnams la ni/ /sman pa 29ji ltar sman byin na/ /tsha dang kha dang bska ba yang 31/ /'jig rten smod par mi byed pa/ /de bzhin 'dul ba'i bye brag 87wa 302

gis / /ci rigs pa ni gso bar bya/ /sdang ba'i sems can rnams la ni/ /'phyas 1)te sangs rgyas rnams mi smod/ /'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba/ /shin tu rmad byung (brgyal ba byung 3/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab lasal/ /'gro ba'i chos ni 'di 'dra 5)ste/ /shin tu sdang sems drag po yi/ /sems can thams cad de tshe byung / /shin tu drag po mthong nas ni/ /'jam po nyid du mi sbyor ro6// /shes rab thabs kyi snying stobs can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs / /snying 7)rje'i snying stobs khros gyur pa/ /sems can rnams la phan byed pas / /de nas pha rol gnon pa yis/ /sems can khams ni du ma gnon9ske/ /sdig med nan gyi 51 stobs kyis su/ /thams cad dbang du dgod par bya/ /pha rol gnon pa'i rigs 11tshul gyis/ /ji ltar byang chub 'dod byas nas / /sems can khams ni du ma dag /thams cad dbang du dgod par 12byas / /rdo rje slob dpon chen po yis/ /log 'dren bgegs rnams de ltar 1nadagod / /byang chub sems dran bsgom 1 byas na15/ /skyon gyis gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /de phyir sngags pa che khros la/ /bskal pa'i me yi mthu lta bus/ /rdo rje ral gri'i 17phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gcad 1 par bya/ /rkang pa'i tshul ni de nyid kyis/ /rdo rje gar gyis rnagar byas la/ /rkang pa g.yon pa brkyang zhes 'dor/ /rkang g.yas brkyang ba'i gnas brten 19te/ / bsnun bya rked 2 pa'i gnas su ni 1/ /ral gri shubs su zhugs par 22bya/ / mnan pa na med pa'i tshul gyis ni / /shugs kyis 25lag pa sar bsdams la/ /rkang pa spo 2 ba'i tshul gyis su/ /ral gri phyung 2 ba 'dra bar bzung / /ral gri tshul du gzhug pa ni/ /mdzub mo gung mo gshib na par bya/ /de nas lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /87wa 303

ral gri shubs su bya ba ni/ /mthe'u chung dang ni srin lag dang / /mthe bos ral gri shubs su bya/ /de nas rkang pa g.yas pa yis/ /sa la bgegs kyi gzugs bris te/ /so yis mchu mnan 0)khros byas la/ / rang gi (kyerdo rje nyi (5༄'bar bas/ /rkang pas mgo ni mnan ri45byas la(gekyi/ /lag pas ral gri phyung nas su / / de ni 6)rdo rje 7/gom stabs kyis/ /gar gyi tshul du kun bskyod cing 58)/ /rdo rje ral gri'i 9 phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gcad (7par bya/ /rdo rje ldan des gang bcom pa/ /de yi 11srog la mi sems so/ /de nas de dag zhi bar 'gyur/ /yang na 'chir 12'gyur the tsom 12med/ /brgya byin mtshungs pa'i bgegs zhig na'ang kṇi / /de yi 7mod la brlag par 8'gyur/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon che/ /snying rje snying brtse 1 tshosems ldan pas/ /ji ltar de yang skye bar 'gyur18/ /de ltar de la snying brtser (19)bya/ /rdo rje ral gri'i stang 5 ristabs sol/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon ches/ /rdo rjes 21gtub par bya ba byas/ /rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgya yis/ /gnod par sems pa thams cad gtub/ /rdo rje 'byung bar 'dug nas su/ /rdo rje mthu rtsal brtsam byas la/ /rkang pa bteg cing bzhag tshul gyis/ /rdo rje gar ni rab tu bya/ /'khor lo rgyas da par bya rim gyis dam/ /pa dma'i 2 thal mo sbyar byas la/ /rkang pa rnam par bzhag byas nas/ /sa la 'khor lo 'phang bar bya/ /rnying sprad gnas su 'dug byas nas snye/ /'brug sgra dal 'dra'i hūṃ brjod de/ /thal mo brdab pa'i tshul gyis su/ /sa la 'khor los bsnun par bya/ /bzlog ste sgolan bur byas nas su/ /lag pa sbyor ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /'khor lo lta bur byas nas su/ /gyen du 'phangs la gzhig na par bya/ /bkug ste rkang pas mgo mnan nas/ /bgegs rnams la ni bsnun 87wa 304

par bya/ /'on tam zhi)rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /yang na shi 'gyur the tsom 2med/ /de ltar rim pa'i tshul 'di yis/ /bgegs rnams la ni gnod par bya/ /sdig pa'i gnod pa med par ni/ /bskul yang 4bde bar mi 'gyur ro5/ /gal te rdo rje sems dpa' che/ /snying rje'i sems dang ldan 'gyur bas6/ /bgegs la zhi bar bya 'dod na/ /cho ga 'di yi tshul du bya/ /ba lang gi ni lci ba las/ /de 'dra ba yi gzugs byas la/ /sngags pas zhi ba'i sems kyis ni97/ /sngags pas 'o mas bkrus nas su nan/ /med la snga mkho bzhin du 'gyur/ /de ltar kun du bgegs rnams ni/ /kun la cho ga bzhin du 79bya/ /rim pa 'di yi tshul gyis ni / /gsang sngags rnams la'ang (1 sbyar bya ste/ /gcad 11dang gnon pa byas pa dang ske/ /bkag pa dang ni bcings pa'ang 12rung / /gal te bsgrub par 'dod na kyi ni/ /de nas snga mkho sabazhin du 'gyur/ /'on tam 15gsang sngags rnams la ni/ /bye brag tu ni spos kyis bya/ /ba 7ni ser mo'i 'o ma'amanya yang na mar gyi sbyin sreg bya/ /yang na brgya dang nya rtsa brgyad kyis 1 / /sbyin sreg gis ni kun zhir 3 )'gyur/ /zhi ba'i sems kyis zhi ba ste/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis rgyas par ro sto/ /drag shul spyod las 2gang yin pa/ /de ni khros pa na brtsam par bya / /ji 27ltar las ni ci rigs par snye/ /gsang sngags rnams la sngags pas bya// tshogazhan du na ni 2 1mi bya ste/ /las kyi tsho 2'bras bu med par 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'khor lo'i stang 0stabs so/ /rdo rje tshul gyis de nas kyang / /rdo rje 'byung bar byas nas su/ /mtshog 31mar thal mo sbyar nas de 5/ /rdo rje gar ni rab tu bya lha / /rting sprad gnas ra kyi tshul gyis su gi/ /smin bsgyur rkang pas reg 7par bya / /lag pa gnyi ga 7sa la byug /de bzhin phyogs bzhi rnams su yang / /87—305

yid kyis bskor ba'i tshul gyis so1/ /rkang pa 'khor lo bzhin du bskor/ /lag gnyis rked pa'i gnas bzhag la/ /rdo rje bgad napa rab byed cing / /lag pa g.yas pa bsgreng bar bya/ /rdo rje'i mdzub dmos rab tu bsdigs/ /hūṃ brjod bsgyings dang bcas par bya / /rdo rje nyi ma'i mig ldan pas/ /rdo rje'i mdzub mos bsdigs nas ni/ /bdud kyi dbang phyug bdag nyid kyang / /bltas pas pa de ni mod la 'bros6/ /bya rog bong rdo 'phen mthong bzhin/ /rdo rje bgad 7pa'o / /de nas rdo rje sngags pa chesan/ /rdo rje 'byung bar 9byas nas su/ /mi mthun rkang stabs 1 byas nas su/ /lag pa bsnol 11te khu tshur bcang bo/ /mthe bo gyen du bsgreng byas la/ /gung mo gshibs te bsgreng 1lhabar bya/ /mdzub mo de gnyis zla ba 1 bsgreng / /rdo rje kha zhes brjod pa yin/ /rkang pa g.yas pa bteg 15par bya/ /g.yon pa gzugs shing de bzhin bya/ /rdo rje lce ni 16me ltar 'bar/ / rgod ma'i 1 kha ltar mngon sum rta bya/ /'brug sgra dal 'dra'i hūṃ brjod de/ /kha yi thad kur gzhag par bya/ /phyogs bzhi 19dag ni thams cad kyi/ /rgya mtsho bzhi yi chu 'thungs 2 na/ /mig sngar snang bar gyur pa yi / /snang ba kun lta nasmos ci dgos/ /de ltar byas na phyogs bzhi po/ /kun nas 'byung na ba thams cad skems/ /'tshub 2 ma kun dang 2 lce 'bab dang / /sprin rnams kun nas 'du ba yang 2 ‘/ /rdo rje kha ni glal ba dang / /gtor bas rab tu 'thor bar 'gyur / /'jig rten du ni ltas byung 5 ba/ /kun nas gnas grub gang yin pa/ /sngags pas 2 rdo rje me lce yi/ /me lce 59ltar bsgyur de kun zhi/ /rdo rje kha yi phyag rgya yis/ / bgegs rnams thams cad bza' bar bya/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i phyag rgya yis/ / 1bgegs rnams thams cad bca' bar bya/ /rdo rje kha glal ba'i stang 87wa 306

stabs so/ /de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor che/ /rdo rje ye shes bsgyur nas su/ /bgegs la gso ba byas nas 1rini/ /nyes pa yod pa ma yin no/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes las byung ba'i2/ /rdo rje slob dpon gso byed pas/ /bdag 'drar bsngags pa de 'dra ste/ /sngags pa ci 'drar 4 rgyal de bzhin/ /sems can kun la snying rje dang / /byang chub sems ni brtan bya ster/ /thabs kyis ri dam pa thob 'gyur bas 7ri/ /rnam par 'phrul ra ba thams cad la9/ /gzhan du na ni phyogs rnams na/ /bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bsngags mi 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dang bral ba ni/ /lha yi mchod 'os ma yin no/ /thabs dang shes rab bral 'gyur ba10/ /rgyal ba'i sras po nyan thos dang / /gang yang rang sangs rgyas rnams 1 ni/ /dka' 12thub gnas la gnas pa ste/ /bdag don phan pa'i sems ldan pas15/ /de dag la ni bya ba med/ /thabs dang ye shes las byung ba'i la / /byang chub sems ni 15snying rje can/ /byang chub sems kyi shing rta dang / /byams dang snying rje'i kha sgyur dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa dang / /bsdu 1sgyu ba bzhi yi rdo rje dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid sa 1 dang / /byang chub phyogs kyi rtsa lag la/ /brten nas sangs rgyas sras 1 po rnams/ /sems can don dga'i 19rtse bas rtsen / /de ltar slob dpon rdo rje 'chang / /thabs dang ye shes mkhas pa yis / /sdang ba rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /sems ni rab tu gso bar bya/ /rdo rje'i tshul gyis de nas yang / /rdo rje 'byung bar byas nas ni/ /rkang pa mthun pa'i gnas bzhag ste/ /rdo rje thal mo gzhum 2 byas la/ /rdo rje gar ni byas nas su / /lag pa g.yas pa gyen du bsgreng / /g.yon pa koskor 22brten nas su/ /gung mo dang ni mdzub mo gshib na/ /mthe'u 2 chung mthe bo sprad 5par bya/ /87wa 307

g.yas pa lha yi 17ba dan gsum/ /g.yas brkyang rkang par mnan 55tshonas su/ /rdo rje bgad dpa'i tshul gyis ni/ /kye ma'o 54)bdag nyid rdo rje can/ /bdag nyid du ni bdag gnas so/ /hūṃ brjod bsnyems 5dang khros pa yis/ /rdo rje gar 6)gyis gtang 7bar bya/ /phyag rgya 'di ni rdo rjes bsdigs/ /rdo rje bgad 8pas bsdigs pas na/ /lha dang lha min gsang bar bcas/ /dkyil 'khor tshe'am bsgrub pa'i tshe/ /bgegs 9byed phyir ni 'gro mi 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'dzin gyis thog mar bcing / /gtsug nas byung ba nyid kyang ni/ /bgegs 7byed phyir ni 'gro mi 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon sum shes/ /bgegs rnams phan tshun smra byed cing / /bsrung ba'i phyir ni de dag kun/ /lhan cig dkyil 'khor drung du dong 11/ /rdo rje stangs kyis 12bskul bas 1lhan/ /rdo rje slob dpon skal ba boche/ /bsod nams tshogs ni bsags pa la/ /gzhan rnams thams cad phyag 'tshal lo//rdo rje'i tshul gyis de na yang sa/ /rdo rje gar ni rab byas la/ / padma thal mo sasbyar nas su/ /phyogs rnams kun du rgyas par bya/ /g.yas pa brkyang ba'i stabs byas te/ /bskal pa'i me yi 'od 'dra bas/ /thal mo brdab 18pa'i tshul gyis su/ /khros pas 19lag pa brdab par bya/ /lag gnyis rdo rje tshul gyis su/ /mthe'u chung mthe bo sprad byas la/ /g.yon pa koskor 2 brten nas su/ /g.yas pa gyen du bsgreng byas la/ /āḥ 2rgyu hūṃ hūṃ brjod de bskul ba yis/ /sngags pas kun du sgra yang brjod/ /rdo rje sgra ni byung ba na na/ /sdang ba thams cad phung bar 'gyur / /brgya byin tshangs dang zla ba sogs/ /rdzu 'phrul che ba'i gza' chen ri yang ske/ /thos pa tsam gyis kun 25g.yos te/ /kun du sgra yi 27sems kyang nyams/ /de tshe thal mo sbyar te 'dud/ /rdo rje sgra chen gang na bar/ /thams cad lhan 87wa 308

cig lhags nas su/ /rdo rje sgra yis gzir 'gyur zhing 1/ /stan las sems ni nyams pas na/ /mnga' bdag sug las ci 'tshal ba/ /bdag cag myur du bka' 465 ces/ /sngags pa la ni lung yang nod/ /sngags pas bsams te gar byas na/ /lha rnams myur du grol bar 'gyur/ /de nas byams pa'i sems bskyed la/ /brtul zhugs can gyis phyag rgya dgrol/ /rdo rje kun du sgra'o/ /rdo rje 'byung bar 'dug nas su/ / rdo rje gar ni 'bar byas la/ /2rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas su/ /phyogs rnams kun du rgyas byas te/ /mi mthun rkang stabs byas nas su/ /bsnol te khu tshur bcangs na byas la/ /mthe bo gnyis ni gshibs 4te bsgreng ske/ /gung mo gnyis ni gshibs byas la/ /mdzub mo dbu ma'i tshigs 5bkug ste6ri/ /gung mo gnyis la sbyar bar bya/ /rdo rje kha ni 7byas pas na/ /sdang ba thams cad zhi bar 'gyur/ /kha yi thad kur bzhag na 8ni/ /rdo rje sgra 9yang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bdag ni rdo rje chen po can/ /rdo rje ye shes stobs dang ldan/ /hri ha hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ /rdo rje'i gom stabs tshul gyis ni/ /rdo rje gnon 1 po'i gom pa yis/ /bzhag 11dang 'degs 12pas 'gro byed cing /ci /phyogs rnams bzhi por brjod par bya/ /rdo rje sgra 'byung 1 bskul bas na/ /bgegs chen rnams dang grags 7rnams dang / /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i 15lha rnams kyang 17/ /de yi mdun du 'gro bar byed/ /rdo rje sgra yis bdag cag tshig /rdo rje sgra yis bskul bas na1 / /bdag cag rang gi gnas nas g.yos/ /rdo rje dbang po 18bka' myur stsol/ /gal te dpal gyi sgo bzhed dam/ /rgyal srid dngul chu mig bsku 19dang / /kun nas gter rnams gzigs bzhed dam/ /bka' stsol cig ces de skad smra/ /dga' bas 2 byin nas sgrub po 2 la/ /phyag 87wa 309

'tshal mchod pa byas nas dong / /rdo rje'i tshul gyis de nas yang / /rdo rje slob dpon mthu chen gyis/ /rdo rje'i gar ni rab byas la/ /rdo rje can gyis 3)phyag rgya bcing ske/ /rkang pa pus mor btsugs nanas su/ /lag pa gnyis ni khu tshur bcang / /gung mo gnyis ni bsgreng nas su/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni ngos la sbyar ske/ /g.yas brkyang gom stabs byas nas su/ /myur du rdo rje'i gom stabs kyis / /'khrul 'khor kun las 5bsnun byas la/ /sgo rnams thams cad dbye bar bya/ /lha min gnod sbyin rgyal po dang / /srin po rdzu 'phrul che rnams kyang / /thams cad rang gi gnas nas g.yos/ /bskal pa zad dam ji snyam sems/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgyas bsnun pas na/ /sems ni blong tsho65zhes gyur nas su/ / rdo rje ye shes cher 7ldan pa/ /ga la ba der nye bar dong 8/ /rdo rje 'bar bas bdag cag tshig /sngags pas dpal gyi sgo bzhed dam/ /'on te dngul chu bcud len bzhed / /rdo rje dbang pos bka' myur stsol/ /smras nas kun gyis 9de mod la/ /yid la 'dod pa sbyin par byed/ /gal te lha dang lha min dang 1 / /gsang ba bkol bar 'dod na yang / /'dod pas de dag lhags nas su/ /'dod pa bzhin du las byed do/ /lung dang 'gal bar byed pa dag /ci ste dam bcas mi 'ong 11na/ /slob dpon rdo rje 'chang ba po/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya 12yongs ldan pa/ /sos ni mchu mnan 1 khros pa dang / /me 'bar lta bur 'jigs rung bas/ /myur du rdo rje'i gom stabs kyis/ /sa rnams kun la bsnun par bya/ /g.yas brkyang gom stabs byas nas su/ / ji ste dam bcas mi 'ong na/ /1 rdo rje'i phyag rgyas 15bsnun par bya/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgyas bsnun pas na/ / a la la 17zhes de skad 17smra/ /stan las lus kyang rab tu nyams/ /lus ni me yis 1 rab tu 87wa 310
