'bar / /rdo rje rnal 'byor chen po pa/ /ga la ba der nye bar dong / / skal ba 1chen pos yongs su skyobs/ /bka' lung myur du bdag cag stsol/ /klu nadang gsang ba lha min rnams/ /'phral du bsgo ba'i lung bzhin byed/ /bsgo ba'i lung ni bsgrubs nas su/ /rang rang gi ni gnas su dong / /de lta na ni lha dbang song / /de lta ma yin mi gtong 4ngo / /de nas bsgo lung bzhin byas nas / /de dag myur du gnas su dong / /slob dpon rdo rje 'chang ba posar /de nas phyag rgya btang byas te96/ /rdo rje'i gar gyi tshul gyis su7/ /rked 8pa'i gnas su gzhag par bya/ /rdo rje'i tshul gyis de nas yang / /rdo rje'i gar ‘ ni rab byas la/ /rdo rje zhags pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /sdang ba thams cad bcing bar bya / /dus bzhi tsho1 )rab tu bskul byas la11/ /gal te bsgo lung 'gal byed na/ /rdo rje'i lcags kyus dgug bya zhing / /rdo rje'i zhags pas bcing bar bya/ /rdo rje rnam pa'i sgra'o/ /rdo rje thal mo btsum 12nas su/ /mthun pa'i stabs su gnas byas te15/ /lag pas borgyab tu bsnun byas la/ /rdo rje gyen du 'phang bar bya/ /de nas rdo rje blta byas 15la/ /'brug sgra dal 'dra'i hūṃ brjod de/ /rkang pa spo ba'i tshul gyis su/ /g.yas dang de bzhin g.yon pa spo1 ‘/ /lag pa g.yon pa'i mdzub mo dang / /mthe bo sprad de zhags 1 par bya/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub mo yis/ /rtse bkug lcags kyus 18brtan por bya/ /rdo rje rgyags 19pa'i mig ldan pa / /so yis mchu mnan khros pa yis/ /gang la bgegs ni yod pa der/ /rdo rje stabs kyis myur song la/ /rkang pa g.yas brkyang stabs 2 byas lan / /rdo rje'i lcags kyu'i na phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad dgug gi bya zhing / /rdo rje zhags pas bcing bar bya/ /gal te 'khor lo can dang ni/ /dbang 87—311

bcas drag po tshangs bcas pa/ /gal te rdo rje 'chang srung yang / /sngags pas gzhi 1tshonas drangs (2te dgug /bkug nas rdo rjes dbacings pa yis/ /rdo rje'i gzeb tu gzhug 4par bya/ /ji srid 'dod pa rdzogs 'gyur ba(5)/ /de srid bar du gzhag par bya/ /bsgo ba'i lung ni mi nyan te ni/ /gal te 'dod pa ma rdzogs na / /bdag gi 'dod pa 7'byor 'dod pasarin// /de la chad pas gcad 99)par bya / /de yi gzugs ni byas nas su/ /rdo rje rkang pas gzir ri byas nanyu1/ / a la la 12zhes sgra 'byin cing / / lha yi (1 dbang po'ang bo'ong bar tsha'agyur/ /de la bsgo ba'i lung yang dbog17 /rdo rje gar gyis 1 tshode nas yang / /thal mo shin tu sbyar byas la/ /dbang chen stabs 1 kyis 'dug nas su/ /phyogs rnams kun du rgyas par bya/ /rkang pa spo ba'i tshul gyis su/ /g.yas dang de bzhin g.yon pa spom/ /lag pa gnyis ni sbyar nas su/ /phan tshun bsnol te khu tshur bcang 19)/ /gung mo gnyis ni gshibs 2 nas su/ /mdzub mo de la gzugs par bya nga yi rdo rje'i phyag rgya de/ /bgegs rnams kun gyi dam tshig yin/ /snga ma bzhin gyi stabs 21tshul gyis na/ /phyag rgyas bgegs rnams bkug nas su/ /khro bo yi ni rdo rje 'dis na/ /de la dam tshig sbyin par bya/ /rdo rje stabs kyi 5 phyag rgya bcing / /tsū zhes bya ba'i sgra phyung 5la/ /bdag nyid rdo rjer 27bsgyur nas su/ /bgegs rnams thams cad dgug par bya/ /lan ni smra bar mi byed na/ /de ni gtang 7bar mi bya'o/ /gal te cung zad mi smra na/ /de la chad pas gcad 28bya ste/ /shing gi dug dang star na bu dang / /yungs kur dag ni bsres pa las/ /de yi gzugs ni byas nas su/ /me yi nang du bor byas na/ /gal te tshangs pas bsrungs na yang / /bgegs de de yi mod la 'gro/ /sngags pas de la bsgo 187wa 312

bar bya/ /de nas de la rgyas par bya/ /byams pa'i sems ni bskyed nas su/ /phyag rgya btang bar bsam byas na0)/ /gzir dang bcing dang dgug 5pa rnams//thar nas bde bar gnas par 'gyur/ /de nas slob dpon rdo rje 'chang / /ye shes che la rab gzhol zhing (5)/ /sems can don la snying rje bas/ /rdo rje nyid du yang bsgyur te(4)/ /mthun pa'i rkang stabs byas nas su/ /rdo rje gar ni rab byas la/ /rdo rje thal mo legs sbyar te/ /phyogs rnams kun du rgyas par bya/ /gom pa spo ba'i tshul gyis su/ /g.yas dang de bzhin g.yon pa spo/ /lag pa gar byed tshul gyis ni/ /de nas thal mo rab 5sbyar ro/ /gom pa bskyod pa'i 6tshul gyis su(7)/ /mkhas pas phyogs bzhi rnams su bskor/ /rdo rjes /rengs byed phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad rengs par bya/ /myur du rdo rje gom pa yis/ /phyogs rnams rdo rje 99rengs par bya/ /rtse mo brgyad pa'i lhun po che/ /rdo rje mtshan can bsam par bya/ /'og tu lag pa rdo rje can/ /steng du g.yas pa'ang rdo rje can/ /rdo rjes 7rengs byed rab byed cing / /phyogs rnams kun du bskor byas na/ /gang dag sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i11/ /bgegs rnams thams cad rengs par 'gyur/ /rdo rje rengs byed byas pas na/ /bgegs byed phyir ni 'tshe 12mi byed/ /de yi spyi bor rdo rje ni/ /legs par 'dug par bsams (1 byas na/ /tshangs pa'i gnas la thug pa nas/ /sa 'og bdun la thug pa'i bar/ /rdo rjes yorengs pas rengs 'gyur te/ /rmongs shing sems kyang med par 'gyur/ /sngags pa mkhas pas 'dod bar du15/ /de srid du ni rengs par byedas/ /rdo rje tshul gyis de nas kyang 17/ /rdo rje'i gar ni rab byas la / /mtshog sna mar thal mo sbyar byas te/ /phyogs rnams kun du rgyas byas na/ /87wa 313

kun nas byung 1ba'i chu rnams kyang / /sngags pas bskam (2par byed par nus/ /mthun pa'i rkang stabs byas nas su/ /rdo rje'i thal mo gzhum (55byas la lag pa g.yas pa gyen du ni/ /zhags pa bcas pas (4 brkyang bar bya/ /de bzhin rkang pa g.yon pa ni/ /g.yon dang 5lhan cig gdeg 96par bya/ /de bzhin phyogs bzhi rnams su yang / /gom pa 'dor ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /mngon du bskal pa'i me lta bu/ /so yis mchu mnan 7khros pa yis/ /'og logs su ni mig bltas te/ /rdo rje'i gom pas myur song la/ /rkang pa g.yon pa bskum byas te / /lhun po'i /rtse mor gzhag par bya/ /'og ma shugs 9nas 'byin pa'i lag /g.yas pa steng khonas de bzhin te/ /mchod pa'i rkang stabs sbyar ba yis/ /kha yi tshul du 'dug par bya/ /rgod ma rta yi kha tshul gyis/ /rgya mtsho'i 1 chu rnams btung bar bya/ /rdo rje ldan pas 15bshad pa yi1 / /bsam gtan sngags pa ldan gyur na1 / /chu ni a la la 15zhes su/ /sgra 'byin kun nas 17'du 'gyur na/ /'bab chu dang ni chu klung dang / /sprin las byung 1 ba smos ci dgos/ /bskyod na gal te 'o ma yi/ /chu las byung ba'ang skam par 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i tshul gyis de nas yang / /rdo rje'i thal mo mtshog 18mar sbyar/ /phyogs rnams kun du rgyas byas te/ /sprin bzhin yongs su rgyas par bya/ /dbang chen gom stabs byas nas su/ /rkang pa spo ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /rkang pa g.yon pa bteg bya 19ste/ /de nas sa la gzhag par bya/ /rkang pa g.yas pa bteg nas su/ /g.yas phyogs su ni bskor bar bya/ /lag gnyis khu tshur 2 tshul gyis 21su/ /rdo rje ldan pa g.yas pa bsgreng / /g.yon pa mkhur bar brten nas su/ /'khor lo bzhin du yongs su bskor/ /de bzhin g.yas pa bzhag nas su/ /lag pa g.yon pas yongs su 87—314

bskor / /g.yas pa mkhur 1bar brten nas su/ /rdo rje ldan pa'i nagayon pa bsgreng ske/ /rdo rje gom pas myur song la/ /g.yas pa brkyang ba'i gom stabs kyis//ti se'i )rtse mor rkang bzhag ste/ /rkang stabs sbyar ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /lus ni 'dud 4pa byas nas su/ /rengs byed rtsa rabar sbyor ldan pas/ /so yis mchu 6mnan khros gyur cing / /bdag nyid me 7dang 'drar gyur pa / /stobs chen sgra yang cher 9ldan pa/ /gtum po 1 chen po pha rol gnon/ /rdo rje'i tshul gyis steng bskor la/ /nges par gnon 11pa blang bar 12bya/ /sngags pa sngags la 'jigs med pa/ /des 12ni gang du khros pa 1 'dor/ /rdo rje des gnon 15tshul gyis ni/ /rkang pa g.yon pa btsugs nas su/ /rdo rje gnon 17pas bsnun byas na17/ /dbang po chen po'ang phye mar rlog1 /rdo rje gnon 19pas bsnun byas da na/ /sa rnams thams cad rab tu g.yo21/ /lhun po mand+rar na ti se dang / / 'khor ri rnams ni na g.yo 'gyur na/ /lha min na sgo lta smos ci dgos/ /rdo rje ldan pas bshad na'o/ /bsnun pas rnam pa 55brgyar 'gyur te/ /phub ma sbar 2tshigang rlung gtor bzhin/ /slob dpon rdo rje 'chang ba pos/ /sa sbyang brtsam 2 par bya ba ni / /rdo rje'i thal mo sbyar nas su/ /snying gar na bzhag ste 29rgyas par bya/ /rkang pa rting sdo pa sprad nas su/ /lag pa gar byed spyod pa 1dang / /rkang pa bzhag pa'i tshul gyis su/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa gzhag par bya/ /rkang pa bskyod pa byas nas su/ /de nas rting pa yang sprad de/ /gar gyi tshul ni de nyid kyis / /phyogs bzhir yongs su bskor bar bya/ /khros pas dbus kyi gnas su ni / /rdo rje gom pas ri myur song la/ /rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas su/ / gung mos 8srin lag 'khyud byas la/ /gnyi jig khu tshur bcangs 5byas la ‘/ /rting pa sprad 87—315

pa'i rkang stabs kyis/ /sa la bzhag dang bteg bya ste 11/ /g.yas su yongs su brkyang rin byas la/ /bar bur thams cad bsal 8)bar bya/ /me me skuzhes ni brjod byas la/ /nang na gang dag ci yod pa/ /sngags pas thams cad bsal bar bya/ /hūm̐ dang bcas shing phaṭa bcas pa'i/ /gsang sngags mkhas pas 5cibarjod par bya/ /'og dang sa yi 6)steng na ni/ /bar bur thams cad zhir (7)'gyur te/ /kun du bgegs ni med gyur na 8)/ /sngags pas mnyam gzhag las rnams bya/ /de nas slob dpon rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje bzhag pa 9skulegs bslabs pas/ /rdo rje gar ni rab byas la/ /tshangs pa'i rkang stabs byas nas sum/ /padma'i thal mo sbyar byas te/ /snying ga'i 57thad kur bskor bar nyu7bya/ /gar byed tshul gyis lag pa gnyis/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcangs par 'bya/ /g.yon pa g.yon du brkyang bar bya/ /g.yas pa g.yas su brkyang bar bya/ /mthun pa'i rkang stabs 1 byas nas su/ /hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sgra brjod la/ /sngags pas 'khor lo bzhin du bskor/ /rdo rje gom pas myur song la/ /g.yas brkyang gom pa'i witshul gyis ni/ /rkang pa bzhag pa'i tshul gyis su/ /de nyid kyis ni yang bskor rol/ /hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sgra phyung la/ /de bzhin phyogs bzhi rnams su yang (15 /rdo rje khu tshur bskor bas na/ /bgegs rnams thams cad 'dar tshabar 'gyur/ /rdo rje blo dang ldan pa yis/ /sa bsdus 'dor bar 1 'dod na ni/ /gom pa bzhag pa'i 'gros 18kyis su/ /myur du g.yas pa brkyang byas la/ /gcig ni ri rab rtse la bzhag /cig shos ti se'i rtse mor bzhag /de ltar rkang stabs bzhag pa ni/ /kun du 'dor bar rab byed cing / /sa 'og na ni lag pa g.yon/ /g.yas pa sa yi steng na ste/ / a la la zhes 1 sgra 'byin cing / /'jig rten 87—316

khams kun 'phen 1)byed narinan/ /bgegs rnams gzhan lta ci zhig smos / /log 'dren sdang ba drag po rnams/ /mi yi 'jig rten 'di nas ni/ /gzhan du 'phen pa ci zhig smosangan/ /ci ste 'jig rten khams rnams kyang 5/ /kun nas tshig par byed 'dod na(6)/ /rkang stabs tshul ni de nyid kyis/ /phyogs bzhi dag tu 'jug par 'gyur(7ri/ /rdo rje'i gom pas myur song la/ /g.yas pa brkyang ba'i stabs (8)tshul gyis/ /nyi ma bcu gnyis lta bur ni/ / me lce 97phreng ldan bzod dka' ba/ /rkang pa g.yon pa brtan byas la/ /rdo rje 'dzin de 1 lag pa bsgreng //lus ni btud par (17byas nas su/ /rkang pa g.yas pa bteg byas la/ /sngags pas 32'khor lo bzhin du bskor/ /rlung lha rnams kun yang 1 skusdud byed cing / /nam mkha' me 'drar bsgyur nas su/ /bsreg pa'i bskal pa lta bur 'jug /lag na 'dzin pa'i rdo rje ni/ /kun du ri rab 'drar bsams la/ /rtsu zhes bya ba'i sgras gnon zhing bo/ /rdo rje 'og tu 'phangs 17byas na1 / /ri dang nags su bcas pa yi/ /sa rnams thams cad 'khrug par 'gyur/ /de nas thal ba nyid gyur 1 te/ /mer ni shing bal bcug pa bzhin/ /slob dpon rdo rje 'chang ba pos / /de nas bsdu ba brtsam byas te/ /rkang stabs tshul ni de nyid de/ /bye brag tu ni lag pa bsgreng 19/ /rdo rje gom pas myur song la mchongs pa 2 bskor ba byas nas su/ /phyag rgya yi 1ni stang na stabs bya/ /rgyab nas stang da stabs tshul gyis ni/ /dbus kyi gnas su phyin par bya/ /de bzhin phyogs bzhi 5 rnams su yang / /rdo rje 5bsnun pas brdeg par bya/ /stang 2dzistabs tshul ni de nyid dang / /sngags pa blo ldan lag tshul gyis/ /sa rnams thams cad blangs 2 byas la/ /de nyid du ni gzhag par bya/ /kun nas bsdu bar na byed cing ni smyo/ /87wa 317

mkhas pas gsang sngags brjod byas la/ /rdo rje can gyis bshad pa bzhin/ /sa rnams kun du gzhag par bya/ /rim pa yi 1ni 'di nyid kyis/ /mkhas pa rithams cad kun du bzhag /de nas slob dpon rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje zhags pa legs bslabs pas/ /sdang 4ba lha dang lha min dang / /mi rnams gzhag bya gdul bar bya/ /bsam dbang bzhin du 'byung ba yi 5/ /rdo rje'i ye shes legs bslabs pas/ /'dul ba'i tshogs ni tha dad pa/ /thams cad rnam par gdul bar bya/ /gdung bas 'dul ba'i 'jig rten ni / /gdung ba nyid kyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi tshul gyis su / /dpa' bo 8lnga po kun du bya / /mthun pa'i rkang stabs byas nas su/ /g.yas brkyang dzastabs kyis gnon 1 par bya/ /rkang stabs bzhag pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /'ben la lta zhing lag pas gtang ske/ /srin lag mthe'u chung sprad byas la/ /lag gnyis lu gu rgyud du bya/ /g.yon pa'i 11gung mo mtheb mtshungs sbyar12/ /g.yas pa yi ni mdzub mo de/ /brkyang ba'i tshul du byas pa ni/ /gzhu dang mda' 1/zhes brjod pa yin/ /gung mo yi ni rgyab logs su/ /mdzub mo mda' yi tshul du bzhag /g.yas brkyang stang 1 stabs tshul gyis su15/ /hūm̐ bcas brjod de phog par bsnun/ /gal te sa yi 'og gnas sam/ /tshangs pa'i gnas na 1phyoganas gyur tam/ /drag pos bsrungs par gyur kyang rung / /rdo rje 'phang bar byas 1 nas su/ /rdo rje mda' 18yis phog gyur na/ /de ni 19gson par mi bsam mo/ /'phang ba'i stang 2 ristabs sol/ /de nas slob dpon rdo rje 'chang / /thabs shes pa la mkhas gyur cing / /'phang 21pa'i tshul du legs bslabs pa/ /sdang ba'i sems can gdul 22bar bya/ /de nas slob dpon rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje zhags 2 pa legs bslabs pas/ /87—318

srid pa gsum la khyab lus kyis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gdul 1bar bya/ /mthun pa'i rkang stabs 2byas nas su/ /rkang pa bzhag pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /lag pa g.yas dang g.yon pa yis / /thal mo khong stong sbyar bar bya/ /de yi phyag rgya bcings nas su/ /phyogs rnams kun du 4bskor byas na/ /srid pa gsum yang 'gugs pa'agyur na/ /log 'dren bgegs rnams smos ci dgos/ /dgug pa'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas slob dpon rdo rje 'chang / /mthun pa'i rkang stabs byas nas su/ /padma'i 6thal mo sbyar byas la/ /phyogs rnams kun du rgyas par bya47ske/ /rkang stabs bzhag pa'i tshul gyis su/ /gnas ni myur du bzung 8byas la//rdo rje khu tshur snying gar 9bzhag /khros pas rtsu gi sgra brjod de/ /rgya mtsho bzhi po'i klu 1 rnams la/ /rdo rje'i lag pas bsnun par bya/ /klu skrag 11thal mo sbyar ba dag /rgya mtsho nas ni 'thon 12par gyur1 / /gang dag sa yi 'og gnas pa/ /lha min ngasrin po gsang ba 15rnams/ /bsgo ba'i lung la brtson yid kyis/ /ci tshol 7cig ces 'khod 1 par byed/ /rdo rje 'bar bas bdag nyid 1 gzir/ /gnod sbyin mo'am srin mo 19'am/ /lha min mo'am klu mo'am/ /bcud kyis len nam dngul chu'am/ /rin chen rnams dang 2 nor bu rgyal 1/ /dpal dang 5 phun sum 'dod ldan nam/ /thugs la ci dang ci bzhed pa/ /bdag cag rnams la bka' myur 465na / /sngags pas gang yang rung blangs la / /gsang ba kun du gtang nibar bya/ /bsgo ba'i lung dang 'gal bar byed phyo/ /ci ste bsgo yang 2 mi 'ong na/ /rkang stabs tshul ni de nyid kyis/ /g.yon brkyang 2 stabs kyis gnon 9par bya/ /lhun po la ni rkang bzhag ste/ /lag pas dbyug pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sgra sgrog da cing ni thams cad gnas / /sa 'og thams cad gnon 5par bya/ /87—319

ha ha zhes ni sgra 'don 1cing / /bsgo ba'i lung dang rdzusa'agal byed pa/ /thams cad kyis ni bzung /rinas su/ /shin tu myur du dbug par (0byed/ /sngags pas de gcig tshar bcad 955de/ /lhag ma thams cad gtang (lebar bya/ /bsgo ba'i lung la de bzhag la/ /mkhas pas legs par bslab 9 )par bya/ /gsang ba srin po thams cad la/ /dgyes tsho pa'i sems ni yang bskyed de/ /de dag dam tshig byin nas ni/ /de rnams kun du gtang (9 bar bya// //'phags pa lag na rdo rje dbang bskur balnga/ bam po bcu gcig pa/ de nas slob dpon rdo rje 'chang / /snying brtse snying rje'i sems ldan pas/ /mi dang mi min la sogs pa/ /shin tu gnod byed lha rnams dang 37/ /lha min gsang bar bcas rnams dang 12/ /gzhan yang sdang ba'i gdon la sogs/ /nad sbrul dug la sogs rnams kyis/ /sems can rnams la gnod byed cing / /dam tshig la ni mi gnas te/ /rgyags pa'i yid dang ldan pa dag(lha /nad dang mu ge la sogs pas/ /sems can rnams la gnod byed de/ /pha rol gnod byed rngumangon dga' ba/ /de dag snying rje med pa dang / /bstan pa las geni 'gal byed cing / /shin tu rgyags pa'i shas che ba/ /mthong nas de dag tshar gcad nyisaphyir / /sngags la 1 mkhas pas sbyar bar bya/ /bdag la sdig par 'gyur snyam du / /bdag nyid las 1 ni mi sems shing / /bdag nyed lam 19min zhugs gyur lam/ /gzhan dang gzhan yang phung byed pa/ /gzhan la gnod pa )de dag la/ /sngags pas bzod pa 21mi bya ste/ /skrag na par bya zhing bcing bar bya/ /gtub nasapar bya zhing gsad 2 par bya/ /de nas slob dpon rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje zhags pa legs bslabs pas/ /nam mkha' go skabs med byas te/ /rdo rje dbyibs 87wa 320

su bsgyur nas su/ /gus pas bsgrims 17bcas 'jo tshul dang / /bzhin 'dzum rgyags (lde)dang ldan pa yis/ /rdo rje'i gar ni rab byas la/ /lag pa bskyod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /phyogs rnams kun du gar bya zhing / /dngos dang mthun par bzung (8)byas la/ / bsgom pa (4)la ni sems bzhag cing / /rdo rje'i rang bzhin lus sra bas/ /mi mthun rkang stabs tshul gyis ni/ /rdo rje 'chang bas lag bsgreng ste/ /rdo rje mig gis kun bltas la/ /srid pa gsum po thams cad gnon(5)ske/ /dpa' bo'i 96)gnas su gnas nas su/ /rkang pa gdengs 7pa'i tshul gyis su98)/ /hūm̐ brjod 'jigs pa 'jigs su rung 9kyi/ /mig gnyis nyi ma zla ba ste / /kha ni rgod ma rta yi kha/ /lte ba dga' bo nye dga' bo/ /lto ba rgya mtshor bsam par bya/ /lhun po de yi 1 rimago bor 11bya/ /de bzhin lag pa 'khor 15yug ril/ /sa ni rkang pa gnyis yin te/ /nor rgyas bu sprul gsang bsrel yin15/ /rlung ni de yi riborna ba gnyis/ /de yi 15spa rnams me yin te/ /lce ni 'jigs pa chen po'i 7glog / a la la 1 zhes sgra chen ldan/ /'brug sgra hūṃ zhes sgra phyung bas18 / /phyogs rnams kun du yongs su bskor/ /rab tu bskul bas de nas ni / /rdo rje'i sgra yis bskyel 19gyur nas/ /klu dang dri za srin po dang / /lha dang lha min sogs kun dong / /rtsu brjod pas 21ni 'jigs gyur 22zhing / /'chi bar 'gyur te the tshom med/ /rdo rje sgra yis tshig 'gyur zhing na / /blong bar gyur cing 25dman par blta tsi/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor cher na ldan pa/ /ga la ba der nye bar dong 8/ /rdo rje chen pos 29bka' stsol la / / lhan cad 1de ltar ma mdzad cig /de nas dam tshig bzhag byas la/ /lha rnams thams cad gtang 2bar bya/ /rdo rje 'jigs pa gtum che ba na/ /'jigs pa chen po 'jigs byed 87—321

pa / /'jigs par 1bya rnams 2'jigs bskyed pa/ /chen pos mchod 'os rmad byung bas/ /mi dang mi ma yin rnams la/ /'jigs chen ltas 'byung che 'byung dang ske/ /lha dang klu dang sha za dang / /gza' dang ma mo brtse med rnams/ /nad dang mu ge la sogs dang / /yul 'khrugs pa dang 'chi byed dang / /bdud rnams dang ni log 'dren dang 4/ /srul po srin po la sogs pa'ang 5/ /bdag yul gzhan yul las byung ba'i/ /gnod pa gzhan yang du ma rnams/ /de dag rnam par gzhig pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed sbyar bar bya/ /rkang pa rgyas par bya tshul gyis/ /hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i sgra brjod na/ /rdo rje 'jigs pas phyirab bskul bas/ /thams cad myur du 'jigs 7par 'gyur/ /'di ni don yod thogs pa med/ /rdo rje 'jigs pa mi bzad pa/ /sngags pas kun du sbyor byas nasal/ /srid pa gsum yang dbang 'gyur na/ /mi yi 'jig rten mngag gzhug pal/ /byed par gyur pa /smos ci dgos/ /tshig gis cung zad bskul bas na/ /gang dag shin tu dregs ldan pas9/ /srin po lha min gsang ba pa1 / /de dag thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /rdo rje ye shes legs bslabs pas/ /dbang phyug kun dang yon tan thob11/ /lha rnams kun gyi rgyal por 'gyur/ /mkhas pas dbang la 'god par byed/ /klu yi gnas su klu rnams dang / /gnod sbyin rgyal dang gnod sbyin dang / /dri za rnams kyi bdag por 'gyur/ /lha min gnas su lha min dang / /mkha' lding gnas su mkha' lding dang / /mi ci rnams kyi bdag por 'gyur/ /lha dang lha min mir bcas pa/ /bsgo ba'i lung bzhin gus sems kyis/ /rdo rje 'jigs sgra cher 12ldan pa/ /de yi dbang du thams cad 'gyur / /rdo rje 'jigs su rung ba yi1 / /sgra chen po yi 1 phyag rgya'o/ /kun la 87wa 322

rdo rje rab 'phrul 1ba/ /de yi 'og tu brjod par bya/ /dpal ldan mchod pa byed pa pos/ /phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs rnams kyi/ /sangs rgyas rnam pa kun du mchod/ /srid par bdag nyid che rnams kyi/ /bsam yas mchod min gang yang med/ /'dzum dang bcas shing mig rgyas pas/ /g.yas pa dang ni g.yon tshul gyis/ /rdo rje'i thal mo btsum nabyas la/ /phyogs bcu rnam pa kun du 'dud / /dpral bar thal mo sbyar byas la/ /phyogs rnams kun du yongs bskor zhing / /dus gsum rnam par bzhugs 4pa yi/ /sangs rgyas kun la phyag bya'o / /bde gshegs kun la phyag bya mchod/ /sems can 'dul zhaba'i mchod pa ni/ /bsam pa ji bzhin 'jug 6pa ste/ /bsam pa tha dad sems can khams / /bsam pa sna tshogs rnam par 'phel/ /bsam pa sna tshogs rnam rtog pa ske/ /bsam pa chags med /de dang des/ /sngags pas rnam pa thams cad du//sems can khams mang gdul 9bar bya/ /de nas slob dpon rdo rje 'chang / /kun la shes pa'i bocher byung 1 ba'i/ /sgeg 12dang dpa' dang snying rje dang / /rgod 1lhadang khro 1 dang 'jigs byed dang / /'jigs rung rmad byung zhi ba rnams/ /bsam pa chags pas 15rnam dgur 17dgongs/ /de nas slob dpon rdo rje 'chang //kun la ye shes 'byung byed pa'i17/ /rkang pa g.yas dang g.yon pa ni/ /gom pas 18mdzes dang ldan pa yis/ /lag pa g.yas dang g.yon pa ni/ /gar byed pa yi tshul gyis su/ /mdzub mo mthe bo rtse sprad la/ /g.yon phyogs su ni blta bar bya/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa sbyar tshul gyis19/ /'dzum bcas 5 rgyas pa gus bsgrims shing 21/ /lag na rdo rje 2 gsor ldan pas/ /rjes su chags pas gar bya'o / /lha rnams kun dang gsang ba dang / /lha ma yin dang mi rnams dang / /87wa 323

'dod khams dbang phyug bdag 1)po dang / /sa gsum gnas rnams chags byed cing ske/ /mig zur bgrad (midang lta ba yis/ /de dag thams cad dbang du 'gyur ske/ /sa gsum thams cad 'gugs byed na/ /sa steng (cadami rnams smos ci dgos / /lha yi rgyal po sogs bkug nas/ /sdom pa can gyi rdo5)dbang 'jog ste/ /thams cad bsgo ba bzhin byed cing / /mngag gzhug (6)par ni rab tu dgod/ /rdo rje cher 57༄ldan kun shes nas / /rdo rje glu ni blang bar bya/ /rdo rje glu yis bskul bas na/ /rjes su chags dang 99)chags chen 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpar mos 1 pa yis/ /glu dang gar ni rab tu bya/ /bsam pa chags pas brgyal gyur nas11 / /sems can khams ni rjes chags bya/ /rdo rje'i glu ni 'di yin no12/ /sa gsum dag na 'bar ba'i sku mnga' rjes su chags mdzad 'dul ldan pas32/ /nyi ma stong phrag bcu bas rno ba'i 'od zer stong dang ldan pa posanyi / /rnam mang cha byad gzugs kyis sems can 'gro ba rjes su chags mdzad pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dbang phyug dam pa mdzes pa'i stobs ldan gar mdzad gsol/ / ṣa ṭa 'ab la sogs pa'i ga16/ /rdo rje gar gyis bya ba na417/ /sa gsum thams cad 'gugs 12byed na/ /sa steng zhu/mi rnams smos ci dgos/ /rdo rje gar gyi phyag rgya'o / /de nas slob dpon rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje nyid du yang sgyur zhing / /rdo rje gar gyi sbyor ba yis/ /thams cad la ni gar mkhan bya/ /gom stabs thams cad mdzes ldan par/ /g.yas pa da dgug pa'i phyag rgya dang 1/ /g.yon pas btang ba'i 22phyag rgya bya/ /mig zur bgrad na dang lta ba yis/ /lag pa g.yas dang g.yon pa yis/ /'khyud par byed pa'i sbyor ldan pas/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha rnams ni/ /rnam pa kun du dbang bsgyur rite/ /mngag gzhug pa ni 87—324

rab byed cing / /rdo rje can gyi lung la brtson/ /rdo rje chags pas chags byas pas / /shin tu chags pas dregs myos pa'i/ /lha dang mi dang gsang ba pa1/ /bsgrub bya rin rnams kyang sngags pas bsgrub/ /rdo rje'i lus la yongs chags pas/ /'dod chags thams cad yongs su 'dorarin / /rdo rje'i glu snyan ldan pa yis/ /sems can khams rnams chags par bya/ /rjes su chags pas chags pa'i phyir/ /lha rnams thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i glu yi 4snyan pa'i sgra rnams thams cad dang / /gzod ldanas rang bzhin dag pas rdo rje sems dpa' bskul / /sgyu ma'i dngos po rnam 56mang dang / /snyan pa'i sgra ni de nyid dang / /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul thams cad kyis/ /dbang bsgyur de nas sangs rgyas snang ske/ /'jig rten thams cad yongs su 'dren/ /bdud rnams thams 7cad yongs su 'dul/ /shes pa thams cad yongs su sbyong / /sems can thams cad yongs smin byed/ /glu 'di rab tu len byed cing / /rdo rje'i gar ni rab byas na/ /lha dang gang dag gnod sbyin dang / /lha min klur bcas thams cad 'grub / /rdo rje'i grus ni rina'adren pa'o/ /de nas slob dpon rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje sems dpar yang bsgyur te/ /dpa' 9chen bsam par 1 kun chags pas/ /dpa' bos nyu1lnga po bstan ri12par bya/ /mthun pa'i rkang stabs byas nas su/ /g.yas pa brkyang bas nyu pha rol gnon1 / /g.yon pa brkyang ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /seng ge bzhin du bsgyings par 15bya/ /tshangs pa'i gnas la yang gnas te/ /rdo rje se gol sbyor ba dang / /rdo rje bsnun stabs tshul gyis ni/ /tshangs pa la sogs bsdu bar bya/ /rdo rje'i glu ni len byed cing / /sa gsum 'bar ba'i sku ldan pa/ /nyi ma bye ba 'bar mtshungs pa/ /nam mkha' mtshungs shing mnyam 87—325

med pa/ /chos dang rgyal mchog rnams kyi gtso/ /sangs rgyas sku mchog de la 'dud / /so yis mchu ni rab gnon 1cing / /kun nas mig can khro gnyer bzhin / /rked 25par rdo rje brten nas su/ /phyogs bcu kun du )blta bar bya/ /g.yas pa rdo rje tshul gyis ni/ /phyogs rnams kun du rab bsgrags pas(4)/ /lta 'jigs 'od zer 'bar ldan zhing / /bsreg 5pa'i bskal pa gzhan 6lta bu/ /grub 'gyur rdo rje me 'bar ba/ /'jigs pa che ltar bzod dka' bas/ /bgegs rnams la ni sbyor bar bya/ /'jig rten gsum po thal bar rlog /nyes pa chen po ma yin la/ /phyag rgya 'di ni sbyar mi bya/ /thun mong ma yin dgos napa ni/ /tha ma'i tshe na sbyar bar bya/ /rdo rje 'chang bas bsrungs gyur kyang ske/ /hūṃ brjod pas ni thal bar rlog9 / 'jig pa'i me 1 )ltar bzod dka' ba117/ /rdo rje chen po'i 12phyag rgya'o/ /de nas slob dpon rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje'i ye shes legs bslabs pas/ /snying gar 1/rdo rje khu tshur gnyis/ /bzhag nas 'di snyam bsam pa ste1 / /sems dmyal yi dgas dud 'gro dang / /gang gzhan sdug bsngal sdug bsngal rnams/ /lag pas 15drang ba'i sbyor ba yis /bde ba kun gyis bstabs 7par bya/ /bza' 1 btung la sogs char pa dang / /gos dang rin chen rgyan 1 gyi char/ /de dag rnams la kun du dbab/ /ci bder yang dag bstabs pas na/ /snying rje 19sbyan ras gzigs dbang bzhin/ /kun du yongs su rgyas par bya/ /sems can kun gyi 2 bla med bde/ /thob par shog ces 21bsam par bya/ /snying rje'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas slob dpon rdo rje can na / /rdo rje ye shes legs bslabs pas/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcing bya zhing / /mtshog 2 mar thal mo sbyar bar bya/ /bteg 2 dang sgeg na pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /de 87wa 326

nas myur du smad 91)par bya/ /rdo rje bgad 2chen phyag rgya 'di/ /rdo rje 'chang nyid bzhin du dgod / /bgad 4pa chen po'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas lag pa snegayas bteg ste6ci/ /g.yon pa rked 7pa'i phyogs su bzhag /g.yon brkyang rkang stabs byas nas su/ /de nas thal mo yang sbyar te / /'jigs rung sgra 9ni grag 1 byed cing / /thal mo sbyar ba btud par bya/ /'jigs su rung ba chen po'i sgra'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas brkyang rkang pa'i stabs byas te/ /lag pa gnyis kyis rgyal 11rol du/ /khu tshur gnyis ni bcang bar bya/ /bgegs 12kun 'dar bar 1 bya ba'i phyir/ /mgul pa nges par smad bya zhing / /sgra chen rab tu brjod byas na/ /phyag rgya 'di yi nya sbyor ba yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad 'dar bar 15'gyur//mthun pa'i rkang stabs byas nas su/ /mtshog 1 tshomar thal mo sbyar byas la/ /lag pa gnyi ga 1 sto bar gzhag /g.yas brkyang rkang stabs sbyor ba yis/ /sngags pas 'khor lo bzhin du bskor/ /ha ha zhes pas rab brgyan 1 pa/ /phyag rgya 'di ni rgya chen te19/ /ri rnams phye mar rlog 2 byed na/ /sdang ba'i sems can ci smos te/ /sngags pa'i 'dod pa bzhin du 'gyur/ /mthun pa'i rkang stabs byas nas su/ /lag pa gyen du bsgreng byas la/ /gdu bu'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya / /de bzhin so yis ma 21mchu mnan gi/ /g.yon pa brkyang ba legs sbyar bas//bgegs rnams kun la bsnun par bya/ /phyag rgya 'di ni sgra na chen te/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bzlog 2 pa yin/ /phyag rgya 'di ni legs sbyar bas/ /thams cad bzlog par gyur pa yin/ /mthun pa'i rkang stabs byas nas su/ /lag gnyis brang la sbyar 25ba las/ /lag pa g.yas pa bsgreng byas te/ /rkang 2 pa g.yon brkyang legs sbyar bas27/ /tho ba yi ni phyag rgya yis/ /rdo rje 'chang nyid 87wa 327

yin pa'ang (17bsnun/ / rdo rje tho bas bsnun pas na/ /(mide yi mod la phye mar 55)'gyur / /tho ba'i stang stabs 4)so/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i sbyor ba yang / /lag pa mchan khung gzhug par bya/ /nyi ma 'bar 'dra'i lta 'dra /ltebs/ /hūṃ brjod bsnyems pas thur rme du blta/ /lag na tsho7༄rdo rje nyid bsgyur te/ /'jigs su rung ba'i sgra phyung 8la/ /rgya mtsho man dār 9bcas pa yibo/ /sa rnams thams cad g.yo bar bya/ /so yis mchu ni mnan bya zhing / /rdo rje rkang pas bsnun par bya/ /phyag rgya 'di ni legs sbyar bas17/ /de dag thams cad 'dar 12bar 'gyur / /g.yas brkyang rkang stabs byas nas su/ /lag gnyis khu tshur bcang 51 tshul gyis/ /g.yon pa brang la sbyar chosabar bya/ /g.yas pa gyen du bsgreng byas la/ /mdzub mo myur du bsgreng byas shing / /rdo rje'i sgra ni dbyung gebyas na/ /gal te sangs rgyas nyid gyur kyang 17/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bskyel bar bya/ /rdo rje can gyis 1 bshad yin no518/ /snang ba'i sems can smos ci dgos/ /phyag rgya 'di 19ni bskyod pas na/ /de dag thams cad dul 2 stabar 'gyur/ /mthun pa'i rkang stabs byas nas su/ /g.yas pa gyen du bsgreng byas la/ /lag pa thal mo brkyang bar bya/ /g.yon pa brang du sbyar 21bar bya/ /lag pas na myur du bsnun stabs kyis/ /hūṃ dang bcas pas sa la bsnun/ /nam mkha' me 'bar 'dra ba yi / /ral gri'i na phyag rgya bcing na byas la/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gtub 5par bya/ /rdo rje can gyis 27bshad yin non / /mthun pa'i rkang stabs byas nas su / /lag pa 'og tu bcug 2snyenas ni/ /rkang pa'i dbus tsho smyonas bzung rte )byas la//de ni gyen du bteg par bya/ / hūṃ zhes rdo rje 1sgra dang ni/ /khros shing khro gnyer bcas pa yis/ /rkang pa de yis yang bsnun la/ /der ni bgegs ni bsam 87wa 328

par bya/ /rdo rje'i rkang pas bsnun byas na17/ /ri rab rnams kyang phye mar rlogarin /rdo rje rkang pa'i stang smyos/stabs so/ /g.yas brkyang rkang stabs sbyor ba yis(ge / /lag gnyis 'khor lo'i tshul du brkyang / /so yis mchu mnan khros pa yis / /kun du 'khor lo 'phang bar bya/ /phyogs rnams kun na 5gnas pa yi/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams gzhig 56)par 'gyur/ /zhig par 'gyur ba'i 7zhing rnams nas/ /rgyal ba dam pa rnams kyang 'byon / /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che/ /gang gzhan dbang ni thob 'gyur ri9rnams/ /blong 7zhes gyur nas blo ldan pa/ /lag na rdo rje'i gan du dong / /srog zad na ni mi rung gis11/ /bu gcig nged kyis ci zhig bya/ /khyod ni ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /nged kyis myur du sgrub bo zhes/ /rdo rje sems dpa' blo ldan la15/ /lung ni yongs su nod par mdzad/ /bskal pa 1lhame ltar gyur pa yis/ /g.yas brkyang stang 1 stabs byas nas su/ /'bar ba'i phyag rgya legs sbyar bas/ /sa gsum thams cad 'bar bar bya/ /sa gsum 'bar bar mthong gyur nas/ /sngags pa rnams la rtag 'tshe ba/ /bgegs 57byed ma rungs gluchen po pa/ /srin po snang ba rnams skrag go/ /phyag rgya 'di 'dra mthong gyur nas/ /de nas de dag zhi bar 'gyur/ / mthun pa'i rkang stabs byas nas su/ /17de tshe nges par bsnun blangs la/ / sngags pas 18gyen du 'phang bar bya/ /de tshe sos ni 19mchu mnan la/ /myur du gom pa 2 gcig bor te/ /nges par bsnun pas 1bsnun de 25tshe/ /srin po sdang ba bgegs dbyed pa/ /de dag thams cad phye mar 'gyur/ /rdo rje nges bsnun phyag rgya yis/ /de dag thams cad bzlog par bya / /dbang chen gnas la gnas nas su/ /lag pa gnyis ni bsgreng byas la/ /lhun po'i 25rgyal po blangs 87wa 329

nas 1su/ /lag pa gnyis su de bzhag na nas/ /sngags pa la ni bgegs (5)byed pa / /sdang ba'i sems can rnams la bsnun/ /bsnun pas rnam par phung 'gyur cing ca/ /'chi bar 'gyur te the tshom med/ /rnal 'byor gzhol ba'i sngags pa la / / gang tshe bgegs shig bgegs 'byed na / /de tshe sngags pa stobs chen gyis / /phyag rgya 'di la sbyar bar bya/ /phyag rgya 'di la rab sbyar ba9/ /mthong nas de dag 'dar 1 bar 'gyur/ /de nas slob dpon rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje ye shes legs bslabs pas/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag byas nas/ /cod pan stabs kyi thabs 11bshad do/ /sngags pas shar phyogs kha bltas la/ /lag pa g.yas pa mtshog 15mar bzhag /g.yon pa rked 1 pa'i phyogs su bzhag /rghaṃ zhes bya ba'i sgra phyung la/ /'brug sgra dal 'dra'i phyag rgya yis/ /phyogs rnams kun du bskor bar bya/ /g.yas 7brkyang ba yi 15tshul gyis kyang 10/ /ngang pa'i rtsal gyi sbyor ba yis/ /lag pa g.yas pa gdengs 1 byas na/ /rgya mtsho rnams kyang bteg par 'gyur/ /ngang pa'i rtsal gyi phyag rgya'o/ /rkang pa g.yas pa bteg nas su/ /lag pa gnyis ni sar btsugs la/ / a la la 1 zhes 19rnam brgyan pas/ /sa gsum thams cad bteg byas na/ /rgya mtshor bcas pa'i ri rab kyang / /thams cad shin tu bteg par 'gyur/ / man dā ra dang ti se dang / /gzhan yang gang dag ri rnams kyang / /ha la ha la'i phyag rgya yis/ /bsnun pa de dag slar mi 'chags / /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i sbyor ba yang / /lag pa gnyis ni lto bar na bzhag /hūṃ brjod snyems 2 pas mar bltas te/ /so yis mchu ni mnan byas la/ /rdo rje cod pan phyag rgya 25yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bza' bar bya/ /g.yon pa brkyang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /de yi tshe na g.yon bteg 87wa 330

ste / /khros dang bcas pas rkang bzhag pas/ /sa gsum thams cad drang bar bya / /drang ba'i cod pan gyi 1)phyag rgya'o/ /mthun pa'i rkang stabs byas nas su/ /lag pa gnyis ni bteg byas la/ /bgegs rnams thams cad 'ching byed 2cing ske/ /'khor lo bzhin du phyogs su bskor/ /phyag rgya 'di la legs sbyar bas la/ /de dag bcings 94kyidang gzir bar 'gyur/ /bgegs rnams thams cad sel bar byed5ci/ /rdo rje can ni 6nyid kyis bshad/ /bgegs 7skrag par byed 8pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /rnal 'byor stan la 'dug nas su/ /rkang pa g.yas pa bteg nas ni9kyi/ /lag gnyis 'khor lo'i 1 tshul du bya/ /rkang pa gcig ni 11yongs su bskor/ /'khor lo cod pan phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bskyel bar bya/ /mthun pa'i rkang stabs byas nas su/ /me tog thal mo sbyar tshul 1 gyis/ /de yi 15tshe na sa la bzhag /de nas myur du yang bteg 1 go/ /'dis mchod pas na sngags pa la/ /thams cad bgegs 15byed mi 'gyur ro/ /mchod pa'i cod pan gyi phyag rgya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i 10bdag po skrag par byed 1 pa zhes bya ba'i stang 1 stabs yod de19/ nga byang chub sems dpar gyur pa na/ bskal pa dpag tu med par gyur pa de'i tshe de'i dus na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas rgyan gyi 2 dbyangs las ngas thos kyis21/ de legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung na shig dang ngas khyod la bshad do/ /de yis skrag par byas nas na bgegs/ /log 'dren thams cad gdungs par 'gyur/ /phyogs rnams kun du 'bros byed cing / /'chi bar gyur te the tshom med/ /lag gnyis phan tshun bsnol nas su/ /g.yon pa brkyang 87—331

bar rab sbyar te51/ /phyogs rnams kun du bskor bar bya55)/ /de nas rkang pas yang mnan no55)/ /skrag byed 'di ni skrag pa che/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bzlog pa ste/ /skrag pas rnam par phung 'gyur zhing / /'chi bar gyur te the tshom medam/ /de nas rkang pa'i tshul gyis kyang 4/ /mig ni thur ri5)du blta (6byas la/ /lag pa g.yas pa bsgreng nas ni/ /g.yon pa brang la bcar ri7)byas te/ /lag pa sa la brdabs nas 8ni/ /rdo rje'i thal mos bsnun par bya/ /rdo rje thal mo'i stang (stabs so/ /rnal 'byor stan la yang 'dug ste/ /mtshog ri mar thal mo sbyar byas la/ /rkang pa g.yas pa bteg nas su/ /'khor lo bzhin du yongs su bskor / /'di ni rlung 'ching chen po ste/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs/ /gal te rnam 'thor 11rlung byung yang / /de yang mi g.yo 'dug par 'gyur/ /rlung 'ching ba yi stang 1 stabs so/ /gar gyi tshul gyis 1 legs bslabs pas/ /rkang pa spo bar byas pas 1 yang / /lag pa thur du smad byas la/ /lag gnyis mthe bo srin lag sprad/ /g.yon pa brkyang ba 15legs sbyar te/ /lag pa g.yas pas gar bya'o/ /gar gyis 17bgegs rnams thams cad ni/ /shin tu dga' ba skye bar 'gyur/ /dga' bas sngags 1 pa de la ni/ /de dag phyin cad bgegs 18mi byed19/ /mthun pa'i rkang stabs byas nas su/ /lag pa g.yas pa bsgreng bya sten ske/ /g.yon pa ral gri'i tshul byas la/ /gnyi 1ga gcig tu sbyar bar bya /gal te rdo rje 'chang gyur kyang / /bgegs rnams thams cad drang bar bya /kun nas shin tu drangs nas kyang / /de nas phyag rgya gtang 2bar bya/ /rdo rje'i zhags pas bcing 2 byas na / /gnod par gyur pas kun du yang / / a la la ri gzhes 24sgra 'byin cing / /sems ni blong 2 zhes gyur pa yis/ /blo ldan lag na rdo 87wa 332

rje la/ /lung ni yongs su nod 1)par byed/ /phyin cad bgegs 2ni ma byed ces / /lag na rdo rjes dalung bsgo'ordo ni/ /rdo rjes 95gzir ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags pa (phyiraci ltar (7)'dod pa bzhin/ /de nas snying rje yang bskyed de/ /sngags pas mnyam 85)gzhag sa la ni(she kyi/ /me tog thal mo sbyar nas su/ /de yi tshe na de dag la/ /gang tshe sngags pa 57mnyam gzhag ste11/ /khyed cag bgegs 12ni ma byed par/ /gnas su deng zhes nyu brjod par bya/ /g.yas brkyang stang 1 stabs byas nas su/ /lag pa gyen du bsgreng bar bya/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i tshul gyis kyang ris/ /khu tshur mchan khung gnyis su gzhags /hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sgra ldan pal/ /sngags pa drag po'i 7las byed pas/ /phyogs rnams thams cad kun nas kyang ske/ /rdo rje gzir bas gzir bar bya/ /gzhan yang gang dag log 'dren bgegs / /srin po gang dag grags pa dang / /rgod ma rta yi kha gdangs 1 par//de dag thams cad gzir gyur cig19 /rdo rje gzir ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /gzir nas de dag lhags gyur 2 tshote/ /shin tu mi bzad 'dar 1byed cing / /srog zad gyur na mi rung gis 2/ /ci 'tshal na bka' ni myur gsol ces / /bsgo ba'i lung ni nod 5par byed/ /sngags pas ci 'dod lung na bzhin du/ /gal te lung ni nod byed na/ /de lta na ni thar bar 'gyur/ /gzhan du na ni nam yang min/ /shin tu mi bzad gzir bas na/ /khyod ni ci bzhed de bzhin du/ /bgyid kyis 8bka' lung stsol cig ces/ /de tshe de dag de skad smra/ /mtshog 9mar rdo rje thal bzhag nas/ /de nas de dag dam tshig sbyin/ /sa la bgegs kyi gzugs bris la / /g.yas pa brkyang 21bas mnan dananas su/ /rdo rje ral gri'i ra phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gtub par bya/ /gtub 25par byas 87wa 333

pas de dag kun/ /de la skyabs su 'gro bar byed/ /snying rjer 1ldan pa'i sems kyis su/ /de nas phyag rgya gtang 2bar bya/ /snying rje'i sems kyis de dag la/ /ma 'jigs shig ces smra bar bya/ /sngags pas de yi da 'dod pa bzhinal/ /de nas de dag rang gnas 'dod/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag phyag rgya gsum yod de/ gang ngas 4bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig tu byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa de'i 5tshe/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa spyod pa'i rgyan gyi snying po las 6phyag rgya gsum thob ste/ bskal pa du mar de bstan pa tsam gyis bgegs rnams 7kyis nga 8la ma gtses kyis 9sems rtse gcig tu bsgrims 1 la de nyon cig /g.yas brkyang rkang stabs byas nas su/ /lag pa g.yon pa snying gar 11bzhag /g.yas pa gar dang bcas pa yis /mtshog 12mar legs par gzhag par bya/ /bgegs rnams rtag tu gzhig pa yi ri /dam tshig 'di ni brjod pa yin/ /'di ni bstan pa tsam gyis kyang / /'bros par 'gyur te the tsom 1 med/ /phyir zlog pa 15ni yang byas la/ /sa la lag pa brdab par bya/ /lag pa gnyis ni bteg nas su/ /de tshe mkhur 17ba bud par bya1 —/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcing bas na1 / /de tshe bgegs rnams bcom par 'gyur / /rdo rje can ni nyid gyur kyang / /rdo rje'i phyag rgyas 19bcom 'gyur na/ /mthong ba tsam gyis bgegs rnams kun/ /phung bar gyur pa smos ci dgos / /sngags pa 2 shar phyogs bltas 'dug la/ /lag pa g.yas pa dkur na brten te/ /g.yon pa brkyang ba 2 legs byas la/ /g.yon pas thams cad dgug par bya/ / sa bcur gnas pa kun kyang dgug /25thams cad nas ni bkug nas su/ /87—334

rdo rje'i phyag rgyas bsnun par bya/ /1rdo rje'i phyag rgyas bsnun pas na/ / de yi 2med la phye mar 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje nga'i slob ma rnams tshonam gtogs par 4khyod kyis su la 5bsnyad 6par mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can ma dad pa de dag ni tshul 'di la yid mi ches shing de dag 'di skad du/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa ma yin no zhes smra bar 'gyur bas ske/ de dag gi rna lam du yang bsgrag 8par mi bya na phyag rgya lta ci smos/gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la slob dpon gyis slob ma rnams kyi 9mtshan nyid shes nas sbyin par bya'i 1 gzhan du ni ma yin no/ /de nas lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la gtugs nas 11bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang dag 12slob dpon la brnyas par bgyid pa de dag gi 15rnam par smin pa ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten skrag par 'gyur gyis 1 de skad ma smra shig /gsang ba pa'i bdag po 'on kyang cung 15zhig brjod par bya'i 0/ dpa' bo bsgrims te de 1 nyon cig /mtshams 1 med la sogs mi bzad pa/ /dmyal ba gang dag ngas bshad pa/ /de 9rnams kyi ni 2 gnas su brjod/ /der ni bskal pa mtha' yas so/ /de lta bas na rnam na kun du/ /de la nam yang brnyas mi bya/ /gsang ba pa'i na bdag po slob dpon la slob mas na ji ltar blta 2 bar bya zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la 25ji lta ba bzhin du'o/ /de yi sems ni de lta na/ /rtag tu dga' sgyu ba skye bar 'gyur/ /de ni 'jig rten thams cad la/ /phan par 5 byed pa'i 2 sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /lag na rdo rje 87—335

dbang bskur ba'i 1)mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las stang (gustabs kyi (mirim par ④rje) ba rdzogs so(5)// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes shin tu rgyas pa chen pos bdag nyid rgyas pa de dag gi tshig gi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du (6)'jug par bya ba'i phyir chos kyi dbyings yangs pa la dmigs nas 'jug (7)cing / bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad du bdag nyid rinasabyin gyis brlabs nas/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba mngon du byed cing sangs rgyas kyi gsung dbyangs (9dbakod pa'i rgyan gyi snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nya )so/ /bcom ldan 'das snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ de nas de'i med la de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul 411snyed dag gis/ ye shes shin tu rgyas pa dpag tu med pa bsgrub 12pa'i don du 1 thugs su chud nas de dag nyid na tshabazhugs bzhin du phyag brkyang 15ste lag na rdo rje'i spyi bor bzhag go/ /bzhag nas lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sems dpa' lachen po legs so legs51 rme/ / rdo rje ye shes 18rdzogs byed pa/ /khyed 17ni sangs rgyas byas pa gzos tsho/ /sangs rgyas sras po rdzu 'phrul che/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mchog /dam pa gsang ba khyod kyis shod/ /gzungs 21sngags tshul du dgod 3 byos la/ /gang du zhugs ma thag tu ni/ /sdig pa thams cad med gyur pa32/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir 2 ni bshad par gyis/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed na de dag thams cad phyag slar bskums so/ /de 87—336

nas lag na rdo rje ting nge 'dzin de las langs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyed 0)ma/ sdig pa thams cad byang bar byed ma/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed ma/ bgegs thams cad rnam par 'jig 5)par byed ma/ phun sum tshogs pa thams cad skyed (mim/ gzungs sngags chen mo'i camachog 'di 5smras so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā he bud dha ma ti ri / sarba pā pa ni ṣa ṇi/6)/ gardza gardza/ bhañdza bhañdzatsun/ marda marda/ ga ri/ga ral/ ha sa ha sa/ da ma da ma/ ma tha ma tha/ bidhwa na smyos ya bidhwa ngon sa ya/ sarba sha rghaṃ ta 11ra ma ti/ bi 1 ma le/ pū ra ya pū ra ya/ pra 1 ti dzñā 1 na / sarba bhū 8ta/ rū (15pa si te1 tsho/ bha ga ba ti ge/ ga na ga na/ dza hi dza hi/bi ma la sa (17ni/ kra ma ṇimo )/ ha da ba ni/ ra ma ṇi 1/ ma tai gi ke naḥswā hā/lag na rdo rjes gzungs sngags gsang ba lha'adi smras ma thag tu de nas de'i rna mod la sa chen po 'di 'gul lo lha/ /'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /ldeg rab tu ldeg go/ /lho 27phyogs mtho na nub phyogs dma'o/ / byang phyogs 7mtho na shar phyogs dma'o/ /nyi ma dang zla ba yang sa la lhung ngo / /rig sngags 'chang rnams kyang lhung ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag gzungs thams cad la dbang thob pa de dag kyang mog mog 28por gyur to/ /thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de yang blong blong rtepor gyur te / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la yid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing gnas par gyur to 1/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'khor de blong blong ra por gyur pa mthong nas de dag la 'di skad ces smras so / /kye grogs po dag khyod kyis da ye shes chen por dbang bskur ba'i gzungs jisngags chen mo ra dran par gyis shig /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas/87wa 337

byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lag na rdo rje gzungs 'di ni mthu chen po ni 1yin na/ sgrub pa po gang la la zhig 'di 'dzin pa dang / yid la byed pa dang / mchod pa byed pa'i 2)mthu ci lta bur rig par bya / de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dadapal gzungs sngags ca'adi'i mthu'am/ nus mthu'am mthu bsgyings pa ci 'dra'or/ /'jam dpal shar phyogs logs na 'jig rten gyi khams 'od zer dri ma med pa zhes bya ba yod de / 'jig rten gyi khams der de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od zer dri ma med pa zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das des thams cad 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs sngags 'di byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje tog la 'dzin 7du gzhug 8pa'i phyir byin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' de la byin ma thag tu / de'i mod la gzungs sngags 9'di'i mthus de'i spu'i khung bu thams cad nas sangs rgyas kyi gzugs 1 rnams byung 11zhing zhugs te/ mtha' rtogs 12par ni 1 mi nus so/ /sangs rgyas kyis 1 byin gyis brlabs 15ma gtogs par/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag gzungs thams cad la dbang thob pa de tshadag gis kyang 'di ci 'dra ba 1 yin zhes bstan par mi nus so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs de dag gis nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor til gyi gang bu bzhin du gang bar gyur nas gnas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs de dag gis / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 1 chen po de la 'od zer gyis dbang bskur nas sku de nyid du zhugs 19so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzungs sngags chen 87wa 338

po 'di nyid kyi mthus so/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas/ byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis chos thams cad kyi bdag 91)por dbang bskur ba yin na/ khyod kyis kyang gzungs sngags chen po'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i phyir/ gzungs sngags chen po'i dkyil 'khor shod cig /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 2kyilag na rdo rjes/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal 3don yod par grub par 4bya ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 5ye shes gang dag gzungs sngags kyi tshul du gnas shing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 6byin gyis brlabs pa dag nyon cig /de dag gang zhe na/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/sarba thā a ma ri/ a ma ri/ ṭa ta/ bañdza / dzha dzha/ mi tsi mi tsi/ sgo ṭa sbo ṭa8)/ ma ta ma ta/ du ra dānta 9da ma ka swā hā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te 1 bhyaḥ/sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā/ he te/ ka ṇi 11shi ka ni ti/ sarba ta thā ga ta ba na ke /bo dandi de/ tra ṭa ṭa 12hra ṭa ṭa da/ hūṃ phaṭa hūṃ phaṭa/ gardza gardza/ ba ra ma ti/ bi hūṃ ri ka swā hā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te 1 bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/sarba thā/ bha 15ga ba te/ pradzñā pā ra 17mi tā 1 ā/ sarba pā pakṣa yaṃ 1 ka ri/ dzñā na a pa spha 19ra ṇi / bhañdza bhañdza / ma tha ma tha/ da ma da ma/ ā 2 na ya/ā na na ya/ sa ra sa ra/ mā ra ya rna mā ra ya gi/ sarba bhū 27te dza na tri ye swā hā/na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā/ gardza gardza/ ma tha ma tha/hā ma hā ma/ bhañdza bhañdza / dus snyi na swa ra ni ra gho ṣe/ ha na ha na/ bi 87wa 339

dhwan 1)sa ya bi dhwan (5nas ya/ mo ṭa naya mo ṭa ④ya/ da ha da ha/ bi pu la nirma (del ni ra dzā (7te/ ā ha ra ā ha ra/ ā gatstsha ā gtsu(7)/ sarba bud dha sa rū ⑧pa pi te mā bi (9)lo ba swā hā/ 'jam dpal gzungs sngags 0chen po 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbyings /)phyug ma zhes bya banyurte/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyed /lham/ byang chub kyi snying po ston par byed ma/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung ma nor ba'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas mig mi 'dzums cipar byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la bltas te/ 'di skad ces masmras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyang de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du tshabalta bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ khyod ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes chen po sngon ma mthong ba rnams 3 tshodang / dam tshig la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa gcig nas gcig tu rgyun mi 'chad par bya ba'i phyir/ ye shes chen por dbang bskur ba dang ldan pa'i gzungs sngags 'di yid la byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas de'i mod la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas/ dbang chen po bskur ba'i gzungs sngags la sogs pa ye shes bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu las nges par byung ba'i 18ye shes chen po'i rdo rje rtogs par gyur to/ /ye shes chen po'i rdo rje 19rtogs ma thag tu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du mchod pa'i sprin chen po dag byung bar gyur ton / /kye ma'o 51ye shes chen por dbang bskur bas/ /'jam dpal 'di la 52dbang bskur to/ /zhes stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du sgra 'ur ces grags so ri/ /de'i mthus 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul phra 87wa 340

rab kyi rdul snyed dag utpa la chen po'i nang du zhugs par mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs rnams zhugs ma thag tu/ de nas chos kyi sku rtogs pa'i mthus(1 la/ de'i mod la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i spu'i khung bu'i mtshams rin)rnams dang / cod pan dang / rgyan dang / yan lag dang /nanying lag thams cad nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs rnams byung zhing zhugs te / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa bcu la gnas pa/ sems kyi dbang thams cad thob pa de 4dag gis kyang spu'i khung bu gcig gi tshad kyang rtogs par ma (snyenas na/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / gzhan 'jig rten pa rnams kyis lta ci smos/ de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas yid la byed pa de btang ste/ yang 6byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la mig mi 'dzums 7par ring du bltas nas/ zhing rnams 'di dag yongs su sbyang bar bya / /rgyal sras kun gyi smon lam mthu 8rdzogs bya/ /sems can phan dang snying brtse 91nad med cing / /zhi ba bdud rtsi rnyed khodaka' ye shes bstan/ /ye shes dam pa gces nyunyapa 'di thob nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing nas sems can khrag khrig phrag /grangs med khyod kyis brjod pa dgrol bar bya/ /khyod kyis 1 ting 'dzin bstan pa mchog tu bya/ /zhes ched du brjod pa 'di ched du 13brjod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ / 'jam dpal legs so legs so/ /1 'jam dpal khyod kyis tshig 'di 15smras pa ni shin tu gtsigs te khyod yang legs so/ /'jam dpal khyod 'di lta bu'i gzungs sngags chen po'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi rnams yid la byed pa ni shin tu dka' ba byed pa'o/ /'jam dpal yang byang chub sems 87—341

dpa' chen po gang dag ye shes chen po 'di lta bu dag yid la byed pa dang /'dzin pa dang / bsgrub pa dang / glegs bam du byas nas nyin gcig bzhin du (1 phyag 'tshal ba de dag ni shin tu dka' ba byed pa ste/ de dag (na ni nges par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gyur ro/ /de dag 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe nye bar gnas pa rnan yang de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi tsho zhing bcu'i rdul pa phra rab kyi rdul snyed dag 6mthong ba sbyin par tsho7)'gyur te/ rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 8byin gyis brlabs 9 par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gang gi tshe 'di nyid la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi khochos kyi tshul 'di rtogs nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir mngon par brtson par byed pa dag go 'phang de thob par gyur pa 3lhaye shes chen por dbang bskur ba'i gzungs sngags kyi dkyil 'khor chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba 15sngon ma byung ba de sems can chen po shod cig /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal gang du zhugs pa tsam gyis mtshams 1 med pa lnga po dag kṇi yongs su byang bar 'gyur ba dang / don thams cad kyang 'byor par 'gyur ba dang / dpal thams cad skyed par skuda'agyur ba dang ske/ sdig pa thams cad las rab tu grol bar 'gyur ba dang 17/ ye shes chen por 1 dbang bskur ba'i gzungs sngags kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par dgod pa de nyon cig /'jam dpal dkyil 'khor brjod par bya'o/ /'jam dpal de la lus can thams cad la gsang chen dang bcas pa/ slob dpon rnams kyi 87wa 342

gsang chen 1tshomachog / gsang ba 2bas kyang ches gsang ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gzungs sngags 'di dag gi dming du gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor brjod par bya'o/ /'jam dpal de la dkyil 'khor gyi tshad la/ tshad ni khru brgyad 4tham pa 5ste/ /slob dpon nyid kyi khru yis 6bya/ /ye shes 'a byung 7ba'i dkyil 'khor der/ /cha ni rnam pa gsum du bya/ /blo dang ldan pas cha gsum du/ /der ni sgo khyud rnams byas te / /der ni sgo yang bzhi gtod 9do/ /gru bzhi lham pa kha khyer bcas/ /sngon gyi bzhin du cha gsum la/ /cha ni rnam pa brgyad brgyad bya/ /mkhas pas cha brgyad byas nas su/ /dbus kyi char ni 'jug par bya/ /chos rnams thams cad ma skyes par/ /thang cig thang cig bsam byas la/ /phun sum tshogs pa kun byed pa/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal po bri bar bya/ /sngags pas de yi dbus su ni/ /padma mchog tu mdzes pa byi1 / /kun kyang ma rgad 'dra ba ste/ /'dab ma brgyad pa 11brjod pa yin/ /de yi steng du bum pa ste/ /bum pa'i steng du utpal lo12/ /utpal steng du dung bri ste/ /me lce phreng bas 1 'khrigs pas mdzes/ /shes rab pha rol phyin de ni/ /ye shes chen por 1 dbang bskur ldan/ /cha brgyad gang dag brjod pa 15yang / /dbus kyi cha las byung ba ste/ /gzungs kyi tshul du bri ba yang / /cho ga'i lorim bzhin mthun par bya/ /de la shar phyogs su ni bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ba chen mo dbang po 1 chen po'i dkyil 'khor na 1 gnas pa utpa la'i phyag rgyar bri bar bya ste/ mtha' rnams su utpa la bkram 19zhing me lce 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gnas par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ba chen mo'i gzungs sngags ni 'di yin te/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe 87—343

bhyaḥl/ sarba thā rā oṃ bha ga ba ti/ sarba ta thā ga ti 6)dza ni ke(mi /su rā (miya pra ti gisadzñā na/ ta ta raṭa ṭa/ marda marda/ ā ha ra ā ha ra/ rgyu hūṃ dza hi dza hi swā hā/dbang ldan gyi (6)phyogs su bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje mi pham pa me lce (7zhes bya ba'i gzungs bri bar bya ste/ chu yi 58)dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /padma shin tu mdzes pa bri/ /de yi steng du 'khor lo ste/ /me lce'i (9)phreng bas ⑩'khrigs pa mdzes / /de la gzungs sngags ni 'di yin te/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/lha/ sarba thā hūm̐ hrīḥ/snye/ sarba padma/snye/ ta hrīḥbhañdza bhañdza'i/ ma tha lim tham/ da ma ma ni da ma ma ni/ gargha (1 mori gargha /nyari hrīḥ1)swā hā/ me'i phyogs su brten nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma sdig pa thams cad spong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs bri bar bya ste/ chu 2 tshodang dbang chen ldan pa yi nye/ /phyag rgya gzugs rnams 2bri bar bya/ /padma'i steng du rdo rje ste/ /me lce'i rdo snyenang du shin tu mdzes//de la gzungs sngags na 7'di yin te/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te 9 dzābhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥm/ sarba thā tra ṭa tra ṭa/ mu hū mu hū/ sarba ( —9sna paṃ ri tshosho dha ne swā hā/ lho phyogs su ni gdul dka' ba tsho nazhes bya ba'i gzungs bri bar bya ste/ me dang rlung dang ldan pa yi 9/ /utpa la ni der bri'o/ / de yi ni )steng du rin po che/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs skong ste 1/ /me lce tsho phreng ba 'khrigs zhi ba/ /padma rnams kyis ra yongs su bskor byu/ /de la gzungs sngags ni gilha'adi yin te/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te databhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā/ dha ka dha ka /mo ṭa mo ṭa/ da ha da har / sarba ta thā ga ta dzñā 28na nidzā te rtag hā/ bden bral phyogs su ni bdud thams cad rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs bri bar bya ste/ de yi me yi dkyil 'khor te tsho/ /padma'i dbus su gnas pa yin nye/ / de yi steng du 87wa 344

sngags pa yis/ /1)lcags kyu shin tu mdzes pa britshon/ /phan tshun 'brel pa'i rdo rje dag(kye /blo dang ldan pas der dgod do/ /de la gzungs sngags 4)'di yin te/na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā ha ha/ mi hu mi hur//da ma da ma/ khā rtenagyi khā 975nyi/ dhu na dhu na/ mi tsi mi tsi/ dur dānta 8da ma ni swā hā/ byang 99)phyogs su ni 7bcom ldan 'das ma sgo mtha' yas pa bsgrub 11pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs bri bar bya ste/ de yi dkyil 'khor bri ba ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dra ba yin/ /de yi steng du padma ste/ /'od ni dus mtha'i me lta bul/ /de yi steng du ral gri ste/ /'od zer rnams kyis rab tu sna bskor/ /me lce 1 phreng ba 'khrigs ldan pa'i/ /utpal rnams kyis kun khyab 7bya/ /de la gzungs sngags mi'adi yin te/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā mi tsi mi tsi/ gardza gardza/ sbo ṭa ya sbo ṭa laya/ ma tha ma tha/ da ma da ma/ swā hā/rlung gi phyogs su ni 3 dkon mchog 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i gzungs bri bar bya ste / de yi rlung gi dkyil 'khor te/ /cha gsum la ni gtsug tor gnas18/ /lcags kyus 517thams cad dgab )par bya/ /me lce 'bar ba'i phreng bar ldan/ /nub phyogs su ni )bcom ldan 'das ma skul na byed ma bri bar bya ste/ de yi na dbang ldan 2 dkyil 'khor te/ /de la rdo rje legs par gnas/ /de yi steng du padma che/ / de yi steng 25du bgrang nor phreng / /de dag me lce 7phreng gis dkris rje / /steng du padma rnams kyis dgab ri/ /de nas cha gsum pa la ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che/ /sngags pas ci rigs bri bar bya/ /brgyad rnams su yang snga ma bzhin/ /de la shar du rnal 'byor pas/ /'jig rten dbang po'i 29'od chen bri/ /padma shin tu mdzes pa ni/ /de yi phyag rgyar 87wa 345

brjod pa yin/ /me'i phyogs su ni 1byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 2kun tu bzang po'i phyag rgya yid bzhin gyi nanor bu bri bar bya'o/ /dbang bdag 94riphyogs su ni 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i phyag rgya utpa la bri bar bya'o/ /lho phyogs su ni lag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya rdo rje bri bar bya'o/ /byang phyogs su ni byams pa'i phyag rgya ril ba spyi blugs 5bri bar bya'o/ /rlung gi phyogs su ni sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i phyag rgya padma bri bar bya'o/ /bden bral gyi phyogs su ni nam mkha'i snying po'i phyag rgya ral gri bri bar bya'o/ /nub phyogs su ni sa'i snying po'i phyag rgya padma bri bar bya'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lag na rdo rje legs so legs so/ /lag na rdo rje khyod kyis sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir ye shes chen pos 6dbang bskur ba'i gzungs sngags chen po'i dkyil 'khor brjod pa khyod yang legs so / /de skad ces smras pa dang 8/ lag na rdo rjes 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal ye shes chen por dbang skur 9raba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 57'di su'i lag na gnas pa de nyon mongs pa dang bral bar 'gyur ro11/ /'jigs pa dang dgra dang bral bar 'gyur ro12/ /gal te chom rkun gyi nang na 'dug gam/ srin po'i nang na 'dug gam/ dgra'i nang na 'dug gam/ 'thab pa'i nang na 'dug 1 kyang rung ste/ de'i lus la mtshon gyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro1 / /chom rkun gyis 'joms sapar mi 'gyur/ srin po la sogs pas gtse bar 17mi 'gyur ro1 / /de la dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung 18/ rtag tu dpal dang ldan par 'gyur/ sdig pa thams cad yongs su byang bar 'gyur/ sangs rgyas 87—346

bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong la dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa yang de la nyin gcig bzhin mngon du 'gyur/ 'chi ba'i dus kyi 1tshe na 2yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis riyongs su gzigs 4par 'gyur/ shi nas kyang bde ba can du skye 5)bar 'gyur na/ gang du 6'dzin pa dang klog 7pa dang yid la byed pa dang ming 8tsam yang 'dzin pa lta 9ci smos te de'i sgrib pa thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /des 1 ngan song gi sgo rnams gcad 1 par 'gyur12/des ngan song dang lhanangan 'gro rnams rgyang ring du 1 'gyur ro15/ /gang zhig nang par langs nas su/ /lan cig klog par byed pa'i mi/ /srid pa'i 17nyam ngar 17byas pa yi18/ /sdig las grol bar de 'gyur ro// //'phags pa lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba/ bam po bcu gnyis pa ste tha ma/de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po su 19dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po 'di bris nas 2 der zhugs par gyur na / de'i bsod nams kyi phung po ji tsam du 'gyur/ lag na rdo rjes smras pa/'jam dpal kho bos ni de'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i tshad bstan par mi nus mod kyi / 'on kyang 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams kyi phung po ni sa'i rdul ji snyed yod pa de de 22snyed du rig par bya'o/ /'jam dpal ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sems can sdig can na gang tshul 'di la yid mi ches pa dag yod de/ 'jam dpal the tshom mang ba 2 dang / rnam par rtog pa sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin can dang / mi dge ba'i 25bshes gnyen gyis yongs su 26zin pa dang / pha la ma gus pa dang / ma la ma gus pa dang / slob dpon 87—347

dang bla ma la smod pa dang / bla ma'i skyon 'dru 51ba'i sems can de dag la ni (5)ye shes chen por da bang bskur ba'i gzungs sngags kyi ci ridakyil 'khor 'di lag tu (4'chang du mi gzhug 5go/ /rna lam du yang grag par mi bya'o/ /'jam dpal de dag gi mdun du ni gtam yang mi bya'o/ /glegs bam du bris pa yang de dag gi mdun du dbye bar996)mi bya ste/ sems can sdig 7can de dag gis spong ba cung zad byas pas kyang ngan song sems can dmyal bar 'gro bar myur 8du 'ong ngo / /'di skad du 'di ni sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa ma yin no zhes 9zer te/ de dag ni bdag kyang phung la gzhan dag kyang phung 7bar byed do/ /de ltar byed pa'i sems can de dag la ni gsang sngags kyi dngos grub med do zhes kho bo smra'o110/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang rtag tu rgyab kyis phyogs par 'gyur te/ de dag rgyab kyis phyogs par gyur nas 12nges par 'byin pa dang gsang sngags kyi dngos grub gtan med do/ /de skad ces smras pa dang /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gsang sngags kyi tshul 'di la dad pa gang yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 1lhade dag ni shin tu dka' 7ba byed pa yin no//'jam dpal khyod kyis 15ji skad smras pa bzhin te/ de dag ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 17nges pa yin te/ de dag la ni hu tshode bzhin gshegs pa rnams byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po gang ye shes chen por dbang bskur ba'i 518gzungs sngags chen po'i dkyil 'khor 19chen po 'di yi ger 'dri ba dang klog pa dang 87wa 348

'dzin pa 0)de'i bsod nams kyi phung po ji tsam yod par rig par bya/ lag na rdo rjes smras pa/ 'jam dpal sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul phra 2cirab kyi rdul ji snyed pa de snyed (5)kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi bsod nams kyi phung po ji tsam pa de'i bsod nams kyi phung po yang de tsam du rig par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid gzungs sngags 'di'i rang bzhin du bzhugs te / tshul 'di ma rtogs pa blun po de dag gis ni mi shes so/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' gzungs thob pa dang sems can thams cad la dbang thob pa ji snyed pa rnams rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul sna tshogs byed pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du lamachod pa'i sprin rnam pa sna tshogs ston pa de dag thams cad kyang gzungs sngags 'di dag gi mthu yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po gang dag 5bdud pham par byed pa dang ske/ byang chub mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba de dag kyang gzungs sngags 96'di dag gi mthu yin no/ /'jam dpal su gsang ba'i ye shes chen por dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir dbang bskur ba 47de ni dam tshig thams cad la zhugs pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/de bzhin gshegs pa nyid de lta bu'i rang bzhin nam gzungs sngags kyi rang bzhin nam dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin du gnas pa'i phyir te/ de bas na gzungs sngags kyi dkyil 'khor 'di 8ma gtogs pa de las gzhan med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dkyil 'khor 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de bas na 9su 'dir dbang bskur ba de ni dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi dbang bskur beb yin no/ /'jam dpal phyogs gang du ye shes chen 87—349

por dbang bskur ba'i gzungs sngags kyi dkyil 'khor 'di byed pa'am gang gi lag na 'chang ba'am gang gi phyir 'dri ba'am1/ gang zhig nyin gcig bzhin tshon du nang par langs nas lan re klog pa de la 'jigs pa rnams mi 'byung ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang de la nyin gcig bzhin du gzigs par 'gyur ro/ /'chi kur 3yang de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sku ston 4par mdzad do/ /'jam dpal ltos dang sa la gnas pa'i shing dang nags tshal thams cad ni sa med na de dag kyang med do/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po sems la dbang thob pa rnams kyang gzungs sngags 'di dag la gnas te/ 'di dag gis 5byin gyis brlabs pas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi 6go 'phang rnyed do/ /bdud las rnam par rgyal bar byed do/ /chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar byed do / /byang chub tu 8mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /de nas sems can gyi don rnam pa sna tshogs kyang byed de9/ 'di dag 7thams cad gzungs sngags 11'di dag gi mthu yin no/ /'jam dpal de lta 1 bas na khyod kyis kyang chongs 1 shig /lhogs shig /yid la byos 1 shig /gzhan dag la rgya cher yang dag par ston cig dang /des 15sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal sa phyogs gang na ye shes chen por dbang bskur ba'i gzungs sngags 16chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'di byed pa'i sa 1 phyogs de mchod rten lta bur 'gyur ro/ /gang gi lag 1 na 'chang ba'i sngags pa de la yang ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o19/ /'jam dpal sngags pa de la ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rtag tu byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ro/ /sngags pa des kyang gzungs sngags chen po'i dkyil 'khor 87—350

'di rin po che'i 1za ma tog bzhin du rtag tu bsrung bar bgyi'on/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jam dpal sems can gang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 4 gus pa med 5pa'i rang bzhin can dang slob dpon gyi skyon 'dru (tshob dag yod pa'i phyir te/ 'jam dpal de dag la ni chung ngu na 7gtam du yang bzlas par mi bya/ glegs bam yang bstan par mi bya na / nan gyis 9dkyil 'khor du yang 1 dbang bskur ba dang klog tu gzhug pa dang bltar gzhug 11pa lta ci smos/ 'jam dpal 'di lta bu dag ltar gzhug 12pa dang tshig tu 'byung 1 ba ni byang chub sems dpa' de'i 'khrul pa yin te/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa'i bag med pa chen por rig par bya'o/ /de ni 'khrul pa chen po dang shin tu kha na ma tho ba chen po yin no/ /'jam dpal sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po 1 la bslu 15ba ni sla'i1 ‘/ gzungs 1 sngags kyi tshig 'di dag spong ba 18ni de lta ma yin no/ /'jam dpal sangs rgyas rnams 19'byung ba ni dkon 5 te / dper na u dum bā 21ra'i me tog bzhin no/ /de bas kyang gzungs sngags 22'di 'dra ba dag ston pa ni dkon no/ /de bas kyang nan tan gyis sgrub pa ni 2dadakon no/ /de bas kyang 'di gang dag gi jilag na 'chang ba dang gang dag 'di nyan pa dang / 25klog pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / yang na dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i sems can de nedag ni shin tu dkon / sems can 'di dag gi bsod nams kyi phung po'i mtha' yang rtogs par mi nus na/ gang dag 2 nang bar langs nas lan cig klog pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de'i mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa rnams yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'jigs pa thams cad 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad dang phyir rgol 87—351

ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad kyang ri1)'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i lus la nad thams cad 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang la las rdzunanadaben pa'i phyogs su ba lang gi lci bas dkyil 'khor byugs la me tog phul nas tshes grangs dang zhag phyed pa dang yud tsam dang dus 95)bzang po la gro ga 4)la bris sam/ yang na yar ngo'i 9༄tshes brgyad dam tshes bcwa 96)lnga la spos dang me tog dang bdug pa dang lha bshos (pephul la/ mar gyi mar me brgyad dang gser gyi bum pa lnga bzhag nas gro ga la bris te mgul pa'am dpung ba'am lag ngar ram rked pa la btags (2)la thab stimo 'gyed pa'i nang du 'gro 'amatsholam du 'gro 'am 31rgyal po'i pho brang du 'gro na yang 32de la 'jigs pa de dag 12thams cad 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal 'di ni sems can la 1 bsrung ba'i mchog yin te/ khyim mam gtsug lag khang ngam gnas khang gang na gzungs sngags 'di dag 'dug pa'i gnas der bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gang gis skagazungs sngags 'di dag las gang yang rung bas bsrung ba byas pa 7la 'gal bar byed pa ni lha dang bcas pa dang / bdud dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na ngas ma mthong ste/ de'i mgo bo 17lag na rdo rje ngas rdo rje 1 kun du 'bar zhing me lce gcig tu gyur pas 'gems so19/ /'jam dpal char mi 'bab na yang gzungs sngags 2 )'di dag bklag 21par bya'o/ /pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 'ong na yang bklag par bya'o/ /mi nad kyi gnod pa byung na ba la yang da bklags na 'jigs pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur te de'i mod la zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po gzungs sngags chen po'i dkyil 'khor shin tu rgya che ba 87—352

'di dang shin tu zab pa 'di dang gting dpag dka' ba dang gsang ba 1bas kyang ches gsang ba sems can sdig can rnams la bstan du mi rung ba 'di ni 2lag na rdo rje khyod kyis shin tu dkon pa zhig smras te/ 'di ni sngon ma thos na 'di sems can ji lta bu dag la bshad par bya/ lag na rdo rjes smras pa/'jam dpal gang dag byang chub kyi sems sgom mo pa la zhugs pa dang gang gi tshe de dag gi byang chub kyi sems grub par gyur pa de'i tshe/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag ye shes chen por dbang bskur ba'i gzungs sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du gzhug 4par bya'i5)/ gang dag gi tsho6 byang chub kyi sems rdzogs par ma gyur pa de dag ni gzhug 7)par mi bya ste/ de dag ni 8dkyil 'khor yang ltar mi gzhug 9go/ /de dag la ni phyag rgya dang gsang sngarges kyang bstan par mi bya'o/ /'jam dpal gzungs sngags chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'di byin gyis brlab 1 )par bya ba'i phyir phyag rgya chen po gang bcings hu)pa tsam gyis thams cad byin gyis brlabs 12par 'gyur ba bshad kyis 12nyon cig /lag pa gnyis sbyar la g.yas pa'i gung mo bkug pa rdzini gzungs sngags thams cad 'dren pa'i phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la / na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā 15u gatstsha 17bu ninyi1 /pa ri pū 1 ra ṇi zhe/ sa mi sa mi/ mo ga li mi ga li rtsu phaṭa/ de nyid kyi gung mo snga ma bzhin du 2 )bzhag na dkyil 'khor du gzungs sngags rnams kyi 1byin gyis rlob gepar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi phyag rgya ni/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs la mdzub mo gnyis bkug na thams cad drangs par na'agyur ro/ /de'i gsang sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe 87—353

bhyaḥl/ sarba thā (1)ta thā ga ta/ bo dhi satwa ma dha ri/ ā gatstsha ā gatstsha sa// sa ni da rnyidhe/ ku ru ku ru/ rghaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas mchod pa ge mchog 'byung ba'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/ lag pa gnyis sbyar nas mdzub mo gnyis bkyed pa ni mchod pa 'byung ba'i phyag rgya ste/ 'di 5rimachod pa'i mchog 6)byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /gsang sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/sarba thā/ ma hā pū 7dza/ pra brta ni/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pra brta 8ya pra brta 99ya/sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ye swā hā/ 'jam dpal de nas slob dpon gyis 1 cho ga snga ma bzhin du slob ma yongs su gzung 11bar bya ste/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom 12pa grub pa la dkyil 'khor 'di dang phyag rgya bstan par bya'o1da/ /de ma yin pa gzhan pa 1jil ni glegs bam yang bltar gzhug 15par mi bya'o/ /'jam dpal gal te byang chub sems dpa'i spyad 17pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dam tshig mi shes pa'i sems can la dkyil 'khor bstan tam phyag rgya bstan na/ des sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams bslus par 'gyur ro/ /mtshams med pa lnga yang byed 1 par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal byang chub sems dpas 1 mtshams med pa lnga byas pa ni sla'i19/ dam tshig mi shes pa dang lus yongs su ma sbyangs pa dang / byang chub kyi sems bsgom 2 pa ma grub pa la ston pa ni de lta ma yin te/ 'jam dpal sems can de dag gi mdun du ni nam yang 21tshig tu brjod par mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can sdig can de dag ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la drin du mi gzo 22ba dang / dad pa med pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa sems na de la ya mtshan du 'dzin par gyur 2 te/ sangs rgyas kyi yul 'di 87—354

ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo snyam nas/ cang mi zer bar gyur 1to/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 2chen po gzungs sngags 'di dag mnyan dpa dang dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang klog pa dang dran par byed pa dang / chung ngu ni 4rna lam du grag 5pa tsam du gyur pa de yang shin tu dka' ba 6yin no/ /lag na rdo rjes smras pa/ 'jam dpal de de bzhin no//ji skad smras pa bzhin te/ 'jam dpal gang dag gzungs sngags 'di 7la mchod pa byed pa 8dang yi ger 'dri 9ba'i sems can de dag ni shin tu dkon par rig par bya'o/ /su gro ga'am 0gzhan la bris nas yan lag dang nying lag gang yang rung ba la 'chang na de la 'jigs pa thams cad mi 'byung zhing sdig pa thams cad las grol bar 'gyur te/ de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba nyin gcig bzhin du sangs rgyas stong las bsags par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal phyogs gang 11na gzungs sngags chen po'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa 'di gnas pa'am/ gang gi lag na yod pa'i sa phyogs de ni mchod rten lta bur 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po gzungs sngags 'di dag 'chang ba dang klog pa dang kha ton byed pa gang yin pa de la ni/ kho bos mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur bya'o/ /de'i phyi bzhin du yang rtag tu 'brang bar bya'o/ /gang gi tshe 'chi ba'i dus byed pa de'i tshe na 12yang kho bos de'i 1 dge ba'i bshes gnyen bya ste 1 rtag tu byang chub kyi lam 15nye bar ston par bya'o/ /'jam dpal legs so legs so/ /tshig 'di ni 17legs par smras so/ /'jam dpal kho bos kyang de 87—355

la mchod pa bya'o/ /rtag tu de'i phyi bzhin du yang 'brang bar bya'o/ /rtag tu bsrung bar yang bya'o/ /'chi ba'i tshe na 517yang de la lung (gyibastan par bya'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po gang bsgrubs (kyepas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad 4)pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur ba dang ske/ gzungs sngags gang bsgrubs na sngags pas tshe 'di nyid la yid la ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba'i gzungs sngags de dag gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rim par 5phye ba rgyas par shod cig /de skad ces smras pa dang byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal gzungs sngags 'di dag gi 96 bsgrub pa sangs rgyas rnams kyis ji skad gsungs pa 7bshad kyis nyon cig /tshes tsho grangs dang rgyu (9)skar dang 7yang sbyar mi dgos/ smyung ba yang bya mi dgos/ bgegs kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur te/ gzungs sngags bsgrub pa'i tshe yang rtag tu sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul chen po thams cad kyis 11byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal thog mar re zhig gzungs sngags 'di dag gi ri mo'i sku gzugs kyi cho ga 'byung ste/ kha thabs bzhin du ras 12nyos la skra la sogs 1stemed par bya'o/ /de nas ba las 'byung 1 ba'i sna lngas bkrus la spos chus bsku'o15/ /de nas tshes grangs dang zhag phyed pa dang yud tsam bzang po la ri mo bris te sari mo mkhan gso sbyong dang ldan pa 'drir gzhug 1 go/ /ri mo mkhan de yang 'khor los sgyur bas bsrung bar bya'o/ /nyin gcig bzhin du lha bshos dang mchod pa yang dbul 87—356

bar bya'o/ /de nas ri mo mkhan gyis 1dbus su bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma na/bri bar bya ste/ skyil mo krung du 'dug la thor tshugs can nating nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs par bya / bcom ldan 'das ma'i g.yon rol du so sor 'brang ba 5chen mo bri 6bar bya ste/ utpa la'i rgyal po chen po la 'dug 57cing ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs la lcang lo can na'aphyang bar bya9/g.yas logs su rdo rje mi pham cho1rtapa'i me padma dkar po la 'dug cing rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs kyis lus brgyan la/ lag pa g.yon pa na 11'khor lo thogs pa12/g.yas pa bcom ldan 'das ma la phyag 'tshal bar bya1lha/ steng gi phyogs su yang rig sngags 'chang gnyis me tog gi char 'bebs pa byi1 / 'og logs su sgrub pa po'am malag na pog phor thogs pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma la blta 7zhing yal ga me tog can thogs 1 pa skyil mo krung gis 'dug 1 par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 19pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sa riphyogs gtsang ma'am/ dben pa'am/ ri'am nags tshal lam/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ gang yid dang 'thad pa der 'dug la/ slong smyo nyemo'i zas za zhing nang gi gtsang sbra spyod pas ri mo'i sku rna gzugs de'i mdun du gzungs sngags gang yang rung ba gcig bzung daste/ bzhi 'bum bzlas brjod byas la/ tha mar zla ba nya la ci 'byor pas mchod pa byas te / mtshan rangs bzlas brjod byas na nang bar ram nyi ma 'char kur mtshan ma 'byung ste/ sngags pa'i lus la 'od zer rnyisnang ba 7'byung zhing sku gzugs la me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur/rig sngags 'chang rnams ca co'i sgra 'don par 'gyur/ 'brug sgra grag 2 par 'gyur / bcom ldan 'das ma yang bu nga grub zin gyis longs zhes tshig brjod 87—357

par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis mchod yon phul nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma la 1 'di skad na du bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs par mdzod cig ces thos shig /'on kyang ribacom ldan 'das mas rig sngags 'chang gi lag pa (nanas bzung nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du 'jog ste/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i mthus skad cig thang cig 95)yud tsam cig nede la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa sgrub par byed cing / sems can gyi khams thams cad skad cig re re la dga' bar byed do/ /rig 7 sngags 'chang gi 'khor du ma dang 8)de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal bcom ldan 'das ma'i ri mo'i sku gzugs kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i mdo 9'di ni don thams cad sgrub pa/ sdig pa thams cad rab tu sel ba/ 'jigs pa thams cad rab tu 1 sbyong ba/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa yin no/ /'jam dpal gang ri mo'i sku gzugs 'di mthong ba dang mchod pa byed pa dang su'i lag na 'dug pa dang su yi ger 'dri ba 1 de la ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams byang chub kyi lam ston par 'gyur zhing sdig pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bsod nams las skyes par 'gyur/ 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur/ bdud sdig can rnams kyis gtse bar mi 'gyur / 'chi ba'i tshe sangs rgyas mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje de de bzhin no/ /ji skad smras pa de bzhin te/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang ri mo'i sku 12gzugs 'di mthong ba dang ri mor 'dri 1 ba dang / gang gi lag tu 1 'dug pa de ni yon tan dpag tu med 87—358

pa dang ldan par 'gyur/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'gyur zhing ngan song ngan 'gror yang 'gro bar mi 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su yang rtag tu skye bar 'gyur te smon lam thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' phyag 1na rdo rje la gsol ba btab pa/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po gzungs sngags 'di dag gi spyi'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rim par dbye ba gang gis byang chub kyi spyad 2pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa rnams kyis tshegs chung ngus/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mnyes par bya bar 'gyur ba dang rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs byed par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs nga/ thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du sems can thams cad sdug bsngal thams cad las thar bar dbyed par 'gyur ba khyod kyis shod cig /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal sems can rnams la phan gdags pa'i phyir gzungs sngags 'di dag gi spyi'i bsgrub pa'i rnam par phye ba bshad kyis nyon cig /'jam dpal de la byang chub kyi spyod 4pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang 5yang rung ste/ ri mo'i sku gzugs bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'das ma 6gzugs sam/ kha dog 7gam/dbyibs sam/ yi ger yid la bsams te/ zla ba drug gi bar du bsgoms na las thams cad nus par 'gyur te/ dug ni mthong ba tsam gyis 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /gdon gyis zin pa ni bsdigs pa tsam gyis 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan ci yang rung bas zin pa yang mthong ba tsam gyis gtong bar 'gyur ro/ /87—359
