dpag tshad brgya'i pha rol na gnas pa yang las thams cad byed do/ /'jigs pa thams cad la ni lan brgya 0rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas pa'i skud pas bsrung ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /bgegs thams cad la ni chus srung bar labyed do/ /sgrub po rnams sam ro langs bsgrub 3)pa rnams la gsang 3)sngags 'di dag las gang yang rung ba gcig gis bdag bsrung ba dang / gzhan bsrung ba dang /phyogs bcing ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi mtshams gcad na/par bya'o/ /de nas lus mi snang bar byed 'dod na skar ma rgyal la/ sdong ros kha thabs bzhin du 6rinyos te rang gi khrag gis bsgos la/ de nas phyung ste ri mo'i sku gzugs kyi mdun du gzhag go/ /de nas zas su 'o ma dang phye'i 'de gu 57༄za zhing zhag bdun gyi bar du dus gsum du lan brgya 2rtsa brgyad ri9ribazlas brjod bya'o/ /de nas mar gyi ngo zhag brgyad la kha zas mi za bar lag pa g.yon par bzhag ste/ bcom ldan 'das ma bzlas brjod byas na 'grub par 'gyur te/ thig le byas pas lus mi snang bar 'gyur zhing 'dod dgur sgyur boba'i gzugs can lo lnga stong thub par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das ma mthong bar 'dod na zla ba gcig gi bar du slong (11mo'i zas za zhing ri'i rtse mor song ste bcom ldan 1 'das ma bzlas brjod bya'o / /de nas zhag gsum smyung 1 ba byas te/ zla ba nya /bol byang chub kyi shing drung du ci 'byor pas lha bshos dbul zhing mchod pa byas te bcom ldan 'das ma la bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de nas nam phyed na bcom ldan 'das ma nyid 'ong bar 'gyur te/ de la me tog dkar po dag gis mchod yon dbul lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mas 15sgrub pa po'i spyi bor byugs nas bu 7legs so/ /khyod la mchog ci zhig sbyin par bya zhes de nyid zer ba dang ci 'dod pa de bslang 1 bar bya 87wa 360

ste / 'dod na 6)zho 'am/ rig 5)sngags 'chang nyid dam/ lus mi snang ba'am/sa'i 'og tu 'gro ba'am/ gzhan yang yid la gang 'dod pa ci yang rung ba de thams cad bslang babar bya'o/ /ci ste ngang pa bsgrub par 'dod na li khri 4las ngang pa'i (5)gzugs byas te/ ri mo'i sku gzugs kyi phyirimadun du bzhag la kunda'i me tog gis 6)mchod pa rgyas par byas nas mtshan rangs bcom ldan 'das ma bzlas brjod byas na nang par ram nyi ma 'char kur grub par 'gyur te/ de la zhon nas 9shenam mkha' la 'phags pa dang tshangs pa gnyis par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste rma bya bsgrub par 'dod na 'jim pa la rma bya'i gzugs byas te/ ri mo'i sku gzugs kyi mdun du bzhag la zla ba drug tu bcom ldan 'das ma bzlas brjod byas pa'i mjug tu zla ba nya la ci 'byor pas mchod pa byas te/ mtshan rangs bzlas brjod byas na nyi ma 'char kur rma bya'i skad 'byin par 'gyur te/ skad byung (9)ma thag tu sngags pas bslang tshabar bya'o/ /de blangs pa tsam gyis sngags pa smin drug gi bu dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /cho ga de bzhin du sa srung gi 11bu bsgrubs lon brgya byin dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /lus mi snang ba 1 bsgrub par 'dod na/ mi'i thod pa blangs la shing mngar khodang lhan cig tu zhib mor btags te/ tha mar yar gyi ngo'i 15tshes brgyad la arga'i 17shing gi me bus la ri mo'i sku gzugs la mchod pa rgyas par phul 41 nas mtshan rangs sbyin sreg byas te/nang par de'i thal bas sen nyu8mo'i sen 19ris byas na lus mi snang bar 'gyur te/lus mi snang ba 9 )thams cad kyi rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /sbyor ba gzhan yang 'byung ste / li khri 2stomar dang lhan cig tu bsregs la/ de nas zangs kyi snod du bzhag ste/ ri mo'i sku gzugs la mchod pa rgyas par 22byas na na shel bzhin du na 87—361

ma ṇi/ dha ba ni/ ra ma ṇi/ mā te gi swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das ma ye shes chen por dbang bskur ldan pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥl/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā/ a ma ri/ a ma ri/ ta ṭa/ bhañdza/ bhañdza/dzha dzha/ mi tsi mi tsi/ sbo ṭa ya sbo ṭa ya/ ma tha ma tha/ dunānta da ma ka swā hā/na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā/ ho he/ ki 1tshon de/sarba ta thā ga ta bha ne ke/ bho dhi na da da/ tā ṭa tā ṭa/ hūṃ phaṭa rgyu phaṭa/gardza gardza/ pa ra ma ti/ bi hu ri ke swā hā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā/ bha ga ba ti pradzñā pā ra mi te a/ sarba pā pa kṣa yo ka ri dzñā na artsi spha ra ṇi/ bhañdza/ bhañdza/ ma tha ma tha/ da ma da ma/ ā na ya ā na ya/sa ra sa ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ sarba buddha dza ne getri yi swā hā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā/ gardza gardza/ ma tha ma tha/ da ma da ma/bhañdza bhañdza/ dus sgyi/ sarba nisgo ṣe/ ha na ha na/ bi dhwan ya/ bi dhwan ya/mo ṭa ya mo ṭa ya/ da ha da ha/ bi phu la nirma la nidzā te55)/ ā ha ra ā ha ra/gatstsha gatstsha/ sarba buddha pan+ya pa sa ti ma/ mā bi lasba swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje'i dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ bha ga ba ti/ sarba ta thā ga ta dza 4ni ka /pū ra ya pra ti dzñā na/ ta ṭa ta ṭa/ marda marda/ ā ha ra ā ha ra/ hūm̐ rghaṃ dza ti swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ba chen mo zhes bya ba'i gzungs so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā/ hūṃ trī/sarba buddha 5nomā ti ri/ bhañdza bhañdza/ ma tha ma tha/ da ne ma ni da 7ma ni/ gtā ri gnā ri trī swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje mi pham ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs so/ /87wa 465

na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā/ tā ṭa tā ṭa/ mu hu mu hu / sarba pā pa bi sho dha ni swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das ma sdig pa thams cad spong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/sarba thā/ dha ka dha ka /mo ṭa mo ṭa/ da ha da ha/ sarba ta thā ga tā dzñā na nir dzā te swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das ma gdul dka' ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā/ ha ha mi hu mi hu/ da ma da ma/ khā hi khā hi/ dhu na dhu na/ mi tsi mi tsi/ dur dran ta da ma ni swā hā/bcom ldan 'das ma bdud thams cad rnam par 'joms ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs sol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba thā/ mi tsi mi tsi/gardza gardza/ spro ṭa ya sbo ṭa ya/ ma tha ma tha/ da ma da ma swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgo mtha' yas sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs so/ /'jam dpal ye shes chen por dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di gang gi lag na gnas pa de nyon mongs pa dang bral bar 'gyur/ 'jigs pa dang bral bar 'gyur/ de gal te chom rkun gyi nang na 'dug gam/ srin po'i nang na 'dug gam/ dgra'i nang na 'dug gam/ 'thab pa'i nang na 'dug kyang rung ste/ de'i lus la mtshon gyis mi tshugs par 'gyur/ chom rkun gyis bcom par mi 'gyur/ srin po la sogs pas gtse bar mi 'gyur/ de la dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung bar 'gyur/ rtag tu dpal dang ldan par 'gyur/ de'i sdig pa thams cad yongs su byang bar 'gyur/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa yang de nyid la nyin gcig bzhin mngon du 'gyur/ 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe yang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis yongs su 87—466

zin par 'gyur/ shi nas kyang bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur na/ gang 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / yid la byed pa dang / mi gtong bar 'dzin pa lta ci smos te/ de'i sgrib pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur ro/ /des ngan song gi sgo rnams bcad par 'gyur ro/ /de ngan song dang / ngan 'gro rnams rgyang bsrings par 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig nang par langs nas su/ /lan cig klog par byed pa'i mi/ /srid pa nyam ngar gang byas pa/ /sdig pa kun las grol bar 'gyur / /srin po la sogs chom rkun dang / /mtshon dang dgra yis mi tshugs shing ske/ /dus min 'chi las rab tu thar/ /rtag tu dpal dang ldan par 'gyur//'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe na yang / /ngan 'gro rnams las bsrings 'gyur te/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs bzung nas/ /bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur/ /de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī lend+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //87—467

༄gi /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi rgyud ces bya ba/1stegazhug /rgya gar skad du/ bha ga bān du nī lngas ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi tant+ra na saram / bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi rgyud ces bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dus gsum du bzhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa rdo rje'i ④rigs kyi sangs rgyas lcang lo can gyi pho brang na byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje dang / rdo rje sde dang / rdo rje kun tu 'dzin pa dang / rdo rje rab tu 'dul byed dang / rdo rje mi bzad duge'ajoms 56dang ske/ rdo rje gdug pa kun 'dul dang / rdo rje dbyings las rgyal ba dang /rdo rje dgyes gnas skyob la sogs pa'i 'khor bye ba phrag snyed zhirarnams dang thabs cig (nyetu bzhugs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag 87wa 469

na rdo rje nyid kyis rdo rje thugs kur lan gsum gsor te/ bcom ldan 'das la bskor ri1ba lan gsum byas nas phyag 'tshal te/ pus na)mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po 'byung po kun 'dul bar byed cing / sa 'og gi gdug pa can 'dul bar byed pa'i rdo rje kun 'dul zhes bya ba'i rgyud chen po bshad du gsol / rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po bshad du gsol khyab bdag chen po bshad du gsol / gdug pa kun 'dul bar byed pa chen pos 95)bshad du gsol/ mun pa kun 'joms pa chen po bshad du gsol zhes phyag na rdo rjes 4cigasol ba btab bo / /de skad ces gsol pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ rdo rje 'chang 5chen po gsang ba pa 'khyod sems can rnams kyi don du rdo rje kun 'dul zhes bya ba'i rgyud nga tsho ril zhu ba legs so/ /gsang ba 8)pa'i bdag po legs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po legs so/ /de'i phyir lag na rdo rje'i rigs rnams khyed 9rjes su nyon la yid la zung (7shig /ngas rnam par phye ste rdo rje sa 'og 'byung po 'dul ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i rgyud bshad kyis 3)rjes su zung 12shig /de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje kun 'dul 12gyi ting nge 'dzin gyis 1 sa 'og gi gdon dang / 'byung po kun 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms 15par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin de la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i ba spu'i 1 dzobu ga thams cad nas khro bo gdug pa kun 'dul bar byed pa du ma spros te / sa 'og sa stengs 1 sa bla gsum 1shegang bar mdzad de/ sa 'og gi klu rnams kyi gnas rnams 19gdug pa'i hūṃ sgras kun tu gang bar byas nas klu'i rgyal po brgyad 87—470

po ①'khor dang bcas pa btul te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bkug go/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas gdug pa'i sems langs te dbugs shin tu tsha nabar gtong bar sems pa de bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen te/ gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la byin gyis brlabs nas klu thams cad kyi zhe sdang rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ nī la dbadzra gro dha nā ga hūṃ phaṭa ces (gebazlas so/ /de nas klu mtha' yas sems rab tu zhi ste byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur pas klu thams cad sems rab tu zhi'o/ /de nas mtha' yas la sogs pa'i klu'i nya5)rgyal po chen po (6nas 'og na bzhugs pa rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po de (7)la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das phyi ma'i dus na slad ma'i tshe sems can rnams la sa 'og gi gdon rnams kyis bar du mi gcod cing de dag gi gdug 8pa zhi bar byed pa'i cho ga bshad du gsol/ bdag cag klu'i rgyal po rnams dang bdag cag gi 'khor rnams kyis sems can chen po de la bar du gcad 59)par mi nus pa bshad du gsol / bdag cag klu'i rgyal po rnams kyi don du 'gyur ba bshad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos klu'i rgyal po chen po rnams la cung zad spyan gyis gzigs nas bka' stsal pa/ klu'i rgyal po dag legs so/ /zhu ba'i dus la bab bo/ /ngas sems can rnams kyi don du rab tu phye ste bshad kyis 7nyon cig /bcom ldan 'das legs so/ /zhes gsol te klu la sogs pa 1lharnams 12ltar nyan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis klu 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i le'u 'di bshad de/ hūṃ/ sems can kun gyi 1 don gyi phyir/ /rdo rje 'dzin chen ston pa des/ /nyid kyi 'khor la 1 rab 87—471

gzigs te/ /'od zer kun tu rab bkye nas/ /gdon rnams rlag 6)byed thabs gsungs pa/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi (2tshes brgyad dang / /de bzhin bcu bzhi bcwa tsho lnga la/ /rab tu dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ /phyag na rdo rje rab khros pa / /gzhon tshul 'gying ba rab bsams la/ /rin chen snod dam kham phor du/ /gser la sogs pa'i rin chen bdun/ /dag par bsgrubs te rab bcug nas/ /gsang sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pas / /'byung po de la gtor byin te/ /gang gnas brtan 9shesar rab sbas la/ /'byung po klu gdug zhe zhi bar 'gyur/ /gang tshe zhi bas ma phan na/ /de tshe gdug pa'i mtshon cha rnams/ /rang gi khang par rab tu 'bar/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad drag po ste/ /de tshe sngon gyi sems dran pas/ /zhi bar 'gyur bar the tshom (6cimed / /de nas 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyis las kyi 7/lha'i cho ga rab tu gsungs pa/ rtag tu byang chub sems thob cing / /dam tshig sdom pa kun ldan pa / /khrus kyi las rnams kun bya ste/ /rnam par dag pa'i sa gzhi la/ /dkyil 'khor ji ltar mdzes par bya/ /hūṃ yig las byung lcags kyu yis/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /skad cig mdun bsams mchod dun sogs bya/ /oṃ shun+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ādma ko3rta(9)/ stong pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams bsgomachikhul/ /nam mkha'i khams su a dang ni/ /zla ba dang po yi ge rtsu/ /'od zer kun du 'bar bar bsgom13/ /'gro drug nyon mongs kun sbyangs te/ /rnam grol sa la nges bkod nas/ /'od bsdus rgyu gi rnam par bsam/ /de nyid rdo rje rtse lnga can/ /'od zer phreng ba 'phro bar bsam/ /de yi 'od kyis sems can rnams / /rdo rje'i 12ngo bor thim par bya/ /de las 1/khro bo chen po'i sku/ /sku 87—472

mdog sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /g.yon brkyang na tshod bcu drug 'chang / /mtha' yas la sogs brgyad kyis brgyan 1)/ /sku mdog nag po'i gzugs can de(mi / /zhal gcig /phyag gnyis rdo rje bsnams/ /na bza' sngon po'i zer 'jol can/ /spyan gsum dmar mdzes gyen du 'jil/ /ral pa gyen brjes rdo rje yi/ /dbu rgyan can du bsam ri5par bya'o/ /de nas ye shes khro bo che/ /spyan drangs dzaḥrdu baṃ hoḥ cas gzhug /mgo dang lkog ma snying ga 7ru/ /oṃ āḥs gi rnam pa yi/ /yi 98)ge bcu gsum sngags kyis brgyan9/ /'khor lo padma rdo rje bsam57ske/ /mi bskyod rdo rjes dbang bskur te/ /kun 'joms rnam par dag par bsam/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di'i rtsa ba'i sngags las thams cad pa gsungs pa rta/ oṃ nī lī ba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rab tu brjod par bya'o/ /sngags kyi phreng ba de dag kyang / /zhi la rab dkar dbang la dmar / /rgyas la ser po drag la gnag12 /rtog pa kun tu spangs te bzlas1 / /spro dang bsdu ba'i bye brag gis/ /ji ltar mos pa'i bsam gtan bya/ /mi mos rnal 'byor rab tu spang / /phyag na rdo rje khro rgyal gyis/ /dge kun rten 1 pa'i yid 'di la/ /gang brtson pa de phan yon no/ /kun tu rab tu 15dga' 17sogs 1 dag /mi snang la sogs rab tu 'grub/ /kun rten 18rab tu spyad dge can / /rten 17can sbyor ba rab tu dben/ /dngos grub mchog tu rab tu 'grubarka/ /dpal rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud las zhi ba'i las sgrub pa dang lha'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 87—473

phyag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /bar chad zhi byed gtor ma yi/ /cho ga mchog ni bshad du gsol/ /sems can don du brtson ldan bgyi/ /zhes gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ legs so rdo rje 'chang ba gtso/ /bar chad zhi ba'i cho ga dang / /dngos grub thabs kyi cho ga ni(1/ /gtor ma kun gyi (5)gter 'gyur bshad/ /rab tu mdzes pa'i snod mchog tu/ /bza' dang bca' ( —)ba la sogs pa'i/ /phun sum tshogs pa rab tu bya/ /stong pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'gro ④bas/ /rbha las mdzes pa'i snod bskyed de/ /khaṃ las kha zas nam mkha'i khams/ /mnyam par bsams te sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃ a kā 95)ro mu khaṃ sarba dhasmra :ā dunutpanda tad oṃ āḥ(6)rgyu phaṭa swā hā zhes brjod do/ /bdud rtsir bsams 975te rab tu spel/ /spel ba gnyis kyis rnam par sbyang tshodakyi/ /nam mkhar hrīḥ79/las padma brgyad/ /dpag tu med pa bsam bya ste/ /gtso bo mgon po rnam thos bu/ /gnod sbyin bye tshogs kyis bskor cing / /klu brgyad kyis mchod spyan drang 7bya/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po de dag la/ /rmugs 'dzin gang ba bzang po dang / /nor bzangs 317ku be ra dang ni/ /yang dag 'brog gnas lngas rtsen nyu2dang / / pi tsi kuṇḍa 12li rnams ni/ /'khor gyi tshul gyis gtso la bskor/ /phyogs dang mtshams 57su bsam par bya/ /bye ba'i 'khor tshogs thun mong yin/ /klu brgyad gnod sbyin phyi na'o/ /de nas lcags kyus spyan drangs la/ /ma bral gtso dang lcags kyu'o/ /bzhin pa seng ge rta yi tshogs/ /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i rgyal mtshan dang / /nor bu rin chen bum pa dang / /rin chen 'bar ba 15ral gri dang / /gri mdung khang brtsegs ral gri phub/ /mtshon cha sna 87wa 474

tshogs 'phyar bar bsgom0)/ /spyan 'dren tshe na rnga sogs dang / /dung chen 'bras spos dag ni dbul/ /oṃ bai shra ba ṇa sa pa ri bā ra (ges mā dzaḥtshon dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥl / oṃ bee swā hā/ oṃ bee shra ba ṇa ā kunta 5)ya hūṃ dzaḥ/ zhes spyan drang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mṛ (bta kuṇḍa (7)li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ni bgegs bskrad pa'i sngags so/ /de nas me tog la sogs pas ni/ /mchod pa dag ni nam mkha' ru/ /rab tu mchod de spro bar bya/ /oṃ nī māṃ ba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi ā tshwa pa ya ti i mi ba li groṇḍa tu79na/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/7/ ma ma sarba tsho11siddhim 12sra yatstshantu nyusnyem ma kusmyu mo gha rilaswā hā/ oṃ bai shra ba skoṇa ya swā hā/ oṃ dza ma bha lā ya gluswā hā/ oṃ purṇa chos smabha dā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dā ya swā hā/ oṃ ku bai rā 38ya swā hā/oṃ si pra dzñā nā ya 〈peswā hā/ oṃ gu hya sthā nā ya 2 rig hā/ oṃ pārtsi kā ya 2)swā hā/oṃ tsi pi kuṇḍa 32li ne na swā hā/ gtor ma dbul ba'i sngags so/ /de nas mchod de mgron du )rnams btang tsho ge/ /'od zer lcags kyu bgrol na nas su/ /bgrol ri ba'i dus na gshegs dang mnyam/ /mnyam langs /spyod pa'i cho ga bya'o/ /rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud las gtor ma'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas 6bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub bsgrub ri par 'dod pa'i don du 'jig rten pa'i 'khor lo kun 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas sku'i ba spu nas 'od zer spros te lha/ rnam thos sras 'khor bcas kyi thugs bskul nas 'khor der 'dus te/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te rin po che'i phye mas gtor nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni chos skyong ba'i rgyal po rnam thos kyi bu zhes bgyi ba 87—475

lags te/ bdag gis chos dang ldan pa rnams kyi chos bsrung 1)zhing yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir bdag nyid kyis rinagasang ba bshad na bcom ldan 'das kyis skabs dbye bar ci gnang zhes gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po legs so/ /rang gi gsang ba legs par shod cig /ngas kyang /rjes su yi rang zhing byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /rdo rje 'chang ba kun gyis kyang byin gyis rlob par 'gyur gyis 4khyod kyis legs par sgros shig ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas rnam thos kyi bu rang gi stan las langs te bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas rang gi rig pa 'di smras so/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇa ya hūm̐ rghaṃ/pa tsa pa tsa/ sbyin sgyunda 5swā hā/ zhes brjod nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi 6/sngags 'di'i sgrub pa ni 'di lags te/ gang zhig bdag sgrub 7par 'dod pa des dus gsum du mchod pa rgya chen po bshams te/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa mchod la sems rtse gcig dang ldan pas gnas dben par 'dug 8ste/ bcom ldan 'das 99phyag na rdo rje sgom 97 pa pos bdag gi sngags de khri phrag gcig bzlas/ de nas las rnams bsgrub 511par bya'o/ /de ltar bdag sgrub 12pa dang bdag gi las sgrub pa po des bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma dang mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod par bya'o/ /de la bdag dang bdag gi 'khor rnams la mchod pa dang gtor ma rgya chen po dbul ba'i sngags ni 'di rnams yin te/ oṃ bai 1 tha ba ṇa ya swā hā/ /oṃ dzam bha lā ya 1 swā hā/ oṃ pūrṇa 1 bha dā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi sabha dā ya swā hā/ oṃ ku be 1 rā ya swā hā/ oṃ saṃ pra dzñā nā ya 1 swā hā/ oṃ gu hya sthā nā ya 1 swā hā/ oṃ pā: kā ya 2 swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇḍa 21li ne 2 swā hā zhes pa'i sngags de rnams na ni bdag gi 87—476

'khor dang bcas pa la mchod pa dang gtor ma sbyin pa'i sngags gnyis su shes par bya'o/ /de nas bdag gi las sgrub 1pa ni bdag gis bshad kyis 2bcom ldan 'das kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol nas 'di'i las bshad pa ni / gang zag gang gis sgrub 4'dod pas/ /gsad 5dang sbyin sreg 6mnan pa gsum / /rim pa ji bzhin shes par bya/ /bsgrub bya bstan la sdang ba rnams/ /spra tshil la sogs gzugs byas la/ /dgug dang gzhug sogs dbang du bya/ /yig 'bru bcwa 7)brgyad sngags kyis ni/ /dus gsum brdeg 8par rab byas nas/ /'phral du yid ches 'joms pa ste/ /bsgrub bya gsod par the tshom med/ /gal te sbyin sreg 9byed pa na/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod las/ /'dir ni drag pos bsgral bar bya/ / der spa 1 tsha la rab bsreg bya/ /thab khung rab dang 'bring tha ma/ /rab kyis mtho gsum 'bring gis do/ /tha mas mtho gang tshad du bya / /bud shing tsher ma can shing gis/ /kun tu drag po rab tu bsgrub11/ /bag zan yungs kur 412mer bsreg lha cing / /sdang ba'i lus ngag yid gsum rnams / /rdzas la bstims te sbyin bsreg 1 bya/ /'khor bcas gnod sbyin mer bsams te/ /bsreg 15pa'i rdzas kyis mchod pa'am/ /las me gnod sbyin rdzas kyis brab/ /gang ltar byas kyang 'grub par 'gyur/ /de tshe bstod pa 'dis kyang ni/ /rtse gcig sems kyis bstod par bya/ /hūṃ kun 'dul mi bzad gnod sbyin sogs/ /gdug pa dpal tsha rab tu 'jigs/ /khro bo rngam pa cher sgrogs 7pa/ /'khor bcas rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /oṃ bee shra ba ṇa pulpe 17rtsu swā hā/ oṃ bai 18sha ba ṇa dhū 19pe hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bai shra da ba ṇa dī paṃ 21rtsu swā hā/oṃ bai shra ba ṇa gan dhe 224 swā hā/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇa nai bi bye 2 rtsu swā hā/ gtso bo 87—477

mchod cing (17'khor kyang mchod/ /de nas rim pas mchod pa ni/ /gsang sngags kun tu spel te bzlas(na/ /spro dang bsdu ba kun du bya/ /spel byed kun gyi thun mong yin/ /oṃ bee shra wa ṇa ya (5)che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa swā hā/ gtso bo ji ltar 'khor kyang de/ /rang gi rig pas mchod par bya/ /rig pa kun tu brtan 'dibyas nas/ /rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bsam/ /phrin (lde)las bcol la gtor ma btang 6/ /gtor (7 dang gtor ma'i rim pa ni/ /go rims (8)bzhin du dbul bar bya/ /zhi ba'i las kyi rim pa ni/ /thab khung mtho gang tshad nyid la / /bsreg 'o/rdzas la sogs tsharab tu dbul/ /lus ngag yid gsum sdig bcom nas/ /ye shes me yi ngo bor bya/ /snod dang thab 3lhani dor bar bya/ /der ni gdon rnams kun sreg 51gecing / /bgegs chen zhi ba'i yas nyugekyang bya/ /rgyas dang dbang du bya ba la/ /las dang bye brag rim pa rnams/ /sngar bshad pa yi las bzhin du/ /thab 7dbyibs bye brag shes par bya/ /ser dang dmar ba'i bud shing sogs15/ /rim pa rdzas ldan dbul ba ni/ /oṃ bee shra ba ṇa ya mudha rna subhi 51 ku ru ye 1 swā hā/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇa ba sho 19ku ru 9 )swā hā/ oṃ bee shra ba ṇa ye ( nyashārnyi ku ru swā hā/ gtso bo 22ji bzhin 'khor bcas ni/ /rig napa'i rdzas kyis mchod par bya/ /bsreg 2 pa'i rdzas ni bag zan dang / /yungs kur gemangar sogs rim pas mchod/ /phrin las rnam bzhi kun 'grub ste/ /brtse bar brtson pas nye bar 'grub/ /'bring dang tha mas 'bring dang ni/ /tha ma nyid du shes par gyis/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la rnam thos kyi bu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rnams kyis bshad pa'i las 'di rnams sgrub smyo 7pa po des dus ri tshorgyun du bcom ldan 'das phyag 87—478

na rdo rje dang / gnod sbyin rnams la dkar gsum gyis mchod par bya'o1/ /chang kun tu spang bar bgyi'o(5)/ /sha rnams ni 'os 5)pa dang shis pa drang bar bya'o//de ltar rtse gcig gis bdag cag sgrub 4pa de rnams kyi phrin 5kyilas ji lta ba bzhin du bdag cag gis ma bsgrubs na bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'khus par gyur cing (6)/ bdag cag gis chos ma bskyangs par byas pa yin no/ /de la bdag gi bro tshig ni 'di yin no/ /oṃ bee shra ba ṇa ar tha kha tham zhes pa'o7/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rnam thos kyi bu chen po legs so//shin tu rab tu legs so/ /ma 'ongs pa'i gang zag gi 98)don du rang gi gsang ba smras pa ni don chen po dang ldan no/ /ngas kyang de rnams kyi don 9nges par 'grub par bya ba'i phyir sngags 'di bshad kyis 1 nyon cig /bcom ldan 'das la legs so zhes rnam thos kyi bu la sogs pa rnams ltar nyan no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi nī lī ba ra dha ra badzra sbo ṭa hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ rig pa 'di ni las thams cad dbang du sdud pa'i sngags so/ /rnam thos kyi bu chen pos ji ltar khas blangs pa ltar gsang ba dang ldan par byed pa'o/ /de bzhin gyur zhes smras cho11nas gnod sbyin mi snang bar gyur to/ /rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud las rnam thos sras kyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams kyi don du gdug pa can la bsnun 12pa'i 'khor lo bshad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab bo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bar thugs kyis gnang nas 87—479

rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer kun tu khyab par spros te/ sems can thams cad la 1byams pas khyab par mdzad nas lag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje ngas sa 'og gi nabagegs la bsnun dpa'i 'khor lo bshad kyis ( )khyod rtse gcig 5tu nyon cig de ltar 'tshal lo (6)zhes ltar nyan no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang zhig 'khrul 'khor byed 'dod pas/ /nyams dga' dben pa'i gnas dag tu/ /phyag na rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bya/ /snod bcud rdo rje gtum por bsgom / /rlung nas 8)ri rab mthar thug pa/ /rdul snyed grangs kyi sku ru bsam/ /dbus na phyag rdor rnal 'byor bsgom9ri/ /ri bong 'dzin pa zhabs kyis brdabs/ /stong gsum tshad kyi zla ba la/ /bgegs chen kun tu 'dar bar bsgoms/ /sku la nyi ma stong ldan pa'i/ /gzi brjid bzod dka'i 'od zer gyis/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'tshig par bsgom11/ /ljags las bzlas pa'i sngags phreng gis/ /stong gsum gang bar rab tu bsgom12/ /rgyan du byas pa'i klu brgyad kyis/ /kha rlangs 1 chen po btang ba las/ /lha klu thams cad skrag par 'gyur/ /thugs las khro spros de dag gis/ /bskal pa'i rlung ltar 'thor bar 'gyur/ /phyag gis rdo rje rab bsnun pas/ /skyogs risagazer bzhin du bsnun par 'gyur/ /rdzu hūm̐ 'brug ltar rab tu sgrogs15/ /skad kyis kun tu bkug par bsam/ /de ltar byas 'gyur 17thams cad 'grub/ /las kyis mnar ba 'jig par 'gyur/ /phyag na rdo rje mi shes par/ /gang zhig gzhan bsgrub 1 skal dman par/ /'di la gang 'grub thams cad 'grub/ /mchog dang thun mong 1 bye brag go/ /rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud las bsnun pa'i 'khor lo ste le'u bzhi pa'o// //87—480

de nas gzhan yang 'khrul 'khor gyi/ /cho ga rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs/ /gro ga'am shing shun dag la ni/ /re'u 1mig nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i/ /'khor lo dag ni rab bris te9kye/ /zla ba yar gyi ngo la brtsam/ /rtse gcig sems kyis rab tu bri/ /dbus su drag po'i yi ge dgod/ /gnyis par nor 'dzin yi ge ste/ /gsum pa badzra zhes pa dang / /bzhi par chu yig dang po cadagod/ /lnga par ṇi 5ni rab tu dgod/ /mtshams bzhir bsgrub bya'i gsod snying bri/ /de ni nang gi re'u 6)mig go/ /phyi yi re'u (7mig bcu gnyis la/ /oṃ spangs yi ge bcu gnyis la / /de yi gsang sngags 'di yin te/ /nī lī 8ba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi rtsu phaṭa zhes bya'o/ /rab tu rdzogs pa'i 'khor lo ste/ /bsgrub bya'i snying gar 9dril de gzhug /dang po'i risamatha' nas dril bar bya/ /de nas sbyin sreg 11cho ga bya/ /gal te mnan pa byed 'dod pas/ /sngar bzhin 'khrul 'khor rdzogs byas nas/ /mtha' ru mnan pa'i cho ga bya/ /kham phor gsar pa kha sbyar du/ /bcug nas rdo rje rgya gram bri/ /rdo yi spyin 1 gyis rab sbyar nas/ /gtsug lag khang sogs mnan par bya/ /gal te re'u mi mig mi 'dod na/ /rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i 'khor lo bya/ /lte bar hūṃ dang bsgrub bya'i ming / /spel la rab du dgod par byasal/ /7lhag ma bcu gnyis rtsibs la dgod/ /bri ba rdzogs na snying gar 17gzhug /dgug dang gzhug sogs byas la bsreg17 /mi 'dod mnan pa'i cho ga bya / /mar gyi dus la shis pa yin/ /'khrul 'khor ji ltar bris pa ltar/ /gang 'dod las la the tshom med/ /dper na me lces rtswa 1 bsregs 'dra/ /gang yin 19gnas par mi 'gyur ro/ / dpal rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud las 2 bri ba'i 'khrul 87—481

'khor gyi cho ga ste ①le'u lnga pa'o// //de nas yang lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das thams cad zab mo'i spyod yul lags pas sbyin sreg ②la sogs pas grol bar cang 'gyur lags sam/ bdag gi the tshom ①bsal du gsol zhes zhus so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje snying rje che/ /dad pa'i shugs kyis rab nyams te/ /dkyil 'khor rdzas kyi ④sbyor ldan zhing / /sbyin sreg ⑤las dang de nyid shes/ /sdom par khyadam tshig rgyud ldan na/ /mtshan mas grol bar 'gyur ba ste/ /dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg lardzas la sogs/ /med na dngos grub mi 'grub pas/ /sbyin sreg ⑧las ni 'bad pas brtsam/ /phrin las bzhi yi sbyin sreg ⑨las/ /drag po'i rim pa bya ba ni/ /khru ⑩bzhi pa yi dkyil 'khor la/ /dbus su zur gsum khru re tshad/ /zabs su khru phyed brko bar bya/ /phyi rol rim pa gsum ldan pa/ /dbus su rdo rje'i mtshan ma bri/ /rim pa gsum la rdo rje yi/ /rtse gsum phreng gis bskor ba bri/ /mtshams 7su lcags kyu bri bar bya / /tsher ma can gyi 7shing bu ni/ /khru gang tshad kyis rab tu shis/ /dug dang khrag dang ske tshe sogs/ /rdzas ni rim par shes par bya/ /bdag nyid lha yi ⑫rnal 'byor gyis/ /ye shes khro bo spyan drangs te/ /'jig rten gsum 'dul gzugs su bsam/ /mchod pa'i rim pa rab tu dbul/ /de la sbyin sreg ④gi sngags gsungs pa 'di yin te/ oṃ nī lī ba ra dha ra/ oṃ 8badzra dzwa la a na ⑩la ha na sarpā 'o)duṣṭa sab gi st+waṃ tsoku ru nī lī ba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa ces pas rdzas rnams bsreg mgo/ /dug khrag ske tshe 5) lan tshwa las/ /87—482

gzugs byas rab tu bsgrubs te bsreg① /oṃ nī lī ba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi yakṣa khā da ②ya khā da ya laban dha ya ban dha ya mo ha ya mo ha ya sha rghaṃ 2)ā na (zhe)ya tt+waṃ phaṭa/gzugs la brab pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ nī māṃ ba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi sha rghaṃ groṇḍa 96u kursha ya ④rgyu dzaḥ(gudzaḥ/ 'gro ba dgug pa'i sngags so/ /de ltar sbyin sreg rab (9)byas nas/ /chu bo skams bodang klu shing gcad11/ /glang chen g.yang ltung 1 me chen 'bar/ /nad dang yams sogs byung ba'i tshe/ /zhi ba mchog gi las bsgrubs te/ /thab khung skum po rab dkar ba/ /rim pa gsum ldan khru gang tshad / /zabs su khru phyed nyugebarkos byas nas/ /zhi ba'i las kyi cho ga bya/ /de ltar byas na mtshan ma yi/ /dngos grub thob par the tshom med/ /lag na rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin/ /gus pas rgyud don rab tu zung sko/ /'gro ba'i don la rab brtson gyis/ /kye ma rgyud chen mchog tu gsang / /byin rlabs nyu5sngon du cher 'byung ba/ /ston pa rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs/ /rab tu 'bad pas bsgrub chosapar gyis/ /dpal rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud las sbyin sreg 51 tshogi rim pa ste le'u drug pa'o // //de nas ston pa rdo rje 'chang / /dpal chen gdan la rab bzhengs nas/ /lag na rdo rje la gzigs nas/ /las kyi cho ga bshad par bya/ /dug la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams la/ /gang 'dod pa yi 1shegazugs byas te/ /snying gar 'khrul 519'khor rab tu gzhug /bdag nyid las kyi lhar gsal bas/ /ga 'u nang du rab bcug ste/ /tshon 3 gyi tha gu sna lnga dkri 1/ /snying ga'i 2lcags kyus lharab bkug nas/ /yi ge bcu gsum 'khrul 'khor bzlas/ /'gul g.yo yi ni rtags 87—483

༄ga /'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can rdo rje sa 'og ces bya ba'i rgyud/3)༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ ārya badzra pā ṇi nī 'asba ra dha ra badzra pā tā la 9genā ma tant+ra②/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can rdo rje sa 'og ces bya ba'i rgyud/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das sa 'og rim pa bdun klu'i rgyal po'i gnas na rin po che'i khri la bzhugs te/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' bo dang / rigs ldan la sogs te klu rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' phyag byan rdo rje la sogs pa rnams dang thabs cig ④ste/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs g.yas pa nas 'od zer brgya stong du ma bkye (7bas 'jig rten du 'gyur ba dang / ltas (7byung bas (8)'jig rten pa rnams 'jigs shing skrag spunas brgyal bar gyur 7to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ 'od zer 'di 'gyur ba dang ltas 3nyebyung ba'i rgyu 87—497

dang rkyen tsho19ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'di ni bsod nams nakyi tshogs tshad med pa las grub pas 'bras bu yang tshad med kyis dbyang chub sems dpa' brgyal carab las bslang du gsol/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje'i thugs ka nas 'od zer brgya stong du ma bkye ste/ 'od kyis reg (5pa tsam gyis brgyal ba las bslang ngo ne/ /de nas 'jig rten pa rnams kyis ched du brjod pa/ e ma thub 7 chen thugs rje yi/ /'jig rten thams cad brgyal gyur na/ /thugs rje chen po'i 'od zer gyis/ /brgyal ba thams cad slongs 8par gyur9/ /de nas 'jig rten pa rnams sa 'og rim pa bdun gyi klu'i rgyal po'i gnas su 'dus par gyur nas gsol ba btab pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi phrin 1 las can/ /ston pa bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /'jig rten rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /rdul bral chos rnams bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa nya1badzra pā ṇi hūṃ zhes gsungs pas snod dang ldan par byas so/ /de nas klu'i 12rgyal po rnams 'khrugs so/ /shin tu yid 'khrugs nas kha g.yab cing brang brdungs te/ kye ma kyi hud bdag klu'i gnas dang ston pa ni 'jig rten pas phrogs 1 pas 'jig rten pa rnams brlag par bya'o zhes zer nas / klu'i kha'i rlangs 1 pas 'jig rten pa rnams la marje'i nad btang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis nad sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas thugs ku'i 15dpal be'u las nad sel ba'i 'od zhal nas kyang badzra da ya zhes bya ba'i sngags dang bcas te byung bas 16me long la has btab pa bzhin du song ngo / /de nas klu'i 17rgyal po rnams kyis klu bran rnams bskul 18nas la las 19rtsa nas zhugs so/ /la las dbang po'i sgo nas zhugs so/ /la 87wa 498

las nyu)rus pa nas zhugs (0pa la bcom ldan 'das kyis dbugs me lce ltar 'bar ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rtsa nas (5)zhugs pa la dbugs kyis bsregs so/ /dbang po la zhugs pa dang / rus pa la (4zhugs pa bsreg rin pa'i 'khor los bcom mo/ /de nas klu'i 96)rgyal po rnams cher 'khrugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das nyid la snang ba re re chad nas lus la dkri 7bas byang chub kyi sems dang ldan te rgyan du song ngo / /de nas klu'i 8)rgyal po rnams kyis bstod pa/ 'jig rten 'di na klu 54)rgyal 7/mthu che 17yang / /bcom ldan ba spu'i brgya yi nyanachar pho mi phodarige / /de nas mabacom ldan 57'gro ba skyob pa la/ / klu yi 51 tshorgyal po rnams kyis rtag tu bstod/ /rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud las gleng gzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje 'chang la yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal nas gsol ba btab pa/ ser sna'i dbang gis dbul gyur pa/ /nor rnams ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ /mdun gyi phyag na rdo rje yi/ /ye shes sems dpa'i phyag g.yas par/ /dzambha la ni bsgom par bya/ /bdag nyid sngags kyi rgyal po zlos/ /snying gar 18'od zer dag gis ni/ /ye shes sems dpa' bskul bar bya/ /ye shes sems dpas dzambha la'i/ /sngags ni zlos pa nyid du bsgom / /ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka 51munas/ /'od byung dzambha la bskul lo/ /nor gyi zhu 7rgya mtsho gang bar 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje 'dzin la gsol ba btab pa/ nyes pa shin tu phra mo la/ /grags dang rnyed pa'i don du ni/ /'jig rten gnod byed sgrib 1byed pa/ /thog ser bzlog 22pa bshad du gsol/ /thog mar mchod rten sngon po brtsig 3 /rab gnas 87wa 499

gzhung dang mthun hu)par bya/ /de yi 'og tu 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs brgyad lte bar bcas pa bri/ /rtsibs la lha srin snying po bri/ 'a ②/ rmadha/ 16①/lhab④la/ odhal/ lhos༅/ 1snyam/ snabadu/ dbus su sngags mkhan bri bar bya / /de nas thod pa'i nang du gzhug /thod pa mchod rten 'og tu mnan/ /snying po'i la'od kyis ⑩sngags mkhan dang / /lha srin 'khor dang bcas pa dgug /de la thun gyis brab par bya/ /'byung po 'khrug 7pa'i dus su ni/ /ston pa'i nga rgyal ldan pa la/ /mthe bo dag 8ni mthe'u hunyechung la/ /rgyu las phyag na rdo rje bskyed / /mthe'u 8chung phyag na rdo rje yi/ /thugs nas phyag na rdo rje ni/ /zhags pa 8lcags kyu thogs pa spro/ /snying gi lcags kyus dgug pa dang / /mgrin pa zhags pas bcing bar bya/ /mthe bong phyag na rdo rje yi/ /rdo rje las ni rdo rje spro/ /bgegs rnams la ni bsnun par bya/ /ba spu'i gshis na rdo rje 'phro / /nam mkha' thams cad rdo rjer grub/ /yungs kur ⑩do rjer bskyed ⑩la brab8 / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje 'dzin pa la mchod cing phyag 'tshal nas ched du brjod pa/ e ma'o /nga)ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /sems can rnams la phan don du/ /tshar gcad rjes gzung gsungs pa mtshar/ /dbul dang yi dgas sum̐ staganas las thar/ /rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud las nor bsgrub 0pa dang gnod pa bzlog (2pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje 'dzin la mchod cing phyag 'tshal nas gsol ba btab pa/ klu dang gnod sbyin sa bdag gi/ /mdze dang dmu du )chu ji ltar bzlog /de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal pos/ /gsung ni 'di skad 87wa 500

bka' stsal to/ /mdo sdes ni las kyi rnam par smin pa mi zlogs la sngags kyis bzlog pas khyad par du 'phags so/ /de la klu zhes bya ba nyon mongs pa gti 1mug shas che bas (5)chags pa dang zhe sdang yang che ste/ gti mug gi dbang gis gnyid che ba dang / zhe snang gi dbang gis skye ba bdun du mi gtong ba dang /chags pa'i dbang gis chags pa la gnas pa'i lus la zhugs nas mi gtong ba'o/ /klu gdol pa can gyis mthong ba tsam gyis nad bskyed tshon do/ /rigs gsum ni reg pa tsam gyis nad bskyed 94)do/ /klu bran rnams ni steng sgo gsum nas zhugs nas lus kyi bcud za bar byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ de rnams ji ltar 'dul bar bgyi/ de nas bcom ldan 'das klu 'gugs (5)par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas sngags 'di gsungs so/ /nā ga bi dā ra ḍā dzaḥ/ nā ga ursā da na ya dzaḥ/ sbyor ba gsum la legs gnas pas/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis 'gugs par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis klu 'dul bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ nyid kyi dbugs las sngags 'di rnams phyung ngo / /tabya sbom/ bud dha bud dha/ bi bud dha bi bud dha/ mā ti kra ma tha96/ ha ra ha ra nā ga (7)dzā(8)/ pra ha ra pra ha ra nā ga rmā9ri/ canda sbyin nā 7ga hro 11da yā ni/ bhinda bhinda tson ga mtha yi ṇi bi ṣpe ryan tu nā ga sha rī rā 'aṇi/ bi sbo ṭa ya nā 1lhag nā 57ya nā 1 ni/ 'jigs shing skrag ste 18brgyal bar 'gyur/ /snying gar 19yi ge hūṃ bsgoms pas/ /klu rnams thams cad bsregs gyur pas/ /bde ba can gyi gnas su skye/ /byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ de la 'jug pa'i gnas du 5 tshomachis/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rtsa bzhi dag 87wa 501

nas zhugs gyur nas/ /rtsa rnams na zhing tsha ba dang / /steng sgo mi bde rngul yang 'byung / /rmugs dang gnyid kyi bdag nyid can/ /sha mdog dbu (1)ba lta bu ste/ /rmi lam du ni chu 'od 'byung / /de nas chags pa spyad par bya/ /dbang po gsum du zhugs gyur na/ /dbang po sbrid cing lus kyang 'dar/ /sha ni skam (5)zhing rus pa na45)/ /de la chags pa mi spyad do/ /sa yi dbang po kun nas 'jug /ba spu'i khung bu dmar zhing 'gyur/ /phol dang sha bkra 'byung ba dang ske/ /rmi lam du ni byol song 'byung / /rgyal po dang ni rtsa bzhir 'jug /tho rangs mi dga' mngon shes smra/ /gnyid chung ba spu'i gshis kyang dkar/ /gu gul nag po bsten par bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes gsol pa/nad de 'tsho ba dang mi 'tsho ba'i rnam pa ji ltar lags/ rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs pa/ bsnyen pa mtshan ma thob pa yis/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang gla rtsi dang / /'bras bu gsum dang rma bya'i sha / ril bu ri4)byas la sgal tshigs gzhag / de yi (5)bar du rma bya'i sgro/ /mdangs dang ldan na 'tsho bar nges/ /nag por gyur na mi 'tsho'o / /byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de la tshar gcad 6)pa'i thabs du mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa//sngags dang 'khrul 'khor sman dang bsreg /thabs ni rnam pa bzhi yin te/ /byang chub rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /dbang bskur dam tshig ldan pa dang / /bsnyen pa brtan par gyur pa yis/ /dang por sngags kyis bzlog par bya/ /snying ga'i (8)sngags kyi 9)rgyal po yis/ /rlung dang 'grogs te 'byung bar 'gyur/ /nad kyi snying por 57rgyu bsams te/ /rgyu rkyen tshogs pas bsreg par bya/ /de nas phyir bzlog mnan par bya/ /sbyin sreg nya1rnam pa gsum du bshad/ /dang po 87—502

zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 1ste/ /rlum po khru gang kha dog dkar/ /kha khyer sor bzhi ri rirdo rjes mtshan/ /gru gsum sor bcu kha dog nag kyi /kha khyer sor gsum rdo rjes mtshan / /zla dbyibs zla ba dmar 'dra ba/ /khru do kha khyer de 'drar shes/ /zhi ba 'o ma can shing gi/ /gtum pa 'bigs par byed de'o/ /dbang yang zhi ba dag dang mtshungs/ /rgyun bzhag 4me dang rigs ngan khyim/ /raṃ 5las thab dang me lha bskyed/ /zhi rgyas dbang la bdud rtsi lnga/ /gtum pa dmar dang khrag dag dang / /dug dang gu gul nag po dang / /gzugs brnyan dag gis mchod par 'bya/ /'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs pa mchog gi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭakkis 7dbang bskur zhing / /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sregan /'jigs byed me lha nyid la phyag 'tshal 9'dud/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad rab stsol zhing / /bdag gzhan phan sogs la zhugs pa/ /tshangs sras mchog la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /me yi thugs kur 1 drag po ni/ /cho ga bzhin du bskyed par bya/ /sbyin sreg 11de dag 'brel pa yis/ /nor rnams thams cad ster bar byed/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 15'dzin pa la zhus pa/ drag po'i sngags rnams ji ltar lags/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pas lha srin thams cad 'dul ba'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /tabya thā/ hūṃ phaṭa nā ga bi dā 15ra ṇa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ nā ga ursā 7da nā ya tsū 15phaṭa/ nī la 17ba sa nā ya hūṃ 1 phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta 1 ba la pa rā kra mā 19ya rdu 2 phaṭa/ kṛ tān tā 21ya hūm̐ 2phaṭa/ kri tānta surū pā 2 ya rghaṃ 25phaṭa/ ro ṣa ṇa 27ya hūm̐ 2 phaṭa/ tā sa nā ya rtsu 2 phaṭa/ kumbhaṇḍa u'i 29da nā ya rtsu 1phaṭa/ pre ta pi shā 2tsa bi nā sha dka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ yakṣa a pa smra 587—503

phan don du/ /gnod sbyin bsgrub par bya ba ni/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /rdo rje slob dpon smod (1pa dang / /theg pa che la smod pa dang / /de bsgrub 2pa la snying nas brnyas/ / sgrub pa 'di ni brtsam par bya/ //de la ri rab kyi 'og na calas kyi gnod sbyin gyi lus blangs la gdong bzhi lag pa bzhi yod pa gdong dang po bcom ldan 'das kyi sngags zlos pa/ gnyis pa na (5rang gi srog snying zlo 6ba/ gsum pa na me lce'i dbugs 'byung / bzhi pa na sha dang khrag za ba yod/ de sgrub 7pa'i thabs bshad kyis legs par nyon la yid la zung 8shig /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /sngags kyi rgyal po 'bum bzlas la/ /'byung ba bzhi yi dkyil 'khor bri/ /de yi steng du khrag chen gyis/ /padma 'dab ma bcu drug pa/ /btson 9dong tshul du bri bar bya/ /dar sngon de yi nang du bting / /dbus su mi yi sha dang khrag /dang po khyi ste gnyis pa phag /gsum par rna can zangs gtsug phud/ /lnga 1 par skad can drug par ra/ /bdun pa skye gnyis brgyad par glang / /g.yas kyi phyogs nas bskor ba'o/ /ma ho rta dang 11lug dang spre'u12/ /g.yon gyi phyogs nas bskor ba'o/ /de ni dbul ba'i dam tshig go/ /khrag dang dug dang ske 1 tshe yis/ /nam gyi phyed kyi dus dag tu / /dur khrod ras la 'di ltar bri/ /zhal brgyad phyag stong yang na bcu/ /zhal bzhi dang po zhi ba ste/ /gnyis pa dmar po chu srin no/ /gsum pa khro nag yid dang khro/ /bzhi pa yi dgas 1 mgo yin no/ /skra ni gyen brdzes zhal dang mtshungs / /sprul pa bya rgod khra dang spyang / /de yi mgo can bri bar bya/ /dgug gzhug dbang ni bskrad par bya'o/ /'di ni bstan 15pa'i dam tshig go/ /bsnyen pa'i dam tshig gnyis dag gis/ /gsum rgyal dag las shes par bya/ /oṃ yakṣa 87wa 506

ha sa ha sa da ra da ra hūm̐/ khra dang sbyang ki khyi la sogs/ /mi 1lam du 'am dngos su 'byung / /de nas mchod pa'i dam rdzas kun/ /bsgrub bya'i rdzas dang bsres (5)byas la/ /gzugs brnyan byas la thod par gzhug /mar ngo gnod sbyin gzugs kyis mchod/ /oṃ yakṣa mā ra ya mā ra ya/ a pra ti ha ta rab la pa rā kra mā ya phaṭa/ sasba shā rghaṃ tsho4)se gha rabi nā sha 6ka rā ya phaṭa/ nī lī ba 7ra dha 8ra badzra pā ṇi rā (9)tshwa pa ya ti mā ra ya tsitta la phaṭa/ des kyang grub par ma gyur na / /gzugs brnyan rdul la sbyin sreg 1 bya/ /las skyes gzugs brnyan gong bur gzhug /des kyang grub par ma gyur na/ /oṃ yakṣa mā ra ya/ mā ra ya/nā sha nyu1ya/ nā sha 41 ya/ tsitta la rbad rbad/ phyag gi 1 rdo rjes bsnun par bya/ /des kyang grub par ma gyur na/ /nī māṃ ba sa nā ya phaṭa/ stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes ngo mtshar nas ched du brjod pa/ zung du 'brel bar gnas gyur pa/ /yi las rlung ste paṃ las pad/ /'chi ba zhes bya'i rnam rtog 'di/ /bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud las gnod sbyin sgrub 1 pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba btab pa / snying nas slob dpon smod pa la/ /klu gzhug pa ni ji ltar lags/ /rdo rje can gyis bshad du gsol/ /klu'i lag na nad bcu gcig yod de15/ mdze dang /mdza' to dang / ka ta ma dang / ka she dang / 'bras dang / phol dang /shu ba dang / skem pa dang / g.yan pa dang / dmu 1 3chu dang / gag pa'o/ /klu'i gnas ni sa 'og gi rim pa bdun no/ /klu bran ni 'dzam bu'i gling na yang 87—507

brgyad gnyis lon pa'i nyams tshul can/ /drag cing khros pa'i ro dang ldan/ /brang 'gro brgyad pos sku la brgyan/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis pa/ /rang gis 1rdo rje bsnams pa ni/ /bsnun pa'i tshul du 'dzin pa dang / /g.yon pa bsdigs pa'i mdzub 2mo can/ /na bza' sngon po'i ge sham thabs 'dzin/ /spyan mig dmar zhing mche ba gtsigs/ /dbu skra nyi ma'i 'od 'dra ba/ /steng du bcings dbus cod pan ldan/ /zhal nas hā hā'i snyigad rgyangs ldan/ /khro bo'i bdag po 'jigs par byed/ /log 'dren la sogs 'a/'joms mdzad pa/ /de 'drar 6bdag nyid rab bsgoms la/ /de nas bdag nyid snyoms 'jug pa/ / de yi 97snying gar 8nyi ma la/ /rang gi chos kyi yi ge las/ /khros pas yang yang spros mdzad cing / /de dang lhan cig bsgom par (ḍabya/ /sngags dang phyag rgya bcas pa yis/ /de bzhin du yang dbang blang zhing / /rdo rje rtsu mdzad ting 'dzin gnas/ /gdug pa'i sems can 'dzin byed cing / /'od zer 'byung ba sna tshogs kyis/ /rims dang gdon dang dug sogs 57bza'/ /rdo rje sa 'og tu rgyu ba las rtog pa dang po'o// //de nas spyan sogs 411skye mched la/ /rtsu byung khro bo bsgom par bya sku sogs 1nagasum la rdo rje gsum/ /bsgom 1 pa 'di ni dbang byed pa'o/ /dang po zhi bas zhi bar bya/ /klu la sogs 1 pa'i gzugs byas la/ /rang snying 'od kyis bkug la bstim/ /mchod sbyin bya ba snying rjes sbyin/ /'jog po dang ni rigs ldan dang / /mtha' yas nor rgyas padma dang / /pad 15chen dung skyong stobs kyi 7rgyu / /dug rnams snying rje'i sbyor bas sbyang nya / /nag po dkar po sngon po dang 3she//87wa 516

rang gi gnas su sbyar bar bya/ /yang na zhi ba'i thab khung du/ / klu yi 1sdig pa zhi bar bya/ /shin tu gnag pa'i rigs de la/ /mngar gsum chu yis gso bar bya / /gang zhig sdig can zhi mi 'dul/ /gnyis kyi sbyor bas rgyun gcod bya/ /khrag dang dug sogs 5)rdzas dag la/ /rig pa bzlog pas bsgrubs nas ni/ /shin tu khros pa'i khro bo yis/ /dgug dang gzhug dang myos bsad cadang / /cho gas (5)gdug pa dbang byas la/ /bsreg 6pa la sogs 7las bya'o/ /brgyad dang bcu bzhi'i dus kyi tshe/ /skya rengs shar dang dmar rengs nacha/ /nyin mtshan zad pa'i (9nadus kyi tshe/ /skra bkrol khebacud 'dzag gcer bu ni/ /byol song gnas su khrag skyug go/ /lus dbus me 'bar bsgrub bya de/ /khro bo'i ba spu'i nyu1bu ga las/ /spros pa'i khro bo khros pa dang / /mngag gzhug 12rnams kyis drangs byas nas/ /rtog pas rtog pa bza' bar bya/ /sngar ni rdo rje sa 'og las / /gdug pa 'dir ni bza' bar bya/ /mang du smras pas ci zhig dgos/ /ma bcos pa yi sems can la/ /snying rje'i yid can rdo rje sems/ /til sogs 1dardzas dang sngags sbyor gyis/ /sdig pa zhi byed sbyin sreg sabya/ /rig pa'i blo can kun bzang gis5ge/ /zho la bsreg sabya rgyas pa'o/ /mi rtag gyur pa'i gdul bya la / /'dod chags yid can bde chen gyis/ /bdag nyid dgos pa brtan bya'i phyir / /utpal dmar sogs kyis bsgrub 1 pa'o/ /'dir ni ma rungs sdig pa byed / /gtsor ni sbyang ri phyir khro sems kyis/ /mngon spyod las ni rgyud kun las / /bshad pa thams cad 'dir bya'o/ /rig sngags snying rje'i shugs kyis 'gro / /las ngan rgyun 19gcod bcos ma yin/ /las ngan dag pa'i rang bzhin dul/ /khros pas dmigs par mi 'gyur te/ /sbyor ba rnams ni bcos mar 87—517

'gyur / /byang chub bcos med 'bad spangs 37pa'o/ /rdo rje sa 'og tu rgyu ba las rtog pa gnyis pa'o// //de nas khams gsum rnam rgyal po/ /sngar ni sprul pa bcu drug pos/ /rtog pa bcu phrag dang bzhi yang / /gnyis kyis rig pa nana'ajoms byed 'dir/ /sprul pa brgyad du bsdus pa dang / /bdag nyid gcig pu bsgom (5)pa'ang gsungs/ /nam mkha'i khams su 'byung bzhi bsam/ /ri rab lhun po trī yig las/ /padma 'dab grangs lte ba la/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'o/ /hūm̐ las byung ba'i khro bo ni/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi na bza' sngo/ /rdo rje dril bu mda' gzhu 'gengs / /sbrul dang mi sdug mgos brgyan (gcing / /stag lpags smad dkris 'jigs sel ba/ /khro bo rnam rgyal bsgom par bya/ /thugs ku'i (5)rgyu gi sbyor ba yisal/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs mtshams su/ / 'jig rten gsum snang rdo rje dang —/ /6)'jig rten gsum 'dul rin chen dang / /'jig rten gsum 'ching padma dang / /'jig rten gsum 'jig tsho7kyilas nyid dag /g.yas rnams rang ming mtshan ma la/ /g.yon rnams gdug 78)pa bsdigs pa'o/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil dang dbyug sngon dang / /mi 9g.yo ba dang rta mgrin khro/ /rdo rje dang ni dbyug pa dang ske/ /ral gri padma g.yas rnams so/ /g.yon pa gdug pa bsdigs pa'o/ /brgyad kyi dbus na khro bo bdag /'jig rten gsum gyi 'khrul pa sbyong bo/ /dbyug pa nag sogs pho nya bzhi/ /sku mdog mtshan mas brgyan 11pa khros/ /lcags kyu la sogs sgor 12gnas pa/ /khro bo'i 'khor lo 'jigs sel bsgom snye/ /gtso bcas rig pa'i khro bo kun/ /rgyu 1 ma'i phreng bas 15do shal byas/ /gos 87—518

sngon can la stag lpags dkris/ /gdug pa sel ba'i lam du bsgomatshe/ /de nas khams gsum rnam rgyal gtsos/ /khro bo'i mtshan nyid sngags ②bcas bshad/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can sangs rgyas gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis (derjes su gnang ba / mche ba gtsigs ⑤pa dang 'tsham ⑥pa mig me memadag gi phung po 'dra ba/dbugs me lce ltar 'bar ba/ 'jigs pa'i nga ro can lag pa dang rkang pa klu nor rgyas kyi bus brgyan ⑧pa/ klu nag po se ral khar thogs pa/ klu dga' bo dang nye dga' bo 'bar bas rna cha byas pa/ sbrul 'bar ba rin po che'i cod pan thogs pa/ sbrul gdug pa 'bar ba za ba/ bzhin rgyas pa smin ma dang khro gnyer ⑨dpral bar ⑩bsdus pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ gshin rje'i cha 3lhabyad can lce glog ltar 'gyu 8ba/ gsus po che rtso)sbrul za ba/ lag pa brdabs pa'i sgras 'jigs par byed pa/ klu'i rgyal po 'dab bzangs ska skirags su bcings pa/ a la la zhes sgrogs par byed pa/ rgya mtsho'i zabs su dpag tshad brgyad 8khri bzhi stong yod pa rkang pa'i pus mor phyinas pa dbang po dang nyi ma phrag pa 0la khur ba klu thams cad rlag (3par byed pa/ gad rgyangs chen po rgod 37pas kun tu 'khrug par ku nyebyed pa/ gshin rje'i gzugs can khams gsum pa 'jigs par byed pa/ klu thams cad rlag du chepar byed pa la phyag 'tshal lo de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis gsungs pa'i rig dusngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /tabya thā/ bho bho bca gā ( nyesnyi pa ta ye/ i da: ④snyi ba ra dha ra sha rī raṃ/ badzra pā ṇi hre ( snyed yaṃ yaḥsanyes mā shu snati kra ma tha mā ku lo'i chad nadu)/ bha so )bi ṣpe so)ti/ tabya thā snye/ buddha buddha/ bi buddha bi buddha/ ma 87wa 519

tī māsta 1ha ra ha ra nā gā ṭwāṃ sbyin sgyundan// nā ga skṛ snad yā ni/ birnya birnya (0nā ga marmā ṇi'i/ bi shi ne/ryantu nā ga sha rī rā ṇi / bi sbo ṭa yarin/ nā ga na 99)ya nā ni 7rgyu rghaṃ phaṭa/ tabya thā/ nā ga bi dā ra ḍā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ nā go'i (1)da nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ nī lo 12ba sa nā ya rtsu phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta ba nyusal pa ra bkra mā ya hūm̐ phaṭa / kṛ tanta 15ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kṛ 17tānta rū pā ya rtsu 51 phaṭa/ ro 1 ṣa ḍā 517ya rdzu phaṭa / tā sa nā ya 2 rtsu phaṭa/ rku bhāṇḍa'i 1da nā 22ya hūṃ phaṭa/ pre ta pi ri /shā tsa bi nā sha 25ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ yakṣa 27pa smra ra bi nā sha rna ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ha sa ha sa/dha ra dha ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ nā sha naya nā sha ri kāya/ sarba bi ji )nā sha tsho1ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba sha rghaṃ gso gha dbi nā sha da )ka rā ya rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ nī lto gildeb ra dha ra ra badzra pā ṇi rā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ de'i cho ga la gnod sbyin gyis zin pa la chu la sngags kyis btab ste sdo gtor na btang bar 'gyur gi ro/ /klu zlog durtepar 'dod na sgyug shad kyi lcug ma'am bal po se'u'i 1lhug mas bya'o/ /yi dgas chogadang brjed ji byed rnams la ni skud pa sngon pos bya'o/ /rims nad med par bya ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa la ni skud pa sngon pos bya'o/ /nor 'dod na zhag gcig smyung ribar gnas te pog gis bdugs 45na mi lam du dge ba dang mi dge ba'i don thams cad ston par tsho'agyur la gser gyi dong tse 6 bdun stong ster bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyas btab pa dgrol bar 'dod na thal bas bya'o/ /sgo lcags dbye bar 'dod na yungs kur 8gyis bya'o/ /'jigs pa thams cad bsrung 9ba la ni mar rnying pa'am 5 tshothal ba'am yungs kur ri gyis bya'o/ /nad kyis 'jigs pa thams cad la ni skud pa sngon po la bsrung rinaba'i mdud pa byas te mgul du btags na bsrung 5 ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /byis pa gdon gyis nyen pa la ni 87—520

tshon sna lnga'i skud pa mgul 1)du btags na bsrung na ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /chom rkun 5)bzlog par (7'dod na sas bya'o/ /dug la ni rtswa 5ku shas byab par bya'o / /bdag bsrung (6)ba la ni yid kyis sam chus bya'o/ /gzhan bsrung 7ba la ni skud pa sngon pos bya'o/ /las de dag thams cad la sngags brjod pa 8ni lan gsum mam (9)bdun nam bcu bzhi'am nyi shu rtsa gcig gam brgya rtsa brgyad brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar byas na 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje sa 'og tu rgyu ba las rtog pa gsum pa'o// //rtog pa 'di dag dbang byed pa/ /lag na rdo rje khros pa las/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bran g.yog rnams ni bskul bar bya/ /oṃ a mṛ 7ta kuṇḍa hu1li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'di ni bka' tsam nges bsgrag 12cing / /bee yig sum cu nya rtsa gnyis brjod/ /snying ga'i ci'od kyis dbang bya zhing / /gu gul dud pas brod byas la/ /gser (7sna chen po seng ge la zhon pa dang 17/ rmugs 'dzin dang / gang ba 3 bzang dang / nor bu bzang dang / ku be ra dang /yang dag shes dang / 'brog gnas dang / lngas rtsen dang / bi tsi kuṇḍa 1 li rnams la mkho ba sbyin par bya'o/ /'di rnams rta la bcibs 19pa la /'od dang ldan zhing me long can/ /ras dkar gtsang mas gsal byas la/ /gsal snang kun ni bri bar bya/ /yang na kun kyang sbrul 2 nag bcibs 1/ /'jigs pa'i mtshon cha phyag na bsnams rte/ /bskul ba dag par dbang byas na/ /mngon spyod las kun byed par 'gyur/ /drag po dgu dang nyi shu brgyad/ /sa gsum khyab pa spros nas ni/ /sngags grub stobs kyis bdag bran na byed/ /dus tshod 87—521

dus la mchod par 1byed/ /de nas dbul bas 'jigs pa la/ /rmugs 'dzin bsgrub na/pa yid 'ong bshad/ /kun kyang gter rnams mnan pa la/ /rin chen 'bar bas khyim 'gengs pa/ /skyor gang rdo rje chus 'grub 'gyur/ /padma zla dang gter chen la/ /rdza las byung ba'i gnod sbyin dgu/ /bkug la rang rang gsang sngags kyis/ /chu dang bcas pa'i mchod sbyin dbul kyi/ /'di ni sngags kyi rkang pa rnams so/ /oṃ bai 4sha pa ṇa ya 5swā hā/ oṃ dzi bha lā ya 6swā hā/ oṃ purṇa 7snya drwa ya naswā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dā ya 9su hā/ oṃ ku 0be rā ya 411swā hā/oṃ saṃ pra dzha nā ya 15swā hā/ oṃ gu hya sthā nā ya 1 swā hā/ oṃ pā: kā ya saswā hā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇḍa li ne 15swā hā/ de nas yang dag spyod pa'i mchog / lha yi 7brtul zhugs dag pa bshad/ / dus rnams 1 kun du dar 18ras gtsang ma'i 17gos sngon byin gyis brlab bya zhing / /bram ze'i rigs ltar dri can zas dang 'gro mgyogs sha las ring du 'dug /smyung 2 bar gnas shing chus bkrus stodakar gsum dag dang dgatsang ba'i rna zas za zhing / /ngag gi rlung bsdams dad dang snying rjes yid brlan rtag tu 5 brtson par 'jug /bsam gtan khang pa mdog ni sngo bsgyur ba 5lci 27dri zhim chu yis byugs / /dkar dang sngo ba'i name tog bkram la sku gdung bla ma mdun bzhag la/ /cho rigs 9btsun pa'i sgrub sdo pos 21gos dkar bgos la ku sha'i stan la 'dug /snying rjes khros pa'i rig sngags dam pa dag cing ra mdzes par bzlas par dbya/ /ru drukṣa yi da bgrang phreng brgya phyed byin gyis brlabs la lag mugayas gzung dzi/ / phreng ba'i ril bu re dang lha re sngags re bcas nas snying gar gzung 8/ /rnal 'byor 'di rnams rnam par dpyad 9cing 'gro la 'jungs pa'i sems ldan pas/ /bdag dang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir du rtog pa 87—522

bshad pa byas pa (1)yin/ /rdo (ge rje sa 'og tu rgyu ba las rtog pa bzhi pa'o// //dbyar kha skyes pa'i rtswa dang nags tshal las tsho byung me mched ltar/ /rlung gis grogs byas bsregs nas thal ba'i lhag ma'ang ma lus bzhin/ /bskal pa dpag med skyes pa'i rtog 4)pa'i dri ma'i rma rnams la/ /bsrung 5ba dad dang brtson 'grus sngags bzlas sems dag 5)me yis bsreg /nyi ma'i snying po 'dzam bu'i (8)gling gi (9nodabus su rigs bzung ste/ /skyes pa 1 dang ni 11bud med dbang po skyon med tshul khrims can/ /skye ba snga ma'i lam shugs dag dang bla ma'i lung thob pa/ /dad 12dang snying rje'i sems can gtong ba'i 1 blo dang ldan pa des/ /rig pa'i khro bo bsgom skadang de rjes de ni bzlas 'bad na/ /bstod dang mchod mnyes bran g.yog lha min gsang ba brnyas med cing / /chu yi mchod sbyin 'khor lo dag dang tsogator ma la brtson zhing / /sbyin sreg 1 rnams kyis 1 lha dang bran g.yog mnyes byas na1 rme/ /ring por 2 mi thogs sgrub pa 2 po des rtags dang 2 phyag rgya lha'abyin par 'gyur/ /'dir ni mang du smra 2 mi dgos/ /sngar ni rdo rje sa 'og tu/ /bshad pa'i mtshan ma ster bar 'gyur/ /zangs lcags bla ma'i gnang bya'o/ /lus sogs rig pa'i dbang bskur gnas/ /me dang rlung sogs 2 'byung ba dang / /nad dang gdon dang byad rnams dang / /bdud kyis glags 2 ni rnyed mi 'gyur/ /me lce phreng ba'i rtog pa las/ /bshad pa'i 'chi ba'i sbyor byung na/ /ser sna 'di ni pha rol 'phang / /smon lam lam sna la brten nas/ /'di 'og byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /'gro ba smin pa'i bla mar 'gyur/ /yang na srid pa bar ma dor/ /sngags kyis 28rnam shes gzi bskyed nas/ /'gro phan 87—523

rig pa 'dzin gyur nas/ / de yi (1)'og tu sems dpa'o(9/ /tha ma'ang lam la brten nas ni/ /rang 'dod pa yi rten/lus rnyed nas/ /snga ma lam sel de 'og tul/ /dngos grub la ni rnam par gnas/ /lha dang sngags sogs (gertogs pa des / /rtog pa dman pa mnan pa yin/ /nam mkha' lta bur rtog med la/ /'jig rten ngor ni rtog pas sprul/ /gdul bya sdang sogs sems 'khrugs la/ /nga 95)ni snying rjes 56)snang bar mdzad/ /khro sogs bsal (7)du med gyur na/ /khro bor da na kyini ci phyir 'gyur/ /dang po rnal 'byor 'tshe ba bcom/ /de phyir rig sngags sbyor ba rnams/ /rgyud kun du ni gsungs pa yin/ /'tshe ba bcom nas dag pa ni/ /sems dag pa ni bde ba yin/ /gdug pa'i sbyor ba phrogs pas na / /bde bar byang chub lam brten la/ /rdo rje sku nyid 'gyur med la/ /bdag gis 9)rig pa'i ye shes de/ /lus can de yi 'bras bu'o/ /ji ltar shel ni dzam bu 1 rika'i/ /me tog gis ni gzhan du snang / /de bzhin rtog med rig pa yang / /khro bo'i dbang phyug 'dir snang nas/ /ji ltar 'dul 'gyur shesasprul pa yis/ /rgyun mi 'chad par khro bor snang / /snying rje med na 'bras bu nyams/ /'gro la phan btags gnod bsal na12/ /rang sems dag pas (1lha'abras bu 'grub / /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i sgrib pa rnams/ /byang chub sems kyis ring du spang ske/ /'di 7ni 'khor ba 'jig par nges/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i sgrib pa rnams / /blo mnyam dus na gnyen po dang / /mi mthun genam mkha' ltar yangs pa / /lhun gyis grub la'abras phyi ma yin/ /ji srid rtog pa'i dri ma yod/ /de srid 'bad de rig pa bsgom1 / /sems sbyong 18snga ma rig 1rtapa yis/ /rgyud nyid du ni 'dod pa yin/ /gang la sems ni dri med pa/ /rtog pa'i dri mas nag 87—524

dpa' phyag na rdo rje bzhugs pas 'jig rten mkhyen pa la bstod pa'i ltas 0)yin gyis gezhes gsungs so/ /rang rang gi 'khor dad pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis rang rang gi 'jig rten mkhyen pa la gsol pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ byang chub sems dpa' de lta ge bar 'tshal na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ de nas rang rang gi 'khor rnams rang rang gi (sku ston pa'i 'od la 'jus nas ri rab kyi steng na lcang lo can gyi pho brang gi nang du rang rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa byon no//de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod de bstod pa byas nas/ byang chub sems dpa' bstod pa yis/ /ngo mtshar ltas (yekyis 'dir mchis pas/ /'jig rten du 'byung dka' ba yis/ /tshar gcad (7na rjes bzung bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas dbang bskur ba mdzad do/ /a bhi 'diṣiñtsa zhes gsungs pas snod dang ldan par byas so/ /'jig rten gsum 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud las gleng gzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa la byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod de lan gsum du bskor ba byas nas yang dang yang du phyag byas nas gsol ba btab pa(9/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir / /bsrung ba rnams kyi mchog gyur pa/ /phyag na rdo rje bsrung ba'i rgyud/ /zhe snang gtso bos bshad du gsol/ /de nas ston pa bordo rje 'dzin/ /zhe sdang kun gyi rgya mtsho gtso/ /'bar ba drag po spyan yangs pas/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /dbus su phyag na rdo rje 87—532

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gnod byed thams cad zlog pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi skṛ 1)da ya gsungs pas gzhan nas byon pa'i ston pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs bskul nas/ tarya thā/hūṃ phaṭa/ nā ga bi dā ra ṇa ya phaṭa/ nā go'i 2da nā ya phaṭa/ nī lī ba sa nā ya phaṭa / a pra (lde)ti ha ta pa la pa rākra 4/mā ya phaṭa/ kṛ 5tāhā ya phaṭa/ kṛ tānta rū pā (6)ya phaṭa/ ro ṣa ṇa ya phaṭa/ tā 7ris nā ya phaṭa/ rku bha ursā nad nā ya phaṭa / pre ta pi shā tsa bi nā sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ yakṣa a pa smra ra 9pi nā sha ka rā ya phaṭa / ha sa ha sa/ dā ra dā ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ sarba bi yin bi nā sha 17ka rā ya phaṭa/ sarba sha rghaṃ saṃ gha 12bi nā 1 sha ka rā ya phaṭa/nī māṃ skob ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi rā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ gsungs pa tsam gyis dang po'i 1 ‘'khor rnams skrag par gyur te ched du brjod pa/ e ma'o ston pa byin rlabs 17che / /e ma nyu sngags kyi nus pa che/ /e ma che ba'i nyon mongs che/ /'khor rnams mnyam pa nyid du gnas/ /'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i rgyud las sa steng 'dul ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gsum dang / 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan nas byon pa'i 'jig rten gsum po rnams bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa la mchod pa dang bstod pa byas te rang rang gi gnas su dong ngo / /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la rgyud 'di 'das pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs pa 'di chongs shig /lhogs shig ces gsungs so/ /17yongs su gtad pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //87—539
