chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes me tog sna tshogs dang /dri dang / bdug pa sna tshogs kyis mchod nas/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la gtugs stinas/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mi mjed ②kyi 'jig rten gyi khams de na yon tan gyi khyad par ci 'dra ba dag gda' ba bstan du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku yang dag pa'i chos kyi gzhi 'di dag las gzhan pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ngan ngon tsam gyis ni sems can rnams kyi tshogs bsags par mi bgyi lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje sems can de dag ni snyom ①las can/ brtson 'grus dman ④pa/ gti mug gis rmongs pa/ 'dod pa'i dregs pas rmongs pa/ yid ches par dka' ba'i/ phar mi 'dzin pa dang ⑤/ mar mi 'dzin pa dang ⑥/ dge sbyong du mi 'dzin pa/ bram zer mi 'dzin pa/ rigs kyi gtso bo la bsnyen bkur mi byed pa stedu/ des ni gzungs (nya'adi lag tu 'ong bar mi 'gyur zhing / bsod nams chung ba/ skal ba chung ba/ blo zhan pa rnams kyis kyang nyan par mi 'gyur / 'chad par mi 'gyur zhing / sdig pa thams cad 'jig par byed pa/de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i gzungs 6)'di la dad pa bskyed par mi 'gyur rol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu nga ni 'di nas shar phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med pa gang gā'i klung yigi bye ma dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong (7'das pa de na 'jig rten gyi khams nor 87—855

bu'i dhisgron ma zhes bya ba grong khyer gyi ②kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad bcu gnyis pa'i ra ba rin po che sna bdun las byas pa/ rgyas pa/ bde ba/ nyams dga' bske/ lo legs pa/ skye bo dang / mi mang pos gang ba/ skyes pa dang / bud ②med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang / skye bo'i tshogs thams cad rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa nyid snang zhing nor bu dang / gser 'bar ba'i mgo rgyan sna tshogs kyis mgo brgyan pa/ lha'i gzugs can/ mthu dang brtson 'grus chen po dang ldan pa/ bshes gnyen ④thams cad dang ldan paX/ rig pa'i gnas rtogs par khong du chud pa/ snang ba 0yod par 'gro'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams de na rgyal po nor bu sna tshogs zhes ④bya ba rgyal srid byed du 'jug ste/ blon po bye ba phrag brgyad cus ⑤yongs su bskor cing btsun mo dam pa gsal byed ma zhes bya ba bud med nyi khri'i 'khor can lha'i bu mo thams cad kyi lus la 'gran pa zhig yod do/ /'jig rten gyi khams de na yang me tog gi shing dang / 'bras bu'i ⑨shing dang / drang 0chu'i shing dang / dri'i shing gang yin pa de dag yithams cad kyang rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin yin no/ /chu las skyes pa'i me tog gang yin pa de dag thams cad kyang rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin yin no/ /thang las skyes pa'i me tog gang yin pa de dag thams cad ni 'dzam bu 8chu bo'i gser gyi rang bzhin no4)/ /mi rnams kyi tshe'i tshad ni bskal pa brgyad khri thub ste/thams cad kyang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas dang /chos dang / dge 'dun la mngon par dad pa yin no/ /rgyal po de yang chos dang mthun 8pas rgyal srid skyong bar byed kyis 8chos dang mi mthun pas ni ma yin te/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i bsam pa can yin no/ /'jig 87—856

rten gyi khams de na yang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nor bu bzang chen 0)po rnam par bkra ba rab gnas gtsang ma zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen pos yongs su bskor (khucing rig 'a)sngags 'chang bye ba phrag mang pos yongs su bskor nas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad de de bzhin gshegs pa de ni gser gyi kha dog gi sku mtshan sum cu ④ma gnyis dang / dpe byad (9bzang po brgyad cu 4)mnga' ba/ 'od 'dom gang gis kun nas bskor ba/ 'od rin po che sna bdun ltar shin tu gsal spyib yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang gser gyi kha dog gi (8)lus 'od 'phro ba/ mtshan dang ldan pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyi padma'i stan 5)la 'khod ⑩pa ste/ thams cad kyang spobs pa mi zad pa/ sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes spyod yul ba/ rig pa'i gnas rtogs par khong du chud pas 'di lta ste/ nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu (nyeganas pa'i 6nyagasang ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs sems shing gzungs de nyid kyi mthus yon tan gyi khyad par 'di byung bar gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de yang gzungs 'di sems can thams cad la rab tu ston to/ /sems can de rnams kyang gzungs 'di'i mthus bde ba nyams su myong ba ste/ sems can de dag thams cad sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / lha ma yin gyi ris rnams las yongs su thar bar gyur to(snye/ /ngan song gi sgo thams cad kyang bcad par gyur yito/ /mtho ris kyi sgo rnams phye'o/ /bde 'gro'i asgo rnams tsothams cad kyang yiphye ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams de'i sems can gang yin pa de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 87—857

yang dag par zhugs so/ /'jig rten gyi khams de na sems can thams cad byams pa'i sems kyis gnas te/ 'di lta ste/ chu dang 'o ma gcig tu gyur pa bzhin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa des kyang sngon byang chub sems dpar ①gyur pa na / nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa'i gsang ba 'di sgrub pa na smon lam 'di skad ces/ bdag gi phyisangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye bar gyur pa'i (misems can gang yin pa de dag thams cad nges par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur cig ces smon lam btab ste④/ gang dag gzungs 'di nyan pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang ske/ kun chub par byed pa dang / sgom pa dang / 'don pa dang / sems pa (snyedang / sgrub par byed pa dang / chung ngu na ming nyan par byed dam/ lag pas reg gam/ lus la 'chang ngam/ mig gis mthong ba tsam mamanya/ glegs bam la bris pa'am/ ras ⑦la bris pa'am/ rtsig pa la bris pa mthong ⑧na mtshams med pa lnga byas pa'am/ mnar med par gzhol ba'am/ dam pa'i chos spangs pa'am/ 'phags pa la skur pa ⑨btab pa'am/ shan pa'am/ gdol pa'amal/ rngon pa'am/ bya ba'am/ long ba'am/ 'on pa'am/ sha bkra can nam / bkren pa'am/ zhar ba'am/ sgur po'am/ dman pa'amatshu/ sngon gyi las kyis 'phangs pa'i sgrib pa can nam/ myong bar gyur par 7ma nges pa'am/bdud kyi 7zhags pas bcings pa'am/ lta ba ngan par lhung ba'am/ log 'dren gyis zin pa'am/ rgyu skar dang / gza'i 8gnod par byas pa de dag thams cad nges par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /chung ngu na dud 'gro'i skye gnas pa ri dgas dang / bya 87—858

dang ske/ sbrang ①bu mchu rings dang / sha sbrang dang / byi ba dang / grog ②sbyar rnams dang / gzhan yang srog chags kyi rigs sna tshogs sgo nga las skyes pa'am/mngal nas ②skyes pa'am/ drod gsher las skyes pa'am/ rdzus ④te skyes pa la sogs te/ de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur te/ 'di la the tshom dang / yid gnyis bskyed par mi bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis (getshig 'di dugasungs ⑦ma thag tu 'khor de dag thams cad dga' zhing ba spu'i khung bu rnams g.yos par gyur to/ /lha'i me tog utpa la dang / padma dang / ku mu da ⑧dang / padma dkar po dang /man dā ⑨ra ba dang / man dā tshur ba chen po'i char yang rab tu bab tsobo/ /lha'i sil snyan rnams kyang sgra 'byin to8/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag thams cad kyi rang rang gi lus las kyang yi'od zer byung bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar yang rin po che sna bdun gyi khang pa brtsegs ma (stebakra ba/blta 8na sdug pa/ shin tu rnam par phye ba/ nyams dga' ba/ ka ba bzhi zug pa / sgo bzhi btod ⑩pa/ them skas bzhi dang ldan pa/ 'od 'bar ba grwa bzhi na ⑩rnar bu rin po che chen po bzhi nyi ma ltar 'od 8'bar ba/ nor bu dang /rin po che dang / mu tig gi dra ba du ma dpyangs 6)pa/ dril bu mang pos mdzes par byas pa/ dar gyi ba dan mang pos kun nas brgyan pa/ me tog sna tshogs du ma'i chun pos mdzes par byas pa zhig byung ngo / /sa 'di rdzu )rnam pa drug tu rab tu 0g.yos te/ 'gul ldeg la sgra 'byin cing mtho ba dang dma' bar gyur to / /lha'i gnas thams cad kyang 'od kyis snang bar byas te ⑩/ lha'i gnas na gnas pa thams cad bskul to/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi yang bskul to/ /rig (387—859

sngags 'chang gi gnas thams cad kyang 6)bskul te/ lha'i rigs ②thams cad kyang 'bar/ kun tu rab tu 'bar zhing me lce gcig tu gyur pa dang / bar chad byed pa'i log 'dren thams cad kyang dngangs ( )skrag ste/ cho nges 'debs shing phyogs (gebacur byer ro(5)/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi mdzod spu nas/'od zer rab tu bkye ste/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kun nas snang bar byas shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad snang bar byas te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rnams bskul nas slar dbu'i gtsug tu nub bo/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de 4)rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya (7)thub pa de la legs so zhes ⑧bya ba byin te/ bcom ldan 'das legs so legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das khyod de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu bzang po rnam par bkra ba rab gnas gtsang ma de gzigs pa dang / phyag bgyi ba dang / bsnyen bkur bgyi zhing bzhud pa'i dus la bab kyi 41)bzhud la nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa gsang ba zhes bgyi rkyu )ba'i gzungs de yang rgyas par gson cig /bcom ldan 'das gzungs de ni mthu che zhing phan yon che ba lags so/ /gzungs de ni sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa lags te/ gang la la zhig nyan tam/ chung ngu na ming ngam/ lag pas reg na yang phyir mi ldog par 'gyur zhing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu (/1mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar (snye'agyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad nas tshugashegs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis gsol ba btab par thugs su chud nas 87—860

yang 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong bkye ste/ ji ltar lhags pa'i 'khor de la bos nas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu tshur sheg6) /de bzhin gshegs pa'i brda byung ba ni 'di yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis (gyigadan las bzhengs pa dang / khang pa brtsegs ma (mide'i dbus su rdo rje'i seng ge'i khri byung nas/ khri de'i steng du rin po che'i padma bkra ba/ blta na sdug pa/yid du 'ong ba/ sdong bu ④ni gser/ padma'i snying po ni mu tig dmar po can zhig byung ste/ de la bcom ldan 'das bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das bzhugs ma thag tu sa chen po 'di che thang du g.yos par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang nor bu chen po dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te(snye / 'khor thams cad dbugs phyung nas steng gi nam mkha'i dkyil du 'khor gyi (7dkyil 'khor tshuthams cad 'khod de/ 'khor mang po dang / 'khod pa chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs (8)chen po dang / rnam par sprul pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' mang po'i 'khor dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa mang po dang / rig postesngags 'chang bye ba phrag mang po'i 'khor dang / gsang 7ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje dang thabs cig tuyi/ brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dag /nyagashegs so/ /de dag (snyethams cad shar phyogs logs su dong ba dang / tshad med pa'i gang gā'i 7klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong 'das nas nor bu sgron ma zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams su phyin par mthong ste/ bcom 87—861

ldan 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi mthus skad cig thang cig yud tsam gyis 'jig rten gyi khams der phyin to/ /'jig rten gyi khams der byon ①ma thag tu nam mkha' las babs nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu bzang po rnam par bkra ba rab ⑧gnas gtsang ①ma de'i drung du gshegs so/ /der gshegs nas bcom ldan 'das gnod pa mi mnga'am④/ bskyod pa yang ngam/ bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes gsungs nas/ rin po che sna bdun gyi padma 'dab dum stong pa zhig byin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das lha'i gzhal med khang na 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs pa dang / des phyag gser gyi kha dog can brkyang nas / zab cing zab pas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de yang dag par dgyes par mdzad de/ khang pa brtsegs (nyam de nyid du bzhugs (7nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang zhus pa/bcom ldan 'das khyod kyis (9chos kyi 6)'khor lo legs par bskor lags sam/khyod kyis bdud dpung dang bzhon 9par bcas pa bcom pa ⑩lags sam/ khyod kyis chos kyi sgron ma sbar lags sam/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng snyilags sam/chos kyi rnga brdungs lags sam/ chos kyi dung rab tu bus lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das khyod kyis 'jig rten du sangs rgyas 'byung ba 8bla na med pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen par bgyis skilags sam/ bcom ldan 'das khyod kyis deng 'dzam bu'i gling du chos kyi 'khor lo chos kyi gter lan gnyis lan gsum du tsobaskor ba ⑩mdzod cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshig 'di chagasungs ma thag tu/sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams de thams cad rnam pa drug tu g.yos/rab tu g.yos/ kun du rab tu g.yos/ 'gul/ rab tu 'gul/ kun du 87—862

rab tu 'gul/ ldeg /rab tu ldeg /kun tu rab tu ldeg /'ur 'ur/rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun du rab tu 'ur 'ur/ chem chem/ rab tu chem chem/kun tu rab tu chem chem ste/ me tog gi char chen po yang tunyerab tu 'bab②/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul chen po yang snang / sil snyan rnams kyang ma dgrol chabar sgra 'byin / steng gi nam mkha'i bar snang gi lha'i bu rnams kyang lha'i sil snyan shin tu yid du 'ong ba/ yan lag lnga pa dag dgrol bar byed/ klu chen po gang dag yin pa de dag thams cad ④kyang rin po che sna tshogs kyi char rab tu ⑤'bebs par byed/ dri'i phye ma sna tshogs dang / tsandan gyi chu sna tshogs kyi char yang 'bebs par byed/ gos sna tshogs dang / rgyan dang / lhab lhub sna tshogs kyi char ⑥yang rab tu 'bebs par byed/ lha'i mu tig dmar po dang / spug dang /nor bu rin po che chen po rnam par snang byed dang / nor bu rin po che chen po nyi ma'i snying po dang / chu shel dang / me shel dang / dpal gyi snying po'i char yang rab tu 'bebs par byed/ lha'i me tog utpal dang / padma dang / ku mu da ⑦dang / padma dkar po dang / man dā (nyar ba dang / man dā dzi)ra ba chen po'i char yang rab tu 'bebs par byed/ lha'i 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser las byung ba'i me tog dang / lha'i dngul las byung ba'i me tog gi char yang rab tu 'bebs par byed/ lha'i me tog gi phreng ba'i char yang rab tu 'bebs par byed/nam mkha'i dkyil na gnas pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyang a la la zhes sgra snyan par 'byin cing dbyangs kyang rjes su sgrogs par byed/ legs so zhes bya ba yang sbyin par byed/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa 'jig rten du chos kyi 'khor lo lan gnyis su bskor ba dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che chen po chos kyi rgyal 87—863

mtshan 'dzam bu'i gling du bzhag pa dang / 'di lta ste/ nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa gsang ba'i rgyal po'i cho ga zhib mo chen po (1)'dzam bu'i gling du rab tu spyod par bgyis pa legs so legs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nor bu bzang po rnam par bkra ba rab gnas gtsang ma'i mdzod spu ②nas 'od zer sna tshogs bkye ste/ 'od zer de dag gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' dag gi (5)sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad bskul zhing (gesnang bar mdzad do(5)/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams de yang snang bar mdzad/ lha'i gnas thams cad dang /klu'i gnas thams cad dang / dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang /gshim/ rje'i 'jig rten dang / lha ma yin gyi ris rnams su yang bskul cing ⑥snang (7)bar mdzad de/ slar log (nyanas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas slar yang gtsug tor gyi gseb tu zhugs so/ /de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag thams cad kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag nas rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa mdzad nas/ tshad med pa'i gang gā'i 6)klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sangs rgyas kyi zhing der gshegs nas so so'i rdzu 'phrul gyi cho bo'aphrul gyis rin po che sna bdun gyi khang pa brtsegs ma 17dag sprul nas/ khang pa brtsegs ma'i nang tu du 'dzam bu ()chu bo'i gser las byung ba'i seng ge'i khri dag 7byung ba de la yisangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad rang rang gi 'khor dang / khang pa brtsegs ⑩ma'i 87—864

nang du bzhugs hu)so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ②de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu bzang po rnam par bkra ba rab gnas gtsang mas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad yang dag par dgyes par mdzad de/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul chen pos ①legs par mchod nas ④rang rang gi seng ge'i khri la bzhugs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nor bu'i snying po de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu bzang po rnam par bkra ba rab gnas gtsang ma gang na ba der song ste phyin phyinas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis yil mgo bos phyag byas te⑦/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas ⑧'dus pa chen po yang rab tu gda'/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'dus pa chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang yonye/ mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma lags yipa'i 'dus pa chen po thams cad kyang rab tu gda'/ rigs ⑩sngags 'chang gi tshogs 'dus pa chen po yang lhags nas/ 'di lta ste/ lag na rdo rje la sogs pa byang chub ⑩sems dpa' chen po'i tshogs kyang lhags/ bcom ldan ga'adas rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul chen po yang gda' lags pas bcom ldan 'das nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa gsang ba rab tu bstan pa'i dus ni 'di lags so/ /tshod ni 'di lags so zhes lan gnyis lan gsum du gsol ba btab tunyepa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nor bu bzang po rnam par bkra ba rab gnas gtsang mas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nor bu'i snying po la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu song la/ de bzhin 87—865

gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la gsol ba thob cig 0)dang / des khyod la rab tu ston ②par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nor bu'i snying po bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa gang na (0ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te spyan sngar 'dug nas/ bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nor bu'i snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa gsang ba 'di/ sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ba'i slad du rab tu bstan du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas gsol ba btab par thugs su chud nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i ④bdag po song la 'khor mang po 'di'i dbus kyis phyogs su rdo rjes sa la bsnun ⑤cig /de nas gsang ba pa'i 6)bdag po lag na rdo rjes 9)bcom ldan 'das kyis 6)bka' stsal pa mnyan nas/ 'khor gyi sa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus gang na ba der song nas sa phyogs de la rdo rjes bsnun te sa la tsa)bsnun ma thag tu de nas gru bzhir gas so/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i kyi'ajig rten gyi khams 'di yang rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos so/ /g.yos ma thag tu sa phyogs der rin po che sna bdun gyi khang pa brtsegs yim gru bzhi pa / ka ba bzhi pa zug 7pa/ sgo bzhi btod 8pa/ mnyam pa/ nyams dga' ba / shin tu rnam par phye ba/ chas tsomadzes par byas pa/ bkra ba/ blta tson sdug pa/ 'od 'bar ba/ them skas yibazhi dang ldan pa/ 'phang du dpag tshad 87—866

gsum yod la①/ rgyar dpag tshad lnga yod pa zhig byung ngo / /khang pa brtsegs ②ma'i dbus der yang 'dzam bu'i ③chu bo'i gser las byung ba'i mchod rten nor bu dang —/ rin po che dang / mu tig gi dra ba du mas brgyan 0pa/ rin po che sna bdun las byung ba'i dril bu g.yer ma'i dra bas g.yogs pa/ dril bu du ma 'phyang du bcug pa/ dar gyi chun po du mas mdzes par byas pa/ me tog gi chun po du mas mngon par brgyan ⑤pa zhig byung ngo / /mchod rten de'i dbus na de bzhin gshegs pa gsum gyi sku bzhugs so/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyis khang pa brtsegs 6)ma de dag tshul mchod pa mdzad doni / /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor de yang khang pa brtsegs ma ⑨de dang mchod rten la mchod par byed/ rjed par byed/ me tog dang / bdug ⑩pa dang /dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa yidang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan dang / rol mo dang / thal mo sbyar ba dang / phyag 'tshal bar byed do//de nas lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang /mi ma yin pa'i 'khor mang po de dag ngo mtshar skyes te ya mtshan du gyur/ spro bar gyur nas khang pa brtsegs tsom dang / mchod rten 'di ci'i phyir byung bar gyur ces ca co dang ga zha'i ()sgra mthon 8por 'byin cing mchod rten dang / khang pa brtsegs tsom de la bskor ba byed/ mchod par byed/ rjed par byed/ me tog dang ske/ bdug pa dang / dri dang / phreng tshub dang / byug pa dang / sil snyan sna tshogs dang / pheg rdob tu)pa dag gis mchod par byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang /87—867

thal mo sbyar nas 'khod de phyag 'tshal bar byed do/ /de nas khang pa brtsegs 6)ma de las sgra byung ba/ kye 'khor mang po dag bar snang la ci snang ltos shig ltos shig(mi /de nas ji ltar 'dus pa'i 'khor mang po de dag thams cad kyis bar snang la bltas te bltas ma thag tu bai ḍūrya (gyidang / nor bu rin po che chen po las byung ba'i sprin gyi phung po chen po (4)zhig byung ngo / /de nas sprin ⑤gyi phung po'i steng du nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa gsang ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di yi ge gser gyi kha dog tu bris pa ⑥mthong ngo / /nam mkha'i dkyil de nyid nas sgra byung ba/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa gsang ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs bklag 57)tu gsol bklag (8)tu gsol/ sgra byung ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa re re'i spyan sngar sprin gyi phung po las bris po)pa byung nas 'di skad ces kyang dbyangs su sgrogs so/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa de la phyag 'tshal lo phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod rten mchog 'di sgo phye shig dang ⑩/ mchod rten de'i dbus na 11de bzhin gshegs pa gsum gyi sku bzhugs tetunye/ de'i mthus cho 1lha'aphrul gyi rnam par sprul pa'i khyad par chen po 'di snang zhing / de kho na'i mthus de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 7rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa yang snang / nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa'i gsang ba'i gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor dang / cho ga dang / rig sngags dang /cho ga zhib mo'i yo byad dang bcas pa mtha' dag rdzogs shing rgyas par 'khor gyi dbus su legs par rab tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /de nas phyogs bcu nas 'dus pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyis de bzhin 87—868

gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das mchod rten rin po che 'di dang 'di na bzhugs pa 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nor bu'i rgyal po me tog rgyal mtshan dang / nor bu rnam par bkra ba dang / rdo rje 'phags pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba de dag bstan pa'i skabs dbye bar 1)mdzod cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul ( chen pos khang pa brtsegs duma'i mchod rten gang na bar ④bzhud de/ phyag g.yas pa gser gyi kha dog (5)can/ bsod nams brgya'i mtshan gyis brgyan (6)pa brkyang nas mchod rten mchog de'i sgo'i sgo 'phar phye ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams bstan to/ / de nas (7)de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de (8)la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ shākya thub pa legs so legs so/ /deng khyod kyis 5)'dzam bu'i gling du chos kyi 'khor lo lan gnyis pa bskor tokyi/ /bcom ldan 'das seng ge'i khri 'di nyid la bzhugs shig /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa mchod rten gyi nang du khri de nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'di dag khang pa brtsegs (nyama'i mchod rten gyi nang du /rlogaci'i slad du yigebyung gang nas 1 )gshegs/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje sngon byung ba bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab patso/ tshad med pa/ dpag tu med pa/ gzhal du med pa/gzhal gyis mi lang ba/ tshad tsogazung du med pa/ ches dzi tshogangs med pa na gang 87—869

gi tshe 'dzam bu'i gling 6)'byor pal/ rgyas pa dang / lo legs pa dang /nyams dga' ba dang / skye bo dang / mi mang pos gang zhing ma rmos ③pa ma btab pa'i 'bras sā ④lu byung ste/ bdag gi ba shu med cing yongs su bzung ⑥ba med de/ 'jig rten thams cad bde ba dang laldan pa de'i tshe 'dzam bu'i lagling na sangs rgyas med do/ /de'i tshe ri'i rgyal po rin chen ⑨ri bo zhes bya ba de la drang srong gsum zhig gnas te/ gcig gi ming ni nor bu'i gtsug toratho )/gnyis pa ⑩ni gser gyi gtsug tor/ gsum pa ⑩ni rdo rje'i gtsug tor zhes bya ste/de rnams bdag cag ji ltar sems can thams cad bsgral ba'i phyir 'di lta ste/'jig rten bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par 8byang chub pa'i sangs rgyas nyid 'thob 8par 'gyur snyam zhing gcig tu sangs rgyas yid la byed/ chos yid la byed/ dge 'dun yid la byed do8/ /de nas drang srong de rnams de snyam du bsams yinas yud tsam zhig cang 9/—)mi smra bar 'gyur cing sems pa na/ de rnams kyis sems can thams cad mngon par dga' ba'i byams pa/ rnam par bkra ba'i gzhal med khang zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob cing / lha'i mig skyes ⑪nas ji tsam na steng du bltas na/ gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu bar snang la sum̐ )sgra 'byin pa/ skyes bu dam pa dag 0legs so legs so/ /khyod 'di lta ste/ bla na med pa duyang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa 'di ni legs so / /kye skyes bu dam pa dag nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa ( snyegasang ba sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ④kyis sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don du gsungs pa thos pa tsam gyis phyir mi ldog pa nas/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bar thob par 'gyur/ chos 87—870

thams cad mngon ①du 'gyur/ gzungs kyi sgo thams cad mngon du 'gyur/bdud thams cad las rgyal bar 'gyur/ chos thams cad kyi sgron ma sbar ②bar 'gyur / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad mngon du 'gyur/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyural/ dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / yi dgas ④kyi yul dang / lha ma yin gyi chos rnams las yongs su thar bar 'gyur/ skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang /'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang /yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams ⑤las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ba thob nas ①phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus na/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'di na sems can gang dag phar mi 'dzin pa dang / mar mi 'dzin pa dang / dge sbyong du mi 'dzin pa dang —/ bram zer mi 'dzin pa dang / mi dge ba dang / dam pa'i chos spong ba dang ske/ 'phags pa la skur pa (3)'debs pa dang / mnar med par gzhol ba dang —/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la bslu (8)ba dang / dgra bcom pa gsod pa dang / mtshams med pa lnga byed pa dang / bram ze gsod pa dang /ba lang gsod pa dang / chom rkun byed pa dang / g.yon can dang / sho gam sgugs 6)pa dang / brdzun du smra ba dang / ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pas log par spyod pa dang / phra ma smra ba dang / tshig kyal pa smra ba dang /kyigazhal ba la sgyu 7byed pa dang / gzhal lugs 7la sgyu byed pa dang / sung la sgyu byed pa dang / gzhan gyi nor la /nye'aphrog pa dang / gtams 7pa rnog 7pa dang /bshes pa la 'khu ba dang / sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pas zin pa yidag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag thams cad gzungs 'di'i mthus thos pa tsam mamayi/87—871

bklags pa'am0)/ kun chub par byas pa'am/ lus la thogs sam/ bris nas 'chang ngam/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la 'dogs sam/ glegs bam du byed dam / ras la bris pa'am/ dar la bris pa'am/ rtsig ②pa la bris pa'am/ ra ba chal bris pa'am/ chung ngu na sgra nyan pa'am/ lag pas reg gam/ grib mas phog gam/ sems can gzhan gyis reg na yang de dag thams cad gdon mi za bar phyir mi ldog par gyur pas(ge/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ⑤mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur/ tshe 'di nyid la yang yon tan brgya stong mtha' yas pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa thams cad dang ⑥bral bar 'gyur/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang ldan par 'gyur/ bdud thams cad mthar byed par 4)'gyur/ 'jig rten thams cad dga' bar 'gyur/sems can thams cad kyi mchod pa'i 'os su 'gyur/ rgyal po dang / rgyal bu dang / blon po dang / btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dga' bar 'gyur / dge sbyong dang / bram ze thams cad dga' bar 'gyur/ tshig gzung bar 'os par 'gyur/ rtag tu lag pa dang / rkang pa dang 6nye/ gzhon sha can du 'gyur/ tshig mnyen zhing snyan par 'gyur/ bkren par mi 'gyur te/'jig rten pa'i sdug bsngal nyams su 6)myong bar mi 'gyur/ lus la dug gis mi tshugs te/ mtshon gyis ma yin/ me yis ma yin/ chus ma yin/ de la gcan gzan 0khro bo'i 'jigs pas mi tshugs te/ mi rgod kyi 'jigs pas ma yin / chom rkun gyi tunye'ajigs pas ma yin/ kla klo'i 'jigs pas ma yin/lam dang lam gol ba'i 'jigs pas ma yin/ gnod sbyin gyi 'jigs pas ma yin / 'byung po'i 'jigs pas ma yin/ srin po'i 'jigs pas ma yin/ sha 87—872

za'i 'jigs pas ma yin/ mkha' 'gro ma'i 'jigs pas ma yin te/ sbrul gyi 6)'jigs pa mi 'byung / lus la rims kyis mi tshugs te/ zhag gcig (na pa'am/zhag gnyis pa'am/ zhag gsum pa'am/ zhag bzhi pa'am/ rtag pa'i rims sam / rims thams cad kyis lus la mi tshugs par 'gyur/ mig gi ( stand mi 'byung ste/ rna ba'i nad ma yin/ sna'i nad ma yin/ lce'i nad ma yin/kha'i nad ma yin/ so'i nad ma yin/ mchu'i nad ma yin/ mgrin pa'i nad ma yin/ rna bar zug pa ma yin/ lag pa'i nad ma yin/ ro (gergyab kyi nad ma yin / chu so'i nad ma yin/ gzhang 'brum gyi nad ma yin/ gcin nad ma yin / 'khru ba'i nad ma yin/ shu ba'i nad ma yin/ brla'i nad ma yin/byin pa'i nad ma yin/ rkang pa'i nad ma yin/ nad thams cad mi 'byung ngo / /'di lta ste/ bas bldags (5)dang / lhog (phyirapa dang / me dbal dang / lto na ba dang / g.yan pa dang / phol mig dang / khyi rngo dang / mdze dang / rkang shu la sogs pa thams cad kyi thams cad du mi 'byung (7)/ klad pa na ba ma yin/gzhogs 6)phyed na ba ma yin/ long bar mi 'gyur/ zhar bar mi 'gyur(9)/sgur po ma yin/ pha rol gyi mthus 'chi bar mi 'gyur/ 'on par mi 'gyur/sha bkra can du mi 'gyur/ brnyas shing gnas par mi 'gyur te/ yon tan gyi khyad par 'di dag chos dang ldan par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'chi ba'i tshe na yang spobs pa mi zad par 'gyur7/ sems 'khrugs pas dus byed par mi 'gyur / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zhal mngon yi7du bstan nas dbugs 'byin pa mdzad par 'gyur/ lus la byad dang / g.yengs byed kyis mi tshugs/lus la sngags kyi sbyor bas mi tshugs/ bde bar gnyid kyis log par 'gyur/87—873

bde bar sad par 'gyur/ rmi lam na yang sangs rgyas brgya stong mthong bar 'gyur / de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba thams cad mthong bar 'gyur te/ gsang ba'i gzungs kyi mthus yon tan gyi khyad par de lta bu 'byung ngo zhes smra ba 6)mthong ngo / /de nas drang srong de rnams chos (0kyi dga' ba snying la ②reg cing spro ba thob nas mar sar ④gyi gong bu bzhu ba bzhin du lus zhig nas zhu ba'i khu ba de (5tshosa'i nang du thim mo/ /de nas sa gzhi de las smyug ma'i mde'u gser gyi kha dog can/ rtsa ba rin po che sna bdun las byas pa/ lo ma gser las byas pa/ rtse mo mu tig las byas pa/ bkra ba/blta na sdug (6)pa/ stobs dang ldan pa/ gzi brjid 9)dang ldan pa/ dri zhim pa/shin tu yid du 'ong ba gsum skyes so/ /smyug (nyama'i mde'u de rnams zla ba bcu lon pa dang gas te/ de rnams kyi dbus nas khye'u gzugs bzang po mdzes pa/blta na sdug pa/ kha dog rgyas pa/ mchog dang ldan pa gsum byung ngo / /de nas khye'u de rnams phyogs de nyid du de'i drung na skyil mo krung yo)bcas te bsgom tīzhing 'khod do/ /ji tsam na zhag bdun lon pa'i nyin mo byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ gser gyi kha dog gi lus skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu tu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus 7spras pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis kun nas spras par gyur to/ /smyug hunyema'i mde'u de rnams kyang khang pa brtsegs tsomar gyur to/ /nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa'i 8gsang ba'i gzungs 'di yang nam mkha' la gser gyi yi ger snang ngo / /rgyal po chen po bzhi yang steng nas yigadugs 'dzin cing me tog gis tshonagator te/ 'di skad ces 'jig rten du sangs rgyas byung ngo zhes dbyangs 87—874

su sgrogs shing ①'di lta ste/ klu'i bdag po rgyal po chen po gtsug gi (snyenor bu zhes bya ba dang / grul bum gyi bdag po rgyal po chen po nor bu'i snying po zhes bya ba dang / brang 'gro'i bdag po rgyal po chen po nor bu'i 'od ces bya ba dang /gnod sbyin gyi bdag po rgyal po chen po nor bu'i rdo rje zhes bya ba 'khor gnod sbyin brgya stong phrag du ma dang (mi/ bcom ldan 'das de dag skyil mchod pa byed do / /sa phyogs de yang rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin du gyur to45)/ /me tog gi shing thams cad kyang rin po che'i rang bzhin du gyur to/ /lag na rdo rje de'i tshe de'i dus kyi tshe drang srong smyug 4)ma'i mde'u rnams las byung ba byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa gang yin pa de dag gzhan zhig yin snyam na de ltar mi blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lag na rdo rje de dag ni khang pa brtsegs (7)ma'i mchod rten gyi de bzhin gshegs pa 'di dag yin no/ /sa phyogs kyang 'di yin no / /'jig rten gyi khams kyang 'di yin no/ /smyug ⑧ma'i mde'u yi po)khang pa brtsegs ⑩ma yang 'di yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ⑩'khor 'dus pa yang 'di yin no/ /de rnams drang srong du gyur pa na gzungs 'di thos pa tsam mam(ste/snying po sems la bsgoms pa tsam gyis drang srong gi lus spangs nas byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /lag na rdo rje de'i tshe de'i dus kyi nam mkha'i dkyil na gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu gzungs 'di'i yon tan gyi khyad par bsngags pa smra ba gang yin pa de gzhan zhig yin snyam na de ltar mi blta'o⑩ / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nga 7nyid de'i tshe de'i dus na gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lhar gyur to/ /lag na rdo rje de'i tshe de'i dus na gnas gtsang ma zhes bya ba gang gis drang srong de rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams la bkur 87—875

sti dang / rim gro byas pa gang yin pa de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam 6)na de ltar mi blta'o / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nor bu bzang po rnam par bkra ba rab tu gnas pa 'di gnas gtsang ma zhes bya ba'i (mirim gro bar gyur pa na/ de rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs par lung bstan to/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la legs so zhes bya ba byin no(5) / /shākya thub pa khyod kyis sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i byin gyi rlabs (ri)'di 'dra bas sngon gyi sbyor ba gsungs shing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i gzungs 'di yang dag par bstan te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i gzungs 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po gsang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (5)chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba(6)/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub kyi ri7)snying por gshegs pa'i gsang ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i seng ge'i khri la gshegs pa'i gsang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyi gsang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i gsang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dgongs pa'i gsang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rig pa'i gnas kyi gsang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 8)gsang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya yang dag par 'dzin pa'i gsang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'od zer bye (9)ba rab tu 'gyed pa'i gsang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yang dag 87—876

pa'i mtha'i gsang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi 6)rnam par 'phrul pa'i byin gyi rlabs (7kyi gsang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub sems dpa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyan gyi gsang ba/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sangs rgyas kyis thams cad la rab tu 'god ji pa'i gsang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin rtogs pa khong du ④chud pa'i gsang ba/ sgrib pa thams cad 'jig par byed pa'i gsang ba 'di gsungs pa legs so legs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas dgongs pa dang ldan zhing mkhyen bzhin du(snye/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gzigs nas/ 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong 'di lta ste/ sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / le brgan dang / shel dang /dngul gyi kha dog (6)dag bkye ste/ de rnams 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa rnams su dong nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad snang bar byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la (7)bskul nas slar log ste/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas dbu'i gtsug tor gyi gseb tu zhugs (8)so /'od zer de dag zhugs ri9)ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das kyis tshangs pa'i gsung (1 tshodabyangs chen pos bkang nas rig sngags chen mo /lha'adi gsungs so/ /oṃ sarba ( gyeta thā ga ta (nyam ṇi ⑩sha ta dīptas/ dzā la dzā tshal/ dharma dhā tu garbhe/ ma ṇi ma ṇi ma hā ma ṇi ta thā ga ta skṛ yo da ya 18ma ṇi swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di gsungs ma thag tu/ ri dang / tshal dang / nags tshal du bcas pa'i sa rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 87—877

'das thams cad kyis kyang legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ shākya thub pa khyod kyis mchog tu gsang ba 'di 0)gsungs pa ni legs par gsungs te legs so legs so / /bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir 'dzam bu'i ②chu bo'i gser las byung ba'i sprin chen po nam mkha'i dkyil du chags so / /phyogs bcu kun tu rin po che sna bdun gyi char bab bo/ /tsandan sbrul gyi snying po'i phye ma'i char yang bab bo/ /u dus ra'i (geme tog gi char ⑤bab bo/ /bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir gzhan yang me tog sna tshogs padma dang / ku mu da yidang /padma dkar po dang / dri ngad ldang ba (7dang / man dā ra ba dang / man dā ra ba chen po dang / me tog mdog mdzes (kyedang / mdog mdzes 7chen po dang / mañdzu ṣa 7ka dang / mañdzu ṣa tunyeka chen po 7dang / yid 'ong ba tsodang / pa ri ṣa dhika dang / me tog tsam pa ku'i char dag bab bo/ /bdud kyi gnas thams cad kyang 8rab tu 'bar bar gyur te/ bdud kyi ris yikyi lha thams cad 0skrag cing sngangs tunyepar gyur to/ /bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad kyi lus rdul cing lus dri mi zhim par gyur nas/ phyogs bcur rab tu 'bros par brtsams so / /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mngon par dad pa'i lha gang dag yin pa'i lha dang ske/ klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa dag gis kyang rang rang gi gzhal med khang rnams bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir 6)phul lo/ /de nas nor bu rab snang sems la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong nor bu dang rin po che sna tshogs thogs nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su mchod pa byed do/ /de 87—878

nas lag na rdo rje la sogs pa 6)rig sngags 'chang bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma ras bcos bu'i gos brgya stong gis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed do/ /rgyal po chen po ②bzhi yang rgyal chen bzhi'i ris ①kyi lha'i bu brgya stong phrag du ma me tog sna tshogs dang / bdug pa dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / chos gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan dag thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed do/ /tshangs pa la sogs te/ tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu rnams dang / brgya byin la sogs pa sum cu ④rtsa gsum gyi ris kyi lha'i bu brgya stong dag kyang bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las la brtson par byed do/ /de bzhin du sred med kyi bu dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / nor bu bzang po dang / gang ba bzang po dang / stobs kyi lha la sogs pa yang bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed do/ /lha'i bu nyi ma dang /zla ba yang nam mkha'i dkyil nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa ⑤byed do/ /dpal lha mo chen mo dang / lha mo chen mo dbyangs can ma dang / lha mo chen mo dung can ma dang / gnod sbyin mo chen mo 'phrog ma yang 'khor brgya stong dang /lha mo chen mo 'jigs byed ma dang / rdo rje nag mo dang / me tog so dang /lha mo chen mo (5)pho nya mo dag kyang rang rang gi gzhal med khang rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa (7)byed do/ /dri za'i ris kyi lha'i bu du ma dag kyang sil snyan yan lag lnga dang ldan pa brgya stong bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir brtson pas dgrol bar byed do/ /klu'i rgyal po brgya stong phrag du ma 'dus pa 'di lta ste/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho dang / klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga' bo dang / chu lha dang / shin tu rab gnas dang / gtsug na nor bu 87—879

dang / klu'i rgyal po rnam pa kun nas rdzogs pa'i 'od dag kyang rin po che nor bu skar 'od sna tshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed do/ /'khor chen po yang 'dus par gyur to1)/ /'khor los sgyur ②ba'i rgyal po chen po de yang blon po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma'i 'khor dang / btsun mo'i tshogs kyi 'khor dang bcas shing bu stong du gcig gis ma tshang bas (5)yongs su bskor ④te/mdun gyis bltas so/ /sa de yang rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur to/ /de nas 'khor chen po de nyid kyi dbus bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar sa la brtol (5)nas rin po che sna bdun gyi padma 'dab (6)ma stong pa zhig byung ste/ padma de'i steng du 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser las byas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong pa/ mu khyud dang bcas pa/ lte ba dang bcas pa/ lhag pa'i 'od 'phro ba/ nyi ma bzhin du gsal ba zhig byung ngo / /de'i 'od kyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i spyi'ajig rten gyi khams snang bar byas nas/ 'khor lo de'i lte ba'i nang nas sgra byung ba/shākya thub pa gang 'di 'dra ba'i gzungs kyi gsang ba rnams gsungs pa (kyeni legs so legs so/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po/ /byang chub chen po'i snying por 9rigashegs pa'i rig sngags/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rig sngags kyi snying po/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi yang dag pa'i tshul gyi rig sngags kyi snying po 'di/ bcom ldan 'das yang gsungs ⑩shig/nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa gsang ba tuskrezhes bya ba'i gzungs gsungs 12shig dang 1snye/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bskul ba'i snying po dang ldan pa zhes sabya ba'i gzungs gsungs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskul cing 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dus pas 7bcom ldan 87—880

'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i gsungs pa'i 6)dus ni 'di lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ni sangs rgyas nyid bsgrub (mipa'i rtsa ba/ sdig pa thams cad sel ba/ sdug bsngal thams cad kyi mtsho skems pa/ 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon pa las nges par 'byin pa lags/ 'di ni chu bo chen po las sgrol (8)ba lags te/ gzungs 'di ma mchis par sangs rgyas nyid bsgrub ④par rngo mi thogs lags so/ /'di ni sangs rgyas nyid kyi sa bon ⑤lags/ 'di ni chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba lags/ 'di ni chos kyi sgron ma sbar 6)ba lags/ 'di ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng (7)ba lags/ 'di ni chos kyi dung rab tu 'bud pa lagasal/ 'di ni chos kyi rnga brdung (8)ba lags/ 'di ni chos kyi seng ge'i khri la mchis pa lags te/ de'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po chen po 'di'i dam tshig dang / dkyil 'khor cho gci dang bcas pa/ gsang ba dang bcas pa/ phyag rgya'i le'u dang bcas pa/ ras bcos bu zung dang bcas pa / yo byad dang bcas pa'i cho ga legs par rgyas par gsungs shig /de nas lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang /mi ma yin pa'i 'khor 'dus pa rnams ya mtshan du gyur/ spro bar gyur nas thams cad kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag byas tepo)/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du bltas shing ⑩'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bskul ba yang dag pa 'di dang / gsol ba btab pa gsan nas/ rig sngags kyi cho ga zhib mo 'di 5nyergyas par bka' stsal to/ / bskul ba'i yi le'u ste cho ga dang po'o// //87—881

'phags pa nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa'i ①gsang ba dam pa'i ②cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ bam po gnyis pa/ de nas sdig pa kun ni sel byed pa'i/ /rig sngags lus kyi dri ma med byed pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bla na med pa yi/ /cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po dge bar bshad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ bi ②su la garbhe/ ma ṇi pra ——/ ta thā ga ta nirde sha ne(ge/ ma ṇi ma ṇi/ su pra te⑤/ bi ma le/ sā yig ra gaskyi phyire/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dzā la (kyesto la6)/ buddha dhibi lo ki 7te/ gu hya a dhiṣṭha tati/garbhe swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa gsang ba dam pa'i gzungs 'di bka' stsal pa na sa chen po 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /rin po che'i char chen po bab par gyur to / /me tog gi char chen po bab bo/ /'khor thams cad kyang 'dus te thams cad kyis ca co dang / ga zha'i sgra phyung nas thams cad sa bcu la gnas par gyur to3ste / /thams cad dge ba'i chos dang ldan par gyur to/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis/ shākya thub pa la legs so zhes 8bya ba byin te / shākya thub pa gang byang chub kyi snying por 'gro ba'i gzungs 'di lta bu gsungs pa legs so legs so/ /thos pa tsam gyi 8mod la sdig pa dang / ngan 'gro thams cad 'jig ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /gzungs 'di dran ⑩pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la lha'i na bza' dang / bdug pa dang / me tog dang /dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pas mchod par 'gyur ro/ /bklags ⑩pa tsam gyi /rtemod la phyir mi ldog par gyur zhu nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur to/ /de bzhin 87—882

gshegs pa thams cad kyis 6)bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa/ bskal pa'am / bskal pa brgya'am/ bskal pa stong ngam/ bskal pa brgya stong du yang brjod par mi spyod de/ de ltar gzungs 'di ②phan yon che ba lags so/ /bdud kyi ris kyi lha thams cad kyis ①bar chad bya bar mi nus te/ bgegs kyis bya bar ma yin/ phyir rgol bas ma yin/ mi mdza' bas ma yin/ 'byung pos ma yin/ gdon gyis ma yin/ gnod sbyin gyis ma yin/ srin pos ma yin / mi dang mi ma yin pas goglags rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba mang du 'phel bar 'gyur⑤/ lan cig ༅dran pa tsam gyis kyang de ltar yon tan gyi phan yon mang por 'gyur na shin tu bya ba mang po byed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos / de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis sems can de rnams bsrung 9)bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /spro bar bgyi'o/ /rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang /sba bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag gser gyi kha dog zhu)can brkyang ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje'i mgo la bzhag nas/ rgyal po chen po bzhi po de rnams la dbugs phyung 6)ste/ ngas gzungs 'di gtad ⑩do/ /sems can de yang gtad ⑩do/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po chen po 'di dang / sems can yongs su bskyang 8ba'i slad du yongs su gzung tsolags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gzungs kyi snying po bka' stsal pa/ oṃ ma ṇi badzre hūm̐/ 'di ni snying po'o/ /87—883

oṃ ma ṇi dha ri ①rgyu phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /rtsa ba'i rig sngags kyi cho ga ni/tshes grangs ma yin rgyu skar min/ /smyung 〈geb yang ni bya mi dgos/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs sam/ mchod rten sku gdung dang bcas pa'i drung du bzlas brjod 'ba' zhig (5nyekhri byas nas tshes bcwa 'aralnga'i zla ba nya la shin tu khrus byas te/ gos gtsang ma bgos nas mchod rten sku gdung dang bcas pa'i drung du ci 'byor pas mchod pa bya ste55)/ mar me bzhi (7dbul bar bya/ dri dang me tog la sogs pa yang dbul bar bya'o/ /zas dkar phyagasum bza' bar bya'o/ /mchod rten la bskor ba brgya rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /rig sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas de nyid kyi drung du nyal na/ nam nangs 8)kyi dus 0tshun chad de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa lag na rdo rje yang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gang 'dod pa de rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /gal te mtshams med pa lnga'i las byas pa zhig yin na yang des 7dus gsum du bsgrubs na gdon mi za bar mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /som nyi dang yid gnyis bskyed /huḥpar mi bya'o/ /nang par langs te bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad byas na don thams cad grub sna par 'gyur ro/ /de'i lus la dug gis tshugs par mi 'gyur te/ sbyor ba ngan pas ma yin/ chu yis ma yin/ me yis ma yin/ chom rkun gyis 'phrog par mi 'gyur te/ lus la nad kyis tshugs par mi 'gyur(3/ dgras 'jigs par mi 'gyur ro⑩/ /de'i lus la nad mi 'byung ste/ mig nad ma yin/ sna nad ma yin/ lce nad ma yin/ rna ba'i nad ma yin/ so nad ma yin/ klad tshand ma yin/ yan lag dang nying lag gi nad ma yin/ rims ma yin te/ zhag gcig pa'am/ zhag gnyis pa'am/87—884

zhag gsum pa'am/ zhag bzhi pas lus la tshugs par mi 'gyur ro/ /sbrul gyi 'jigs pas ma yin6)/ gcan gzan ①khro bo'i 'jigs pas ma yin zhing ①/lus la byad kyis tshugs par mi 'gyur ro/ /gzungs 'di ni yon tan de ④lta bu dang ldan pa yin te/ 'jigs pa thams cad rab tu 'joms par byed pa yin/sdig pa thams cad 'jig (5)par byed pa yin/ yon tan thams cad grub par byed pa yin/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byed pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i de kho na nyid grub par byed pa yin te/ gzungs 'di ni bklags ⑥pas grub pa ste/ las thams cad byed do/ /ri khar 'dzegs te bzlas brjod byas na/ mig gis gang du bltas pa der sems can rnams kyi sdig pa thams cad 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal ba thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba thams cad kyang thar bar 'gyur ro/ /lha khang du zhugs te bzlas brjod byas na lha thams cad des ci bsgo 4)ba bzhin byed par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i gnas su zhugs te bzlas brjod byas na klu rnams (8)dbang du 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma la kha bltas te bzlas brjod byas na nyi ma mngon sum (9)du babs nas mdun na 'dug cing mchog ci smra ba ⑩de sbyin par byed do/ /lag na rdo rje'i mdun du bzlas brjod byas na mchog thams cad ster cing mthong bar yang 'gyur ro/ /shu dag la sngags stong rtsa brgyad bzlas nas de zos nas rgyal po'i pho brang du zhugs na rgyal po'i btsun mo 'khor dang bcas pa dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /ci smras pa de sbyin par byed do/ /na le sham gyi 'bru la lan bdun bzlas te/ khar bcug na ci smras pa ster bar byed cing dbang du 'gyur ro/ /yungs kur la lan 17stong rtsa brgyad bzlas te nam mkha' la gtor 87—885

na rlung dang / ser ba thams cad bkag par 'gyur ro/ /lan tshwa la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ bram ze rnams la byin na gang dang gang gis ①lan tshwa zos pa de dang de kho na dbang du 'gyur ro/ /rgyal rigs dbang du bya ②na yungs kur gyi ①sbyin sreg ④bya'o/ /gu gul la sngags stong rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ gang dang gang gi gdon la bdugs phyin de dang de nyid 'bab par ⑥'gyur ro/ /bdugs na gdon thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /char mi 'bab pa'i tshe klu'i gzugs byas ⑦te/ gnas gru bzhir ⑧byas la ba ser mo'i lci ba las 6)klu mgo gsum pa byas la snying gar ⑩gser gyi sa glan (nyepar bya'o/ /lus ni li khris byug par bya'o/ /gnas kyi gzhi ni sngon pos bsku 8bar bya'o/ /gnas gru bzhi ni shing pa la sha ltar kha dog sngon por bya'o/ /bum pa gang ba bzhi gzhag 8par bya'o / /pog por cibazhi gzhag 8par bya'o/ /bum pa bzhi gzhag ⑩par bya ste/gcig ni 'o ma/ gcig ni zho/ gcig ni 'o thug /gcig ni zhun mar bu ram can no/ /ba'i lci bas gling bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o/ /grwa bzhi ru phyes padma bri bar bya'o/ /mda' bzhi btsugs la tshon 7skud sna lngas bskor bar bya'o / /tshon 8sna lnga'i ba dan gdags ⑩par bya'o/ /bdug pa sna ( khyabazhi po gu gul dang / tse pog (nyadang / tsandan dang / du ru ska ( nyabasreg par bya'o/ /sa bon bdun gtor bar bya'o/ /kha dog lnga'i gtor ma gzhag 0par bya'o/ /'bras bu dang me tog gzhag ④par bya'o/ /rig pa 'dzin pas tsokha shar phyogs su bltas te/ 'dug nas rig sngags stong rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ yungs mar tsore re nas spyi bor brdeg par bya'o/ /stong rtsa brgyad tshang bar bzlas na/ de nas klu rnams char gyi rgyun 'bebs par byed do/ /klu thams cad de'i dbang du 87—886

'gyur ro/ /yungs kur ①la bzlas brjod byas te/ klu'i mtshe 'ur chagator na char gyi rgyun 'bebs par byed do/ /seng ldeng ①gi phur bu ④la bzlas brjod byas te klu'i gnas su btsugs na rlung dang / ser ba thams cad bcings par 'gyur ro/ /yungs kur dul brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas te/ log 'dren gyi klad ⑥par btab na log 'dren thams cad bcings par 'gyur ro/ /'o mas bkrus na phyir dusos par 'gyur ro/ /las gang dang gang kho na bya ba'i las de dang de dag 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gtsang mas gos gtsang ma bgo ⑧bar bya ste/ 'di ni rtsa ba'i rig sngags kyi cho ga'i tshul yin no gnyis pa'o// //da khyani snying po'i las rnams 'byung ste/ bzlas brjod 'bum byas na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /nyis 'bum byas na sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /sum 'bum byas na dkyil 'khor thams cad du zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags thams cad grub par 'gyur rol/ /bzhi 'bum byas na rig 'dzin thams cad kyi 'khor los sgyur yibar 'gyur ro / /lnga 'bum byas na lha ma yin gyi sgo thams cad 'byed par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i gnas thams cad 'byed par 'gyur ro/ /drug 'bum byas na gter thams cad 'bur ⑩bar 'gyur ro/ /bzlas brjod bdun 'bum byas na tshe rabs thams cad dran par 'gyur ro/ /bzlas brjod brgyad 'bum byas na rin chen phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur ro/ /bzlas brjod dgu 'bum byas na byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rnam par sprul pa'i byin gyis 8brlabs thams cad 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /bzlas brjod sa ya byas na de bzhin gshegs pa thams 87—887

cad kyis 0)dbang bskur ba thob ⑧par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang phrad par 'gyur te/ de la sogs pa gong nas gong du yon tan gyi ②khyad par thob par 'gyur ro/ /mtshams med pa lnga byas pa'am/ 'phags pa la skur pa (4)btab pa'am/ dam pa'i chos spangs pa'am/ mnar med par gzhol ba yang rung / de dag thams cad kyis bzlas brjod 'bum byas na las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur/ phyir mi ldog par 'gyur/ skye ba dran par 'gyur / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dgongs par 'gyur ro6)/ /mig rnam par dag pa dang / rna ba rnam par dag pa dang / sna rnam par dag pa dang / lce rnam par 96)dag pa dang / dbang po yongs su dag pa thob par 'gyur te/ de ltar gong nas gong du yon tan 6)gyi khyad par dang / gong nas gong du lus yongs su (shernam par dag pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi dngos grub tu bya ba rnams grub 6)par 'gyur ro/ /de kho na grub pa bla na med pa ldong ros la bsgrub pa bshad de ⑩shin tu khrus byas pa gos gtsang ma bgos pa/ zas dkar gsum bza' bas ldong (nyaros blangs te/ zangs kyi snod yogedu bzhag nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar tshes bcu gsum nas tshes bcwa lnga'i nya'i 9/rtebar du/ bzlas brjod 'bum byas na de nas rnam pa ⑫'grub par 8rig par bya ste/ gal te nag por gyur na dpral ba la thig le bya'o// de nas yimi snang bar 'grub par 'gyur te/ lha ma yin gyi sgo thams cad du 'jug par 'gyur/ gnas thams cad du 'jug par 'gyur/ gang 'dod pa de byed par 'gyur ro/ /gal te dud pa byung na des mig bsku bar bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i gnas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur/ lag na rdo rje'i 87—888

gnas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur/ nor dang 'bru thams cad rnyed par 'gyur te/ gang du 'dod pa der 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te 'bar bar gyur na nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur/ 'bar ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur/ lha'i gnas 6)sum cu (nyam gsum gyi lha thams cad kyi dpon por 'gyur/ gang 'dod pa de byed par 'gyur/ ri'i rtse mor 'dzegs te bzlas brjod 'bum byas na 'jig rten thams cad kyi gtso bor 'gyur/gang 'dod pa de byed par 'gyur/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi thams cad ci bsgo ② ba bzhin byed par 'gyur ro/ /mtshor zhugs te bzlas brjod stong rtsa brgyad byas na klu thams cad mthong bar 'gyur④/ yungs kur ⑤blangs nas sngags stong rtsa brgyad bzlas nas nam mkha' la gtor na char chen po 'bab par 'gyur/ klu thams cad ci bsgo ba bzhin byed par 6)'gyur ro/ /rtag tu bzlas brjod byas na dpal chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /bum pa chus bkang ste hab shang tshe'u dang /shing pa la sha dang / yungs kur ⑦dang / gur gum dang / tsandan rnams lhan cig bum pa der blugs la bzlas brjod khri byas pas nad chen pos 2thebs pa bkrus na nad khu)thams cad med par 'gyur/ nad thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur / de'i sdig pa thams cad kyang 'jig par 'gyur/ byad thams cad 'jig par 'gyur/ dpal thams cad thob par 'gyur ro/ /marje'i nad 7kyis thebs pa bkrus na mdze nad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /sha bkra'i nad kyis thebs pa yang bkrus na sha bkra'i nad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /bud med bu 'dod pa rnams des khrus byas na bu rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /dngos grub med pa khrus byas tunyen dngos grub chen po thob par 'gyur ro(/rte/ /de la 87—889

sogs pa gong nas gong du 'jig rten gyi dngos grub tu bya ba rnams kyang grub par 'gyur ro/ /gang 'dod pa de byed par 'gyur ro/ /nye ba'i snying po'i las rnams 'byung ste/ bzlas brjod 'bum byas na bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rkang pa la gtugs nas kye rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag 6)skyobs shig /bdag cag gi srog chud ma gsan cig dang bka' ci stsal pa de bgyi'o zhes brjod par 'gyur ro/ /bzlas brjod nyi khri cig (mistong byas na lha thams cad (bdang /klu thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ rig sngags thams cad kyi bdag por 'gyur ro(ge / /ci bsgo ba de byed par 'gyur ro55)/ /bzlas brjod sum khri byas na 'byung po dang / gnod sbyin la sogs pa thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /bzlas brjod lnga khri byas na gang dgug pa de (6)khugs par 'gyur te/ lha'am/ klu'am/gnod sbyin nam/ dri za'am/ nam mkha' lding ngam/ mi 'am ci'am(7 lha ma yin nam(87/ rig 'dzin nam/ bud med dam/ bram ze'am/ rgyal rigs sam / sa bdag gam/ blon po'am/ btsun mo'am/ khrom gyi ru sna 6)'am/mdun na 'don bonam/ gzhan yang sems can sna tshogs khugs par 'gyur ro/ /gu gul dang yungs kur 1lhagyi sbyin sreg 1)drug khri byas na dri ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur ro/ /bdun khris ni rig 'dzin gyi 'khor los sgyur tunyebar 'gyur ro/ /brgyad khris ni lag na rdo rje 'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas pa mdun na sdod par 'gyur ro/ /dgu khris ni byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis cidabugs 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /'bum tshang bas ni 7de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong bar 'gyur te/ rigs kyi bu khyod gsang sngags thams cad dang / bstan bcos thams cad grub kyis gang skra'adod pa der song cig /nye /87—890

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis zhi)byin gyis brlabs (kyepas phyir mi ldog cing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis gnang gis(mi/ 'jig rten pa'am / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dgos pa gzhan dag kyang ci 'dod pa bzhin khyod kyis las thams cad (7byos shig (5)ces ston par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ ma ṇi kuṇḍa (nyali rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gdan gyi sngags so/ /oṃ ma ṇi bi dza (/ye dha rā dha rā (0rtsu phaṭa 6)swā hā/ dkyil 'khor gyi sngags te yungs kur tu )la lan bdun sngags ⑨bzlas pas so/ /oṃ dzwa li ta ma ṇi ru tsi ra gri ṇi 'artsu hūm̐ phaṭa/ yungs kur yonyedang / dri chur cibasres pa la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te phyogs bzhi ⑫bcing ngo / /oṃ ma ṇi pra bha ba ti ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ thal ba dang chu la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pas log 'dren bcing ngo / /oṃ badzra ma ṇi tiṣṭha tiṣṭha ⑩rtsu phaṭa/ lan bdun bzlas te gtsug tor 7bcing ngo / /oṃ (snyem ṇi bi pu la (rtedi ri di ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ gos kyi sngags so/ /oṃ bi nu )du ma ti ha ra ha ra ma ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ ( kāphaṭa / nye reg ru)gi sngags so/ /oṃ su nim ( shel pa ti ha ra ha ra pā paṃ mi li mi li )hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yungs kur sarnyil lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te khrus bya'o/ /oṃ ma ṇi dha re hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bsang ( 'gator gyi sngags so/ /oṃ di ri di ri bi ma la ka ri rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa/ mchod phyir thogs kyi sngags so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta putpa sa ma ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ me tog gi sngags so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gandha ‘ risnyem ṇi spha ra ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dri'i sngags so/ /oṃ dzwa li ta ma ṇi pra ba ra kū ṭa gā 29ra spha ra ṇa bi ( 7ga te hūṃ/ bdug pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ dzwa li ta shi kha ri ta pa li zhu1rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa/mar me'i sngags so/ /oṃ pra pa ra gra 'a ba li sa ra sa ra hūm̐ hūm̐/ gtor ma'i 87—891

sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā ma ṇi pū 0)ra ya dha ra dha ra rtsu hūṃ phaṭa/ mchod yon gyi sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā bi ma le ju hūm̐ ba ra ba ra hūm̐/ lha bshos kyi sngags sol/ /oṃ dzā tshul spha snyir da ga ga na pra ta ra ṇi (brtsu hūm̐/ sbyin sreg yigi sngags ⑦so/ /oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra ba ra ta ya rdzu/ bgrang phreng gi sngags so/ /sngags 'dis ⑧lan bdun bgrang phreng la btab ste/ bzlas brjod byas na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa'i gsang sngags de dag thams cad bzlas par 'gyur zhing / bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma 5)bzlas par yang 'gyur ro/ /oṃ badzra ma ṇi ka ra ki kyika ri rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa/ skyil mo krung hu)gi sngags so/ /oṃ su pra brti tsoto be ge ma ṇi ma ṇi swā hā/ bzlas brjod kyi sngags so/ /oṃ sarba ⑩ta thā ga ta thā yiyu dza be ta ra 8rgyu ma ṇi tsoka ra ṇi tunyes hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa ⑫thams cad bskul ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ su bi 7bu la la pra ba rdzu nyere du ru du ru hūṃ hūm̐/spyan drang ba'i zhunyesngags so/ /oṃ sarba ( snyeta thā ga ta a dhiṣṭha na tsi ta saṃ rakṣa ṇa ⑫badzre hūṃ hūm̐/ gsol ba gdab pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ su bi pu la ba da ni ha ra ha ra hūm̐ / byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gsol ba gdab pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ a bhi du stes ma ye 3gebadzra dha ra dha ra /tso/ lha dang klu la sogs pa thams cad bod shyipa'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma ṇi be ga ba ti ju/ rgyal po chen po bzhi bod phyopa'i sngags so / /oṃ shu ba ma ṇi hu lu hu 0lu hūm̐/ slob ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta skṛ zhi )da ya badzi 0ṇi dha ra dha ra rtsu hūṃ/ 'jug pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ bhi ra bhi dur dze ga ga na pā 0nyi ni li hu lu hu (stelu tsū hūm̐ hūm̐/ thams cad du (nyamakhyen par byas pa'i 8gyisngags so/ /oṃ ma ṇi sumbha ni be ga ba ti/ bdag dang che ge mo la srungs ⑥shig hūm̐/ bsrung (nyeba'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba 6)ta thā ga ta ku 4)lo ti te (1sma ra ṇa 87—892

bi ①ga te dzā la dzā ②la hūm̐ swā hā/ slar gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags so/ /thams cad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /snying po 'di rnams kyi phan yon ni 'di dag thams cad yin te dpag tu med do/ /thams cad du yang lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas te/ de nas dgos pa ①brtsam par bya'o/ /'di bton ④pas ni thams cad 'grub/ /'dis ni 'gro ba'i sdig kun sel/ /sdig pa de kun ⑤zad byed cing / /sdug bsngal kun las rnam par grol/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dgayi /lung ston 'gyur te the tsom 6)med/ /gang gis snga mar sdig pa'i las/ /mang po ⑧byas pa 'jig par 'gyur/ /rig pa bla med su 'dzin pa/ /de dag myur du sangs rgyas 'grub/ / bochos kyi 'khor lo bla med pa'i / /byang chub rtogs par sla ba dang / /ji ltar gang gā'i 6)bye snyed kyi/ /bsod nams dpag tu med 'thob bo/ /rig sngags rgyas par sgrub 7pa'i le'u ste/cho ga gnyis pa'o// //de nas dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /sngon du sa yongs su brtags nas phyi nas las brtsam par bya'o/ /dri'i snod gtsang mar blugs pa'i tshon sna lnga'i phye 7mas dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi pa bri'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su tsandan gyis byugs te gur gum gyis mchod par bya'o/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi tshad ni khru gnyis pa'o/ /phyi'i dkyil 'khor ni grwa bzhi pa ra'i rang bzhin dang ldan pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi snying po'i dbus su rin po che sna bdun gyi gzhal med khang dang / sangs rgyas kyi padma'i gdan bkra zhing tshon sna bdun dang ldan par bya'o/ /padma'i snying po'i steng du gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong pa 87—893

mu khyud dang lte ba dang ldan pa kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng ba can te yu ba ni bee ḍūrya'o / /dkyil 'khor gyi snying po la kun nas kha khyer dang ldan par bya'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgor ni khru'i tshad tsam gyi gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /tshon sna lnga'i rgya nag 93gi gos zung gis brgyan par bya'o/ /g.yon du lag na rdo rje bsdigs pa'i gzugs can rnga yab dang mtshon cha thogs shing bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' nor bu rdo rje rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa g.yas pa na nor bu dang / rnga yab thogs nas bzhugs pa'o/ /zur bzhir rgyal po chen po bzhi bri bar bya ste/ go cha dang tshem tshem bgos shing lag na mtshon cha thogs pa/ rgyan thams cad dang / ral pa'i cod pan dang ldan pa drag po'i gzugs can bri bar bya'o/ /mtshams bzhir spos chus gang ba'i gser gyi snod bzhi gzhag napar bya'o/ /gal te gser gyi snod med na rdza'i bum pa tshad mi chung ba la gser g.yogs nas bya'o/ /de lta bu'i snod mi 'dzag par 'o mas gang bar byas nas phyogs bzhir gzhag ri dpar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas logs su lha mo dpal chen mo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /g.yon du lha mo chen mo dung can ma bzhugs pa bri'o/ /sgo'i dbus su lha mo chen mo rdo rje pho nya mo phyag brgyad pa lag na mtshon cha thogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing bzhugs pa bri'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi snying po'i (4)phyogs bzhir dar sngon po 'phyang ba dang /bcud sna tshogs dang / tshul sna tshogs gzhag 55par bya'o/ /bum pa gang ba bzhi dang / mar me sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / 'bras bu dang me tog sna tshogs rnams gzhag (65par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi ni gser las grub pa'i bum pa gzhag 7)go/ /so sor du ru ska bsreg (8)par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi 87—894

snying por dngul gyi rang bzhin gyi bum pa gzhag 6)go/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bdug spos so/ /nor bu 'dzin pa'i du ru ska (midang / tsandan dang / ma hā rā dzñā (gyidang / kun du ru dang / kā ka gobi dza dang / spos dkar gyi bdug pa'o/ /dpal lha mo'i tsandan no/ /dung can ma'i gu gul lo/ /pho nya mo'i sha la'i bdug spos te so sor bsreg par bya'o/ /gtor ma yang sbyin no/ /dkyil 'khor gyi snying po'i bya ba'o/ /phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor ni sgo bzhi rnam par 'byes shing cha mdzes pa bkra shis kyi sgo bzhi gnas pa bya'o/ /shar gyi sgor khyab 'jug 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /lhor dbang phyug chen po'o/ /nub tu me tog so zhes bya ba'i gnod sbyin mo'o/ /byang du 'jigs byed ma zhes bya ba'i lha mo ngo tsha dang bcas pa bya ste/ na chung bdun dang bcas pa'o/ /de nas phur bu sum cu so gnyis gdab par byas la kha dog lnga'i skud pas phur bu bcing ngo / /zur bzhi mnyam par kha dog lnga'i ba dan gyis brgyan (snyeno/ /me tog sna tshogs dgram pa dang /gtor ma dang / me tog sna tshogs rnams ma 'khrugs pa mnyam par bya'o/ /bcud sna tshogs 'phrog pa'i snod bdun gzhag zhidago/ /rdza'i snod sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ske/ phye ma'i snod sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / pog phor sum cu rtsa gnyis dang /mar me brgya rtsa brgyad gzhag (7)par bya'o/ /phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad dang / dri yis gang ba sna tshogs gzhag (8)par bya'o/ /bdug pa dang kun du ru sna tshogs sreg go/ /de nas sgo nas 'jug pa la dri yis gang ba'i bum pa gnyis bzhag (9ral/ji ltar rnyed pa'i gtor ma byin nas ji lta ba bzhin du gzhug pa'i cho ga la spyad la/de nas oṃ ma ṇi bi pu la pra tikhri ta sidhe a bhi ṣiñtsa ya yaṃ sarba 7ta thā ga 11ta a bhi ṣe sarbha ra bha ra saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ ji lta ba bzhin du sngags 'dis dbang bskur 87—895

na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbugs 'byin pa dang / thams cad 'grub pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa yang mngon du 'gyur ro/ /gang bsams pa'i don de de bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rtog pa'i rjes su 'jug go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos zab mo la bzod pa 'thob cing rjes su rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi snying por 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu la sogs pa yon tan gyi khyad par rnams 'thob ste/ji srid bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi lam ma rdzogs kyi bar du phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sgrub pa'i le'u ste/ cho ga gsum pa'o// //de nas phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid bshad par bya'o/ /snying po chen po bzhi'i phyag rgya la sbyar ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs spyi la sbyar ba dang / lag na rdo rje'i snying po bzhi'i phyag rgya btus pa rnams dang / dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi phyag rgya dang / phyag rgya gzhan yang brtsam par bya'o/ /'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi phyag rgya la sbyar ba'i cho ga dang / phyi rol gyi phyag rgya gzung ①bar bya'o / /thams cad du phyag rgya gzhan rnams ji ltar bde bar brjod do/ /sa②ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la sbyar ba ni/ oṃ sarba gta thā ga ta ṣṭṛ ④da ya ma ṇi dzwa la ni ā (2be shā (6)ya hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang phyag rgya'o⑦//oṃ sarba (8)ta thā ga ta pra 5)ba ra gra ma ni hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya 0bī saṃ bho dha yin badzra hūm̐ hūṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs dbyung ba'i phyag rgya'o8/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhiṣṭha tson 87—896

ma ṇi ①ma ṇi hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs ②kyi phyag rgya'o④/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra ba ra ma ṇi ru tsi ru tsi ④rgyu hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ⑤rdo rje ⑥seng ge'i khri'i phyag rgya'o⑦/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bi pu la saṃ bha be rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa/de bzhin gshegs pa'i dudabang bskur po)ba'i phyag rgya'o⑩/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya ma ṇi badzra rdzu hūm̐/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya'o⑨/ /oṃ sarba tunyeta thā ga ta dza tugeya a pa rā dzi 0ta badzra ju hūm̐/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i phyag rgya'o8/ /oṃ sarba ⑩ta thā ga ta dharma 0ṅgā tu ma hā ma ṇi shi kha re ha ra ha ra hūm̐ hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyag rgya'o8/ /oṃ sarba ⑩ta thā ga ta ma hā badzra ha sgo )ya ha ra ha hur hūṃ phaṭa/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rjes gzung ⑤ba'i phyag rgya'o 3/ /oṃ du ru du ru ma ṇi ma ṇi ma hā binu (nyeta ma ṇi swā hā/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i phyag rgya duste / 'phags pa nor bu'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o⑩/ /oṃ lo ka pā tshuli te dze so)ya dza ⑥ya rtsu hūm̐/ rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams kyi phyag rgya gzung zhu bar bya'o/ /oṃ bi pu la gra 0pa ti saṃ bha ra dus/ dpal lha mo'i phyag rgya gzung dubar bya'o/ /oṃ rdasnri ④ni saṃ tsū/ dung can ma'i bsdigs du)pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ ā tsog ma ya dzrī nunyer mutstsha da tā duhāste ni hūm̐/ pho nya mo'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya'o/ /oṃ sa manta nu)a ka ri ( )bi pū ra ṇi 0ta ka ta ka 0rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa/ dkyil 'khor na gnas pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya'os / /spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya gzung skyobar bya'o/ /oṃ sa ra sa ra bi sa ra hūm̐ hūm̐/padma'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya rgyas pa'i le'u ste cho ga bzhi pa'o// //de nas don kun sgrub pa'i sku gzugs kyi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ ras kha tshar (nyem bcad ⑩pa/ skra med pa/ khru gang ba'am/ khru do gru bzhi lham pa la ri 87—897

mo mkhan smyung ba byas pas snod sar par tshon 0)spyin med pas bcom ldan 'das rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ padma'i steng na chos 'chad cing bzhugs pa/khang pa brtsegs ②mas yongs su bskor ba bri bar bya'o/ /g.yas su lag na rdo rje lag pa bcu gnyis pa ston ku'i 'dam bu mda' rgyu lta bu'i mdog can/ lag pa ②na mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa/ gdong bzhi pa bya ste④/ gdong dang po ni zhi ba'o / /gnyis pa ni khro bo'o/ /gsum pa ni mche ba gtsigs pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni gdong khro gnyer can (5)gyen du lta 6)ba ste/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis bzhag ⑦pa/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ padma'i steng na skyil mo krung phyed ⑤kyis 'dug pa 6)bya'o / /g.yon phyogs su ni 7byang chub sems dpa' nor bu rdo rje zhes bya ba gdong bzhi pa lag pa bcu drug pa bya ste/ lag pa g.yas na (7yid bzhin gyi nor bu thogs nas de bzhin gshegs pa la dbul (gleb/ lag pa g.yon yin padma thogs pa/ lag pa gcig gis dbugs 'byin pa/ lag pa gnyis ni thal mo sbyar ba ④bya'o/ /lag pa gzhan ni mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa 8bya ste/ rtse gsum pa dang / 'khor lo dang / rdo rje dang / ral gri dang / me tog gi phur ma dang / bgrang phreng dang / ril ba spyi'u ablugs dang / ral gri dang /glegs bam dang / mchod rten dang / ri rab bo/ /gdong dang po ni zhi ba'o/ /gdong g.yas pa ni nag po chen po dang 'dra ba'o/ /gdong g.yon pa ni mi'i seng ge'i dbyibs/ shing pa ⑩la sha'i kha dog lta bu'o/ /gdong gong ma ni bzhin bsgyur tu ba padma'i stan nyirtel skyil mo krung 6 )phyed kyis 'dug pa ( 7bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu dung can ma bri ste/ lag pa brgyad pa pus mo btsugs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las la mngon par brtson pa so bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje'i 'og tu 87—898

dpal lha mo chen mo pus 6)mo btsugs nas nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyi snod bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa la dbul ba ②bya'o/ /dpal lha mo chen mo'i rgyab tu pho nya mo bzhin 'dzum pa lag pa bzhi pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa / mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa ①bya'o/ /dung can ma'i rgyab tu me tog so gos dkar po ④rgyan pa/ me tog thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la gyen du blta ba (gebya'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rin po che sna bdun gyi kha dog can gyi padma 'dab stim brgyad pa/ sdong bu ni bee ḍūrya7/ snying po ni gser las byas pa bya'o/ /de'i steng du 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi 'khor lo shin tu rnam par phye ⑧ba lte ba dang bcas pa/ kun nas 'bar ba/ shin tu rnam par bkra ba bri bar bya'o/ /padma de'i drung du rgyal po chen po bzhi ya lad dang / go cha dang tshem tshem bgos ponyepa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bri bar bya'o/ /padma de'i drung du rdzing bu rin po che sna tshogs kyis tsobargyan pa bya'o/ /rdzing (1de'i 'gram du rig pa 'dzin pa/ lag pa na pog phor dang yonye/ me tog gi mgo lcogs tu thogs la lag pa cig lngashos na bgrang phreng thogs te/ pus tsomo btsugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa la 8gyen du blta ba tunyebya'o/ /khang pa brtsegs tu ma'i gan hurtedu tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa nam mkha'i dkyil na bcom ldan 'das la me tog sna tshogs kyis so )mchod pa byed pa bya'o/ /de la sogs pa sku gzugs kyi cho ga rnams bya'o/ /de nas rig pa 'dzin pas 6)gos dkar po bgos te/ zas dkar gsum za bas tshes brgyad nas tshes bcwa so lnga nya'i bar du sku gzugs kyi mdun du bzlas brjod 'bum ( getshang bar bya'o/ /de nas sku gzugs 'gul zhing bdag nyid 'bar bar mthong bar 87—899

'gyur / sgrib pa med pa'i mig thob par 'gyur/ nor bu rnam dag spyod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur/ rig 'dzin thams cad kyi 'khor los sgyur 4)bar 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong bar 'gyur/bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyi mod la dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas las thar bar 'gyur/ 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug la sogs pa thams cad spangs par ②'gyur ro②/ /ser sna'i dri ma dang bral bar 'gyur/bsod nams thams cad dang ldan par 'gyur/ bde ba thams cad dang ldan par 'gyur/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yang dag par gzung ④bar 'gyur/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ⑤byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis dbugs 'byin par 'gyur/lha thams cad kyis yang dag par gzung (7bar 'gyur/ gnod sbyin dang /srin po dang / yi dgas ⑦dang / sha za dang / lha ma yin dang /⑧ nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa thams cad kyis kyang bsrung bar 'a༄'gyur/ rgyal po'i pho brang kyithams cad du mchod pa'i 'os su 'gyur/ 'jig rten thams cad la dbang bskur bar 'gyur / yon tan dang pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad yongs su gzung ⑩bar 'gyur / de la sogs pa yon tan gyi khyad par thob par 'gyur/ mthong ba tsam mamatso / bzlas brjod byas pa (3tsam mamacha/ bklags 8pa tsam gyis yon tan dang / phan yon 'di dag yongs su gzung ⑩bar 'gyur na cho ga ⑩lhag par mang du byed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ gang zhig klog par byed pa dang /'don par byed pa dang / bzlas brjod la mngon par brtson par byed pa dang /87—900
